programme.title: Pippi Langstrumpf
programme.desc: Pippi Longstocking is a cheeky nine-year-old girl with freckles, two sticky red braids and different colored stockings. She lives without parents, but with a horse and a monkey in a large, colorful villa. She doesn't let anyone dictate anything to her, she is brave, generous and so strong that she can even lift her horse. Together with her friends Tommy and Annika she experiences the craziest adventures. / Pippi Langstrumpf ist ein freches neunjahriges Madchen mit Sommersprossen, zwei abstehenden roten Zopfen und unterschiedlich gefarbten Strumpfen. Sie lebt ohne Eltern, aber mit einem Pferd und einem Affen in einer groSSen bunten Villa. Sie lasst sich von niemandem etwas vorschreiben, ist mutig, groSSzugig und so stark, dass sie sogar ihr Pferd hochstemmen kann. Zusammen mit ihren Freunden Tommy und Annika erlebt sie die verrucktesten Abenteuer.

programme.title: The hunt for the Kju Wang / Die Jagd nach dem Kju Wang
programme.desc: The city of Venice, inhabited by birds, is ruled by a powerful duke. This duke owns a valuable gemstone, the Kju-Wang, which symbolizes his power. The ambassador of a foreign country wants to steal the Kju-Wang. / Die Stadt Venedig, die von Vogeln bewohnt wird, wird von einem machtigen Herzog regiert. Dieser Herzog besitzt einen wertvollen Edelstein den Kju-Wang, der seine Macht symbolisiert. Der Botschafter eines fremden Landes will den Kju-Wang stehlen.

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to run a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police force. From now on he investigates here with Inspector Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.desc: Die engagierte Sonderkommission der Wiener Wasserschutzpolizei klart im GroSSraum der osterreichischen Hauptstadt Verbrechen auf. Der Fokus des Kriminalistenteams liegt dabei auf Straftaten, die an und auf der Donau sowie ihren Nebenflussen geschehen.

programme.title: SOKO Kitzbuhel
programme.desc: Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Dabei werden die Ermittler von Karins Vater Hannes unterstutzt, der das legendare Gasthaus "Pochlarner Stuben" betreibt, und mit ahnlichem kriminalistischen Spursinn gesegnet ist wie seine Tochter. Und schlieSSlich ist da noch Grafin Schonberg, die sich mit ihren Kontakten zum Kitzbuheler Jetset immer wieder als wertvolle Hilfe fur die Beamten erweist.

programme.title: Rickerl - Music is at most a hobby / Rickerl - Musik is hochstens a Hobby
programme.desc: The idealist Erich "Rickerl" Bohacek keeps himself afloat as a street musician in Vienna. He dreams of making a big breakthrough with his melancholic, humorous songs. He wants to be a role model for his little son Dominik, who is with him every other weekend and absolutely loves his chaotic part-time dad. Between his role as a father and his passion for music, Rickerl tries to find his very own sound in life. / Der Idealist Erich "Rickerl" Bohacek halt sich als StraSSenmusiker in Wien eher schlecht als recht uber Wasser. Dabei traumt er davon, mit seinen melancholisch-humorvollen Liedern den groSSen Durchbruch zu schaffen. Er will ein Vorbild fur seinen kleinen Sohn Dominik sein, der jedes zweite Wochenende bei ihm ist und seinen chaotischen Teilzeit-Papa abgottisch liebt. Zwischen seiner Vaterrolle und seiner Musikleidenschaft versucht Rickerl, seinen ganz eigenen Sound im Leben zu finden.

programme.title: The Sinner
programme.desc: Detective Harry Ambrose returns to his hometown on the outskirts of New York to solve a disturbing and heartbreaking crime: an 11-year-old boy is said to have murdered his parents with no apparent motive. Ambrose quickly realizes that this is no ordinary child. His investigation took him deep into the hidden darkness of his hometown. There are people there who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets. This also includes the mysterious Vera. / Detective Harry Ambrose kehrt in seine Heimatstadt am Rande von New York zuruck, um ein beunruhigendes und zugleich herzzerreiSSendes Verbrechen aufzuklaren: Ein 11-jahriger Junge soll ohne ersichtliches Motiv seine Eltern ermordet haben. Ambrose erkennt schnell, dass es sich nicht um ein gewohnliches Kind handelt. Seine Ermittlungen fuhren ihn tief in die verborgene Dunkelheit seiner Heimatstadt. Dort gibt es Menschen, die vor nichts zuruckschrecken, um ihre Geheimnisse zu schutzen. Dazu gehort auch die mysteriose Vera.

programme.title: Shameless
programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives as a single father with his six children. However, he spends most of his time in the bar and prefers to spend the little money the family has on alcohol instead of food. His eldest daughter Fiona is forced to take on the role of mother to her siblings: the intelligent but petty criminal Lip, Ian, who hides his homosexuality, the responsible but fragile Debbie, the violent 10-year-old Carl and little Liam. Together, the children try to master their lives in a creative, scandalless, but also warm-hearted way, despite their impossible father. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Gemeinsam versuchen die Kinder, trotz ihres unmoglichen Vaters ihr Leben auf kreative, skandalose, aber auch warmherzige Weise zu meistern.

programme.title: Days that didn't exist / Tage, die es nicht gab
programme.desc: Miriam, Doris, Inès and Christiane have been friends since their school days, but now have to face the secrets of the past. programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Biznis klub
programme.desc: With a new concept, the business club will bring the economy closer to you and provide you with relevant current events in the field of economy and business, monitor economic developments and trends at the global level and investigate their impact on the growth and development of the economy in Srpska. We will reveal to you successful entrepreneurs and their experiences in business, and affirm those who are just at the beginning of developing their business ideas. Along with regular reports from stock exchanges and the gold market, one of the priorities will be reports from regional economic forums, where we will seek answers to key questions from eminent experts. / Biznis klub novim konceptom približiće vam ekonomiju i pružiti vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti ekonomije i privrede, ispratiti ekonomska kretanja i trendove na globalnom nivou i istražiti njihov uticaj na rast i razvoj ekonomije u Srpskoj. Otkrićemo vam uspješne preduzetnike i njihova iskustva u poslovanju, te afirmisati one koji tek na početku razvoja svojih poslovnih ideja. Uz redovne izvještaje sa berzi i tržišta zlata, jedan od prioriteta biće i izvještaji sa regionalnih ekonomskih foruma, gdje ćemo od eminentnih stručnjaka potražiti odgovore na ključna pitanja.

programme.title: Sisi
programme.desc: The Extraordinary Life of Elizabeth of Bavaria, better known as Sisi, tells the story of an extraordinary woman who became Europe's first superstar. The series follows her teenage days, her love story with Emperor Franz Joseph I, and life's ups and downs, revealing her greatest joys, but also the pain and suffering she went through. / Izuzetni život Elizabete od Bavarske, poznatije kao Sisi, prikazuje priču izvanredne žene koja je postala prva evropska superzvijezda. Serija prati njene tinejdžerske dane, ljubavnu priču s carem Franjom Josipom I, te životne uspone i padove, otkrivajući i njene najveće radosti, ali i bol i patnju kroz koje je prolazila.

programme.title: ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most watched show of Alternative Television _ Central News exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news provides an overview of events in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on current topics of the day. Journalists of the ATV newsroom research, discover and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city current affairs, sports and weather. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

Onima koji žele da nauče nešto novo i korisno, žele da unaprijede proizvodnju i povećaju prinose.

The first daily information, the first morning reports from the field throughout Republika Srpska, interesting contributions from the world of politics, culture and sports, dedicated to people and interesting events. / Jutarnji program Alternativne televizije "ATV jutro" specifičan je spoj informative i zabave. Prve dnevne informacije, prvi jutarnji raporti sa terena širom Republike Srpske, zanimljivi prilozi iz svijeta politike, kulture i sporta, posvećeni ljudima i zanimljivim dešavanjima.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: Autoshop magazin
programme.desc: Specijalizovana i sponzorisana emisija posvećena svijetu automobilske industrije. Najvažinije informacije, noviteti, recenzije u polusatnom izdanju idealne su za ljubitelje četvorotočkaša.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.desc: The Extraordinary Life of Elizabeth of Bavaria, better known as Sisi, tells the story of an extraordinary woman who became Europe's first superstar. The series follows her teenage days, her love story with Emperor Franz Joseph I, and life's ups and downs, revealing her greatest joys, but also the pain and suffering she went through. / Izuzetni život Elizabete od Bavarske, poznatije kao Sisi, prikazuje priču izvanredne žene koja je postala prva evropska superzvijezda. Serija prati njene tinejdžerske dane, ljubavnu priču s carem Franjom Josipom I, te životne uspone i padove, otkrivajući i njene najveće radosti, ali i bol i patnju kroz koje je prolazila.

programme.title: Bistra voda
programme.desc: The story of two once close friends, Aleksandar and Arsen, who unexpectedly meet in Skopje after 45 years. Years of betrayal and separation have left deep traces, and the meeting awakens memories, emotions and hope for reconciliation. / Priča o dva nekada bliska prijatelja, Aleksandru i Arsenu, koji se nakon 45 godina neočekivano sreću u Skoplju. Godine izdaje i razdvojenosti ostavile su duboke tragove, a susret budi sjećanja, emocije i nadu za pomirenje.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: Unutrašnji rat
programme.desc: The story follows Esben, who escapes from the battlefield of the First World War, after three years at the front, and how he could return to his wife Kirstina and son Karl. However, nothing is the same there anymore _ a charming German officer, Gerhard, has won Kirstin's heart and replaced Esben's role as a father. He witnesses a horrific nightmare as he watches his family slowly disappear in front of him as he desperately tries to save them. / Priča prati, Еsbena, koji bježi sa ratišta Prvog svjetskog rata, nakon tri godine na frontu, a kako bi se mogao vratiti ženi Kirstini i sinu Karlu. Međutim, tamo više ništa nije isto _ šarmantni njemački oficir, Gerhard, osvojio je Kirstinino srce i zamijenio Еsbenovu ulogu oca. On postaje svjedok užasne noćne more gledajući kako njegova porodica polako nestaje ispred njega, dok on očajnički pokušava da je spase.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: The nation bears witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-reportage show by journalist Biljana Stokić, will reveal to you what the heart of the people says about Srpska, about the tradition and history of our towns and villages, about their everyday life and the struggle to preserve true values, hard work, faith, and love for their and our homeland. In a mix of honest stories of those who live from their work, through the discovery of landmarks and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with words of hope and inspiration, and with images that melt the heart, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokić, with many years of journalistic experience, will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are its problems and challenges? Where does he find the strength to work and nurture traditions and good interpersonal relationships? How does our birth lump breathe and does it have equal beauty? What do they remember? What are they amazed by? What do they return to? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell their story, those for whom we do not know how much love, perseverance, courage they carry, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt both suffering and the beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Krvavo cvijeće
programme.desc: The story of Dilan and Baran, two young people who are forced to enter the port of marriage. Despite numerous conflicts, their unwanted marriage gives birth to a strong love. / Priča o Dilan i Baranu, dvoje mladih ljudi koji su prisiljeni uploviti u bračnu luku. Unatoč brojnim sukobima, njihov neželjeni brak iznjedriće snažnu ljubav.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Wild bees / Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Three sisters were left alone after the death of their father. Without the support of a man, they will have to stand up to the opposite and dominant sex and show that they are capable of running their own estate. / Tri sestre ostale su same nakon smrti oca. programme.title: Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: Ćirilica
programme.desc: Popular television show by author and host Milomir Marić every Monday on ATV _ u! You will have the opportunity to watch everything that is not published even by scandalous tabloids. "Cirilica" brings the hidden background of events that are talked about the most and least known about! Milomir Marić brings together the incompatible, at the border where political propaganda and false promises stop, and reality begins. Politicians speak like ordinary people, without censorship and political platitudes. / Popularna televizijska emisija autora i voditelja Milomira Marića svakog ponedjeljka na ATV _ u! Imaćete priliku gledati sve ono što ne objavljuju čak ni skandalozni tabloidi. "Ćirilica" donosi skrivenu pozadinu događaja o kojima se najviše priča, a najmanje zna! Milomir Marić spaja nespojivo, na granici gdje prestaju politička propaganda i lažna obećanja, a počinje stvarnost. Političari govore kao obični ljudi, bez cenzure i političkih floskula.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: Agrar
programme.desc: The show is dedicated to farmers, but also to those who live in urban areas, have gardens, orchards, greenhouses. To those who want to learn something new and useful, they want to improve production and increase yields. / Emisija je posvećena poljoprivrednicima, ali i onima koji žive u urbanim sredinama, imaju baštu, vrt, voćnjak, plastenik. Onima koji žele da nauče nešto novo i korisno, žele da unaprijede proizvodnju i povećaju prinose.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Wild bees / Divlje pčele

programme.desc: With the help of top geologists and various scientists, "How the Earth Was Made" is a documentary series that explores the powerful forces and events that shaped our planet. Through stunning, computer-generated cinematography, viewers go back billions of years to learn how the Earth was formed and the drastic changes it went through. / Uz pomoć vrhunskih geologa i različitih naučnika, "Kako je Zemlja nastala" je dokumentarna serija koja istražuje moćne sile i događaje koji su oblikovali naš planet. Kroz zadivljujuću, kompjuterski generisanu kinematografiju, gledatelji se vraćaju milijardama godina unazad kako bi saznali kako je Zemlja nastala i kroz koje je drastične promjene prolazila.

programme.title: Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: Biznis klub
programme.desc: With a new concept, the business club will bring the economy closer to you and provide you with relevant current events in the field of economy and business, monitor economic developments and trends at the global level and investigate their impact on the growth and development of the economy in Srpska. We will reveal to you successful entrepreneurs and their experiences in business, and affirm those who are just at the beginning of developing their business ideas. Along with regular reports from stock exchanges and the gold market, one of the priorities will be reports from regional economic forums, where we will seek answers to key questions from eminent experts. / Biznis klub novim konceptom približiće vam ekonomiju i pružiti vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti ekonomije i privrede, ispratiti ekonomska kretanja i trendove na globalnom nivou i istražiti njihov uticaj na rast i razvoj ekonomije u Srpskoj. Otkrićemo vam uspješne preduzetnike i njihova iskustva u poslovanju, te afirmisati one koji tek na početku razvoja svojih poslovnih ideja. Uz redovne izvještaje sa berzi i tržišta zlata, jedan od prioriteta biće i izvještaji sa regionalnih ekonomskih foruma, gdje ćemo od eminentnih stručnjaka potražiti odgovore na ključna pitanja.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: MMA UFC 264
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Boks
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need any more reason to follow this noble martial art? We find the first traces of boxing already in the third century BC on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxing were established in the 18th century in London and define the fighting area, equipment and illegal and allowed types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Studio UFC: 321
programme.desc: Watch a studio show dedicated to current fights organized by the UFC. This association was founded in 1993 in Las Vegas. / Pogledajte studijsku emisiju koja je posvećena aktuelnim borbama koje organizuje UFC. Ovo udruženje je osnovano 1993. godine u Las Vegasu.

programme.title: MMA UFC 31
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: WRESTLING World Championship U23 Novi Sad Day 8 / RVANJE Svetsko Prvenstvo U23 Novi Sad Dan 8
programme.desc: The World Wrestling Championship is an international competition organized by the International Wrestling Federation FILA. Since its establishment in 1904, the world championships in Greco-Roman style wrestling have been held, to which the men's freestyle competition was added in 1951, and in the women's category in 1987. The championships are held every year, except for the years when the Summer Olympic Games are held. / Svetsko prvenstvo u rvanju je međunarodno takmičenje koje organizuje međunarodna rvačka federacija FILA. Od svog osnivanja 1904. godine održavaju se svetska prvenstva u rvanju grčko-rimskim stilom, kojem je 1951. dodato i takmičenje slobodnim stilom u muškoj, a 1987. i u ženskoj kategoriji. Prvenstva se održavaju svake godine, osim u godinama kada se održavaju Letnje olimpijske igre.

programme.title: MMA UFC 321
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Kik-boks
programme.desc: Kickboxing is practiced as a form of self-defense, regular maintenance of body shape or as a martial sport. Kickboxing as a modern martial sport that includes several sports disciplines, These are Semi contact (Semi contact), "Light contact", "Full contact", Low kick, Thai kickboxing, musical forms and Aero kickboxing. The beginnings of this martial art date back to the 60s of the 20th century in Japan, while kickboxing became popular in Europe and North America ten years later. Maximum protective equipment is used, which consists of a helmet, mouth guard, chest guard (women), genital guard, gloves, shin guards and slippers. / Kikboks se praktikuje kao vrsta samoobrane, redovno održavanje telesne forme ili kao borilački sport. Kikboks kao moderan borilački sport koji obuhvata više sportskih disciplina, To su Semi kontakt (Polu kontakt), "Light contact" (Lagani kontakt), "Full contact" (Puni kontakt), Lou kik, Taj kikboks, muzičke forme i Aero kikboks. Početci ove borilačke veštine datiraju još iz 60ih godina 20. veka u Japanu, dok se u Evropi i Severnoj Americi kikboks popularizovao deset godina kasnije. Koristi se maksimalna zaštitna oprema koja se sastoji od kacige, štitnika za zube, štitnika za prsa (žene), štitnika za genitalije, rukavica, štitnika za potkolenice te papuča.

programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league / Košarka - NBA liga
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA league, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna mjeseca davne 1946. godine zauvijek će promjeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svjetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namijenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podijeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gdje u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Football - Polish League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league in Poland. The first Polish football league was founded in 1927, and the league is organized by the Polish Football Association (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league, and the winner directly wins the title of Polish champion. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu osnovana je 1927. godine, a tu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno u ligi sudjeluje 16 ekipa, a pobjednik direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona.

Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play the "World Series Finals". The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football - BiH Cup / Fudbal - Kup BiH
programme.desc: The Football Cup of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the most popular football competition in the country and has been held since the 2000/2001 season. The first winner of the cup was Željezničar from Sarajevo, who defeated Sarajevo 3-2 in the final. Željezničar is also the club with the most trophies with four trophies won, while Sarajevo and Široki Brijeg are closely followed with three cups won each. The competition system is such that until the quarter-finals, one elimination match is played, while two matches are played in the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. / Fudbalski kup Bosne i Hercegovine je najmasovnije fudbalsko takmičenje u državi i održava se od sezone 2000./2001. Prvi osvajač kupa bio je Željezničar iz Sarajeva koji je u finalu svladao Sarajevo 3-2. Željezničar je ujedno i najtrofejniji klub sa četiri osvojene tutule dok ga u stope prate Sarajevo i Široki Brijeg sa po tri osvojena kupa. Sistem takmičenja je takav da se do četvrtfinala odigrava po jedan meč na ispadanje dok se u četvrtfinalu, polufinalu i finalu igraju dva susreta.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The English League Cup, unlike its more popular "brother" the FA Cup, begins its history in the 60s of the 20th century, thus using the possibility of playing under floodlights in the evening hours, which was not possible before. All matches are played in midweek with the only final being played over one leg on a neutral ground at Wembley Stadium in London. The interesting thing about this competition is that the final is already played in February or March, and the winner secures a place in the UEFA Europa League if he has not already secured a place in the Premiership. The first winners of the competition were Aston Villa footballers in 1961. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football - BiH Cup / Fudbal - Kup BiH
programme.desc: The Football Cup of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the most popular football competition in the country and has been held since the 2000/2001 season. The first winner of the cup was Željezničar from Sarajevo, who defeated Sarajevo 3-2 in the final. Željezničar is also the club with the most trophies with four trophies won, while Sarajevo and Široki Brijeg are closely followed with three cups won each. The competition system is such that until the quarter-finals, one elimination match is played, while two matches are played in the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. / Fudbalski kup Bosne i Hercegovine je najmasovnije fudbalsko takmičenje u državi i održava se od sezone 2000./2001. Prvi osvajač kupa bio je Željezničar iz Sarajeva koji je u finalu svladao Sarajevo 3-2. Željezničar je ujedno i najtrofejniji klub sa četiri osvojene tutule dok ga u stope prate Sarajevo i Široki Brijeg sa po tri osvojena kupa. Sistem takmičenja je takav da se do četvrtfinala odigrava po jedan meč na ispadanje dok se u četvrtfinalu, polufinalu i finalu igraju dva susreta.

programme.title: Football - Cup of Serbia / Fudbal - Kup Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Cup is the second most important and powerful football competition in Serbia, which has been played under that name since 2006. During Yugoslavia, Serbian clubs played cup competition with other republics of the former state, while from 1991 to 2006, Serbian and Montenegrin clubs played. After the end of the existence of the state of Serbia and Montenegro, the Cup of Serbia was created. At one time, this competition was named after the sponsor, and the final is played based on one game won. The host city and the stadium of the final are known in advance. / Kup Srbije je drugo po važnosti i snazi fudbalsko takmičenje u Srbiji koje se igra pod tim imenom od 2006. godine. Za vrijeme Jugoslavije srpski klubovi su igrali kupsko takmičenje sa ostalim republikama bivše države dok od 1991. do 2006. igrali su srpski i crnogorski klubovi. Nakon prestanka postojanja države Srbije i Crne Gore nastao je Kup Srbije. Ovo takmičenje je jedno vrijeme imalo naziv po sponzoru, a finale se igra na jednu dobijenu utakmicu. Grad domaćin i stadion finala su unaprijed poznati.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league / Košarka - NBA liga
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA league, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna mjeseca davne 1946. godine zauvijek će promjeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svjetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namijenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podijeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gdje u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Baseball - MLB / Bejzbol - MLB
programme.desc: MLB or "Major League Baseball" is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the "World Series". The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play the "World Series Finals". The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili "Major League Baseball" je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem "World Seriesa". Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju "World Series finale". Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league gets a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the League for Champions and the League for Relegation. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Željezničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - BiH Cup / Fudbal - Kup BiH
programme.desc: The Football Cup of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the most popular football competition in the country and has been held since the 2000/2001 season. The first winner of the cup was Željezničar from Sarajevo, who defeated Sarajevo 3-2 in the final. Željezničar is also the club with the most trophies with four trophies won, while Sarajevo and Široki Brijeg are closely followed with three cups won each. The competition system is such that until the quarter-finals, one elimination match is played, while two matches are played in the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. / Fudbalski kup Bosne i Hercegovine je najmasovnije fudbalsko takmičenje u državi i održava se od sezone 2000./2001. Prvi osvajač kupa bio je Željezničar iz Sarajeva koji je u finalu svladao Sarajevo 3-2. Željezničar je ujedno i najtrofejniji klub sa četiri osvojene tutule dok ga u stope prate Sarajevo i Široki Brijeg sa po tri osvojena kupa. Sistem takmičenja je takav da se do četvrtfinala odigrava po jedan meč na ispadanje dok se u četvrtfinalu, polufinalu i finalu igraju dva susreta.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The English League Cup, unlike its more popular "brother" the FA Cup, begins its history in the 60s of the 20th century, thus using the possibility of playing under floodlights in the evening hours, which was not possible before. All matches are played in midweek with the only final being played over one leg on a neutral ground at Wembley Stadium in London. The interesting thing about this competition is that the final is already played in February or March, and the winner secures a place in the UEFA Europa League if he has not already secured a place in the Premiership. The first winners of the competition were Aston Villa footballers in 1961. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: NBA Action
programme.desc: NBA Action

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league / Košarka - NBA liga
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA league, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna mjeseca davne 1946. godine zauvijek će promjeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svjetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namijenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podijeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gdje u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Football - Cup of Serbia / Fudbal - Kup Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Cup is the second most important and powerful football competition in Serbia, which has been played under that name since 2006. During Yugoslavia, Serbian clubs played cup competition with other republics of the former state, while from 1991 to 2006, Serbian and Montenegrin clubs played. After the end of the existence of the state of Serbia and Montenegro, the Cup of Serbia was created. At one time, this competition was named after the sponsor, and the final is played based on one game won. The host city and the stadium of the final are known in advance. / Kup Srbije je drugo po važnosti i snazi fudbalsko takmičenje u Srbiji koje se igra pod tim imenom od 2006. godine. Za vrijeme Jugoslavije srpski klubovi su igrali kupsko takmičenje sa ostalim republikama bivše države dok od 1991. do 2006. igrali su srpski i crnogorski klubovi. Nakon prestanka postojanja države Srbije i Crne Gore nastao je Kup Srbije. Ovo takmičenje je jedno vrijeme imalo naziv po sponzoru, a finale se igra na jednu dobijenu utakmicu. Grad domaćin i stadion finala su unaprijed poznati.

programme.title: Football - BiH Cup / Fudbal - Kup BiH
programme.desc: The Football Cup of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the most popular football competition in the country and has been held since the 2000/2001 season. The first winner of the cup was Željezničar from Sarajevo, who defeated Sarajevo 3-2 in the final. Željezničar is also the club with the most trophies with four trophies won, while Sarajevo and Široki Brijeg are closely followed with three cups won each. The competition system is such that until the quarter-finals, one elimination match is played, while two matches are played in the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. / Fudbalski kup Bosne i Hercegovine je najmasovnije fudbalsko takmičenje u državi i održava se od sezone 2000./2001. Prvi osvajač kupa bio je Željezničar iz Sarajeva koji je u finalu svladao Sarajevo 3-2. Željezničar je ujedno i najtrofejniji klub sa četiri osvojene tutule dok ga u stope prate Sarajevo i Široki Brijeg sa po tri osvojena kupa. Sistem takmičenja je takav da se do četvrtfinala odigrava po jedan meč na ispadanje dok se u četvrtfinalu, polufinalu i finalu igraju dva susreta.

programme.desc: NBA Action

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league / Košarka - NBA liga
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA league, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna mjeseca davne 1946. godine zauvijek će promjeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svjetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namijenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podijeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gdje u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.
