programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Njemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name "Tschammer-Pokal". 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the table of the third league. The rest of the participants come from the winners of the regional cups. The matches are played according to the single cup system, in which after the regular 90 minutes extra time is played and then penalty kicks if the winner is not decided by then. The final has been played every year since 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The winner of the cup secures a place in the UEFA Europa League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: Football - Cup of Serbia / Fudbal - Kup Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Cup is the second most important and powerful football competition in Serbia, which has been played under that name since 2006. During Yugoslavia, Serbian clubs played cup competition with other republics of the former state, while from 1991 to 2006, Serbian and Montenegrin clubs played. After the end of the existence of the state of Serbia and Montenegro, the Cup of Serbia was created. At one time, this competition was named after the sponsor, and the final is played based on one game won. The host city and the stadium of the final are known in advance. / Kup Srbije je drugo po važnosti i snazi fudbalsko takmičenje u Srbiji koje se igra pod tim imenom od 2006. godine. Za vrijeme Jugoslavije srpski klubovi su igrali kupsko takmičenje sa ostalim republikama bivše države dok od 1991. do 2006. igrali su srpski i crnogorski klubovi. Nakon prestanka postojanja države Srbije i Crne Gore nastao je Kup Srbije. Ovo takmičenje je jedno vrijeme imalo naziv po sponzoru, a finale se igra na jednu dobijenu utakmicu. Grad domaćin i stadion finala su unaprijed poznati.

programme.desc: Arena Sport 1x2 follows excitement and changes in results on all fields around the planet. An unusual channel in this area, modeled on similar ones in England, France and Germany. Special graphics, state of the tables, current form... Special daily shows, analyses, famous guests. There are of course direct broadcasts, multicasts of matches that start at the same time, attractive replays... If you are interested in the latest results _ Arena Sport 1x2 is the right place for you. / Arena Sport 1x2 prati uzbuđenja i promene rezultata na svim terenima širom planete. Pored direktnih prenosa, ovaj kanal je pravo mesto na kome prvi možete da saznate kada lopta uđe u mrežu ili prođe kroz mrežicu. Nesvakidašnji kanal na ovim prostorima, po uzoru na slične u Engleskoj, Francuskoj i Nemačkoj. Posebna grafika, stanje na tabelama, trenutna forma… Specijalne dnevne emisije, analize, poznati gosti. Tu su naravno direktni prenosi, multiprenosi utakmica koje počinju u isto vreme, atraktivne reprize… Ukoliko vas zanimaju najnoviji rezultati _ Arena Sport 1x2 je pravo mesto za vas.

programme.title: Football - English league / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams start the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Carabao Cup / Fudbal - Carabao Cup
programme.desc: The English League Cup, unlike its more popular "brother" the FA Cup, begins its history in the 60s of the 20th century, thus using the possibility of playing under floodlights in the evening hours, which was not possible before. All matches are played in midweek with the only final being played over one leg on a neutral ground at Wembley Stadium in London. The interesting thing about this competition is that the final is already played in February or March, and the winner secures a place in the UEFA Europa League if he has not already secured a place in the Premiership. The first winners of the competition were Aston Villa footballers in 1961. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football - German Cup / Fudbal - Kup Nemačke
programme.desc: The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name "Tschammer-Pokal". 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the table of the third league. The rest of the participants come from the winners of the regional cups. The matches are played according to the single cup system, in which after the regular 90 minutes extra time is played and then penalty kicks if the winner is not decided by then. The final has been played every year since 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The winner of the cup secures a place in the UEFA Europa League. / Sami početak Nemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom "Tschammer-Pokal". U ovom takmičenju sudeluje 64 ekipe uključujući sve klubove iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri ekipe na tabeli treće lige. Ostatak učesnika dolazi od strane pobednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukom kup sistemu u kojem se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toga jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Evropa Ligu.

programme.title: Alpine skiing - FIS World Cup in Zelden (Women) / Alpsko skijanje - FIS svetski kup u Zeldenu (Ž)
programme.desc: The competition season in Zelden starts already at the beginning of October, when the world's best female skiers gather at the top of the Rettenbach Glacier. This is one of the most prestigious competitions in the discipline of alpine skiing, which is held every year in the organization of the FIS. / Sezona takmičenja u Zeldenu počinje već početkom oktobra kada se najbolje svetske skijašice okupljaju na vrhu glečera Retenbah. Ovo je jedna od najprestižnijih takmičenja u disciplini alpskog skijanja koje se svake godine održava u organizaciji FIS-a.

programme.title: Biciklizam - Strade Bianche (M)
programme.desc: The first "Strade Bianche" race was held in 2007, and at that time only men had the right to participate. Since 2015, the "Strade Bianche Donna" has also been held, i.e. a race intended for women. The races start on the same day, traditionally on the first or second Saturday in March. The name translated from Italian means "white roads" and refers to the macadam parts of the route. / Prva "Strade Bianche" trka održana je 2007. godine i tada su pravo učešća imali samo muškarci. Od 2015. godine održava se i "Strade Bianche Donna", odnosno trka predviđena za žene. Trke startuju istog dana, a tradicionalno je to prve ili druge subote u martu. programme.title: Biciklizam - Strade Bianche (M)
programme.desc: The first "Strade Bianche" race was held in 2007, and at that time only men had the right to participate. Since 2015, the "Strade Bianche Donna" has also been held, i.e. a race intended for women. The races start on the same day, traditionally on the first or second Saturday in March. The name translated from Italian means "white roads" and refers to the macadam parts of the route. / Prva "Strade Bianche" trka održana je 2007. godine i tada su pravo učešća imali samo muškarci. Od 2015. godine održava se i "Strade Bianche Donna", odnosno trka predviđena za žene. Trke startuju istog dana, a tradicionalno je to prve ili druge subote u martu. Naziv u prevodu sa italijanskog znači "beli putevi" a odnosi se na makadamske delove rute.

programme.title: Biciklizam - Strade Bianche (M)
programme.desc: The first "Strade Bianche" race was held in 2007, and at that time only men had the right to participate. Since 2015, the "Strade Bianche Donna" has also been held, i.e. a race intended for women. The races start on the same day, traditionally on the first or second Saturday in March. The name translated from Italian means "white roads" and refers to the macadam parts of the route. / Prva "Strade Bianche" trka održana je 2007. godine i tada su pravo učešća imali samo muškarci. Od 2015. godine održava se i "Strade Bianche Donna", odnosno trka predviđena za žene. Trke startuju istog dana, a tradicionalno je to prve ili druge subote u martu. Naziv u prevodu sa italijanskog znači "beli putevi" a odnosi se na makadamske delove rute.

programme.desc: A one-day classic cycling race that takes place in the north of France towards the border with Belgium, in mid-April. programme.title: Profesorica glazbe
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about a creative music teacher whose program is canceled, but her students help her. Alyson Daley is disappointed that her music class at school has been cut. She created and designed that program a number of years earlier and during that time she helped many gifted students to develop in singing and dancing, and their skills were shown every year in the big final program. When her former students found out about the school's decision, they decided to stage a musical themselves and raise money to continue the program... / Romantična komedija o kreativnoj profesorici glazbe čiji je program ukinut, ali joj pomažu učenici. Alyson Daley je razočarana jer je njezin glazbeni predmet u školi ukinut. Ona je taj program kreirala i osmislila niz godina ranije i za to je vrijeme pomogla mnogim darovitim učenicima da se razvijaju u pjevanju i plesanju, a njihovo je umijeće svake godine prikazano u velikom završnom programu. Kad su njezini bivši učenici doznali za odluku škole, odlučili su na scenu sami postaviti mjuzikl i prikupiti novac za nastavak programa...

programme.title: Prizma - multinacionalni magazin
programme.desc: We talk about the convoy of young Bosniaks and their friends to Srebrenica and Potočare, we discover what the teachers of the Slavic language and culture teach, who performed at the Theater Evenings of National Minorities in Zagreb, and how the small but valuable editorial office of the Ruthenian Association works, which prepares magazines and books in the Ruthenian language. / Govorimo o konvoju mladih Bošnjaka i njihovih prijatelja u Srebrenicu i Potočare, otkrivamo što uče učitelji slovenskog jezika i kulture, tko je nastupio na Kazališnim večerima nacionalnih manjina u Zagrebu, te kako radi mala, ali vrijedna redakcija Saveza Rusina, koja priprema časopise i knjige na rusinskom jeziku.

programme.title: Zajedno u duhu
programme.desc: The weekly show follows the life and activities of religious communities with an emphasis on topics related to ecumenism and interreligious dialogue, with a guest in the studio. / Tjedna emisija prati život i djelovanje vjerskih zajednica s naglaskom na teme vezane za ekumenizam i međureligijski dijalog, uz gosta u studiju.

programme.title: Veterani mira
programme.desc: The weekly show, in studio conversations and reports, illuminates and tries to solve the problems faced by veterans and sensitize the public. / Tjedna emisija, u razgovoru u studiju i reportažama rasvjetljava i nastoji riješiti probleme s kojima se susreću branitelji te senzibilizirati javnost.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Zovite babicu
programme.desc: Christmas is approaching, and the midwives in Poplar have more work than ever. An abandoned baby is found on the steps of Nonnatus House, and the whole community joins together in an effort to find the mother and collect the necessary help. At that time, Jenny Lee is handling a special heartbreaking case _ taking care of the old and wandering Mrs. Jenkins. Newly married Chummy is devotedly trying to organize a children's Christmas play and make it unforgettable. As they try to find out who abandoned the child and why, Jenny helps Mrs. Jenkins face her own past and discover the fate of the children who were taken from her long ago when she was sent to the poorhouse. / Božić se bliži, a primalje u Poplaru imaju više posla nego ikad. Na stubama Nonnatus Housea pronađena je napuštena beba, a cijela se zajednica udružuje u nastojanju da pronađe majku i prikupi potrebnu pomoć. Jenny Lee u to vrijeme vodi poseban slučaj koji slama srce _ brine se o starici i lutalici gospođi Jenkins. Svježe udana Chummy predano se trudi organizirati dječju božićnu predstavu i učiniti je nezaboravnom. Dok pokušavaju doznati tko je dijete ostavio i zašto, Jenny pomaže gospođi Jenkins da se suoči s vlastitom prošlošću i otkrije sudbinu djece koja su joj davno oduzeta kada je bila poslana u ubožnicu.

programme.title: All that heaven allows / Sve što nebo dopušta
programme.desc: Melodrama. The attractive and wealthy widow Cary Scott (J. Wyman) is unsuccessfully courted by the elderly Mr. Harvey (C. Nagel). She doesn't really like him, but her grown children _ son Ned (W. Reynolds) and daughter Kay (G. Talbott) _ for whom the social status of a suitor is more important than their mother's emotions, would have nothing against their mother's possible marriage. Their mother's emotions boil over when she notices the attractive and younger gardener Ron Kirby (R. Hudson). Cary soon falls in love with the gardener... This melodrama is one of the best works of the legendary American-German director of Danish origin Douglas Sirk (1897-1987). Sirk belongs to the narrowest top of the greatest masters of film melodrama: in just 6 years, between 1954 and 1959, he signed as many masterpieces (The Magnificent Obsession, Everything the Sky Allows, Darkened Angels, The Age of Life and the Age of Death, Written on the Wind and Imitation of Life), restoring its dignity to the often undeservedly despised genre. "All that the sky allows" is an exemplary example of Sirk's directorial aesthetics, whose characteristic features are a brilliant visual style, a great handling of the viewer's emotions, a phenomenal feeling for profiling female characters, a masterful talent for talking in pictures and skillfully interweaving high and so-called low art, for which Sirk was loved by modernist and postmodernist directors like R. M. Fassbinder, whose film "Angst essen Seele auf" is a kind of remake of "All That Heaven Allows". As in The Magnificent Obsession, Oscar winner J. Wyman (Johnny Belinda) and Sirk's favorite actor R. Hudson (Written on the Wind, Dynasty) played the main roles. / Melodrama. Privlačnoj i imućnoj udovici Cary Scott (J. Wyman) bezuspješno se udvara postariji gospodin Harvey (C. Nagel). On joj se baš i ne sviđa no njezina odrasla djeca _ sin Ned (W. Reynolds) i kći Kay (G. Talbott) _ kojima je od majčinih emocija važniji društveni status udvarača, ne bi imala ništa protiv eventualne majčine udaje. Emocije njihove majke uzavru nakon što primijeti privlačnog i mlađeg vrtlara Rona Kirbyja (R. Hudson). Cary se ubrzo zaljubi u vrtlara... Ova melodrama jedno je od najboljih ostvarenja legendarnog američko-njemačkog redatelja danskoga podrijetla Douglasa Sirka (1897.-1987.). Sirk spada u najuži vrh najvećih majstora filmske melodrame: u svega 6 godina, između 1954. i 1959., potpisao je isto toliko remek-djela (Veličanstvena opsesija, Sve što nebo dopušta, Potamnjeli anđeli, Doba života i doba smrti, Zapisano na vjetru i Imitacija života), vrativši često nezasluženo prezrenom žanru njegov dignitet. "Sve što nebo dopušta" ogledni je primjer Sirkove redateljske estetike čija su karakteristična obilježja briljantan vizualni stil, sjajno baratanje gledateljevim emocijama, fenomenalan osjećaj za profiliranje ženskih likova, majstorski talent za pričanje u slikama i vješto prepletanje visoke i tzv. niske umjetnosti, zbog kojeg su Sirka voljeli modernistički i postmodernistički redatelji poput R. M. Fassbindera, čiji je film "Angst essen Seele auf" svojevrsni remake "Sve što nebo dopušta". Kao i u Veličanstvenoj opsesiji, glavne su uloge odigrali oskarovka J. Wyman (Johnny Belinda) i Sirkov najomiljeniji glumac R. Hudson (Zapisano na vjetru, Dinastija).

programme.title: Pozitivno
programme.desc: Do you know how you can relive your childhood through painting? Our guest is the author of several books and the president of the Motorcycle Club Veterani Croatia Ratko Dragović Klek. Meet the Croatian woman who returned from Colombia to the land of her ancestors. / Znate li kako se kroz slikarstvo može još jednom živjeti djetinjstvo? Gost nam je autor više knjiga i predsjednik Moto kluba Veterani Croatia Ratko Dragović Klek. Upoznajte Hrvaticu koja se iz Kolubije vratila u zemlju svojih predaka.

programme.title: Biblija
programme.desc: In the Old Testament, it is mentioned that idols were worshiped by pagan nations, but also by the Israelites who, despite the Covenant with God, made a golden calf and worshiped it. What are our modern idols _ and are they different from those of the first people? About idols, prof. Davor Vuković and Rev. Tomislav Benaković in the show In the Bible. / U Starom zavjetu spominje se da su idole štovali poganski narodi, ali i Izraelci koji su, unatoč Savezu s Bogom, načinili zlatno tele i klanjali mu se. Koji su naši suvremeni idoli _ i razlikuju li se od onih prvih ljudi? O idolima nekad i danas govore prof. Davor Vuković i vlč. Tomislav Benaković u emisiji U Bibliji.

programme.title: Misa
programme.desc: Reformation Day is commemorated on October 31, 1517, when Martin Luther nailed his 95 Theses to the door of the All Saints Church in Wittenberg. On this occasion, we are broadcasting the service which will be led by the pastor of the Evangelical Church Municipality in Osijek, Samir Vrabec. / Dan reformacije obilježava se u spomen na 31. listopada 1517. kada je Martin Luther pribio svojih 95 teza na vrata crkve Svih Svetih u Wittenbergu. Tim povodom prenosimo bogoslužje koje će predvoditi župnik Evangeličke crkvene općine u Osijeku Samir Vrabec.

programme.title: Zvona za mrtve
programme.desc: In the parishes of Radobilja, Žeževica and Zagvozd, in the hinterland of Omiš and Makarska, the custom of breccia for the souls of the departed is still alive, on the night of All Saints, on All Souls' Day. The bell must be rung, i.e. struck so that the bat hits only one side of the bell, and that all night long, until the morning mass, because, according to custom, the ringing of the bell must not be interrupted. It is an act of remembering the deceased and praying for them, but, of course, also a social gathering, i.e. self-affirmation of the community. The atmosphere of that night is contemplative, but still, there can also be completely "secular" moments... The scenario is based on the research of folklorist Vida Bagur. Author of original music: Samuel Sacher / U župama Radobilja, Žeževica i Zagvozd, u zaleđu Omiša i Makarske, još je živ običaj brecanja za duše pokojnih, u noći sa Svih svetih, na Dušni dan. Mora se zvoniti, tj. brecati tako da bat udara samo o jednu stranu zvona i to cijelu noć, sve do jutarnje mise, jer se, prema običaju, zvonjava ne smije prekinuti. To je čin prisjećanja na pokojne i molitve za njih, ali, dakako, i društvenog okupljanja, odnosno samopotvrđivanja zajednice. Ozračje te noći je kontemplativno, no ipak, zna biti i posve "svjetovnih" trenutaka... Scenarij je temeljen na istraživanju folklorista Vide Bagura. Autor originalne glazbe: Samuel Sacher

programme.title: Gentler among women / Blaž među ženama
programme.desc: Through Ho, Spiro finds out who Anki's crush really is and decides to do something. In order to reduce the number of angry people from the cramped house, Daria plans to move in with grandmother Bjanka, but not only Bjanka but also her cat Bajdo is wondering about it. Some of our eastern neighbors are looking for Maja in Split _ who would it be but her abandoned and grieving husband? Blaž oscillates between all these situations like a ball in a pinball machine, on the way looking for the Holy Grail _ tickets for an exclusive concert by Nene Belan... Creators of the series: Branko Ružić and Goran Kulenović / Špiro preko Ho doznaje tko je zapravo Ankičina simpatija i odlučuje nešto poduzeti. Kako bi smanjila broj čeljadi bijesne iz kuće tijesne, Daria se planira smjestiti kod bake Bjanke, ali tu se ne pita samo Bjanka nego i njezin mačak Bajdo. Maju po Splitu traži neki naš istočni susjed _ tko bi to bio nego njezin ostavljeni i ucviljeni suprug? Blaž između svih tih situacija titra kao kuglica u fliperu, usput tražeći Sveti Gral _ karte za ekskluzivni koncert Nene Belana... Tvorci serije: Branko Ružić i Goran Kulenović

Several ladies from the neighborhood are also upset, a young man on a bicycle sneaks up on them at night. Shy and timid, he takes unusual waste from ladies' bins... / Bruno je zaljubljen i želi se oženiti, škola mu je sad još manje važna. Ne očajavaju samo Jagoda i Nikola, očinski je zabrinut i Suvi. Uzrujano je i više dama iz kvarta, noću im se prikrada mladić na biciklu. Sramežljiv i plašljiv, gospođama iz kanti uzima neobičan otpad...

programme.title: Volim Hrvatsku
programme.desc: Sunday afternoons are again cheered up by the team of the show Volim Hrvatska. The captains are Dušan Bućan and Goran Navojec. In the sixth show in Dušan's team, Kristijan Petelin, Mada Peršić and Vanda Winter will show their knowledge. Hana Cvijanović, Roko Sikavica and Jelena Miholjević will compete in Goran's team. Contestants will try their hand at well-known games such as Guess the Song, Happy Birthday, TV and Film, Sport, Famous Compatriots, Shufflers, Average Citizen and Word Croatian. The show is hosted by Mirko Fodor. The hits of local music are performed live by the band Ante Gele. / Nedjeljna popodneva ponovno uveseljava ekipa šoua Volim Hrvatsku. Kapetani su Dušan Bućan i Goran Navojec. U šestoj emisiji u Dušanovom timu znanje će pokazati: Kristijan Petelin, Mada Peršić i Vanda Winter. U Goranovom timu natjecat će se Hana Cvijanović, Roko Sikavica i Jelena Miholjević. Natjecatelji će se okušati u dobro poznatim igrama poput Pogodi pjesmu, Sretan rođendan, TV i film, Sport, Poznati sunarodnjaci, Premetaljke, Prosječni građanin i Riječ hrvatska. Emisiju vodi Mirko Fodor. Hitove domaće glazbe uživo izvodi bend Ante Gele.

programme.title: Superpotjera
programme.desc: In the Superchase, hunters join a super team _ five top experts who act as one. Having created one of the most powerful quiz teams in the world, they are ready to face any challenger. Who among the contestants has enough knowledge, skill and concentration to defeat this unbeatable team? / U Superpotjeri lovci se udružuju u super tim _ petero vrhunskih znalaca koji djeluju kao jedan. Stvorivši jednu od najmoćnijih kvizaških ekipa na svijetu, spremni su suočiti se sa svakim izazivačem. Tko među natjecateljima ima dovoljno znanja, vještine i koncentracije da pobijedi ovaj nepobjedivi tim?

programme.title: Iron Claw / Željezna kandža
programme.desc: Biographical drama based on the true story of the Von Erich brothers, famous wrestlers who are followed by success, but also a series of personal tragedies. Kevin Von Erich (Zac Efron) tries to break the family "curse" and find peace after the loss of his brothers and pressure from an ambitious father. / Biografska drama temeljena na istinitoj priči o braći Von Erich, slavnim hrvačima koje prate uspjesi, ali i niz osobnih tragedija. Kevin Von Erich (Zac Efron) pokušava prekinuti obiteljsku "kletvu" i pronaći mir nakon gubitka braće i pritiska ambicioznog oca.

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world, as well as a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Christopher Reeve, vječni Superman
programme.desc: The whole world considers Christopher Reeve (1952 - 2004) to be Superman. More than 40 years after the release of Richard Donner's international hit, Christopher Reeve is still the undisputed embodiment of the superhero from Krypton. How did the American actor manage to connect the character and his name so closely? What kind of new life breathed into that hero of the novel, the embodiment of the American dream, that all actors later consider him a model for that role? Thanks to a previously unpublished interview that we managed to get just before the actor's untimely death, the film sheds light on the relationship between the two heroes, follows their development during nine years of cohabitation and afterwards, until the moment when the actor united with the superhero. / Cijeli svijet Christophera Reevea (1952. _ 2004.) smatra Supermanom. Više od 40 godina nakon izlaska međunarodnog filmskog hita Richarda Donnera, Christopher Reeve još je neosporno utjelovljenje superjunaka s Kriptona. Kako je Američki glumac uspio tako usko povezati lik i svoje ime? Kakav je to novi život udahnuo tom junaku romana, utjelovljenju američkog sna, da ga svi glumci poslije smatraju modelom za tu ulogu? Zahvaljujući dosad neobjavljenom intervjuu koji smo uspjeli dobiti netom prije preuranjene smrti glumca, film rasvjetljava veze između dva junaka, prati njihov razvoj tijekom devet godina suživota i nakon toga, sve do trenutka kad se glumac sjedinio sa superjunakom.

programme.title: Golden velvet / Zlatni baršun
programme.desc: Set in Great Britain during the glam-rock era of the early 1970s, it tells the story of fictional bisexual pop star Brian Slade, who faked his own death. / Radnja, smještena u Veliku Britaniju tijekom ere glam-rocka ranih 1970-ih, donosi priču o fiktivnoj biseksualnoj pop-zvijezdi Brianu Sladeu, koji je lažirao vlastitu smrt.

programme.title: The third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: All stereotypes about life in retirement, and unfortunately there are a lot of them and they are mostly related to poverty and diseases, are destroyed by the heroes of the stories of our show this week. Regardless of whether they live in their own home or in a home for the elderly. Pensioners from Rijeka told us about discovering talents in retirement, and kindergarteners mingled with users of the St. Anthony's home in Karlovac. The married couple Lazić testified to us about their longevity, both in life and in marriage. Marjan Majdak showed us his models and reminded us that the beauty of life is in a series of details. Lucija Kuljiš and Viktorija Mardešić told us a story about returning to their old and happy old age after living in America for many years. / Sve stereotipe o životu u mirovini, a na žalost ih je puno i uglavnom su vezani uz siromaštvo i bolesti, ruše junaci priča naše ovotjedne emisije. Bez obzira na to žive li u svom ili u domu za starije. O otkrivanju talenata u mirovini govorili su nam riječki umirovljenici, a vrtićarci su se družili s korisnicima doma sveti Antun u Karlovcu. Bračni par Lazić svjedočio nam je o dugovječnosti, životnoj i bračnoj. Svoje makete izložio nam je Marjan Majdak i podsjetio nas da je ljepota života u nizu detalja. O povratku na svoj škoj i sretnoj starosti nakon dugogodišnjeg života u Americi priču su nam ispričale Lucija Kuljiš i Viktorija Mardešić.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: 25th continuation _ Risotto is on the menu The Risotto is On Lidia will be creative today and prepare a bright yellow seafood and leek risotto with saffron. Then we will learn how to refine the stock with leftover vegetables from the freezer. At the end of the day dedicated to risotto, Lidia will show us that we don't always have to use arborio rice. He will prepare a hearty version of risotto using barley, to which he will add cabbage and sausage meat. Join Lidia in the kitchen and perfect the preparation of risotto her way. / 25. nastavak _ Na jelovniku je rižoto The Risotto is On Lidia će danas biti kreativna i pripremiti jarkožuti rižoto od morskih plodova i poriluka sa šafranom. Potom ćemo naučiti kako se temeljac oplemeni ostacima povrća iz zamrzivača. Na kraju dana posvećenog rižotu, Lidia će nam pokazati da ne moramo uvijek koristiti rižu arborio. Pripremit će zasitnu inačicu rižota upotrebom ječma, u koji će dodati kupus i meso kobasica. Pridružite se Lidiji u kuhinji i usavršite pripremu rižota na njezin način.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is often mistaken for a childhood disorder. However, if it is not recognized and diagnosed in time, it can cause great difficulties for adults in their daily functioning. In this episode, we find out why early detection of ADHD is important and what the possibilities and success of treatment are. / Poremećaj hiperaktivnosti i deficita pažnje (ADHD) često se pogrešno smatra isključivo dječjim poremećajem. No, ako se ne prepozna i ne dijagnosticira na vrijeme, može odraslima uzrokovati velike poteškoće u svakodnevnom funkcioniranju. U ovoj epizodi doznajemo zašto je važno rano otkrivanje ADHD-a te kakve su mogućnosti i uspješnost liječenja.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Susana accepts Valdemar's business offer and tells Sal that she is moving. Salomao is surprised to hear that the jewelry is Simone's excuse to acquit her of Justin's death. Júlia and David reconcile. / Susana prihvaća Valdemarovu poslovnu ponudu i kaže Sal da se seli. Salomao se iznenadi kada čuje da je nakit Simonein izgovor kako bi je oslobodili od optužbe za Justinovu smrt. Júlia i David se pomire.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Curro stops Lorenzo from hitting Jana. Marcelo says goodbye to La Promesa. Santos and Petra bully Pía to keep her away from Ricardo. María Fernández and Samuel manage to sell the vase. Curro decides to tell the truth to Cruz... And to his father Alonso. / Curro spriječi Lorenza da udari Janu. Marcelo se oprosti od La Promese. Santos i Petra maltretiraju Píju kako bi je udaljili od Ricarda. María Fernández i Samuel uspiju prodati vazu. Curro odluči reći istinu Cruz... I svome ocu Alonsu.

programme.title: In Suzy's kitchen / U kuhinji kod Suzy
programme.desc: Suzy Josipović let us into her home where she prepares a simple dish in the kitchen in front of the cameras and shares her culinary knowledge and experience with us. / Suzy Josipović pustila nas je u svoj dom gdje u kuhinji ispred kamera sprema jednostavno jelo te dijeli s nama svoje kulinarsko znanje i iskustvo.

programme.title: Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herb hunter visits the southernmost branch of Lička Plješivice _ Poštak. The highest rounded peak on the northern ridge is Bijeli vrh, 1446 meters high. From a distance, it stands out because of the steep, almost cut-off slope below the peak. In addition to the wide vistas, it is interesting as a hiker because of the natural park of unusual stone sculptures on the grassy slope next to the marked trail, at an altitude of 1,200 meters. Some of the plants in this episode are small cacti, narrow-leaved lungwort, stout gorse, bearberry, large sasa, and medicinal primrose. The guests of the episode are Gradimira Bumbak, vice president of HPD Kamenar from Šibenik, and Vesna Bogunović, a lover of plants. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje najjužniji ogranak Ličke Plješivice _ Poštak. Najviši zaobljeni vrh na sjevernom grebenu je Bijeli vrh, visok 1446 metara. Iz daljine se posebno ističe po strmoj, gotovo odsječenoj padini ispod vrha. Osim zbog širokih vidika planinarski je zanimljiv zbog prirodnog parka neobičnih kamenih skulptura na travnatoj padini pokraj markirane staze, na visini od 1200 metara. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su mali kaćun, uskolisni plućnjak, čvrsta šupaljka, medvjedka, velika sasa i ljekoviti jaglac. Gosti epizode su Gradimira Bumbak, potpredsjednica HPD Kamenar iz Šibenika te Vesna Bogunović, zaljubljenica u bilje.

programme.title: Zvona za mrtve
programme.desc: In the parishes of Radobilja, Žeževica and Zagvozd, in the hinterland of Omiš and Makarska, the custom of breccia for the souls of the departed is still alive, on the night of All Saints, on All Souls' Day. The bell must be rung, i.e. struck so that the bat hits only one side of the bell, and that all night long, until the morning mass, because, according to custom, the ringing of the bell must not be interrupted. It is an act of remembering the deceased and praying for them, but, of course, also a social gathering, i.e. self-affirmation of the community. The atmosphere of that night is contemplative, but still, there can also be completely "secular" moments... The scenario is based on the research of folklorist Vida Bagur. Author of original music: Samuel Sacher / U župama Radobilja, Žeževica i Zagvozd, u zaleđu Omiša i Makarske, još je živ običaj brecanja za duše pokojnih, u noći sa Svih svetih, na Dušni dan. Mora se zvoniti, tj. brecati tako da bat udara samo o jednu stranu zvona i to cijelu noć, sve do jutarnje mise, jer se, prema običaju, zvonjava ne smije prekinuti. To je čin prisjećanja na pokojne i molitve za njih, ali, dakako, i društvenog okupljanja, odnosno samopotvrđivanja zajednice. Ozračje te noći je kontemplativno, no ipak, zna biti i posve "svjetovnih" trenutaka... Scenarij je temeljen na istraživanju folklorista Vide Bagura. Autor originalne glazbe: Samuel Sacher

programme.title: Flowers by Saša Šekoranja / Cvijeće Saše Šekoranje
programme.desc: Our famous artist and arranger Saša Šekoranja shows us how we can create our own flower magic at home. / Naš poznati umjetnik i aranžer Saša Šekoranja pokazuje nam kako kod kuće možemo napraviti vlastitu cvjetnu čaroliju.

programme.title: Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: The next adventure takes Sir Tony Robinson through the heart of colorful South America. Riding some of the most luxurious trains in the world, they will stop at fascinating places to dance the tango, visit the Amazon and fulfill a long-standing ambition. On the picturesque streets of Buenos Aires, he will meet the charismatic Viviana Parara, who will help him explore the city. He'll try tango and discover it's more than just a dance, then taste Argentina's legendary steak to see if it lives up to its reputation. In the end, he will find himself in the middle of a street dance on the eve of the upcoming carnival, where he will discover his surprising origins. It leaves Buenos Aires on one of the most famous trains in the world, the Train in the Clouds. At 4,200 meters above sea level, he travels to one of the highest lines in the world and is looking for oxygen to help him cope with the altitude. / Sljedeća pustolovina vodi sir Tonyja Robinsona kroz srce živopisne Južne Amerike. Vozeći se nekim od najluksuznijih vlakova svijeta stat će na fascinantnim mjestima da zapleše tango, posjeti Amazonu i ispuni dugogodišnju ambiciju. Na slikovitim ulicama Buenos Airesa upoznat će karizmatičnu Vivianu Pararu koja će mu pomoći istraživati grad. Okušat će se u tangu i otkriti da je to više od plesa, a zatim kušati legendarni argentinski odrezak da vidi hoće li opravdati svoju reputaciju. Na kraju će se zateći usred uličnog plesa uoči nadolazećeg karnevala gdje će otkriti njegovo iznenađujuće podrijetlo. Iz Buenos Airesa odlazi u jednom od najpoznatijih vlakova svijeta, Vlakom u oblacima. Na 4200 metara nadmorske visine putuje jednom od najviših linija svijeta i traži kisik koji će mu pomoći da se nosi s visinom.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: Consultant for development and human resources management Jasna Rilović talks about salary transparency and the EU directive with which our labor law is harmonized. Actor Emir Hadžihafizbegović will tell us what is the reason for the monodrama "Everything is up to us". Duška Brčić Šušak and Luka Novokmet will present their latest musical works "Sama" and "Reci kako to". Editor and screenwriter: Silvana Kolovrat Director: Jelena Ćulibrk Pajić Director: Kamelija Čančarević / O transparentnosti plaća i EU direktivi s kojom se usklađuje i naš zakon o radu govori konzultantica za razvoj i upravljanje ljudskim resursima Jasna Rilović. Što je povod monodrami "Sve je do nas" reći će nam glumac Emir Hadžihafizbegović. Svoje najnovije glazbene uratke "Sama" i "Reci kako to" predstavit će Duška Brčić Šušak i Luka Novokmet. Urednica i scenaristica: Silvana Kolovrat Voditeljica: Jelena Ćulibrk Pajić Redateljica: Kamelija Čančarević

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: Not far from Sisak, the Veselić family developed one of the most successful ecological farms in Croatia. They are especially proud of the fact that they created a business that also employs foreign workers, for whom they bought the house in which they live. Their fruits and vegetables end up on school tables through special food programs, and they organize delivery to customers themselves. The episode reveals how the combination of superior ecological production, social responsibility and entrepreneurial spirit can become an example of sustainable agriculture. / Nedaleko od Siska, obitelj Veselić razvila je jedno od najuspješnijih ekoloških gospodarstava u Hrvatskoj. Posebno se ponose time što su stvorili posao koji zapošljava i strane radnike, za koje su kupili kuću u kojoj žive. Njihovo voće i povrće završava na stolovima škola kroz posebne prehrambene programe, a sami organiziraju i dostavu kupcima. Epizoda otkriva kako spoj vrhunske ekološke proizvodnje, društvene odgovornosti i poduzetničkog duha može postati primjer održive poljoprivrede.

programme.title: Gentler among women / Blaž među ženama
programme.desc: Where the čeljad is not angry... we don't know, but the house of Blaž Živković aka Živac is certainly cramped. That's why Blaž Darija is trying to find private accommodation _ in Split, no less! An apparently salutary solution to the problem once again has Ankica, or as Blaž calls her to her delight: our good fairy Ankica. During this time, Maja tries to find a representative respondent for a survey about football fans, which also turns out to be a complicated mission, until Blaž recommends that she interview Elvis. Soccer hooligans are also the subject of a new computer game, which Spiro undertook to review with the help of Ivona, but it will not go smoothly either. Why did Daria's landlord Lovro get a dishonorable discharge from the army, who is winked at by Špira's game supplier, how many rounds does it take to get something out of the legendary Torcidas Katabuja, and is Elvis really an incredibly tolerant person? / Gdje čeljad nije bijesna... ne znamo, ali kod Blaža Živkovića zvanog Živac kuća je svakako tijesna. Zato Blaž Dariji pokušava pronaći privatni smještaj i to _ ni manje ni više nego _ u Splitu! Naizgled spasonosno rješenje problema ponovo ima Ankica, ili kako je Blaž na njezin ushit titulira: naša dobra vila Ankica. Za to vrijeme Maja pokušava pronaći reprezentativnog ispitanika za anketu o nogometnim navijačima, što se također pokazuje kao komplicirana misija, sve dok joj Blaž ne preporuči da intervjuira Elvisa. Nogometni huligani su tema i nove kompjutorske igrice, koju se Špiro poduzeo recenzirati uz pomoć Ivone, ali ni to neće proći glatko. Zašto je Darijin stanodavac Lovro dobio nečastan otpust iz vojske, kome namiguje Špirin dobavljač igrica, koliko rundi treba da bi se od legendarnog torcidaša Katabuje nešto izvuklo te je li Elvis stvarno nevjerojatno tolerantna osoba?

programme.desc: HTV's central political talk show in which the political topic of the day is analyzed every evening from Monday to Thursday with relevant guests from opposing viewpoints. / Središnji politički talk show HTV-a u kojem se svake večeri od ponedjeljka do četvrtka uz relevantne goste suprotstavljenih stajališta analizira politička tema dana.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Labirint
programme.desc: Despite the laws, warnings, and campaigns, the number of people killed on Croatian roads is not decreasing, but increasing. About 300 people die in Croatia every year. Although we know that speed and alcohol take lives on the roads, poor traffic culture and low awareness of the consequences have brought us to the very top in terms of the number of victims in the European Union. / Unatoč zakonima, upozorenjima, kampanjama na hrvatskim se cestama broj smrtno stradalih osoba ne smanjuje nego raste. Godišnje u Hrvatskoj smrtno strada oko 300 osoba. Iako znamo da brzina i alkohol odnose živote na cestama, prometna nekultura i niska svijest o posljedicama doveli su nas u sam vrh po broju stradalih u Europskoj uniji.

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Raising the young generation in the intricate jungle habitat requires ingenuity _ parents must master their habitat and know how to use every opportunity to provide a future for the new generation. In faraway Bhutan, a pair of red-throated hornbills live in a lifelong partnership built on trust and commitment. The mother remains imprisoned in the tree for a hundred days and relies on the male as the breadwinner of the family. In Sri Lanka, the bold snub-nosed frog shares a home with a large poisonous tarantula. This unexpected union consists of a harmonious tandem: the tarantula acts as a living bodyguard, and the tiny frog keeps to the house and keeps their shared home clean. In Jamaica, a genius mother shrimp works tirelessly to raise a brood of tiny shrimp. With professional precision, with the help of the resources available in the forest, he creates favorable conditions for his nursery. Elsewhere, jungle parents need room to move _ and others are forced to adapt to changes in the habitat around them. In Australia, the cassowary leads its birds through new dangers in the oldest rainforest in the world. Forest fires in the Amazon drive a rarely seen female tapir in search of new territory and vital minerals, and in China, griffon langurs barely survive on the edge of life. The limestone peaks they live on are surrounded by cultivated land and the langurs have to fight for what is left so that their offspring have a safe habitat to grow. Unexpectedly, new science shows that ancient trees in jungles are not only a source of life for their offspring, but also for countless other rainforest families, from the tops of the crowns, all the way down to the leafy undergrowth. Their influence will be the key to our survival. / Podizanje mladog naraštaja u zamršenom staništu džungle iziskuje domišljatost _ roditelji moraju zagospodariti svojim staništem i znati iskoristiti svaku priliku da bi novom naraštaju omogućili budućnost. U dalekom Butanu par crvenogrlih kljunorožaca živi u doživotnom partnerstvu izgrađenom na povjerenju i predanosti. Majka stotinu dana ostaje zatočena u stablu i pouzdaje se u mužjaka kao hranitelja obitelji. U Šri Lanki odvažna tuponosa žaba dijeli dom s velikom otrovnom tarantulom. Taj neočekivani spoj sastoji se od skladnog tandema: tarantula djeluje kao živi tjelohranitelj, a sitna žaba drži se kuće i održava čistoću njihova zajedničkog doma. Na Jamajci genijalna majka račica neumorno radi na podizanju legla sitnih račića. Stručnom preciznošću s pomoću resursa dostupnih u šumi stvara povoljne uvjete za svoje gojilište. Drugdje roditelji u džungli trebaju prostor za kretanje _ a drugi su prisiljeni prilagoditi se promjenama staništa oko njih. U Australiji kazuar vodi svoje ptiće kroz nove opasnosti u najstarijoj prašumi na svijetu. Šumski požari u Amazoniji tjeraju rijetko viđenu ženku tapira u potragu za novim teritorijem i vitalnim mineralima, a u Kini bjeloglavi languri jedva se održavaju na rubu života. Vapnenački vrhunci na kojima žive okruženi su obrađenom zemljom i languri se moraju boriti za ono što je preostalo kako bi njihovo potomstvo imalo sigurno stanište za rast. Neočekivano, nova znanost pokazuje da drevna stabla u džunglama nisu izvor života samo za svoje potomstvo, nego i za nebrojene druge prašumske obitelji, od vrhova krošnji, sve do lisnatog nastora. Njihov će utjecaj biti ključ našeg opstanka.

Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Curro stops Lorenzo from hitting Jana. Marcelo says goodbye to La Promesa. Santos and Petra bully Pía to keep her away from Ricardo. María Fernández and Samuel manage to sell the vase. Curro decides to tell the truth to Cruz... And to his father Alonso. / Curro spriječi Lorenza da udari Janu. Marcelo se oprosti od La Promese. Santos i Petra maltretiraju Píju kako bi je udaljili od Ricarda. María Fernández i Samuel uspiju prodati vazu. Curro odluči reći istinu Cruz... I svome ocu Alonsu.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Joaquim returns from Sao Paulo. Eugenio comes up with a trip with Violeta so they can be alone. Úrsula tries to distract them, but Rafael stops her. Isadora and Rafael want to open a movie theater in a working-class neighborhood. Bento finds Lorenzo in the hospital. Violeta and Eugenio spend another romantic night. Margo and Iolanda arrive in Campos and discover the impostor Rafael. Santa comes to Enrico's hotel and Lindinho imitates him by slandering Santa and their engagement is broken off. Enrico sleeps with Emilia. Joaquim invites Isadora to make models for Margo's new magazine. Father Tenorio asks Olivia for help. Arthur visits Rafael and tells him about the news regarding Elisa's case. He tells his friend to surrender. Margo and Úrsula meet, and Margo threatens to tell the truth about Joaquim's real mother. / Joaquim se vraća iz Sao Paula. Eugenio smisli putovanje s Violetom kako bi bili sami. Úrsula ih pokuša omesti, ali Rafael je spriječi. Isadora i Rafael žele otvoriti kino u radničkom naselju. Bento nađe Lorenza u bolnici. Violeta i Eugenio provedu još jednu romantičnu noć. Margo i Iolanda stižu u Campos i otkriju varalicu Rafaela. Santa dolazi u Enricov hotel, a Lindinho ga oponaša kako kleveće Santu i dogodi se prekid njihovih zaruka. Enrico spava s Emílijom. Joaquim pozove Isadoru da napravi modele za Margoin novi časopis. Otac Tenorio zamoli Olíviju za pomoć. Arthur posjeti Rafaela i govori mu o novostima u vezi s Elisinim slučajem. Kaže prijatelju neka se preda. Margo i Úrsula se upoznaju, a Margo prijeti da će reći istinu o Joaquimovoj pravoj majci.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Susana accepts Valdemar's business offer and tells Sal that she is moving. Salomao is surprised to hear that the jewelry is Simone's excuse to acquit her of Justin's death. Júlia and David reconcile. / Susana prihvaća Valdemarovu poslovnu ponudu i kaže Sal da se seli. Salomao se iznenadi kada čuje da je nakit Simonein izgovor kako bi je oslobodili od optužbe za Justinovu smrt. Júlia i David se pomire.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: The third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: All stereotypes about life in retirement, and unfortunately there are a lot of them and they are mostly related to poverty and diseases, are destroyed by the heroes of the stories of our show this week. Regardless of whether they live in their own home or in a home for the elderly. Pensioners from Rijeka told us about discovering talents in retirement, and kindergarteners mingled with users of the St. Anthony's home in Karlovac. The married couple Lazić testified to us about their longevity, both in life and in marriage. Marjan Majdak showed us his models and reminded us that the beauty of life is in a series of details. Lucija Kuljiš and Viktorija Mardešić told us a story about returning to their old and happy old age after living in America for many years. / Sve stereotipe o životu u mirovini, a na žalost ih je puno i uglavnom su vezani uz siromaštvo i bolesti, ruše junaci priča naše ovotjedne emisije. Bez obzira na to žive li u svom ili u domu za starije. O otkrivanju talenata u mirovini govorili su nam riječki umirovljenici, a vrtićarci su se družili s korisnicima doma sveti Antun u Karlovcu. Bračni par Lazić svjedočio nam je o dugovječnosti, životnoj i bračnoj. Svoje makete izložio nam je Marjan Majdak i podsjetio nas da je ljepota života u nizu detalja. O povratku na svoj škoj i sretnoj starosti nakon dugogodišnjeg života u Americi priču su nam ispričale Lucija Kuljiš i Viktorija Mardešić.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is often mistaken for a childhood disorder. However, if it is not recognized and diagnosed in time, it can cause great difficulties for adults in their daily functioning. In this episode, we find out why early detection of ADHD is important and what the possibilities and success of treatment are. / Poremećaj hiperaktivnosti i deficita pažnje (ADHD) često se pogrešno smatra isključivo dječjim poremećajem. No, ako se ne prepozna i ne dijagnosticira na vrijeme, može odraslima uzrokovati velike poteškoće u svakodnevnom funkcioniranju. U ovoj epizodi doznajemo zašto je važno rano otkrivanje ADHD-a te kakve su mogućnosti i uspješnost liječenja.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: 25th continuation _ Risotto is on the menu The Risotto is On Lidia will be creative today and prepare a bright yellow seafood and leek risotto with saffron. Then we will learn how to refine the stock with leftover vegetables from the freezer. At the end of the day dedicated to risotto, Lidia will show us that we don't always have to use arborio rice. He will prepare a hearty version of risotto using barley, to which he will add cabbage and sausage meat. Join Lidia in the kitchen and perfect the preparation of risotto her way. / 25. nastavak _ Na jelovniku je rižoto The Risotto is On Lidia će danas biti kreativna i pripremiti jarkožuti rižoto od morskih plodova i poriluka sa šafranom. Potom ćemo naučiti kako se temeljac oplemeni ostacima povrća iz zamrzivača. Na kraju dana posvećenog rižotu, Lidia će nam pokazati da ne moramo uvijek koristiti rižu arborio. Pripremit će zasitnu inačicu rižota upotrebom ječma, u koji će dodati kupus i meso kobasica. Pridružite se Lidiji u kuhinji i usavršite pripremu rižota na njezin način.

programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Two distinguished scientists and professors emerita are coming to visit us. They deal with research that concerns our everyday life. For example, what is the quality of life like in Croatia, how happy and satisfied are we on a scale from zero to ten. We will also find out what is the social position of women and young people. In short, a lot of interesting information that will reveal more about the society in which we live. Be with us in the company of Ljiljana Kaliterna Lipovčan and Inga Tomić Koludrović. / U goste nam stižu dvije ugledne znanstvenice i profesorice emerite. Bave se istraživanjima koja se tiču naše svakodnevice. Primjerice, kakva je kvaliteta života u Hrvatskoj, koliko smo sretni i zadovoljni na ljestvici od nula do deset. Saznat ćemo i kakav je društveni položaj žena, ali i mladih. Ukratko, puno zanimljivih informacija koje će svima nama otkriti više o društvu u kojem živimo. Budite s nama u društvu Ljiljane Kaliterne Lipovčan i Inge Tomić Koludrović.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Life is complex enough that meals shouldn't be like that. Lidia will first prepare a colorful summer salad "panzanella" in a new guise with the addition of roasted zucchini and onions. Then he will teach us how to prepare another simple and visually impressive dish _ a warm ribbon-shaped shrimp and zucchini salad. Learn to cook the easy way by letting the ingredients do the work for you. / Život je dovoljno složen pa jela ne bi trebala biti takva. Lidia će najprije pripremiti šarenu ljetnu salatu "panzanellu" u novom ruhu dodatkom pečenih tikvica i luka. Potom će nas naučiti kako se priprema još jedno jednostavno, a vizualno dojmljivo jelo _ topla salata od kozica i tikve u obliku vrpci. Naučite kuhati na jednostavan način tako što ćete dopustiti da sastojci rade umjesto vas.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: In the new episode of Dr. Beck, we are talking about births at home _ those that are planned and assisted, but also those that happen by accident. We will find out how many women decide to give birth at home and what are the advantages and disadvantages of such births. / U novoj epizodi emisije Dr. Beck govorimo o porođajima kod kuće _ onima planiranim i asistiranim, ali i onima koji se dogode slučajno. Doznat ćemo koliko se žena odlučuje roditi u kućnim uvjetima te koje su prednosti, a koje nedostatci takvih porođaja.

programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Regina is pleased that they arrested Simone, and Susana reveals that she saw Simone bribing Soraya to kill Justin. Furious after being questioned, Simone threatens to take revenge on Susana. / Regina je zadovoljna što su uhitili Simone, a Susana otkrije da je vidjela Simone kako potkupljuje Soraiju da ubije Justina. Bijesna nakon ispitivanja, Simone prijeti osvetom Susani.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Curro tells Alonso that he is his son and that Jana is his sister, as well as the whole truth about Dolores' death. Samuel openly declares his love to María Fernández, and Curro to Ángela. Santos and Petra fight over Ana. Cruz tells Lorenzo that Curro is Jana's brother. / Curro kaže Alonsu da je njegov sin, a da mu je Jana sestra, kao i cijelu istinu o Doloresinoj smrti. Samuel otvoreno izjavi ljubav Maríji Fernández, a Curro Ángeli. Santos i Petra posvađaju se zbog Ane. Cruz kaže Lorenzu da je Curro Janin brat.

programme.title: In Suzy's kitchen / U kuhinji kod Suzy
programme.desc: Suzy Josipović let us into her home where she prepares a simple dish in the kitchen in front of the cameras and shares her culinary knowledge and experience with us. / Suzy Josipović pustila nas je u svoj dom gdje u kuhinji ispred kamera sprema jednostavno jelo te dijeli s nama svoje kulinarsko znanje i iskustvo.

programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: Not far from Sisak, the Veselić family developed one of the most successful ecological farms in Croatia. They are especially proud of the fact that they created a business that also employs foreign workers, for whom they bought the house in which they live. Their fruits and vegetables end up on school tables through special food programs, and they organize delivery to customers themselves. The episode reveals how the combination of superior ecological production, social responsibility and entrepreneurial spirit can become an example of sustainable agriculture. / Nedaleko od Siska, obitelj Veselić razvila je jedno od najuspješnijih ekoloških gospodarstava u Hrvatskoj. Posebno se ponose time što su stvorili posao koji zapošljava i strane radnike, za koje su kupili kuću u kojoj žive. Njihovo voće i povrće završava na stolovima škola kroz posebne prehrambene programe, a sami organiziraju i dostavu kupcima. Epizoda otkriva kako spoj vrhunske ekološke proizvodnje, društvene odgovornosti i poduzetničkog duha može postati primjer održive poljoprivrede.

programme.title: Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Sir Tony Robinson has a mission to know and understand the shared history and culture of Mexico and the US. He leaves the usual tourist paths and meets locals who reveal unexpected stories to him. From the Mexican desert to starry Los Angeles, he explores these fascinating parts of America by train. The journey begins with the El Chepe train on the west coast of Mexico through the spectacular Copper Canyon _ larger and deeper than the Grand Canyon in the USA. There they will meet people who have lived in the canyon for generations. Then he takes the only passenger train in Mexico to the USA and on the way he will stop in the city of Chihuahua, where he will learn how he became prosperous and learn about the traditional drink "sotol", a northern Mexican type of tequila. They will have fun at the distillery tasting exotic varieties, including one with marijuana. Then he comes to the city that, thanks to the cartel wars, was once known as the most murderous city in the world, Juarez. / Sir Tony Robinson ima misiju upoznati i razumjeti zajedničku povijest i kulturu Meksika i SAD-a. Napušta uobičajene turističke staze i upoznaje domaće koji mu otkrivaju neočekivane priče. Od meksičke pustinje do zvjezdanog Los Angelesa, vlakom istražuje ove fascinantne dijelove Amerike. Putovanje počinje vlakom El Chepe na zapadnoj obali Meksika kroz spektakularni Bakreni kanjon _ veći i dublji od Grand Canyona u SAD-u. Ondje će upoznati ljude koji u kanjonu žive naraštajima. Zatim jedinim putničkim vlakom u Meksiku kreće prema SAD-u i putem će stati u gradu Chihuahui gdje će doznati kako je postao prosperitetan i upoznati tradicionalno piće "sotol", sjevernomeksičku vrstu tekile. Zabavit će se u destileriji kušajući egzotične varijante, uključujući jednu s marihuanom. Zatim dolazi u grad koji je zahvaljujući ratovima kartela nekoć bio poznat kao grad s najviše ubojstava na svijetu, Juarez.

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Tourists believe that a rented apartment is not only a place to sleep, but a small piece of the city and country they have arrived in. However, private accommodation is actually a mirror of our society. Cities on the coast live on positional rent: the sea is a currency, and a square meter is worth gold. In places where everyone wants to vacation, it is becoming more and more difficult to live. The old cores are transformed into backdrops for seasonal earnings, and the hosts will huddle at mom's in the summer to let tourists into their beds. One star with the comment "the room was desperate". Apart from the price, nothing was good _ and the whole season can go down the drain. When a home becomes a business plan _ a review can change everything. / Turisti vjeruju da unajmljeni apartman nije samo mjesto za spavanje, već mali komadić grada i zemlje u koju su stigli. No, privatni smještaj je zapravo ogledalo našeg društva. Gradovi na obali žive od položajne rente: more je valuta, a kvadrat vrijedi kao zlato. U mjestima gdje svi žele ljetovati, postaje sve teže živjeti. Stare jezgre pretvaraju se u kulise sezonske zarade, a domaćini će se ljeti stisnuti kod mame kako bi u svoje krevete pustili turiste. Jedna zvjezdica s komentarom "soba je bila očajna". Osim cijene, ništa nije bilo dobro _ i cijela sezona može pasti u vodu. Kada dom postane poslovni plan _ recenzija može promijeniti sve.

programme.title: Policijske priče
programme.desc: Murders in the crime milieu are often full of unanswered questions. In order to get answers to them, Domagoj Zaradić, together with his colleagues, has to contact people from all walks of life and thus portrays the real "Face of the city". / Ubojstva u krim miljeu često su puna neodgovorenih pitanja. Kako bi na njih dobio odgovore, Domagoj Zaradić zajedno sa svojim kolegama mora kontaktirati osobe iz svih sfera života i tako oslikava stvarno "Naličje grada".

programme.title: Kotlina
programme.desc: After the Sarajevo Haggadah disappears from the museum, Edib expands the investigation, and Selma tries to get in touch with the mysterious Mr. Cohen. Ajla, with the help of the information she received from Farah, continues to investigate the background of the events at the museum and uncovers a complex web of behind-the-scenes games. Senchi, waiting for Smiley's answer, looks for new sources of income. / Nakon što iz muzeja nestane Sarajevska Hagada, Edib proširuje istragu, a Selma pokušava stupiti u kontakt s tajanstvenim gospodinom Cohenom. Ajla, uz pomoć informacija koje je dobila od Farah, nastavlja istraživati pozadinu zbivanja u muzeju i otkriva kompleksnu mrežu zakulisnih igara. Senči, čekajući Smajlijev odgovor, traži nove izvore prihoda.

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: HTV's central political talk show in which the political topic of the day is analyzed every evening from Monday to Thursday with relevant guests from opposing viewpoints. / Središnji politički talk show HTV-a u kojem se svake večeri od ponedjeljka do četvrtka uz relevantne goste suprotstavljenih stajališta analizira politička tema dana.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of the show Conversation with a reason is sociologist and political scientist Dražen Lalić. He will discover why his family history became an obsession that he could not let go of, but had to dive into it and write the book Two Houses Above the Sea. We will discuss the differences between different levels of memory culture _ private, family and collective _ and why Lalić believes that the traumas of the Second World War are still unhealed. How should we as a society deal with divisions and why is empathy even for victims "on the other side" important? The book, which tells about all of us through the story of two Dalmatian families, is the reason for this conversation with Dražen Lalić. / Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je sociolog i politolog Dražen Lalić. Otkrivat će zašto mu je obiteljska povijest postala opsesija koju nije mogao pustiti, već je morao zaroniti u nju i napisati knjigu Dvije kuće iznad mora. Razgovarat ćemo o razlikama između različitih razina kulture sjećanja _ privatne, obiteljske i kolektivne _ te o tome zašto Lalić smatra da su traume iz Drugog svjetskog rata i dalje neizliječene. Kako se kao društvo trebamo nositi s podjelama i zašto je važna empatija čak i prema žrtvama "s druge strane"? Knjiga, koja kroz priču o dvjema dalmatinskim obiteljima govori o svima nama, razlog je za ovaj razgovor s Draženom Lalićem.

programme.title: Tim Peake and the Secrets of the Universe / Tim Peake i tajne svemira
programme.desc: In the epic introduction to the series, Tim heads deep into the Western Australian outback, where clear night skies offer breathtaking views of our own galaxy, the Milky Way. While stargazing with British astronomer Dr. Natasha Hurley-Walker, Tim feels planets and stars. / U epskom uvodu u seriju Tim odlazi duboko u zaleđe Zapadne Australije, gdje vedro noćno nebo pruža pogled na našu galaksiju, Mliječni put, od kojeg zastaje dah. Dok gleda zvijezde s britanskom astronomkinjom dr. Natashom Hurley-Walker, Tim osjeća planete i zvijezde.

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Curro tells Alonso that he is his son and that Jana is his sister, as well as the whole truth about Dolores' death. Samuel openly declares his love to María Fernández, and Curro to Ángela. Santos and Petra fight over Ana. Cruz tells Lorenzo that Curro is Jana's brother. / Curro kaže Alonsu da je njegov sin, a da mu je Jana sestra, kao i cijelu istinu o Doloresinoj smrti. Samuel otvoreno izjavi ljubav Maríji Fernández, a Curro Ángeli. Santos i Petra posvađaju se zbog Ane. Cruz kaže Lorenzu da je Curro Janin brat.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Margo threatens Úrsula to tell the truth that Joaquim is not her son. Úrsula begs her to keep the secret. Isadora admits to Heloísa that she is afraid of losing her head to Rafael and decides to give herself to him. Bento, Lorenzo and Silvana try to get home and find themselves in trouble. Benta wounds and he remains motionless. Eugenio calls Violeta to his house. And Úrsula, in an attempt to separate them, brought Matias to see them together. Matias goes crazy when he sees Violeta kissing Eugenia. He attacks him and stabs him with a knife. Joaquim passionately kisses Isadora, because of this a minor quarrel arises between Rafael and Isadora. Santa presents Arminda to Campos radio station. / Margo prijeti Úrsuli da će reći istinu da Joaquim nije njezin sin. Úrsula je moli da čuva tajnu. Isadora prizna Heloísi da se boji da će izgubiti glavu za Rafaelom i odluči mu se prepustiti. Bento, Lorenzo i Silvana pokušavaju se vratiti kući i nađu se u nevolji. Benta rane i on ostane nepokretan. Eugenio zove Violetu svojoj kući. A Úrsula, u pokušaju da ih razdvoji, dovede Matiasa da ih ugleda zajedno. Matias poludi kada vidi kako se Violeta ljubi s Eugeniom. Napadne ga i ubode ga nožem. Joaquim strasno poljubi Isadoru, zbog toga nastane manja svađa između Rafaela i Isadore. Santa daruje Armindi radiopostaju Campos.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Regina is pleased that they arrested Simone, and Susana reveals that she saw Simone bribing Soraya to kill Justin. Furious after being questioned, Simone threatens to take revenge on Susana. / Regina je zadovoljna što su uhitili Simone, a Susana otkrije da je vidjela Simone kako potkupljuje Soraiju da ubije Justina. Bijesna nakon ispitivanja, Simone prijeti osvetom Susani.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Kulturna baština
programme.desc: In the oeuvre of Ivan Rendić, our first modern sculptor, originally from Brač, educated in Venice, Florence and Trieste, the tombstone sculpture stands out in particular. Of the hundred or so mausoleums, tombs and sculptures he made for clients in Trieste, where he already spent part of his life, but also in other Croatian cities, about twenty preserved in the Kvarner area, mostly in Rijeka, are among the sculptor's best works created at the end of the 19th and in the first decades of the 20th century. Although he enjoyed the undivided affection of the public for years, Rendić, having returned to his homeland, died in 1932, forgotten and in the greatest misery. He, who made some of the monuments that make our cemeteries recognizable, was buried in Supetar in a modest grave, without a name or monument. / U opusu Ivana Rendića, prvog našeg modernog kipara, podrijetlom Bračanina, školovanog u Veneciji, Firenci i Trstu, osobito se ističe nadgrobna skulptura. Od stotinjak mauzoleja, grobnica i skulptura koliko ih je načinio za naručitelje u Trstu gdje je proveo već dio života, ali i u drugim hrvatskim gradovima, dvadesetak sačuvanih na području Kvarnera, ponajviše u Rijeci, ubraja se među kipareva ponajbolja ostvarenja nastala potkraj 19. i u prvim desetljećima 20. stoljeća. Premda je godinama uživao nepodijeljenu naklonost javnosti, Rendić je, vrativši se u domovinu, umro 1932. zaboravljen i u najvećoj bijedi. On, koji je načinio neke od spomenika koji prepoznatljivima čine naša groblja, pokopan je u Supetru u skromnom grobu, bez imena i spomenika.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: In the new episode of Dr. Beck, we are talking about births at home _ those that are planned and assisted, but also those that happen by accident. We will find out how many women decide to give birth at home and what are the advantages and disadvantages of such births. / U novoj epizodi emisije Dr. Beck govorimo o porođajima kod kuće _ onima planiranim i asistiranim, ali i onima koji se dogode slučajno. Doznat ćemo koliko se žena odlučuje roditi u kućnim uvjetima te koje su prednosti, a koje nedostatci takvih porođaja.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Life is complex enough that meals shouldn't be like that. Lidia will first prepare a colorful summer salad "panzanella" in a new guise with the addition of roasted zucchini and onions. Then he will teach us how to prepare another simple and visually impressive dish _ a warm ribbon-shaped shrimp and zucchini salad. Learn to cook the easy way by letting the ingredients do the work for you. / Život je dovoljno složen pa jela ne bi trebala biti takva. Lidia će najprije pripremiti šarenu ljetnu salatu "panzanellu" u novom ruhu dodatkom pečenih tikvica i luka. Potom će nas naučiti kako se priprema još jedno jednostavno, a vizualno dojmljivo jelo _ topla salata od kozica i tikve u obliku vrpci. Naučite kuhati na jednostavan način tako što ćete dopustiti da sastojci rade umjesto vas.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Dobro jutro, Hrvatska
programme.desc: A mosaic show that brings current informative and entertaining content from Monday to Saturday, with a host couple in the studio and guests, as well as reports and live broadcasts from all over Croatia and regular sections with advice from all areas of life. / Mozaična emisija koja od ponedjeljka do subote donosi aktualne informativne i zabavne sadržaje, s voditeljskim parom u studiju i gostima te uz reportaže i javljanja uživo iz cijele Hrvatske i redovite rubrike sa savjetima iz svih područja života.

programme.title: Vijesti
programme.desc: A short overview of news from Croatia and the world. / Kratki pregled vijesti iz Hrvatske i svijeta.
