programme.title: Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Our guests today have been friends since childhood. Their paths diverged briefly forty years ago. One went to America, the other stayed in Croatia. The American of Croatian descent became a respected writer and university professor. The one who stayed in Croatia became a respected politician, writer, journalist and university professor. We are particularly pleased to host Boža Kovačević and Josip Novaković. / Naši današnji gosti prijatelji su još od djetinjstva. Putevi su im se, nakratko, razišli prije četrdesetak godina. Jedan je otišao u Ameriku, drugi je ostao u Hrvatskoj. Amerikanac hrvatskog podrijetla postao je cijenjeni pisac i sveučilišni profesor. Onaj koji je ostao u Hrvatskoj postao je cijenjeni političar, pisac, novinar i sveučilišni profesor. S osobitim zadovoljstvom ugošćujemo Božu Kovačevića i Josipa Novakovića.

programme.title: Klasični recepti Mary Berry
programme.desc: This six-part series will show why Mary Berry is a fantastic cook, teacher and inspiration. Each food-filled episode will be dedicated to a specific type of dish, some of which are well-known and some of which are completely new. But Mary will use her unique cooking style to prepare all the dishes, which includes simple skills and processing methods, a small number of ingredients and easy-to-apply tricks for easier preparation. No one else can prepare simpler and more delicious dishes, and all of them will be in the classic Mary Berry style. --- Mary Berry will demonstrate her favorite soul-warming homemade dishes, from the simplest to the decadent. At the same time, they will enjoy preparing food on an open fire with Swedish chef Niklas Ekstedt. / Ova šestodjelna serija pokazat će zašto je Mary Berry fantastična kuharica, učiteljica i nadahnuće. Svaki nastavak ispunjen hranom bit će posvećen određenoj vrsti jela, od kojih su neka dobro poznata, a neka posve nova. No Mary će za pripremu svih jela primijeniti svoj jedinstveni stil kuhanja, koji uključuje jednostavne vještine i načine obrade, mali broj sastojaka i trikove za lakšu pripremu koje je lako primijeniti. Nitko drugi ne može pripremiti jednostavnija, a slasnija jela, a sva će biti u klasičnom stilu Mary Berry. --- Mary Berry pokazat će omiljena domaća jela koja griju dušu, od najjednostavnijih do dekadentnih. Ujedno će uživati u pripremi hrane na otvorenoj vatri sa švedskim kuharom Niklasom Ekstedtom.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: As many as 70 to 90 percent of adolescents in puberty have a problem with acne, but they are not a problem only in that period of life. What is their cause and how to properly treat and cure them, we find out in the show. dr. Dermatologist Gaby Novak Bilić, beautician Zdenka Mihelj, singer Zsa Zsa and nutritionist Ivona Brodić are guests of Natko Becka. / Čak 70 do 90 posto adolescenata u pubertetu ima problem s aknama, no one nisu problem samo u tom životnom razdoblju. Što im je uzrok i kako ih pravilno tretirati i izliječiti otkrivamo u emisiji. Dr. Natku Becku u goste stižu dermatologinja Gaby Novak Bilić, kozmetičarka Zdenka Mihelj, pjevačica Zsa Zsa i nutricionistic Ivona Brodić.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Diary 1 / Dnevnik 1
programme.desc: Aktualne informacije i najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta u podnevnom Dnevniku.

programme.title: Sport
programme.desc: Daily sports reports and reports. / Dnevni sportski izvještaji i reportaže.

programme.title: Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Susana tries to explain that she never intended to harm Cacao or Marquinha while helping Simone in the hospital. But Soraia accuses her anyway. Marlene tells Sal that she doesn't know where Majoris is, but that she could find out if she was bribed. Soraia reveals that she knows about the alliance between Susana and Simone. Marlene and Rui cannot find Majoris and suspect that she may have helped Simone in Justin's murder. / Susana pokušava objasniti da nikada nije namjeravala nauditi Cacau ni Marquinhu dok je pomagala Simone u bolnici. Ali Soraia je svejedno optužuje. Marlene kaže Sal da ne zna gdje je Majoris, ali da bi mogla saznati jesu li je potkupili. Soraia otkrije da ona zna za savezništvo između Susane i Simone. Marlene i Rui ne mogu naći Majoris i slute da je možda pomagala Simone u Justinovu ubojstvu.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana demands that Cruz and Leocadia tell her the truth. Samuel decides to leave La Promesa. Ángela and Curro kiss. Manuel returns from a trip to Italy... and finds Jana shot and bleeding. / Jana zahtijeva od Cruz i Leocadije da joj kažu istinu. Samuel odluči otići s La Promese. Ángela i Curro se poljube. Manuel se vrati s putovanja u Italiju... i nađe Janu kako nastrijeljena krvari.

programme.title: In Suzy's kitchen / U kuhinji kod Suzy
programme.desc: Suzy Josipović let us into her home where she prepares a simple dish in the kitchen in front of the cameras and shares her culinary knowledge and experience with us. / Suzy Josipović pustila nas je u svoj dom gdje u kuhinji ispred kamera sprema jednostavno jelo te dijeli s nama svoje kulinarsko znanje i iskustvo.

programme.title: Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Tourists believe that a rented apartment is not only a place to sleep, but a small piece of the city and country they have arrived in. However, private accommodation is actually a mirror of our society. Cities on the coast live on positional rent: the sea is a currency, and a square meter is worth gold. In places where everyone wants to vacation, it is becoming more and more difficult to live. The old cores are transformed into backdrops for seasonal earnings, and the hosts will huddle at mom's in the summer to let tourists into their beds. One star with the comment "the room was desperate". Apart from the price, nothing was good _ and the whole season can go down the drain. When a home becomes a business plan _ a review can change everything. / Turisti vjeruju da unajmljeni apartman nije samo mjesto za spavanje, već mali komadić grada i zemlje u koju su stigli. No, privatni smještaj je zapravo ogledalo našeg društva. Gradovi na obali žive od položajne rente: more je valuta, a kvadrat vrijedi kao zlato. U mjestima gdje svi žele ljetovati, postaje sve teže živjeti. Stare jezgre pretvaraju se u kulise sezonske zarade, a domaćini će se ljeti stisnuti kod mame kako bi u svoje krevete pustili turiste. Jedna zvjezdica s komentarom "soba je bila očajna". Osim cijene, ništa nije bilo dobro _ i cijela sezona može pasti u vodu. Kada dom postane poslovni plan _ recenzija može promijeniti sve.

programme.title: Policijske priče
programme.desc: Murders in the crime milieu are often full of unanswered questions. In order to get answers to them, Domagoj Zaradić, together with his colleagues, has to contact people from all walks of life and thus portrays the real "Face of the city". / Ubojstva u krim miljeu često su puna neodgovorenih pitanja. Kako bi na njih dobio odgovore, Domagoj Zaradić zajedno sa svojim kolegama mora kontaktirati osobe iz svih sfera života i tako oslikava stvarno "Naličje grada".

programme.title: Our little parties / Naše male fešte
programme.desc: The episode takes us to Cvelferija, a charming plain in Srijem, where the "Sung Cvelferija" takes place every year, an event that celebrates the Shoka tradition through music, dance and togetherness. We follow the preparations for this event, from decorating the village to the arrival of choirs and tambura bands. The event brings a wealth of cultural performances, from children's sections to guests from other parts of Croatia and abroad. The day ends with a large joint circle, where all participants celebrate the Šoká heritage, and the atmosphere is filled with joy, tradition and pride in the cultural identity of this region. / Epizoda nas vodi u Cvelferiju, šarmantnu ravnicu u Srijemu, gdje se svake godine održava "Raspjevana Cvelferija", manifestacija koja slavi šokačku tradiciju kroz glazbu, ples i zajedništvo. Pratimo pripreme za ovaj događaj, od ukrašavanja sela do dolaska zborova i tamburaških sastava. Manifestacija donosi bogatstvo kulturnih nastupa, od dječjih sekcija do gostiju iz drugih dijelova Hrvatske i inozemstva. Dan završava velikim zajedničkim kolom, gdje svi sudionici slave šokačku baštinu, a atmosfera je ispunjena veseljem, tradicijom i ponosom na kulturni identitet ovog kraja.

programme.title: Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Sir Tony Robinson will take the train to the unknown, traveling from Canada to Alaska. He looks forward to meeting Canadians and exploring the great wilderness in this part of the world, from the Rocky Mountains to the beautiful glaciers of Alaska. The journey begins in the high-tech city of Seattle, home to Amazon, Microsoft and Starbucks. The Amtrack Cascades train will take him across the border into Canada, where he will immediately be surprised by the beauty of Vancouver and the warmth of Canadians. / Sir Tony Robinson će se vlakom zaputiti u nepoznato putujući iz Kanade u Aljasku. Veseli se upoznavanju Kanađana i istraživanju velike divljine u ovom dijelu svijeta, od planina Stjenjaka do prelijepih glečera Aljaske. Putovanje počinje u gradu visoke tehnologije Seattleu gdje sjedišta imaju Amazon, Microsoft i Starbucks. Vlak Amtrack Cascades prevest će ga preko granice u Kanadu gdje će ga odmah iznenaditi ljepota Vancouvera i toplina Kanađana.

No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. In addition to sports news, see the detailed weather forecast for the following days. / Najvažnije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta, brojne reportaže, gostovanja istaknutih stručnjaka i komentatora u Dnevniku 2, u najgledanijoj informativnoj emisiji HTV-a. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Heart 7 / Loto 7
programme.desc: Follow the Lot 7 draw live. / Pratite izravno izvlačenje Lota 7.

programme.title: David Skoko: A place for me / David Skoko: Mjesto za mene
programme.desc: David Skoko travels to the Neretva valley to experience the authentic tourist offer of that traditionally agricultural region, and Pavo Jerković, the hearty ambassador of Neretva, will bring him closer to the potential and specificity of this climate. Photo safaris, rides on traditional Neretva boats, mandarin plantations and kite-surfing have become a kind of brand of this valley and have attracted thousands of visitors. On the gastronomic side, we will find out what kind of capelunga shells they are and how many hot peppers go into Neretva's brudet. / David Skoko putuje u dolinu Neretve iskušati autentičnu turističku ponudu tog tradicionalno poljoprivrednog kraja, a Pavo Jerković, srčani ambasador Neretve, približit će mu potencijal i specifičnost ovoga podneblja. Fotosafari, vožnja tradicionalnim neretvanskim lađama, nasadi mandarina ali i kite-surfing postali su svojevrsni brend ove doline i privukli tisuće posjetitelja. S gastronomske strane, doznat ćemo kakve su to školjke kapelunge i koliko ljutih papričica ide u neretvanski brudet.

programme.title: Krah
programme.desc: And as all their lies and secrets come to the surface, Ed, Jess and the rest of their friends must deal with the consequences of Jess's actions. Charlotte reveals how she really feels about Ed, and Liz defuses a potentially fatal situation for Betsey. The friends are shaken after Jess ends up in police custody. Jess's mental state begins to deteriorate after relentless questioning by Detectives Rustin and Farron, though Andrew intervenes, this time as her lawyer. Desperate to get some answers on some issues, Ed and Liz try to find out on their own why Jess is behaving the way she does. Charlotte gets involved after Rob and Mel's relationship publicly falls apart. Mel finally has to admit the truth to herself. Ed and friends are running out of time, and Jess's future hangs in the balance. Everyone has to ask themselves hard questions because of the speculation. As it slowly becomes clear what really happened on Friday night, the police uncover a crucial piece of evidence, and Jess faces life-changing consequences. / I dok sve njihove laži i tajne izlaze na površinu, Ed, Jess i ostali prijatelji moraju se nositi s posljedicama Jessinih postupaka. Charlotte otkriva što zapravo osjeća prema Edu, a Liz smiri situaciju u kojoj je Betsey mogla smrtno stradati. Prijatelji su potreseni nakon što Jess završi u policijskom pritvoru. Jessino mentalno stanje počinje se pogoršavati nakon neumornog ispitivanja detektiva Rustin i Farron, iako se Andrew umiješao, ovaj put kao njezin odvjetnik. Budući da očajnički žele dobiti dogovore na neka pitanja, Ed i Liz pokušavaju sami istražiti zašto se Jess tako ponaša. Charlotte se umiješa nakon što se Robova i Melina veza javno raspadne. Mel si napokon mora priznati istinu. Ed i prijatelji imaju sve manje vremena, a Jessina budućnost visi o niti. Svi si zbog nagađanja moraju postaviti teška pitanja. Polako postaje jasno što se zaista dogodilo u petak navečer, policija otkrije ključan dokaz, a Jess se suoči s posljedicama koje će joj promijeniti život.

programme.title: Otvoreno
programme.desc: HTV's central political talk show in which the political topic of the day is analyzed every evening from Monday to Thursday with relevant guests from opposing viewpoints. / Središnji politički talk show HTV-a u kojem se svake večeri od ponedjeljka do četvrtka uz relevantne goste suprotstavljenih stajališta analizira politička tema dana.

programme.title: Diary 3 / Dnevnik 3
programme.desc: The latest news from the country and the world, as well as a concise weather forecast for the next day. / Najnovije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta te sažeta vremenska prognoza za sljedeći dan.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Miyazaki, duh prirode
programme.desc: The first documentary that talks about the work of Oscar-winner Hayao Miyazaki, emphasizing his deep connection with nature and the environmental themes he deals with in his films. Through protagonists such as Totoro and Princess Mononoke, Miyazaki expresses his preoccupations with the world. His films are often autobiographical and echo the turmoil of the 20th century. This clip-enhanced documentary, featuring his son and director Goro Miyazaki, producer Toshio Suzuki and philosopher Timothy Morton, reveals the profound ecological dimension of Miyazaki's works, which question our relationship to the natural world and living beings. / Prvi dokumentarni film koji o djelu oskarovca Hayaoa Miyazakija govori naglašavajući njegovu duboku povezanost s prirodom i ekološke teme kojima se bavi u svojim filmovima. Kroz protagoniste kao što su Totoro i princeza Mononoke, Miyazaki izražava svoje preokupacije o svijetu. Njegovi su filmovi često autobiografski i u njima se osjeća odjek previranja 20. stoljeća. Ovaj dokumentarni film obogaćen filmskim isječcima, u kojem sudjeluju njegov sin i redatelj Goro Miyazaki, producent Toshio Suzuki i filozof Timothy Morton, otkriva duboku ekološku dimenziju Miyazakijevih djela, koja propituju naš odnos prema prirodnom svijetu i živim bićima.

programme.title: The trap of social networks - five women against five major platforms / Zamka društvenih mreža - pet žena protiv pet velikih platformi
programme.desc: Adolescents who spend more than five hours a day on their smartphones are 66% more likely to develop suicidal tendencies than those who use them for up to one hour a day. 44 US states are currently suing Meta, blaming the company for making an entire generation sick. Faced with powerful tech giants like Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X and Discord, how can we possibly protect children and their childhoods? For the first time in history, state legislators and parents in the US and Europe are joining forces to fight the digital giants. Among them are five women who decided to turn their everyday lives upside down to fight against five major platforms. Alexis, Elisabet, Sofia, Laure and Socheata. They are victims, mothers, doctors and lawyers. They are all behind a movement whose goal is to change the fate of future generations. Alexis, a victim of screen addiction, was among the first to sue Meta, accusing her of "inciting suicide." Elisabet is a mother of three children, and in just a few days more than 10,000 parents joined her WhatsApp group in the fight for "youth without mobile phones". As a result, the state banned smartphones in schools. Sofia is a psychiatrist and a pioneer in the treatment of screen addiction in children, some of whom are as young as seven years old. Socheata joined the fight when her son found himself under the manipulation of an internet predator. She joined the association and, together with police officers specializing in cybercrime, catches pedophiles. Laure is a lawyer determined to change the laws that protect the Big Five. Through the difficulties these women face, we will discover how digital control is a major public health and safety problem that exceeds the limits of our expectations. / Adolescenti koji za svojim pametnim telefonima provode više od pet sati na dan imaju 66 % više izgleda da će razviti suicidalne sklonosti negoli oni koji se njima koriste do jednog sata na dan. 44 američke savezne države trenutačne tuže Metu, okrivljujući kompaniju za pobolijevanje cijele generacije. Suočeni s moćnim tehnološkim divovima poput Mete, TikToka, Snapchata, X-a i Discorda, kako uopće možemo zaštititi djecu i njihovo djetinjstvo? Prvi put u povijesti državni zakonodavci i roditelji u SAD-u i Europi udružuju snage u borbi protiv digitalnih divova. Među njima je pet žena koje su odlučile preokrenuti svoj svakodnevni život naglavačke kako bi krenule u borbu protiv pet velikih platformi. Alexis, Elisabet, Sofia, Laure i Socheata. One su žrtve, majke, liječnice i odvjetnice. Sve stoje iza pokreta kojem je cilj promijeniti sudbinu budućih naraštaja. Alexis, žrtva ovisnosti o ekranu, bila je među prvima koji su tužili Metu, optužujući je za "poticanje na samoubojstvo". Elisabet je majka troje djece, a u samo nekoliko dana više od 10.000 roditelja pridružilo se njezinoj WhatsApp grupi u borbi za "mladost bez mobitela". Kao rezultat toga, država je zabranila pametne telefone u školama. Sofia je psihijatrica i pionirka u liječenju ovisnosti o ekranu kod djece, od kojih neki imaju samo sedam godina. Socheata se pridružila borbi kad se njezin sin našao pod manipulacijom internetskog predatora. Priključila se udruženju i zajedno s policajcima specijaliziranim za kibernetički kriminal hvata pedofile. Laure je odvjetnica odlučna u tome da promijeni zakone koji štite velikih pet. Kroz poteškoće s kojima se susreću ove žena otkrit ćemo kako je digitalna kontrola veliki problem javnog zdravstva i sigurnosti koji prelazi granice naših očekivanja.

programme.title: Potjera
programme.desc: In The Chase, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz _ it is also a race in which the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is? / U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz _ ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana demands that Cruz and Leocadia tell her the truth. Samuel decides to leave La Promesa. Ángela and Curro kiss. Manuel returns from a trip to Italy... and finds Jana shot and bleeding. / Jana zahtijeva od Cruz i Leocadije da joj kažu istinu. Samuel odluči otići s La Promese. Ángela i Curro se poljube. Manuel se vrati s putovanja u Italiju... i nađe Janu kako nastrijeljena krvari.

programme.title: Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Isadora finally surrenders to Rafael and the two spend a wonderful night. Arminda tells Inácio about Mariana's blackmail and asks for help to trick the two of them. Inácio pretends to be in love with Mariana. Arminda becomes the owner of the radio. After Úrsula's trick, Violeta decides to break up with Eugenia. Matias is hospitalized again, but this time Leônidas makes sure that the treatment is not as harsh as last time. Heloísa discovers that Leônidas is actually Bartolmeu's son and that he has been educated. She makes him tell her about his past. Joaquim publishes a magazine with Isador. On the day of the presentation, as agreed, Iolanda discovers that her son is actually Rafael's. Bento begs Lorenzo to say he was killed in battle so he doesn't have to go back to Brazil. Isadora breaks up with Rafael. / Isadora se konačno prepustila Rafaelu i njih dvoje provedu divnu noć. Arminda govori Ináciju o Marianinoj ucjeni i traži pomoć kako bi je njih dvoje prevarili. Inácio glumi da je zaljubljen u Marianu. Arminda postaje vlasnica radija. Nakon Úrsuline smicalice Violeta odluči prekinuti s Eugeniom. Matias je ponovno hospitaliziran, ali ovoga puta Leônidas se pobrine da liječenje ne bude onako grubo kao prošli put. Heloísa otkrije da je Leônidas zapravo Bartolmeuov sin i da je školovan. Natjera ga da joj ispriča svoju prošlost. Joaquim objavi časopis s Isadorom. Na dan predstavljanja, prema dogovoru, Iolanda otkriva da je njezin sin zapravo Rafaelov. Bento moli Lorenza da kaže da je poginuo u bitci kako se ne bi morao vratiti u Brazil. Isadora prekida s Rafaelom.

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Susana tries to explain that she never intended to harm Cacao or Marquinha while helping Simone in the hospital. But Soraia accuses her anyway. Marlene tells Sal that she doesn't know where Majoris is, but that she could find out if she was bribed. Soraia reveals that she knows about the alliance between Susana and Simone. Marlene and Rui cannot find Majoris and suspect that she may have helped Simone in Justin's murder. / Susana pokušava objasniti da nikada nije namjeravala nauditi Cacau ni Marquinhu dok je pomagala Simone u bolnici. Ali Soraia je svejedno optužuje. Marlene kaže Sal da ne zna gdje je Majoris, ali da bi mogla saznati jesu li je potkupili. Soraia otkrije da ona zna za savezništvo između Susane i Simone. Marlene i Rui ne mogu naći Majoris i slute da je možda pomagala Simone u Justinovu ubojstvu.

programme.title: At our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts. / Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: News from culture follows events from various fields of culture and art every day. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: As many as 70 to 90 percent of adolescents in puberty have a problem with acne, but they are not a problem only in that period of life. What is their cause and how to properly treat and cure them, we find out in the show. dr. Dermatologist Gaby Novak Bilić, beautician Zdenka Mihelj, singer Zsa Zsa and nutritionist Ivona Brodić are guests of Natko Becka. / Čak 70 do 90 posto adolescenata u pubertetu ima problem s aknama, no one nisu problem samo u tom životnom razdoblju. Što im je uzrok i kako ih pravilno tretirati i izliječiti otkrivamo u emisiji. Dr. Natku Becku u goste stižu dermatologinja Gaby Novak Bilić, kozmetičarka Zdenka Mihelj, pjevačica Zsa Zsa i nutricionistic Ivona Brodić.

programme.title: Klasični recepti Mary Berry
programme.desc: Mary Berry will demonstrate her favorite soul-warming homemade dishes, from the simplest to the decadent. At the same time, they will enjoy preparing food on an open fire with Swedish chef Niklas Ekstedt. / Mary Berry pokazat će omiljena domaća jela koja griju dušu, od najjednostavnijih do dekadentnih. Ujedno će uživati u pripremi hrane na otvorenoj vatri sa švedskim kuharom Niklasom Ekstedtom.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Svijet zabave
programme.desc: British Prince Andrew had to give up his titles due to new details in the "Epstein case" — but his problems don't end there. The Danish group Aqua is preparing a musical about their thirty-year career, and Bradley Cooper is returning to film direction in the new dark humor drama Is This Thing On?. TBF and Nina Badrić will provide a dose of domestic glamor this week! / Britanski princ Andrew morao se, zbog novih detalja u "slučaju Epstein", odreći svojih titula — no njegovim problemima tu nije kraj. Danska grupa Aqua priprema mjuzikl o svojoj tridesetogodišnjoj karijeri, a Bradley Cooper vraća se filmskoj režiji u novoj crnohumornoj drami Is This Thing On?. Za dozu domaćeg glamura ovoga se tjedna pobrinut će TBF i Nina Badrić!

programme.title: Peti dan
programme.desc: The topics of this Fifth Day are: 1. Trump the king 2. Harari the prophet The commentators are: Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić and Erik Brezovec. / Teme su ovoga Petog dana: 1. Trump kralj 2. Harari prorok Komentatori su: Aleksandar Musić, Marijana Bijelić i Erik Brezovec.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: When the Flyers reach the Stanley Cup Finals, Barry superstitiously asks the family to observe certain rituals. Geoff asks Lou and Linda to spend more time with Muriel. / Kad Flyersi stignu do finala Stanleyeva kupa, Barry iz praznovjerna traži od obitelji da se pridržava određenih rituala. Geoff traži od Loua i Linde da provode više vremena s Muriel.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: In his grandfather's apartment, Adam finds something that his grandfather wrote a long time ago and realizes that they have more in common than he thought. Erica and Geoff want some alone time. / Adam u djedovu stanu pronalazi nešto što je djed davno napisao i shvaća da imaju više zajedničkog nego što je mislio. Erica i Geoff žele biti malo sami.

programme.title: Kućni ljubimci
programme.desc: In the 1800th show, we visit dog breeder Rebeka Tratnik and present the Shiba Inu and Akita Inu breeds that she breeds. Anja Andrel, breeder of Bengal cats, will introduce us to a new litter of kittens. Robert Kranjčević will present the rabbits and ornamental poultry he breeds. In the veterinary clinic, we talk about bronchopneumonia in dogs. / U 1800. emisiji u posjetu smo uzgajateljici pasa Rebeki Tratnik i predstavljamo pasmine shiba inu i akita inu koje uzgaja. Anja Andrel, uzgajateljica bengalskih mačaka, upoznat će nas s novim leglom mačića. Robert Kranjčević predstavit će nam kuniće i ukrasnu perad koju uzgaja. U veterinarskoj ambulanti govorimo o bronhopneumoniji kod pasa.

programme.title: DW: Tomorrow is today / DW: Sutrašnjica danas
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle's show about the European way of life brings interesting things from European cities. / Emisija Deutsche Wellea o europskom načinu života, donosi zanimljivosti iz europskih gradova.

programme.title: Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: Introducing young Croatian innovators! We also take you to an interesting exhibition in London, where the dresses, jewelry and personal belongings of the French Queen Marie Antoinette will be presented at the Victoria and Albert Museum. Find out how a lone female iguana gave birth to as many as eight cubs through parthenogenesis — without mating — and how cockatoos live in the urban parks of Hong Kong. / Predstavljamo mlade hrvatske inovatore! Vodimo vas i na zanimljivu izložbu u Londonu, gdje će biti predstavljene haljine, nakit i osobne stvari francuske kraljice Marije Antoanete u Muzeju Victoria i Albert. Doznajte i kako je usamljena ženka iguane partenogenezom — bez parenja — okotila čak osam mladunaca te kako žive kakadui u urbanim parkovima Hong Konga.

programme.title: Up to the wine / Fino i vino
programme.desc: We travel Croatia in search of stories about dedication and love for work, as well as tradition in a modern guise. We also monitor the success of family farms. / Putujemo Hrvatskom u potrazi za pričama o posvećenosti i ljubavi prema poslu, kao i tradiciji u suvremenom ruhu. Usto pratimo uspjehe obiteljskih gospodarstava.

programme.title: Rekreacija
programme.desc: In today's "Recreation" show, we bring a detailed report from the Sport Fest in Poreč, where several hundred athletes from all over Croatia, as well as the countries of the region, presented themselves to the public during the two days of the event. We introduce you to unusual sports such as dodgeball, hybrid race and arm wrestling, as well as an attractive sports show program such as BMX show and basketball acrobats. We also deal with the topic of the impact of stress on heart health _ find out how to recognize it and the easiest way to get rid of it. We also bring the story of women's boxing along with the attractive fights of our athletes. We also attended the unique Blind Run Race, in which the blind run is simulated by blindfolded participants. The race is of a humanitarian nature, and all funds collected are donated to the Croatian Association of the Visually Impaired and the Blind. In the column from our Gyms4You gym, we bring exercises that actively stimulate the brain. We talk about the connection between physical activity and brain functions and provide advice for optimal brain functioning. / U današnjoj emisiji "Rekreacija" donosimo iscrpan izvještaj sa Sport Festa u Poreču, gdje se tijekom dva dana održavanja javnosti predstavilo više stotina sportaša iz cijele Hrvatske, ali i zemalja regije. Upoznajemo vas s neobičnim sportovima poput dodgeballa, hybrid racea i obaranja ruke, te atraktivnim sportskim show-programom kao što su BMX show i košarkaški akrobati. Bavimo se i temom utjecaja stresa na zdravlje srca _ saznajte kako ga prepoznati i kako ga se najlakše riješiti. Donosimo i priču o ženskom boksu uz atraktivne borbe naših sportašica. Bili smo i na jedinstvenoj utrci Blind Run Race, u kojoj se simulira trčanje slijepih tako što sudionici nose poveze na očima. Utrka je humanitarnog karaktera, a sva prikupljena sredstva doniraju se Hrvatskoj udruzi slabovidnih i slijepih. U rubrici iz naše teretane Gyms4You donosimo vježbe kojima aktivno potičemo i rad mozga. Govorimo o povezanosti tjelesne aktivnosti i moždanih funkcija te donosimo savjete za optimalno funkcioniranje mozga.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Lucian, Virat and Marco discover Nish's body buried in the forest. In his pain, Lucian rushes to Constance and begs her to run away with him, asking her to choose between Vito and him. Alice proves her love to Carl, but realizes that he has been manipulating her. Shaken by Nish's death, Bella mends her relationship with her sister and confesses her relationship with Marco, not realizing that Danioni has plans for Marco. / Lucian, Virat i Marco otkriju Nishovo tijelo zakopano u šumi. U svojoj boli Lucian odjuri do Constance i moli je da pobjegne s njim, tražeći da izabere između Vita i njega. Alice dokazuje svoju ljubav Carlu, ali shvaća da je on manipulirao njome. Potresena Nishevom smrću, Bella popravlja odnose sa sestrom i priznaje vezu s Marcom, ne sluteći da Danioni ima planove za Marca.

programme.title: Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: On the day of the party where Claudine presents her perfume, Bella makes a presentation in front of Mr. Fleuryi to try to get his financial support. Cecil prepares a deadly plan against Danioni, but Jack tricks him. Lucian prepares to escape with Constance while Cecil tries to kill Danioni himself, but is caught by the Blackshirts. Bella finds out she's been granted support, Cecil is taken away, and a grieving Virat bursts into the party with a stolen gun to kill Danioni. / Na dan zabave na kojoj Claudine predstavlja svoj parfem Bella održi prezentaciju pred g. Fleuryijem kako bi pokušala dobiti njegovu financijsku potporu. Cecil priprema smrtonosni plan protiv Danionija, ali Jack ga prevari. Lucian se sprema pobjeći s Constance dok Cecil pokušava sam ubiti Danionija, ali ga uhvate crnokošuljaši. Bella sazna da je dobila potporu, Cecila odvedu, a ožalošćeni Virat uleti na zabavu s ukradenim pištoljem kako bi ubio Danionija.

programme.title: Skiing, World Cup: Soelden (M) / Skijanje, Svjetski Kup: Soelden (M)
programme.desc: The Men's Skiing World Cup has fascinated fans of the sport since 1967. Competitions are held in four basic disciplines: slalom, giant slalom, super giant slalom and downhill. In addition, special races are organized in alpine and team combinations. / Svjetski kup u skijanju za muškarce fascinira ljubitelje ovog sporta od 1967. godine. Natjecanja se održavaju u četiri osnovne discipline: slalom, veleslalom, superveleslalom i spust. Osim toga, organiziraju se posebne utrke u alpskim i timskim kombinacijama.

programme.title: Sportsko srce
programme.desc: Tin Srbič is the most successful Croatian gymnast in history. The 27-year-old from Zagreb has as many as 6 medals from all major gymnastics competitions: he is European and world champion, double European vice-champion and has silver from the World Championship and the Olympic Games. Of the gold medals, he still lacks only the Olympic one. How is it possible to achieve such sporting success in a sport that is on the margins of public and media attention in Croatia, how much inspiration is his role model and friend Marijo Možnik and what motivates him to still remain in top sport, he reveals only for "Sportsko srce". / Tin Srbić najuspješniji je hrvatski gimnastičar u povijesti. 27-godišnji Zagrepčanin ima čak 6 medalja sa svih najvećih gimnastičkih natjecanja: europski je i svjetski prvak, dvostruki viceprvak Europe te ima srebro sa Svjetskog prvenstva i s Olimpijskih igara. Od zlatnih odličja nedostaje mu još samo ono olimpijsko. Kako je moguće ostvariti takav sportski uspjeh u sportu koji je u Hrvatskoj na marginama javnog i medijskog zanimanja, kolika mu je inspiracija uzor i prijatelj Marijo Možnik i što ga motivira da još ostaje u vrhunskom sportu, otkriva samo za "Sportsko srce".

programme.title: Krimi matineja: Foyleov rat
programme.desc: Pilots and their girlfriends live fast and die young in a tale of lust and passion, and Foyle discovers that appearances can sometimes be deceiving. / Piloti i njihove djevojke žive brzo i umiru mladi u priči o pohoti i strasti, a Foyle otkriva da privid katkad vara.

programme.title: Skiing, World Cup: Soelden (M) / Skijanje, Svjetski Kup: Soelden (M)
programme.desc: Skiing, World Cup: Soelden _ giant slalom (M), broadcast of the 2nd run / Skijanje, Svjetski Kup: Soelden _ veleslalom (M), prijenos 2. vožnje

programme.title: Psi na zadatku
programme.desc: The documentary series reveals to us the world of working dogs, exploring their jobs, but also their leisure time. We follow their daily lives and find out how they contribute to our society, and through imaginative interpretations we also listen to their thoughts about it, because each dog has also been given a voice. In the second episode, we follow Greta. Her job is to find the eggs of red-eared turtles, an invasive species that threatens the life and habitat of the indigenous European pond turtle in Zagreb's Maksimir Park. / Dokumentarna serija nam otkriva svijet radnih pasa, istražujući njihove poslove, ali i dokolicu. Pratimo njihov svakodnevni život i saznajemo kako oni pridonose našem društvu, a kroz maštovite interpretacije slušamo i njihove misli o tome, jer svaki je pas dobio i glas. U drugoj epizodi pratimo Gretu. Njezin je posao pronaći jaja crvenouhih kornjača, invazivne vrste koja u zagrebačkom parku Maksimir ugrožava život i stanište autohtone europske barske kornjače.

programme.title: Magazin LP
programme.desc: It provides an overview and summaries of all Champions League matches, as well as stories about the best football players and reports about the actors of the competition. / Donosi pregled i sažetke svih utakmica Lige prvaka te priče o najboljim nogometašima i reportaže o akterima natjecanja.

programme.title: Alpine skiing - Solden World Cup (M) / Alpsko skijanje - Svjetski kup u Soldenu (M)
programme.desc: Skiing, World Cup: Soelden _ giant slalom (M), broadcast of the 2nd run / Skijanje, Svjetski Kup: Soelden _ veleslalom (M), prijenos 2. vožnje

programme.title: Sportsko srce
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Zrinka Ljutić from Zagreb is the world junior champion in alpine skiing, and in 2023 she also shone in the senior competition of the World Cup. In the elite group of the world's best female skiers, Zrinka Ljutić was arguably the youngest skier to reach the podium. Find out whether Croatia and the world will get a new Janica Kostelić, what Ivica and Zrinka have in common, and what the sports and everyday life of this exceptional young girl looks like in "Sportske srcu". / Devetnaestogodišnja Zagrepčanka Zrinka Ljutić svjetska je juniorska prvakinja u alpskom skijanju, a 2023. godine zablistala je i u seniorskoj konkurenciji Svjetskog kupa. U elitnoj skupini najboljih skijašica svijeta Zrinka Ljutić bila je uvjerljivo najmlađa skijašica koja se uspela na postolje. Hoće li Hrvatska i svijet dobiti novu Janicu Kostelić, što je zajedničko Ivici i Zrinki te kako izgleda sportska i životna svakodnevica ove iznimne mlade djevojke, saznajte u "Sportskom srcu".

programme.title: Španjolska s Evom Longorijom
programme.desc: Eva Longoria explores her Spanish roots in her ancestral homeland to discover how that beautiful country and its rich culture shaped one of the world's best cuisines. Four hundred years after her ancestor Lorenzo left Asturias for the New World, Eva Longoria returns to that land of majestic mountains, lush orchards, wild seas and brave people. / Eva Longoria u postojbini svojih predaka istražuje svoje španjolske korijene kako bi otkrila kako su ta prekrasna zemlja i njezina bogata kultura oblikovale jednu od najboljih svjetskih kuhinja. Četiristo godina nakon što je njezin predak Lorenzo napustio Asturiju i zaputio se u Novi svijet, Eva Longoria vraća se u tu zemlju veličanstvenih planina, bujnih voćnjaka, divljeg mora i hrabrih ljudi.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain - Upoznavanje nepoznatog
programme.desc: As peace and hope spread across Sri Lanka following the end of a brutal civil war, Bourdain travels through the once-divided regions to experience the well-fed people, delicious food and vast expanses. He starts from Colombo in the south, the capital, where he discovers the changes on the liberated island, sampling the street food at Nanas King _ light curries and lots of seafood. He takes a ten-hour train ride to the northern time-capsule city of Jaffna, where he enjoys crab curry — the holy grail of Sri Lankan cuisine, known for its spicy and fiery flavors. / Kako se mir i nada šire Šri Lankom nakon završetka okrutnoga građanskog rata, Bourdain putuje nekada podijeljenim regijama kako bi doživio osokoljeni narod, slasnu hranu i nepregledna prostranstva. Kreće od Colomba na jugu, glavnog grada, gdje otkriva promjene na oslobođenom otoku, kušajući uličnu hranu u Nanas Kingu _ lagane curryje i mnogo morskih plodova. Vozi se deset sati vlakom do sjevernog grada-vremenske kapsule Jaffne, gdje uživa u curryju od rakova _ svetom gralu šrilankanske kuhinje, poznate po začinjenim i vatrenim okusima.

programme.title: Petar Pan
programme.desc: While Wendy Darling (R. Hurd-Wood) tells stories to her brothers John (H. Newell) and Michael (F. Popplewell), Peter Pan (J. Sumpter) comes to visit them. Petar, a boy who miraculously does not age, invites Wendy and her brothers to Neverland, the island where he lives with the lost boys. But when they get there, Wendy and her brothers are kidnapped by Captain Cook (J. Isaacs). Petar, with the help of Fairy Zvončica (L. Sagnier), has to deal with Kuk in order to save them. / Dok Wendy Darling (R. Hurd-Wood) priča priče svojoj braći Johnu (H. Newell) i Michaelu (F. Popplewell), u posjet im stiže Petar Pan (J. Sumpter). Petar, dječak koji nekim čudom ne stari, poziva Wendy i njezinu braću u Nigdjezemsku, otok na kojem živi s izgubljenim dječacima. No kad stignu onamo, Wendy i njezinu braću otme kapetan Kuka (J. Isaacs). Petar se, uz pomoć vile Zvončice (L. Sagnier), mora obračunati s Kukom kako bi ih spasio.

programme.title: Table tennis: EP table tennis Zadar / Stolni tenis: EP stolni tenis Zadar
programme.desc: European table tennis championship, reportage / Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu, reportaža

programme.title: Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: The Knežević family from Šiškovci has been cultivating beekeeping for four generations. Their story was not without challenges, the head of the family survived a heart attack twice and returned to his work each time. Today, the whole family works side by side, producing top quality honey and at the same time contributing to the preservation of nature and biodiversity. The episode tells a story about perseverance, togetherness and love for work that overcomes obstacles. / Obitelj Knežević iz Šiškovaca već četiri generacije njeguje pčelarstvo. Njihova priča nije bila bez izazova, glava obitelji dvaput je preživio infarkt i svaki put se vraćao svom poslu. Danas cijela obitelj radi rame uz rame, proizvodeći vrhunski med i istodobno pridonoseći očuvanju prirode i bioraznolikosti. Epizoda donosi priču o ustrajnosti, zajedništvu i ljubavi prema poslu koji nadilazi prepreke.

programme.title: Svijet zabave
programme.desc: British Prince Andrew had to give up his titles due to new details in the "Epstein case" — but his problems don't end there. The Danish group Aqua is preparing a musical about their thirty-year career, and Bradley Cooper is returning to film direction in the new dark humor drama Is This Thing On?. TBF and Nina Badrić will provide a dose of domestic glamor this week! / Britanski princ Andrew morao se, zbog novih detalja u "slučaju Epstein", odreći svojih titula — no njegovim problemima tu nije kraj. Danska grupa Aqua priprema mjuzikl o svojoj tridesetogodišnjoj karijeri, a Bradley Cooper vraća se filmskoj režiji u novoj crnohumornoj drami Is This Thing On?. Za dozu domaćeg glamura ovoga se tjedna pobrinut će TBF i Nina Badrić!

programme.title: Christopher Reeve, vječni Superman
programme.desc: The whole world considers Christopher Reeve (1952 - 2004) to be Superman. More than 40 years after the release of Richard Donner's international hit, Christopher Reeve is still the undisputed embodiment of the superhero from Krypton. How did the American actor manage to connect the character and his name so closely? What kind of new life breathed into that hero of the novel, the embodiment of the American dream, that all actors later consider him a model for that role? Thanks to a previously unpublished interview that we managed to get just before the actor's untimely death, the film sheds light on the relationship between the two heroes, follows their development during nine years of cohabitation and afterwards, until the moment when the actor united with the superhero. / Cijeli svijet Christophera Reevea (1952. _ 2004.) smatra Supermanom. Više od 40 godina nakon izlaska međunarodnog filmskog hita Richarda Donnera, Christopher Reeve još je neosporno utjelovljenje superjunaka s Kriptona. Kako je Američki glumac uspio tako usko povezati lik i svoje ime? Kakav je to novi život udahnuo tom junaku romana, utjelovljenju američkog sna, da ga svi glumci poslije smatraju modelom za tu ulogu? Zahvaljujući dosad neobjavljenom intervjuu koji smo uspjeli dobiti netom prije preuranjene smrti glumca, film rasvjetljava veze između dva junaka, prati njihov razvoj tijekom devet godina suživota i nakon toga, sve do trenutka kad se glumac sjedinio sa superjunakom.

programme.title: Stadion
programme.desc: Weekly overview of the strongest European football leagues, as well as smaller national championships, and other current sports topics. / Tjedni pregled najjačih europskih nogometnih liga, kao i manjih nacionalnih prvenstava, te druge aktualne sportske teme.

programme.title: In the arena: Serena Williams / U areni: Serena Williams
programme.desc: While Serena struggled to continue her winning streak after winning her first Grand Slam tournament, Venus won four in two years. Serena finally found a winning formula, but that will mean nothing when she takes the court against the number one player in the world, her sister. Only one will emerge from that match as the winner. / Dok se Serena mučila nastaviti pobjednički niz nakon osvajanja prvog Grand Slam turnira, Venus je u dvije godine osvojila četiri. Serena je na koncu pronašla dobitničku formulu, ali to neće ništa značiti kad izađe na teren protiv prve igračice svijeta, svoje sestre. Samo će jedna iz tog meča izaći kao pobjednica.

programme.title: Foyleov rat
programme.desc: Pilots and their girlfriends live fast and die young in a tale of lust and passion, and Foyle discovers that appearances can sometimes be deceiving. / Piloti i njihove djevojke žive brzo i umiru mladi u priči o pohoti i strasti, a Foyle otkriva da privid katkad vara.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: When the Flyers reach the Stanley Cup Finals, Barry superstitiously asks the family to observe certain rituals. Geoff asks Lou and Linda to spend more time with Muriel. / Kad Flyersi stignu do finala Stanleyeva kupa, Barry iz praznovjerna traži od obitelji da se pridržava određenih rituala. Geoff traži od Loua i Linde da provode više vremena s Muriel.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: In his grandfather's apartment, Adam finds something that his grandfather wrote a long time ago and realizes that they have more in common than he thought. Erica and Geoff want some alone time. / Adam u djedovu stanu pronalazi nešto što je djed davno napisao i shvaća da imaju više zajedničkog nego što je mislio. Erica i Geoff žele biti malo sami.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: This Wednesday in the Reader's Club we are discussing the book Philosophy of Walking by Frederic Gros. Philosopher and writer Kristijan Vujičić, art historian and producer Paola Orlić, lawyer and Croatian language professor Zoran Maljković and literary critic Bozena Matijević are guests. / Ove srijede u Klubu čitatelja razgovaramo o knjizi Frederica Grosa Filozofija hodanja. Gostuju filozof i književnik Kristijan Vujičić, povjesničarka umjetnosti i producentica Paola Orlić, pravnik i profesor hrvatskog jezika Zoran Maljković te književna kritičarka Božena Matijević.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly decides to start dating again, but soon realizes that adult relationships are complicated and full of pitfalls. Barry discovers a new passion. / Beverly odlučuje ponovno krenuti na spojeve, no ubrzo shvaća da su odnosi među odraslima komplicirani i prepuni zamki. Barry otkriva novu strast.

programme.title: Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Erica is thinking about what she will do in life. She finds inspiration in the movie "Baby Boom" and thinks she has discovered how to have it all. Adam is shooting a remake of the music video for the song "Uptown Girl". He meets Carmen's father and decides to ingratiate himself with him by pretending to be something he is not. / Erica razmišlja čime će se baviti u životu. Nadahnuće pronađe u filmu "Baby Boom" te misli da je otkrila kako imati sve. Adam snima remake spota za pjesmu "Uptown Girl". Upoznaje Carmenina oca i odlučuje mu se dodvoriti glumeći da je nešto što nije.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Looking to escape south London, mother and son meet Sonali Shah in The Lothians, where they search for their ideal country escape, including an artist's studio. Sonali also explores the legacy of the 19th century Scottish conservationist known in America as the Father of National Parks. / Želeći pobjeći iz južnog Londona, majka i sin susreću Sonali Shah u The Lothians, gdje traže svoj idealni seoski bijeg, uključujući i umjetnički atelje. Sonali također istražuje naslijeđe škotskog konzervatora iz 19. stoljeća, poznatog u Americi kao Otac nacionalnih parkova.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George meets the couple who are turning the ship's wheelhouse into a glamping house, revisits the designer from the first season to see his beautiful new eco-buildings, and finally shows us his completed house in the air. / George upoznaje par koji kormilarnicu broda pretvara u kućicu za glamping, ponovno posjećuje dizajnera iz prve sezone kako bi razgledao njegove prekrasne nove ekograđevine, a napokon će nam pokazati i svoju dovršenu kućicu u zraku.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Today's dishes are inspired by French cuisine, which Gordon fell in love with as a young chef. We will see a wonderful salad from Nice with tuna, and Gordon's youngest daughter Tilly will help him prepare the perfect chicken fricassee with a side of fried potatoes and a sensational "crème caramel" with lavender. / Današnja su jela nadahnuta francuskom kuhinjom, u koju se Gordon zaljubio još kao mladi kuhar. Vidjet ćemo krasnu salatu iz Nice s tunjevinom, a Gordonova najmlađa kći Tilly pomoći će mu da pripremi savršeni pileći frikase s prilogom od prženog krumpira te senzacionalni "crème caramel" s lavandom.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Sisters Julia and Angela have a deep connection with Crete, which they have been visiting since childhood. Even after the loss of the parents, this annual tradition continued. Their garden is currently in disarray, full of construction debris. It is crying out for a makeover and the sisters would be happy to bring it the atmosphere of a vacation in Crete: blue and white colors, a pergola, olive trees, lush greenery and corners bathed in the sun. With a budget of £6,000, can Charlie and Chris bring the spirit of Crete to Yateley and turn the space into a Mediterranean dream garden? / Sestre Juliju i Angelu veže duboka povezanost s Kretom koju posjećuju još od djetinjstva. Čak i nakon gubitka roditelja ta se godišnja tradicija nastavila. Vrt im je trenutačno u rasulu, pun građevinskog smeća. Vapi za preobrazbom i sestre bi u njega rado unijele atmosferu ljetovanja na Kreti: plave i bijele boje, pergolu, drvo masline, bujno zelenilo i kutke okupane suncem. Mogu li uz budžet od 6000 funta Charlie i Chris prenijeti duh Krete u Yateley i pretvoriti prostor u mediteranski vrt iz snova?

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue welcomes Lisa Hogan _ who prepares venison served with a homemade bun, salsa and burrata _ and prepares three versions of tiramisu with John's help. / Prue pozdravlja Lisu Hogan _ koja priređuje divljač posluženu s domaćom lepinjom, salsom i burratom _ i uz Johnovu pomoć priprema tri verzije tiramisua.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: It's cold outside the tent. Even the tea can no longer be warm. Samuel Hade sits at 4,500 meters above sea level and has breakfast with his companion Maram. There is also his donkey Sir Edward. This filmmaker went on foot to the roof of the world, to a Kyrgyz nomadic village in the middle of nowhere. People open their doors and hearts to him. At night, he sleeps under a tent in solitude or hides in the meager huts where the locals share meals with him as if it were a matter of course. / Ispred šatora je hladno. Čak ni čaj više ne može ugrijati. Samuel Hade sjedi na 4500 mnv i doručkuje sa svojim pratiocem Maramom. Tu je i njegov magarac Sir Edward. Ovaj filmaš uputio se pješice na krov svijeta, u kirgisko nomadsko selo usred nigdine. Ljudi mu otvaraju vrata i srca. Noću spava pod šatorom na osami ili se sklanja u oskudne kolibe u kojima mještani dijele obroke s njim kao da se to samo po sebi razumije.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Looking to escape south London, mother and son meet Sonali Shah in The Lothians, where they search for their ideal country escape, including an artist's studio. Sonali also explores the legacy of the 19th century Scottish conservationist known in America as the Father of National Parks. / Želeći pobjeći iz južnog Londona, majka i sin susreću Sonali Shah u The Lothians, gdje traže svoj idealni seoski bijeg, uključujući i umjetnički atelje. Sonali također istražuje naslijeđe škotskog konzervatora iz 19. stoljeća, poznatog u Americi kao Otac nacionalnih parkova.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George meets the couple who are turning the ship's wheelhouse into a glamping house, revisits the designer from the first season to see his beautiful new eco-buildings, and finally shows us his completed house in the air. / George upoznaje par koji kormilarnicu broda pretvara u kućicu za glamping, ponovno posjećuje dizajnera iz prve sezone kako bi razgledao njegove prekrasne nove ekograđevine, a napokon će nam pokazati i svoju dovršenu kućicu u zraku.

We will see a wonderful salad from Nice with tuna, and Gordon's youngest daughter Tilly will help him prepare the perfect chicken fricassee with a side of fried potatoes and a sensational "crème caramel" with lavender. / Današnja su jela nadahnuta francuskom kuhinjom, u koju se Gordon zaljubio još kao mladi kuhar. Vidjet ćemo krasnu salatu iz Nice s tunjevinom, a Gordonova najmlađa kći Tilly pomoći će mu da pripremi savršeni pileći frikase s prilogom od prženog krumpira te senzacionalni "crème caramel" s lavandom.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Sisters Julia and Angela have a deep connection with Crete, which they have been visiting since childhood. Even after the loss of the parents, this annual tradition continued. Their garden is currently in disarray, full of construction debris. It is crying out for a makeover and the sisters would be happy to bring it the atmosphere of a vacation in Crete: blue and white colors, a pergola, olive trees, lush greenery and corners bathed in the sun. With a budget of £6,000, can Charlie and Chris bring the spirit of Crete to Yateley and turn the space into a Mediterranean dream garden? / Sestre Juliju i Angelu veže duboka povezanost s Kretom koju posjećuju još od djetinjstva. Čak i nakon gubitka roditelja ta se godišnja tradicija nastavila. Vrt im je trenutačno u rasulu, pun građevinskog smeća. Vapi za preobrazbom i sestre bi u njega rado unijele atmosferu ljetovanja na Kreti: plave i bijele boje, pergolu, drvo masline, bujno zelenilo i kutke okupane suncem. Mogu li uz budžet od 6000 funta Charlie i Chris prenijeti duh Krete u Yateley i pretvoriti prostor u mediteranski vrt iz snova?

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue welcomes Lisa Hogan _ who prepares venison served with a homemade bun, salsa and burrata _ and prepares three versions of tiramisu with John's help. / Prue pozdravlja Lisu Hogan _ koja priređuje divljač posluženu s domaćom lepinjom, salsom i burratom _ i uz Johnovu pomoć priprema tri verzije tiramisua.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: A teenage girl, Beatrice, was found wandering the meadows of Oxford naked. She doesn't remember anything, but forensics reveal that she was raped after the criminal drugged her with an anti-insomnia drug. Lewis and Hathaway narrow down the list of suspects and eventually reach the computer science teacher at Beatrice's school. But the suspect Oswald Cooper has a solid alibi, moreover, he is vouched for by three men, well-known pillars of society. When Cooper is found murdered and castrated, revenge is the obvious motive for the attack on Beatrice, but the police can't prove that Cooper was the attacker, and Lewis tries hard to find a hole in Cooper's alibi. / Tinejdžerica Beatrice pronađena je kako gola luta livadama Oxforda. Ne sjeća se ničega, ali forenzičari otkrivaju da je silovana nakon što ju je zločinac drogirao lijekom protiv nesanice. Lewis i Hathaway sužavaju popis osumnjičenih i naposljetku dolaze do profesora informatike u Beatriceinoj školi. Ali osumnjičeni Oswald Cooper ima čvrst alibi, štoviše, za njega jamče tri čovjeka, poznati stupovi društva. Kada Coopera pronađu ubijenog i kastriranog, očit je motiv osveta za napad na Beatrice, ali policija ne može dokazati da je Cooper bio napadač, a Lewis uza sav trud ne uspijeva pronaći rupu u Cooperovu alibiju.

programme.title: Samo lagano
programme.desc: Today we'll really just take it easy, because we'll hang out with people who managed to put hustle and bustle "on hold", so they continue through life calmly... or at least more calmly... Today we hang out with those who have learned to enjoy the moment and we hope that today's show will inspire you to slow down, at least for a while... And the next time you find yourself overwhelmed by obligations, remember the words of the Danish philosopher Soren Kierkegaard _ "Life is not a problem to be solved, but a reality to be experienced." And then continue on _ but ONLY SLIGHTLY! / Danas ćemo uistinu samo lagano, jer ćemo se družiti s ljudima koji su uspjeli užurbanost staviti "na čekanje", pa nastavljaju kroz život mirno... ili barem mirnije... Danas se družimo s onima koji su naučili uživati u trenutku i nadamo se da ćemo vas današnjom emisijom nadahnuti da, barem nakratko, usporite... A kada se sljedeći put nađete preplavljeni obvezama, sjetite se riječi danskog filozofa Sorena Kierkegaarda _ "Život nije problem koji treba riješiti, već stvarnost koju treba doživjeti." I onda nastavite dalje _ ali SAMO LAGANO!

programme.title: SuperSport HNL
programme.desc: Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the highest ranking football competition in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Association. Until 2022, the league was called the First Croatian Football League. The ten best football clubs from Croatia participate in SuperSport HNL. The club that is crowned national champion has the opportunity to try out for the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA Champions League, while the second and third placed teams enter the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA European Conference League. / Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu.

programme.title: Mlade nade
programme.desc: In the series "Young Hopes", young and talented sportsmen and women are presented in twelve five-minute episodes. / U serijalu "Mlade nade" kroz dvanaest petominutnih epizoda predstavljaju se mladi i talentirani sportaši i sportašice.

programme.title: SuperSport HNL
programme.desc: Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the highest ranking football competition in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Association. Until 2022, the league was called the First Croatian Football League. The ten best football clubs from Croatia participate in SuperSport HNL. The club that is crowned national champion has the opportunity to try out for the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA Champions League, while the second and third placed teams enter the 2nd preliminary round of the UEFA European Conference League. / Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. programme.title: Auto Market Magazin
programme.desc: Every week, the show for car enthusiasts presents new car models, technological innovations, tests new vehicles, and provides advice on maintenance. / U emisiji za ljubitelje automobila svaki tjedan predstavljaju se novi modeli automobila, tehnološke inovacije, testiraju nova vozila, donose savjeti o održavanju.

programme.title: Across the ocean to our roots / Preko oceana do naših korijena
programme.desc: This documentary chronicles the powerful journey of the Homeland Program, an initiative designed to reconnect young people of Croatian descent with their heritage. The program, organized by the Association of Croatian-American Professionals (ACAP) in partnership with the Central State Office for Croats Abroad, brought together 40 participants aged 18 to 30 from all over the world on a two-week cultural tour of Croatia in June 2025 _ from Konavle in the south to Ilok in the east. Documentary filmmaker Flora Lennihan participated in this year's group, documenting their experiences, interactions and personal discoveries during the trip. This was the fourth edition of the Domovina program, which should continue in the coming years. The film, shot in cooperation with Croatian Radio and Television (HRT), will premiere at the 9th annual ACAP conference in Chicago on October 25. / Ovaj dokumentarni film bilježi snažno putovanje Programa Domovina, inicijative osmišljene kako bi se mladi ljudi hrvatskog podrijetla ponovno povezali sa svojom baštinom. Program, koji je organizirala Udruga hrvatsko-američkih profesionalaca (ACAP) u partnerstvu sa Središnjim državnim uredom za Hrvate izvan RH, okupio je 40 sudionika u dobi od 18 do 30 godina iz cijelog svijeta na dvotjednoj kulturnoj turneji po Hrvatskoj u lipnju 2025. _ od Konavala na jugu do Iloka na istoku. Dokumentaristica Flora Lennihan sudjelovala je u ovogodišnjoj skupini, dokumentirajući njihova iskustva, interakcije i osobna otkrića tijekom putovanja. Ovo je bila četvrto izdanje programa Domovina, koji bi se trebao nastaviti i u nadolazećim godinama. Film, snimljen u suradnji s Hrvatskom radiotelevizijom (HRT), premijerno će biti prikazan na 9. godišnjoj konferenciji ACAP-a u Chicagu 25. listopada.

programme.title: River: Sea / Rijeka: More
programme.desc: A mosaic informative show dedicated to the wealth of our Adriatic Sea, coast and coastline. It brings interesting reports on topics related to life at sea and by it. It is broadcast from HRT's studios in Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Pula. / Mozaična informativna emisija posvećena bogatstvu našeg Jadranskog mora, obale i priobalja. Donosi zanimljive reportaže o temama vezanim za život na moru i uz njega. Emitira se iz HRT-ovih studija Split, Rijeka, Zadar i Pula.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Raising the young generation in the intricate jungle habitat requires ingenuity _ parents must master their habitat and know how to use every opportunity to provide a future for the new generation. In faraway Bhutan, a pair of red-throated hornbills live in a lifelong partnership built on trust and commitment. The mother remains imprisoned in the tree for a hundred days and relies on the male as the breadwinner of the family. In Sri Lanka, the bold snub-nosed frog shares a home with a large poisonous tarantula. This unexpected union consists of a harmonious tandem: the tarantula acts as a living bodyguard, and the tiny frog keeps to the house and keeps their shared home clean. In Jamaica, a genius mother shrimp works tirelessly to raise a brood of tiny shrimp. With professional precision, with the help of the resources available in the forest, he creates favorable conditions for his nursery. Elsewhere, jungle parents need room to move _ and others are forced to adapt to changes in the habitat around them. In Australia, the cassowary leads its birds through new dangers in the oldest rainforest in the world. Forest fires in the Amazon drive a rarely seen female tapir in search of new territory and vital minerals, and in China, griffon langurs barely survive on the edge of life. The limestone peaks they live on are surrounded by cultivated land and the langurs have to fight for what is left so that their offspring have a safe habitat to grow. Unexpectedly, new science shows that ancient trees in jungles are not only a source of life for their offspring, but also for countless other rainforest families, from the tops of the crowns, all the way down to the leafy undergrowth. Their influence will be the key to our survival. / Podizanje mladog naraštaja u zamršenom staništu džungle iziskuje domišljatost _ roditelji moraju zagospodariti svojim staništem i znati iskoristiti svaku priliku da bi novom naraštaju omogućili budućnost. U dalekom Butanu par crvenogrlih kljunorožaca živi u doživotnom partnerstvu izgrađenom na povjerenju i predanosti. Majka stotinu dana ostaje zatočena u stablu i pouzdaje se u mužjaka kao hranitelja obitelji. U Šri Lanki odvažna tuponosa žaba dijeli dom s velikom otrovnom tarantulom. Taj neočekivani spoj sastoji se od skladnog tandema: tarantula djeluje kao živi tjelohranitelj, a sitna žaba drži se kuće i održava čistoću njihova zajedničkog doma. Na Jamajci genijalna majka račica neumorno radi na podizanju legla sitnih račića. Stručnom preciznošću s pomoću resursa dostupnih u šumi stvara povoljne uvjete za svoje gojilište. Drugdje roditelji u džungli trebaju prostor za kretanje _ a drugi su prisiljeni prilagoditi se promjenama staništa oko njih. U Australiji kazuar vodi svoje ptiće kroz nove opasnosti u najstarijoj prašumi na svijetu. Šumski požari u Amazoniji tjeraju rijetko viđenu ženku tapira u potragu za novim teritorijem i vitalnim mineralima, a u Kini bjeloglavi languri jedva se održavaju na rubu života. Vapnenački vrhunci na kojima žive okruženi su obrađenom zemljom i languri se moraju boriti za ono što je preostalo kako bi njihovo potomstvo imalo sigurno stanište za rast. Neočekivano, nova znanost pokazuje da drevna stabla u džunglama nisu izvor života samo za svoje potomstvo, nego i za nebrojene druge prašumske obitelji, od vrhova krošnji, sve do lisnatog nastora. Njihov će utjecaj biti ključ našeg opstanka.

programme.title: My flesh and blood / Moja krv i meso
programme.desc: After her boyfriend, a drug lord, accuses her of stealing a huge sum of money from the cartel, 16-year-old Lydia (E. Moriarty) runs away with her elderly father, the only person who supports her in this world. Her father John Link (M. Gibson) was once a drunkard, a drug addict and an outlaw, and at one time also a prisoner, but now he has decided to do the right thing at least once in his life and protect his daughter from evil... / Nakon što je njezin dečko, narkobos, optuži da je kartelu ukrala golemu svotu novca, 16-godišnja Lydia (E. Moriarty) bježi zajedno sa svojim postarijim ocem, jedinom osobom koja joj je na ovome svijetu podrška. Njezin je otac John Link (M. Gibson) nekoć bio pijanac, ovisnik o drogi i odmetnik, a svojevremeno i zatvorenik, ali sada je odlučio bar jednom u životu postupiti kako treba i zaštititi svoju kćer od zla...

programme.title: Zaljev
programme.desc: Julie's life begins to fall apart further when Craig's lies surface, although he tries very hard to explain where he was the night Hannah was killed. That said, Tommy seems to know more about what Craig has been up to than he's letting on. And while the people of Morecambe want to know they are safe in the town, Karen's actions at Hanna's vigil put her job at risk. Manning is under increasing pressure, dissatisfaction in the team is growing, and the investigation is falling into place. Jenn has more and more problems at home, and her relationship with Chris is on even shakier feet. New information about Hanna and Cal comes to light, and the team finds an unexpected clue. / Julien život počinje se dodatno raspadati kad na površinu isplivaju Craigove laži, premda se on silno trudi objasniti gdje je bio one noći kad je Hannah ubijena. Uz to, čini se da Tommy zna više o tome što je Craig radio negoli što govori. I dok stanovnici Morecambea žele znati da su u gradu sigurni, Karen zbog postupanja na bdijenju za Hannu ugrozi svoje radno mjesto. Manning je pod sve većim pritiskom, nezadovoljstvo u ekipi raste, a istraga tapka na mjestu. Jenn ima sve više problema kod kuće pa je njezina veza s Chrisom na još klimavijim nogama. Na vidjelo izlaze nove informacije o Hanni i Calu, a ekipa nalazi neočekivani trag.
