programme.desc: Piers Taylor and Caroline Quentin will travel to Switzerland, where architecture is influenced by neighboring countries and dramatic nature. The house in Les Jeurs was built in the shadow of Mont Blanc at 1300 m above sea level in the Alps. It is a modern version of a traditional Swiss wooden house. The second house lies on the western shore of Lake Maggiore, in an area known for its warm climate and Italian influence. The third house is located close to Zurich. The last house is a villa on the lake with a view of Firvaldštet lake. / Piers Taylor i Caroline Quentin otputovat će u Švicarsku, u kojoj je arhitektura pod utjecajem susjednih zemalja i dramatične prirode. Kuća u Les Jeursu izgrađena je u sjeni Mont Blanca na 1300 m nadmorske visine u Alpama. Riječ je o modernoj inačici tradicionalne švicarske drvene kuće. Druga kuća leži na zapadnoj obali jezera Maggiore, na području poznatom po toploj klimi i talijanskom utjecaju. Treća se kuća smjestila nadomak Zuricha. Posljednja je kuća vila na jezeru s pogledom na Firvaldštetsko jezero.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: In today's sequel, Gordon will show how he prepares his favorite street food at home, such as delicious fried tortillas with shrimp and irresistible salted popcorn with caramel. Son Jack will help him prepare buttermilk fried chicken, one of the Ramsay family's favorite dishes. / Gordon će u današnjem nastavku pokazati kako kod kuće priprema njemu najdraža ulična jela poput slasnih preprženih tortilja s kozicama i neodoljivih slanih kokica s karamelom. Sin Jack pomoći će mu da pripremi prženu piletinu s mlaćenicom, jedno od omiljenih jela u obitelji Ramsay.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: Danni and Dawn decided to create a naughty wonderland for their five-year-old twins Ellie and Sofia. With a budget of £5,000 Charlie and Flo let their creative, playful imaginations run wild. Danni and Dawn moved into their newly built home four years ago. With two small children, the garden was not a priority for them. Now they have decided to transform that space and introduce twists instead of symmetry. Their goal is to create a magical place for Ellie and Sofia where the girls can explore, play hide and seek and build secret hiding places. In addition, they also want a place where the two of them can rest and relax in the shade. / Danni i Dawn odlučile su stvoriti nestašnu zemlju čudesa za svoje petogodišnje blizanke Ellie i Sofiju. Uz budžet od 5000 funta Charlie i Flo puštaju na volju svojoj kreativnoj razigranoj mašti. Danni i Dawn uselile su se u svoj novoizgrađeni dom prije četiri godine. Uz dvoje male djece vrt im nije bio prioritetan. Sad su odlučile preobraziti taj prostor i u njega unijeti vijuge umjesto simetrije. Cilj im je stvoriti čarobno mjesto za Ellie i Sofiju gdje će curice moći istraživati, igrati se skrivača i graditi tajna skrovišta. Usto, također žele mjesto gdje će se njih dvije moći odmarati i opuštati u hladu.

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue greets Mark Lane _ who is preparing a warm kale salad with peanut dressing and plum cake _ and remembers how to make a dish her husband hasn't eaten in nearly twenty years. / Prue pozdravlja Marka Lanea _ koji priprema toplu salatu od kelja s preljevom od kikirikija i kolač od šljive _ te se prisjeća načina izrade jela koje njezin suprug nije jeo gotovo dvadeset godina.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: After the preparation of the university play The Merchant of Venice is abruptly interrupted by the death of the lead actor, Lewis is called to investigate a case that will lead him to confront his own past. / Nakon što pripremu sveučilišne predstave Mletački trgovac naglo prekine smrt glavnoga glumca, Lewis je pozvan da istraži slučaj koji će ga navesti na suočavanje s vlastitom prošlosti.

programme.title: TV kalendar
programme.desc: Documentary-historical show, broadcast daily since 1976. It shows important events and anniversaries from Croatian and world history. / Dokumentarno-povijesna emisija, emitira se svakodnevno od 1976. godine. Prikazuje važne događaje i obljetnice iz hrvatske i svjetske povijesti.

programme.title: Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: The show brings current events, new scientific discoveries, interesting facts from the animal and plant world, and social phenomena. We will look into all the corners of the Earth, and we will not forget the rest of the universe either. We bring the serious, but also the more casual, fun side of science. / Emisija donosi aktualnosti, nova znanstvena otkrića, zanimljivosti iz životinjskog i biljnog svijeta te društvene fenomene. Zavirit ćemo u sve kutke Zemlje, a nećemo zaboraviti ni ostatak svemira. Donosimo ozbiljnu, ali i onu ležerniju, zabavnu stranu znanosti.

programme.title: Prometej
programme.desc: The weekly show about science, new knowledge and innovations that practically change our world, improving our everyday life, presents the professional and scientific achievements of our scientists in all scientific fields. / Tjedna emisija o znanosti, novim spoznajama i inovacijama koje praktično mijenjaju naš svijet poboljšavajući nam svakodnevicu, predstavlja stručna i znanstvena postignuća naših znanstvenika u svim znanstvenim područjima.

programme.title: Poslovni plan
programme.desc: The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP trends, problems and growth generators. / Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta.

programme.title: Koordinacija
programme.desc: The Coordination team takes you to the capital of Albania _ the city of colors and incredible skyscrapers. The guest of Notes is professor emeritus Tihomir Jukić, one of the most respected Croatian urban planners. In Miljokaz, we introduce you to a Croat who manages million-dollar construction projects in Germany, and takes care of his olive grove in Croatia. In the new section Under the helmet, we present a construction engineer who reveals construction irregularities on social networks that no one mentions. Youtuber and craftsman Doctor DS will show how, with quality paints and coatings, an old planter can take on a completely new look. / Ekipa Koordinacije vodi vas u glavni grad Albanije _ grad boja i nevjerojatnih nebodera. Gost Notesa je profesor emeritus Tihomir Jukić, jedan od najuglednijih hrvatskih urbanista. U Miljokazu vas upoznajemo s Hrvatom koji u Njemačkoj vodi milijunske građevinske projekte, a u Hrvatskoj se brine o svojem masliniku. U novoj rubrici Ispod kacige predstavljamo inženjerku građevinarstva koja na društvenim mrežama otkriva građevinske nepravilnosti koje nitko ne spominje. Youtuber i majstor Doctor DS pokazat će kako uz kvalitetne boje i premaze stara žardinjera može poprimiti potpuno novi izgled.

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: The weekly show brings short reports about the everyday life of Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina, follows the political scene there, events in the Croatian community, reminds us of the greats of Croatian culture, science and history. / Tjedna emisija, donosi kratke reportaže o svakodnevici Hrvata u BiH, prati tamošnju političku scenu, događaje u hrvatskoj zajednici, podsjeća na velikane hrvatske kulture, znanosti i povijesti.

programme.title: Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herb hunter visits the southernmost branch of Lička Plješivice _ Poštak. The highest rounded peak on the northern ridge is Bijeli vrh, 1446 meters high. From a distance, it stands out because of the steep, almost cut-off slope below the peak. In addition to the wide vistas, it is interesting as a hiker because of the natural park of unusual stone sculptures on the grassy slope next to the marked trail, at an altitude of 1,200 meters. Some of the plants in this episode are small cacti, narrow-leaved lungwort, stout gorse, bearberry, large sasa, and medicinal primrose. The guests of the episode are Gradimira Bumbak, vice president of HPD Kamenar from Šibenik, and Vesna Bogunović, a lover of plants. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje najjužniji ogranak Ličke Plješivice _ Poštak. Najviši zaobljeni vrh na sjevernom grebenu je Bijeli vrh, visok 1446 metara. Iz daljine se posebno ističe po strmoj, gotovo odsječenoj padini ispod vrha. Osim zbog širokih vidika planinarski je zanimljiv zbog prirodnog parka neobičnih kamenih skulptura na travnatoj padini pokraj markirane staze, na visini od 1200 metara. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su mali kaćun, uskolisni plućnjak, čvrsta šupaljka, medvjedka, velika sasa i ljekoviti jaglac. Gosti epizode su Gradimira Bumbak, potpredsjednica HPD Kamenar iz Šibenika te Vesna Bogunović, zaljubljenica u bilje.

programme.title: Hit dana
programme.desc: Every weekday, Hit presents the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers. / U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača.

programme.title: Vlakom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Sir Tony Robinson will take the train to the unknown, traveling from Canada to Alaska. He looks forward to meeting Canadians and exploring the great wilderness in this part of the world, from the Rocky Mountains to the beautiful glaciers of Alaska. The journey begins in the high-tech city of Seattle, home to Amazon, Microsoft and Starbucks. The Amtrack Cascades train will take him across the border into Canada, where he will immediately be surprised by the beauty of Vancouver and the warmth of Canadians. / Sir Tony Robinson će se vlakom zaputiti u nepoznato putujući iz Kanade u Aljasku. Veseli se upoznavanju Kanađana i istraživanju velike divljine u ovom dijelu svijeta, od planina Stjenjaka do prelijepih glečera Aljaske. Putovanje počinje u gradu visoke tehnologije Seattleu gdje sjedišta imaju Amazon, Microsoft i Starbucks. Vlak Amtrack Cascades prevest će ga preko granice u Kanadu gdje će ga odmah iznenaditi ljepota Vancouvera i toplina Kanađana.

programme.title: The trap of social networks - five women against five major platforms / Zamka društvenih mreža - pet žena protiv pet velikih platformi
programme.desc: Adolescents who spend more than five hours a day on their smartphones are 66% more likely to develop suicidal tendencies than those who use them for up to one hour a day. 44 US states are currently suing Meta, blaming the company for making an entire generation sick. Faced with powerful tech giants like Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X and Discord, how can we possibly protect children and their childhoods? For the first time in history, state legislators and parents in the US and Europe are joining forces to fight the digital giants. Among them are five women who decided to turn their everyday lives upside down to fight against five major platforms. Alexis, Elisabet, Sofia, Laure and Socheata. They are victims, mothers, doctors and lawyers. They are all behind a movement whose goal is to change the fate of future generations. Alexis, a victim of screen addiction, was among the first to sue Meta, accusing her of "inciting suicide." Elisabet is a mother of three children, and in just a few days more than 10,000 parents joined her WhatsApp group in the fight for "youth without mobile phones". As a result, the state banned smartphones in schools. Sofia is a psychiatrist and a pioneer in the treatment of screen addiction in children, some of whom are as young as seven years old. Socheata joined the fight when her son found himself under the manipulation of an internet predator. She joined the association and, together with police officers specializing in cybercrime, catches pedophiles. Laure is a lawyer determined to change the laws that protect the Big Five. Through the difficulties these women face, we will discover how digital control is a major public health and safety problem that exceeds the limits of our expectations. / Adolescenti koji za svojim pametnim telefonima provode više od pet sati na dan imaju 66 % više izgleda da će razviti suicidalne sklonosti negoli oni koji se njima koriste do jednog sata na dan. 44 američke savezne države trenutačne tuže Metu, okrivljujući kompaniju za pobolijevanje cijele generacije. Suočeni s moćnim tehnološkim divovima poput Mete, TikToka, Snapchata, X-a i Discorda, kako uopće možemo zaštititi djecu i njihovo djetinjstvo? Prvi put u povijesti državni zakonodavci i roditelji u SAD-u i Europi udružuju snage u borbi protiv digitalnih divova. Među njima je pet žena koje su odlučile preokrenuti svoj svakodnevni život naglavačke kako bi krenule u borbu protiv pet velikih platformi. Alexis, Elisabet, Sofia, Laure i Socheata. One su žrtve, majke, liječnice i odvjetnice. Sve stoje iza pokreta kojem je cilj promijeniti sudbinu budućih naraštaja. Alexis, žrtva ovisnosti o ekranu, bila je među prvima koji su tužili Metu, optužujući je za "poticanje na samoubojstvo". Elisabet je majka troje djece, a u samo nekoliko dana više od 10.000 roditelja pridružilo se njezinoj WhatsApp grupi u borbi za "mladost bez mobitela". Kao rezultat toga, država je zabranila pametne telefone u školama. Sofia je psihijatrica i pionirka u liječenju ovisnosti o ekranu kod djece, od kojih neki imaju samo sedam godina. Socheata se pridružila borbi kad se njezin sin našao pod manipulacijom internetskog predatora. Priključila se udruženju i zajedno s policajcima specijaliziranim za kibernetički kriminal hvata pedofile. Laure je odvjetnica odlučna u tome da promijeni zakone koji štite velikih pet. Kroz poteškoće s kojima se susreću ove žena otkrit ćemo kako je digitalna kontrola veliki problem javnog zdravstva i sigurnosti koji prelazi granice naših očekivanja.

programme.title: In the mafia den / U mafijaškoj jazbini
programme.desc: After a personal and professional downfall, police officer Bobby Bellucci infiltrates a mafia network connected to the notorious club Gemini Lounge. As he tries to expose the gang from the inside, he sinks deeper and deeper into a world of violence and betrayal. Although the policeman's character is fictional, the plot is based on the real-life Roy DeMeo mafia group that operated in Brooklyn in the 1970s and 1980s, and the club is, according to the FBI, the site of numerous murders linked to the Gambino family. / Nakon osobnog i profesionalnog pada, policajac Bobbyj Belucci infiltrira se u mafijašku mrežu povezanu s ozloglašenim klubom Gemini Lounge. Dok pokušava razotkriti bandu iznutra, sve dublje tone u svijet nasilja i izdaje. Iako je lik policajca fiktivan, radnja se temelji na stvarnoj mafijaškoj grupi Roya DeMea koja je djelovala u Brooklynu 1970-tih i 1980-tih, a klub je, prema FBI-ju, mjesto brojnih ubojstava povezanih s obitelji Gambino.

programme.title: Zaljev
programme.desc: In the Serious Crimes Department, everything changes when a new commander takes over. She is more direct than Manning, so the team has a hard time adapting to the new way of working, but is forced to accept the new situation in order to find new clues in Hanna's case. Erin gets stuck at work due to a misjudgment, and Jenn has to choose between family and the police, which ultimately leaves Chris very disappointed. Jenn loses Julie's trust after she arrests Craig. With the pressure mounting, Jenna's grief over her father's death suddenly comes to light, affecting her entire family. / U Odjelu teških zločina sve se mijenja kad na čelo dođe nova zapovjednica. Izravnija je od Manninga pa se ekipa teško prilagođava novom načinu rada, no primorana je prihvatiti novonastalu situaciju kako bi došla do novih tragova u Hanninu slučaju. Erin zbog pogrešne procjene zaglibi na poslu pa Jenn mora birati između obitelji i policije, zbog čega se Chris naposljetku itekako razočara. Jenn gubi Julieno povjerenje nakon što uhiti Craiga. S obzirom na to da pritisak sve više raste, Jennina tuga zbog očeve smrti iznenada izađe na vidjelo, što utječe na cijelu njezinu obitelj.

programme.title: Lewis
programme.desc: After the preparation of the university play The Merchant of Venice is abruptly interrupted by the death of the lead actor, Lewis is called to investigate a case that will lead him to confront his own past. / Nakon što pripremu sveučilišne predstave Mletački trgovac naglo prekine smrt glavnoga glumca, Lewis je pozvan da istraži slučaj koji će ga navesti na suočavanje s vlastitom prošlosti.

programme.title: who cuts your hair? / ko te šiša?
programme.desc: Božica is at constant war with Žigmund, the owner of the neighboring hair salon, and is trying to attract customers to her hair salon with a new marketing campaign. Lili and Sanja do not have enough understanding of their mother's marketing efforts. Lili dedicated herself to a new hobby, pole dancing, and Sanja found the love of her life. The goddess, of course, must not find out about her daughter's new activities, because neither pole dancing nor the new chosen one is something she would approve of... / Božica u stalnom ratu sa Žigmundom, vlasnikom susjednog frizerskog salona, pokušava novom marketinškom akcijom privući mušterije u svoj frizerski salon. Lili i Sanja nemaju dovoljno razumijevanja za majčine marketinške pothvate. Lili se posvetila novom hobiju, plesu na štangi, a Sanja je pronašla ljubav svog života. Božica, dakako, ne smije doznati za nove aktivnosti svojih kćeri, jer ni ples na štangi, ni novi izabranik nisu nešto što bi odobrila...

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: As Tomás' body lies in the greenhouse, suspicions begin to spread about who the culprit is, but Cruz tries to nip them in the bud. Jana wants to get rid of the ring Tomás gave her, which could incriminate her, but it won't go smoothly. Cruz resists, but Alonso eventually calls the Civil Guard and Sergeant Conrado arrives at the La Promesa estate and begins an investigation. / Dok Tomásovo tijelo leži u stakleniku, počinju se širiti sumnje o tome tko je krivac, ali Cruz ih nastoji sasjeći u korijenu. Jana se želi riješiti prstena koji joj je dao Tomás, a koji bi ju mogao inkriminirati, ali to neće proći glatko. Cruz se opire, ali Alonso na kraju pozove civilnu gardu i narednik Conrado stiže na imanje La Promesa te pokreće istragu.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple from Doncaster, South Yorkshire, find a new home in the beautiful Welsh valleys, The Valleys. Alistair will demonstrate his dexterity with heights in a demonstration exercise by volunteers of the local mountain rescue service. / Alistair Appleton pomaže paru iz Doncastera, na jugu Yorkshirea, pronaći novi dom u prekrasnim velškim dolinama, The Valleys. Svoju spretnost s visinama Alistair će iskazati i u pokaznoj vježbi volontera lokalne službe gorskog spašavanja.

programme.title: Najčudesniji domovi na svijetu
programme.desc: Piers Taylor and Caroline Quentin will travel to Japan, a country where innovation meets traditional design. You can only build on a small area of ​​Japan, so there is beauty even in small spaces. The first is a house in Izura, a coastal area two hours' drive east of Tokyo. Next is the house "Jikka" in Izukogen. Old friends Nobuko and Sachiko decided to build a home to live in when they retire, and they also opened a diner there for the local community. 90% of Japanese people live in cities, so Piers and Caroline will go to Hiroshima, where the Optical Glass House is. The last home is the Glass House for divers, which is located on the coast of the island of Etajima. / Piers Taylor i Caroline Quentin otputovat će u Japan, zemlju u kojoj se spajaju inovacije i tradicionalni dizajn. Graditi se može samo na maloj površini Japana pa je ondje ljepota i u malim prostorima. Prva je kuća u Izuri, obalnom području udaljenom dva sata vožnje istočno od Tokija. Slijedi kuća "Jikka" u Izukogenu. Stare prijateljice Nobuko i Sachiko odlučile su izgraditi dom u kojem će živjeti kad odu u mirovinu, a ondje su otvorile i zalogajnicu za lokalnu zajednicu. 90% Japanaca stanuje u gradovima pa će Piers i Caroline otići u Hirošimu u kojoj je Kuća s optičkim staklom. Posljednji je dom Staklena kuća za ronioca, koja se smjestila na obali otoka Etajime.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: The Art of Home Cooking / Gordon Ramsay: Umijeće kuhanja kod kuće
programme.desc: Gordon will show him his favorite Italian dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner. We will see frittata with sausage meat with fennel and grilled sardines with "gremolata" sauce. Gordon's son Jack will help him prepare the stuffed rusks, the beef pappardelle and the sensational hazelnut panna cotta. / Gordon će pokazati njemu najdraža talijanska jela za doručak, ručak i večeru. Vidjet ćemo fritaju s mesom kobasica s komoračem i srdele s grila s umakom "gremolatom". Gordonov sin Jack pomoći će mu da pripremi prepečence s nadjevima, "pappardelle" s govedinom i senzacionalnu "panna cottu" s krokantom od lješnjaka.

programme.title: Spašavatelji vrtova
programme.desc: The most beautiful detail in Anooshia's garden in Leeds is the clothes drying rack because it's such a lovely vibrant colour! Except for a few spiky plants, the garden is dull and impersonal. With a budget of £5,000 she wants to transform it. But without frogs, statues, mirrors and art. What does she really want? A glamorous garden that could win the Chelsea Flower Show. He wants curvy and straight lines with an array of colorful plants. She would like to have a pergola with a built-in seat, and to camouflage the fences as much as possible. Chris and Charlie have their hands open to create the design Anooshi dreams of. Who will win Chelsea gold? / Najljepši detalj u Anooshijinu vrtu u Leedsu je stalak za sušenje rublja jer je lijepih živahnih boja! Izuzev nekoliko šiljastih biljaka, vrt je dosadan i bezličan. S budžetom od 5000 funta ona ga želi preobraziti. Ali bez žaba, kipova, zrcala i umjetnina. Što ona zapravo želi? Glamurozni vrt koji bi mogao pobijediti na Sajmu cvijeća u Chelseaju. Želi vijugave i ravne linije uz lepezu šarenih biljaka. Voljela bi imati pergolu s ugrađenom sjedalicom, a ograde kamuflirati što je više moguće. Chris i Charlie imaju otvorene ruke za stvaranje dizajna o kakvom Anooshi sanja. Tko će osvojiti zlato Chelseaja?

programme.title: Prue Leith - in the kitchen with friends / Prue Leith - u kuhinji s prijateljima
programme.desc: Prue is visited by Ruby Wax _ who borrows a pair of her colorful glasses _ and prepares two clafoutis with plums and apricots while John turns the leftover apples into juice. / Prue u goste dolazi Ruby Wax _ koja posuđuje par njezinih šarenih naočala _ i priprema dva clafoutija sa šljivama i marelicama dok John pretvara ostatke jabuka u sok.

programme.title: 25. sat
programme.desc: On the last weekend in October, on the night from Saturday to Sunday, while almost the whole world switches from summer to winter time and the clocks move from 3 o'clock to 2 o'clock that night, and while most people do not even notice the change, the passengers of the train on the Vinkovci-Zagreb line got stuck at the 25th hour at the train station in Nova Gradiška. / Posljednjeg vikenda u listopadu, u noći sa subote na nedjelju, dok gotovo cijeli svijet prelazi s ljetnog na zimsko računanje vremena i kazaljke se te noći pomiču s 3 na 2 sata te dok većina tu promjenu ni ne primjećuje, putnici vlaka na pruzi Vinkovci-Zagreb zaglavili su u 25. satu na željezničkoj postaji u Novoj Gradiški.

programme.title: Kaos
programme.desc: Adaptation of five novels by Luigi Pirandello based on the screenplay by the Taviani brothers. The film was shot in Sicily, where Pirandello's stories take place. In the first story, "The Second Son", an old woman sends a letter to two sons who have gone to America and refuses the help of the third son, whom she carried away with an outlaw, the murderer of her husband during the Garibaldi revolution. The hero of the second story experiences suffering with his young wife because he becomes a werewolf during the full moon. The third story is about an unusual dispute over a broken and reassembled jug. "Requiem", the fourth story, follows the dispute between a rich landowner and his shepherds who have settled on the edge of the estate for years. Now he does not allow them to have a cemetery. "Conversation with Mother" is the fifth and last story of that omnibus. Luigi Pirandello returns to his Sicilian homeland, remembers his childhood and shares his grief with the ghost of his mother. / Ekranizacija pet novela Luigia Pirandella prema scenariju braće Taviani. Film je snimljen na Siciliji, gdje se odvijaju Pirandellove priče. U prvoj priči, "Drugi sin", starica šalje pismo dvojici sinova koji su otišli u Ameriku i odbija pomoć trećeg sina, kojega je zanijela s odmetnikom, ubojicom njezina muža u doba Garibaldijeve revolucije. Junak druge priče proživljava patnje sa svojom mladom ženom jer za puna Mjeseca postaje vukodlak. Treća priča govori o neobičnom sporu zbog razbijenog i ponovno sastavljenog vrča. "Rekvijem", četvrta priča, prati spor bogatog posjednika i njegovih pastira koji su se godinama naseljavali na rubu imanja. Sad im ne dopušta da imaju groblje. "Razgovor s majkom" peta je i posljednja priča tog omnibusa. Luigi Pirandello vraća se u svoj sicilijanski zavičaj, sjeća se djetinjstva i dijeli tugu s duhom svoje majke.

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: The Second World War brought to our sea new weapons and tactics of modern warfare. The small wooden partisan ships could not stand up to the much larger and better armed enemy warships. Only after the capitulation of Italy and the arrival of the Allies on the island of Vis did a new era of naval warfare begin, in which German and British naval forces clashed between the Adriatic islands almost every night. In the attacks on German convoys, British torpedo boats stood out in particular, bearing the brunt of the fight against similar German opponents. Our team investigated the wreck of the German torpedo boat S 57, a veteran of naval battles fought with the Allies since the beginning of the war, which sank in August 1944 near the Pelješac peninsula. Today, S 57 is one of the best preserved such wrecks in the world. By researching an unknown wreck of a torpedo boat that was recently found in the North Adriatic, the Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic expedition determined that it was the remains of the British torpedo boat MTB 655, which sank just before the end of World War II. In Great Britain, we also found its commander, who told us a tragic story about the shipwreck and the rescue of his crew. / Drugi svjetski rat donio je u naše more nova oružja i taktiku suvremenog ratovanja. Mali drveni partizanski brodovi nisu se mogli suprotstaviti mnogo većim i bolje naoružanim neprijateljskim ratnim brodovima. Tek poslije kapitulacije Italije i dolaskom Saveznika na otok Vis započela je nova era pomorskog ratovanja, u kojoj su se među jadranskim otocima gotovo svake noći sukobljavale njemačke i britanske pomorske snage. U napadima na njemačke konvoje osobito su se istaknuli britanski torpedni čamci koji su podnijeli glavni teret borbe sa sličnim njemačkim protivnicima. Naša ekipa istraživala je olupinu njemačkog torpednog čamca S 57, veterana pomorskih bitaka koje je vodio sa Saveznicima od početka rata, a koji je u kolovozu 1944. potonuo kod poluotoka Pelješca. Danas je S 57 jedna od najbolje očuvanih takvih olupina u svijetu. Istraživanjem nepoznate olupine torpednog čamca koja je nedavno pronađena u Sjevernom Jadranu ekspedicija Velikih brodoloma Jadrana utvrdila je da se radi o ostacima britanskog torpednog čamca MTB 655 koji je potonuo neposredno pred kraj Drugog svjetskog rata. U Velikoj Britaniji pronašli smo i njegovog zapovjednika koji nam je ispričao tragičnu priču o brodolomu i spašavanju njegove posade.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: This show was recorded in 2016 at the Institute for Croatian Language and Linguistics, where the project Database of Contemporary Croatian Names was ongoing. It was led by Dr. sc. Ankica Čilaš Šimpraga (1970 - 2020). The database was used to create the Dictionary of Personal Names, which was published in 2018 at Interliber. / Ova emisija snimana je 2016. godine u Institutu za hrvatski jezik i jezikoslovlje gdje je bio u tijeku projekt Baza suvremenih hrvatskih imena. Vodila ga je dr. sc. Ankica Čilaš Šimpraga (1970. _ 2020.). Baza je poslužila za izradu Rječnika osobnih imena koji je objavljen 2018. godine na Interliberu.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy helps Osbourne recycle the waste, but concludes that the old cans are really good toys, not trash. / Timmy pomaže Osbourneu reciklirati otpad, ali zaključuje da su stare limenke baš dobre igračke, a ne smeće.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu is upset that no one seems to like her new shoes. / Lu se uzruja što se izgleda nikome ne sviđaju njene nove cipele.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Muc find God's lamb in the little room. Tweedy makes her a bed, but soon discovers that God's sheep are not pets at all and do not need comfortable beds to sleep. / Tvidi i Muc u sobici nađu božju ovčicu. Tvidi joj napravi krevetić, ali ubrzo otkrije da božje ovčice uopće nisu kućni ljubimci i da ne trebaju udobne krevetiće za spavanje.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Stefi and Captain Redbeard found the famous golden shell at the same time and are arguing about who will keep it. The team proposes to solve it with a small competition. / Štefi i kapetan Riđobradi pronašli su poznatu zlatnu školjku u isto vrijeme i prepiru se oko toga tko će je zadržati. Ekipa predlaže da to riješe malim natjecanjem.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: It was an amazing adventure to make it to movie night on time! / Bila je to nevjerojatna pustolovina stići na filmsku večer na vrijeme!

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bob sell all sorts of things at their stand, including Bob's robot helmet! / Bitz i Bob na svom štandu prodaju svašta pa i Bobovu robotsku kacigu!

programme.title: It's at the hotel / Ho ho ho hotel
programme.desc: HO HO HO HOTEL This fall, we invite you to a hotel like you've never seen before! What kind of guests will be welcomed by the best and funniest hosts of Hotel Ruža i Franc and what funny, silly and impossible wishes and problems will be faced by their guests - you will see in 20 episodes of the new humorous and educational series for children! Ruža and Franc can solve any problem, but in their own special and funny way. Dramatic-educational series of 20 ten-minute episodes produced by the Program for Children and Young People takes place in a hotel with the most unusual, best and sweetest hosts Ruža and Franco and their guests with even more unusual crazy wishes and problems! Through the funny and silly incidents of a clumsy magician, a silly scientist, an opera diva who lost her voice and many others, we will learn what is warm and what is cold, what is quiet and what is loud, fast or slow, big or small, high or low, near or far, heavy or light, visible or invisible! In the main series / HO HO HO HOTEL Ove vas jeseni pozivamo u hotel kakav još nikada niste vidjeli! Kakve će sve goste dočekati najbolji i i najzabavniji domaćini Hotela Ruža i Franc i koje će smiješne, šašave i nemoguće želje i probleme imati njihovi gosti- vidjet ćete u 20 epizoda nove humoristično- edukativne serije za djecu ! Ruža i Franc mogu riješiti svaki problem, ali , na a svoj posebni i smiješni način. Igrano- edukativna serija od 20 desetominutnih epizoda u produkciji Programa za djecu i mlade događa se u hotelu s najneobičnijim, najboljim i najsješnijim domaćinima Ružom i Francom te njihovim gostima s još neobičnijim luckastim željama i problemima! Kroz smiješne i šašave zgode nespretnog mađioničara, šašavog znanstvenika, operne dive koja je ostala bez glasa i mnogih drugih, naučit ćemo što je toplo, a što hladno, što tiho, a što glasno, brzo ili sporo, veliko il malo, visoko i nisko, blizu ili daleko, teško ili lagano, vidljivo ili nevidljivo! U seriji glavne

programme.title: Odred jelena
programme.desc: The management of the Steel tower changes twice! Will the Stag Squad be able to return it to a distraught Sir Steel? // Steel and Lady Fluffpot put on a play. Ian's false alarms irritate Kai, but one of them seems to be a REAL emergency! / Steelovom tornju se uprava promijeni dvaput! Hoće li ga Odred jelena uspjeti vratiti izbezumljenom Sir Steelu? // Steel i Lady Fluffpot postavljaju predstavu. Ianove lažne uzbune iritiraju Kaija, no čini se kako je jedna od njih PRAVI hitni slučaj!

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: The Tikvics join the Dinoranchers for a dinosaur taming exercise, but Klara Tikvić prefers to brag about being the best than actually learning. She avoids every obstacle on the track in order to "win", but it backfires when the ankylosaur Skočka escapes and the Dinoranchers ask her to show them how she manages to tame the dinosaurs so quickly. Klara herself tries to bring Skočka back, but instead of bringing her back, she just drives her even further away from Dinoranč! Soon, Igor and Grga find themselves on Skočka's back, and Klara finally admits that she cheated. Ask for the help of Jon and Dinorancher to save Skočka, Igor and Grga. The dinoranchers show her what to do, and this time Klara really learns how to tame dinosaurs, successfully bringing Skočka home. / Tikvići se pridružuju Dinorančerima na vježbi za kroćenje dinosaura, ali Klara Tikvić više se voli hvaliti se kako je najbolja nego stvarno učiti. Izbjegava svaku prepreku na stazi kako bi "pobijedila", no to joj se obije o glavu kad ankilosaurica Skočka pobjegne i Dinorančeri je zamole da im pokaže kako tako brzo uspijeva ukrotiti dinosaure. Klara sama pokuša vratiti Skočku, ali umjesto da je dovede natrag, samo je otjera još dalje od Dinoranča! Uskoro se Igor i Grga nađu na Skočkinim leđima, i Klara napokon priznaje da je varala. Zatraži pomoć Jona i Dinorančera kako bi spasili Skočku, Igora i Grgu. Dinorančeri joj pokažu što treba učiniti, a Klara ovaj put stvarno nauči kako se krote dinosauri, uspješno dovodeći Skočku kući.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Today we learn to look at the clock! / Danas učimo gledati na sat!

programme.title: Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Muc find God's lamb in the little room. Tweedy makes her a bed, but soon discovers that God's sheep are not pets at all and do not need comfortable beds to sleep. / Tvidi i Muc u sobici nađu božju ovčicu. Tvidi joj napravi krevetić, ali ubrzo otkrije da božje ovčice uopće nisu kućni ljubimci i da ne trebaju udobne krevetiće za spavanje.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Volim životinje
programme.desc: Dokumentarno-animirana serija upoznaje najmlađe sa životinjskim vrstama.

programme.title: Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Stefi and Captain Redbeard found the famous golden shell at the same time and are arguing about who will keep it. The team proposes to solve it with a small competition. / Štefi i kapetan Riđobradi pronašli su poznatu zlatnu školjku u isto vrijeme i prepiru se oko toga tko će je zadržati. Ekipa predlaže da to riješe malim natjecanjem.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: When Pablo is awakened by pounding and scraping, he draws a cave in which to hide in fear of a noisy dragon. His friends hide with him and help him design a castle that will protect them better. / Kad Pabla probudi lupanje i struganje, on nacrta špilju u kojoj se sakrije u strahu od bučnog zmaja. Njegovi prijatelji sakriju se s njim i pomognu mu nacrtati dvorac koji će ih bolje zaštititi.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet.
