programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: At the beginning of June 1866, Italy declared war on Austria, deciding to take control of the island of Vis, a key point for the control of the entire Adriatic. After several days of cruising around Vis and bombarding Austrian positions, the Italian fleet decides to conquer the island by landing. However, at dawn on June 20, an Austrian squadron arrived at Vis and a great naval battle began. With a deft maneuver, the Austrian ship sank the Italian admiral ship, the battleship Re d'Italia, and the battle ended very quickly. Legend has it that Re d'Italia was transporting gold coins worth several million euros intended for the establishment of Italian rule on Vis and in Dalmatia. Therefore, the search for the location of the sinking of the Re d'Italie continued for more than a hundred years, until a special Croatian-French expedition found it in May 2005. The last episode of Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic brings a successful search for the location of the Battle of Vis, as well as the reconstruction of that battle, one of the most famous naval battles on the Adriatic. / Početkom lipnja 1866. Italija je objavila rat Austriji, odlučivši od nje preuzeti nadzor nad otokom Visom, ključnom točkom za nadzor cijelog Jadrana. Nakon nekoliko dana krstarenja oko Visa i bombardiranja austrijskih položaja talijanska flota odlučuje osvojiti otok iskrcavanjem. No, u zoru 20. lipnja do Visa stiže austrijska eskadra i započinje velika pomorska bitka. Spretnim manevrom austrijski brod potopio je talijanski admiralski brod, oklopnjaču Re dItalia, te je bitka okončana vrlo brzo. Legenda govori da je Re dItalia prevozila zlatnike vrijedne nekoliko milijuna eura namijenjene uspostavi talijanske vlasti na Visu i u Dalmaciji. Stoga se više od stotinu godina odvijala potraga za lokacijom potonuća Re dItalie, sve dok je u svibnju 2005. ne pronalazi posebna hrvatsko-francuska ekspedicija. Posljednja epizoda Velikih brodoloma Jadrana donosi uspješnu potragu za lokacijom Viške bitke, ali i rekonstrukciju te bitke, jedne od najpoznatijih pomorskih bitaka na Jadranu.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: Etymology is a branch of linguistics that studies the origin of words. In our country it is also called prehistory. Academician Ranko Matasović tells us about the beginnings of research into the origin of words, about our commonality with other languages ​​of the Indo-European group, about why the words brother, frater, brother have the same origin. We also learn how the origin of words that are difficult to determine where they come from, such as the word sedge, raga, etc., is shed light on. / Etimologija je grana lingvistike koja proučava podrijetlo riječi. U nas se zove i iskonoslovlje. Akademik Ranko Matasović govori nam o počecima istraživanja podrijetla riječi, o našem zajedništvu s ostalim jezicima indoeuropske skupine, o tome zašto su riječi brat, frater, bhrata istog podrijetla. Saznajemo i kako se rasvjetljava podrijetlo riječi kojima je teško utvrditi od kuda dolaze, primjerice riječ šaš, raga i sl.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: Ryder and the dogs team up with Al to save the great bridge in Adventure Bay from collapsing. / Ryder i psići udružuju se s Alom kako bi od urušavanja spasili veliki most u Zaljevu pustolovina.

programme.title: It's time for Timi / Vrijeme je za Timija
programme.desc: The class makes Valentine's cards, and Timmy volunteers to deliver them. / Razred izrađuje čestitke za Valentinovo, a Timmy se dobrovoljno javlja da ih dostavi.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu has trouble understanding that Elica got angry when she accidentally ruined her game. / Lu ima problema shvatiti da se Elica naljutila kad joj je slučajno pokvarila igru.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Muc has a good sense of hiding and is very happy when Tweedie follows, and Tweedie doesn't notice! When Tweedy finally finds him, Muc discovers that Tweedy also likes the game of hide and seek. / Muc ima dobar osjećaj za skrivanje i strašno ga veseli kad slijedi Tvidija, a ovaj to ne primjećuje! Kad ga Tvidi napokon pronađe, Muc otkrije da i Tvidi voli igru skrivača.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Štefi has two problems. Ljepko did not return from his search for pearls for her necklace. Where could he be? Numbers can't wait to help! / Štefi ima dva problema. Ljepko se nije vratio iz potrage za biserima za njezinu ogrlicu. Gdje bi mogao biti? Brojčići jedva čekaju pomoći!

programme.title: The song Medo, everything is going well / Pjesmica Medo, sve ide redom
programme.desc: Medo, everything is going in order A cheerful and fun song that introduces us to the rules of good behavior. With the help of Aunt Cow and forest friends, an impatient bear will learn why it's not polite to push yourself over the line. When he wants something _ honey or ice cream, he should be nice and stand in line! / Medo, sve ide redom Vesela i zabavna pjesmica koja nas upoznaje s pravilima lijepog ponašanja. Uz pomoć tete Krave i šumskih prijatelja, jedan nestrpljivi medo naučit će zašto nije pristojno gurati se preko reda. Već kada nešto želi _ med ili sladoled, treba biti fin i stati u red!

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: Little Bunny is afraid to get on the big slide, so the Love Monster has to be brave. / Malena Zečica se boji uspeti na veliki tobogan pa Ljubavno Čudovište mora biti hrabro.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Zip and Pop will delight the audience with their performance at the Kite Flying Festival. Chosen by: Rahela Štefanović / Na Festivalu puštanja zmajeva Zip i Pop svojim će nastupom oduševiti publiku. Odabrala: Rahela Štefanović

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Tango and Miguel need to bale hay and load it into the stegosaur barn, but just then Tango's best friend Aroo arrives for a visit with her wild herd of triceratops. Miguel lets Tango take a short break and play with Aroo, but when he needs help, Tango gets so carried away that he forgets to come back. Miguel tries to load hay into the barn by himself, but soon finds himself stuck at the end of the dino crane! When Tango realizes she's been neglecting Miguel, she and Aroo rush to his aid, and before all three can have fun, they help him finish the hay job. / Tango i Miguel trebaju balirati sijeno i utovariti ga u staju stegosaura, ali baš tada u posjet stiže Tangina najbolja prijateljica Aroo sa svojim divljim stadom triceratopsa. Miguel dopušta Tango da napravi kratki predah i poigra se s Aroo, ali kad mu zatreba pomoć, Tango se toliko zaigra da se zaboravi vratiti. Miguel pokušava sam utovariti sijeno u staju, no ubrzo se nađe zaglavljen na kraju dinodizalice! Kad Tango shvati da je zanemarila Miguela, ona i Aroo pohitaju mu u pomoć, a prije nego što se svo troje može zabavljati, pomognu mu dovršiti posao sa sijenom.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: Pjesmica ZELENA
programme.desc: We bring fun and educational musical moments that your little ones will enjoy endlessly! / Donosimo zabavne i edukativne glazbene trenutke u kojima će vaši najmlađi beskrajno uživati!

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

Edo ih pozove da se dođu igrati na gredicu u povrtnjaku gdje je iskopao jezerce kako bi povećao bioraznolikost.

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: Ryder and the dogs team up with Al to save the great bridge in Adventure Bay from collapsing. / Ryder i psići udružuju se s Alom kako bi od urušavanja spasili veliki most u Zaljevu pustolovina.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: Enid tries to help Mildred win the first challenge in the competition for the new school representative. But her efforts backfire when she summons the first representative in the history of the school, Gertrude the Great. / Enid pokuša pomoći Mildred osvojiti prvi izazov u natjecanju za novu školsku predstavnicu. No njezin se trud izjalovi kad zbog toga prizove prvu predstavnicu u povijesti škole, Gertrude Veliku.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: Etymology is a branch of linguistics that studies the origin of words. In our country it is also called prehistory. Academician Ranko Matasović tells us about the beginnings of research into the origin of words, about our commonality with other languages ​​of the Indo-European group, about why the words brother, frater, brother have the same origin. We also learn how the origin of words that are difficult to determine where they come from, such as the word sedge, raga, etc., is shed light on. / Etimologija je grana lingvistike koja proučava podrijetlo riječi. U nas se zove i iskonoslovlje. Akademik Ranko Matasović govori nam o počecima istraživanja podrijetla riječi, o našem zajedništvu s ostalim jezicima indoeuropske skupine, o tome zašto su riječi brat, frater, bhrata istog podrijetla. Saznajemo i kako se rasvjetljava podrijetlo riječi kojima je teško utvrditi od kuda dolaze, primjerice riječ šaš, raga i sl.

programme.title: Veliki brodolomi Jadrana
programme.desc: At the beginning of June 1866, Italy declared war on Austria, deciding to take control of the island of Vis, a key point for the control of the entire Adriatic. After several days of cruising around Vis and bombarding Austrian positions, the Italian fleet decides to conquer the island by landing. However, at dawn on June 20, an Austrian squadron arrived at Vis and a great naval battle began. With a deft maneuver, the Austrian ship sank the Italian admiral ship, the battleship Re d'Italia, and the battle ended very quickly. Legend has it that Re d'Italia was transporting gold coins worth several million euros intended for the establishment of Italian rule on Vis and in Dalmatia. Therefore, the search for the location of the sinking of the Re d'Italie continued for more than a hundred years, until a special Croatian-French expedition found it in May 2005. The last episode of Great Shipwrecks of the Adriatic brings a successful search for the location of the Battle of Vis, as well as the reconstruction of that battle, one of the most famous naval battles on the Adriatic. / Početkom lipnja 1866. Italija je objavila rat Austriji, odlučivši od nje preuzeti nadzor nad otokom Visom, ključnom točkom za nadzor cijelog Jadrana. Nakon nekoliko dana krstarenja oko Visa i bombardiranja austrijskih položaja talijanska flota odlučuje osvojiti otok iskrcavanjem. No, u zoru 20. lipnja do Visa stiže austrijska eskadra i započinje velika pomorska bitka. Spretnim manevrom austrijski brod potopio je talijanski admiralski brod, oklopnjaču Re dItalia, te je bitka okončana vrlo brzo. Legenda govori da je Re dItalia prevozila zlatnike vrijedne nekoliko milijuna eura namijenjene uspostavi talijanske vlasti na Visu i u Dalmaciji. Stoga se više od stotinu godina odvijala potraga za lokacijom potonuća Re dItalie, sve dok je u svibnju 2005. ne pronalazi posebna hrvatsko-francuska ekspedicija. Posljednja epizoda Velikih brodoloma Jadrana donosi uspješnu potragu za lokacijom Viške bitke, ali i rekonstrukciju te bitke, jedne od najpoznatijih pomorskih bitaka na Jadranu.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: It happened one night / Dogodilo se jedne noći
programme.desc: Spoiled Ellen "Ellie" Andrews (C. Colbert) is a young and slightly conceited rich woman, the daughter of strict millionaire Alexander Andrews (W. Connolly) who, against her father's will, wants to marry dowry hunter and playboy "King" Westley (J. Thomas). When she escapes from a yacht in Miami, where her father is holding her "prisoner" for her own good, Ellie hops on a bus and takes a night drive to New York where Westley is waiting for her. During the trip, she sits next to her a bit rough and irresponsible, unemployed journalist Peter Warne (C. Gable), an ambitious guy who wants to get back to work after a drinking problem. When he learns from the newspaper that his companion is a runaway heiress, Peter suggests that Ellie let him write an exclusive report on the event, and he will help her in return. Although they can hardly stand each other at first, the relationship between Ellie and Peter will gradually begin to change. / Razmažena Ellen "Ellie" Andrews (C. Colbert) mlada je i pomalo umišljena bogatašica, kći strogog milijunaša Alexandera Andrewsa (W. Connolly) koja se protivno očevoj volji želi udati za lovca na miraz i plejboja "Kinga" Westleya (J. Thomas). Kad pobjegne s jahte u Miamiju, gdje ju otac za njezino dobro drži "zatočenu", Ellie uskoči u autobus i krene na noćnu vožnju do New Yorka gdje ju čeka Westley. Tijekom putovanja do nje sjedi pomalo grubi i neodgovorni, nezaposleni novinar Peter Warne (C. Gable), ambiciozan momak koji se nakon problema s alkoholom želi vratiti na posao. Kad iz novina dozna da mu je suputnica odbjegla nasljednica, Peter predloži Ellie da mu omogući pisanje ekskluzivne reportaže o događaju, a on će joj zauzvrat pomoći. Iako isprva teško podnose jedno drugo, odnos između Ellie i Petera postupno će se početi mijenjati.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore i teme iz povijesti hrvatske fotografije te suvremene autore koji djeluju na hrvatskoj sceni.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: In the show, we talk about what made academician Milivoj Solar special. Namely, when two months ago the public found out that this prominent literary theorist and comparatist, a man who taught for 50 years at the Department of Comparative Literature of the Faculty of Philosophy in Zagreb, had passed away at the age of 90, there was almost no media that did not cover the news and no cultural worker who did not want to say goodbye to this man who spoke about complex things with ease. That's how we dedicate today's ART show to Milivoj Solar, a former professor, to thousands of lucky people, including a large number of journalists from our Kulture newsroom, with whom an era ends. The emcee's guest is academician Pavao Pavličić, a former student of Milivoj Solar and then a longtime colleague at the Faculty of Philosophy in Zagreb. / U emisiji govorimo o tome po čemu je bio poseban akademik Milivoj Solar. Naime, kada je prije dva mjeseca javnost saznala da je u 90-oj godini preminuo taj istaknuti teoretičar književnosti i komparatist, čovjek koji je 50 godina predavao na Odsjeku za komparativnu književnost zagrebačkog Filozofskog fakulteta, gotovo da nije bilo medija koji nije popratio tu vijest i kulturnog djelatnika koji se nije poželio prigodnim riječima i uspomenama oprostiti od tog čovjeka koji je s lakoćom govorio o složenim stvarima. Tako i mi današnju emisiju ART posvećujemo Milivoju Solaru, bivšem profesoru tisućama sretnika, među kojima je i velik broj novinara naše redakcije Kulture, s kojim završava jedna epoha. Gost emsije je akademik Pavao Pavličić, bivši student Milivoja Solara a zatim i dugogodišnji kolega na Filozofskom fakultetu u Zagrebu.

programme.title: Book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Zastave, Gabrijela Rukelj Kraškovič and Robert Međurečan As admirers of Miroslav Krleža, we attended the performance of Zastave at Zagreb's HNK, directed and adapted by Ivan Planinić. From that pleasant evening out came, of course, a contribution _ to be more precise, a review. There were many flowers in the house and garden is the title of Gabriela Rukelj Kraškovič's first book, which might lead the reader to think that it is a warm, nostalgic prose. But for such prose, this title would be too much. "Nothing was ever right in those houses", we read at the very beginning of the book whose author is a guest of our show. After the conversation in the studio, another interesting intervention follows _ in the workspace of this year's winner of the "Gjalski" award, Robert Međurečan. His award-winning novel is set in Judea at the time of Christ, hence the title of the work, which, according to the author, was found by the editor Jadranka Pintarić. She opened the Bible and found a suitable title in Psalm 89: So be it. / Zastave, Gabrijela Rukelj Kraškovič i Robert Međurečan Kao poštovatelji Miroslava Krleže, bili smo na predstavi Zastave u zagrebačkom HNK-u, u režiji i adaptaciji Ivana Planinića. Iz tog ugodnog večernjeg izlaska proizišao je, naravno, i prilog _ točnije rečeno, osvrt. U kući i vrtu bilo je mnogo cvijeća naslov je prve knjige Gabrijele Rukelj Kraškovič, koji bi čitatelja mogao navesti na pomisao da je riječ o toploj, nostalgičnoj prozi. No za takvu prozu ovakav bi naslov bio _ previše. "U tim kućama nikada ništa nije bilo u redu", čitamo već na samom početku knjige čija je autorica gošća naše emisije. Nakon razgovora u studiju slijedi još jedna zanimljiva intervencija _ u radnom prostoru ovogodišnjeg dobitnika nagrade "Gjalski", Roberta Međurečana. Njegov nagrađeni roman smješten je u Judeju u Kristovo vrijeme, pa otuda i naslov djela koji je, prema autorovim riječima, pronašla urednica Jadranka Pintarić. Otvorila je Bibliju i u Psalmu 89 pronašla prigodan naslov: Tako neka bude.

programme.title: Animatik
programme.desc: A show dedicated to artistic short animated films by Croatian and foreign authors. Through contributions and conversations with guests in the Animatik studio, he thematizes certain aspects of working on an animated film, showing both new and classic works of Croatian and international animation. / Emisija posvećena umjetničkim kratkometražnim animiranim filmovima hrvatskih i inozemnih autora. Kroz priloge i razgovore s gostima u studiju Animatik tematizira pojedine aspekte rada na animiranom filmu prikazujući i nova i klasična djela hrvatske i svjetske animacije.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: How can a person best meet foreigners even if he does not speak their language? He will sit in the car with them. That's exactly what Samuel Hade did. In two months, this filmmaker hitchhiked across Japan in search of adventure. His motto is: I don't refuse any invitation and I accept everything new. Hitchhiking through Japan is a special trip with overnight stays in a coin laundromat or, secretly, in a university library. It's a journey with cold days, lonely roads and bathing in the hot springs of Noboribetsu. / Kako će čovjek najbolje upoznati strance iako ne govori njihov jezik? Sjest će k njima u automobil. Upravo to učinio je Samuel Hade. Ovaj je filmaš sam za dva mjeseca autostopom proputovao Japan u potrazi za pustolovinama. Njegovo geslo glasi: ne odbijam nijedan poziv i prihvaćam sve novo. Autostopom kroz Japan poseban je izlet s noćenjima u praonici rublja na kovanice ili, potajno, u sveučilišnoj knjižnici. Putovanje je to s hladnim danima, samotnim cestama i kupanjem u vrućim izvorima Noboribetsua.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It brings recordings of Croatian and foreign jazz concerts and festivals, reportage overviews of current events on the Croatian jazz scene. / Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: Choreography for the final line is the name of the 60th Zagreb Salon of Visual Arts. The jubilee edition of one of the most important and long-standing manifestations of contemporary art in Croatia, organized by the Croatian Society of Fine Artists, presented more than 25 works of art, interventions in public space, lectures and performances at more than 20 locations. Zagreb thus became an open-air gallery, and the reaction of the public was not absent. The curatorial concept of the 60th Zagreb salon is signed by the young collective KUĆĆA. In the studio, we talk with Salon curators Luja Šimunović and Klara Petrović, and artists Silvio Vujičić, Vladimir Novak, Andrej Beštak, Anja Leko and Nina Kurtela talk about their works. The third member of the curatorial collective KUĆĆA, Jurica Mlinarec, and the director of HDLU Ivana Andabaka Vujičić also take part in the show. / Koreografija za završnu liniju naziv je 60. zagrebačkog salona vizualnih umjetnosti. Jubilarno izdanje jedne od najvažnijih i najdugovječnijih manifestacija suvremene umjetnosti u Hrvatskoj, u organizaciji Hrvatskog društva likovnih umjetnika, predstavilo je više od 25 umjetničkih radova, intervencija u javnom prostoru, predavanja i performansa na više od 20 lokacija. Zagreb je tako postao galerija na otvorenom, a reakcija javnosti nije izostala. Kustoski koncept 60. zagrebačkog salona potpisuje mladi kolektiv KUĆĆA. U studiju razgovaramo s kustosicama Salona Lujom Šimunović i Klarom Petrović, a o svojim radovima govore umjetnici Silvio Vujičić, Vladimir Novak, Andrej Beštak, Anja Leko i Nina Kurtela. U emisiji sudjeluje i treći član kustoskog kolektiva KUĆĆA, Jurica Mlinarec, te ravnateljica HDLU-a Ivana Andabaka Vujičić.

programme.title: Groznica
programme.desc: The episode explores the very essence of life _ water. From the earliest civilizations to modern-day societies, water is a key thread that shapes our lives, cities and cultures. As we explore the life cycle of water, the rise of ancient civilizations, and the role of water in driving industrialization and sustaining livelihoods, we delve into the cultural, economic, and existential importance of water _ exploring why it is aptly called the driving force of civilizations. / Epizoda istražuje samu esenciju života _ vodu. Od najranijih civilizacija do društava modernog doba, voda je ključna nit koja oblikuje naše živote, gradove i kulture. Dok otkrivamo životni ciklus vode, uspon drevnih civilizacija te ulogu vode u pokretanju industrijalizacije i održavanju sredstava za život, dubinski ispitujemo kulturnu, ekonomsku i egzistencijalnu važnost vode _ istražujući zašto je prikladno nazivaju pokretačkom snagom civilizacija.

programme.title: The Eternal Cycle of Comedy: Wonder Woman / Vječni ciklus komedije: Čudesna djevojka
programme.desc: In a New York restaurant, the attractive wanderer Lulu (M. Griffith) and the hardened businessman Charles Driggs (J. Daniels) meet by chance. Charles leaves without paying the bill and Lulu assures him that such "outbursts" are his way of satisfying his otherwise deeply hidden natural desires, for example sexual. Attractive, imaginative and wild, the girl persuades him to go on an adventure with her. Lulu, actually Audrey Hankel, intends to take the confused Charles to the tenth anniversary of his graduation to present him as her successful husband. The journey to Audrey's hometown turns into a real adventure, where Charles is shocked, but also attracted by each new outburst of the unusual companion: from unconventional sex to incidental theft. However, the couple in love will run into real trouble when they are met at their destination by the psychotic Ray (R. Liotta), Audrey's ex-husband recently released from prison, who desperately wants Audrey back... / U jednom newyorškom restoranu slučajno se susretnu atraktivna lutalica Lulu (M. Griffith) i uštogljeni poslovni čovjek Charles Driggs (J. Daniels). Charles je otišao ne plativši račun i Lulu ga uvjerava da su takvi "ispadi" način na koji on zadovoljava svoje inače duboko skrivene prirodne želje, na primjer seksualne. Privlačna, maštovita i divlja, djevojka ga nagovara da s njom krene u pustolovinu. Lulu, zapravo Audrey Hankel, namjerava odvesti zbunjenog Charlesa na desetogodišnjicu mature kako bi ga predstavila kao svoga uspješnog supruga. Put do Audreynog rodnog kraja pretvori se u pravu pustolovinu pri čemu Charlesa šokira, ali i privuče svaki novi ispad neobične suputnice: od nekonvencionalnog seksa do usputne krađe. Međutim, zaljubljeni će par upasti u prave nevolje kad ih na odredištu dočeka psihotični Ray (R. Liotta), Audreyn bivši suprug nedavno pušten iz zatvora, koji očajnički želi da mu se Audrey vrati...

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: Bart can't control his emotions towards the new teacher, and Lisa befriends an octopus. / Bart ne može obuzdati emocije prema novoj učiteljici, a Lisa se sprijatelji s hobotnicom.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It brings recordings of Croatian and foreign jazz concerts and festivals, reportage overviews of current events on the Croatian jazz scene. / Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni.

programme.title: Munir Vejzović
programme.desc: A biographical film about the painter Munir Vejzović and his work on the occasion of a large retrospective exhibition set up in the Modern Gallery in Zagreb in the spring of 2017. / Biografski film o slikaru Muniru Vejzović i njegovom stvaralaštvu u povodu velike retrospektivne izložbe postavljene u Modernoj galeriji u Zagrebu u proljeće 2017. godine.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: In Dublin, 1904, James Joyce is walking down the street and meets Nora Barnacle, a young woman from Galway. She charms him with her honest, uninhibited behavior and he soon persuades her to come with him to Trieste... / U Dublinu, 1904., James Joyce šeta ulicom i susreće Noru Barnacle, mladu ženu iz Galwaya. Ona ga očara svojim iskrenim, nesputanim ponašanjem i on je ubrzo nagovori da pođe s njim u Trst...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It brings recordings of Croatian and foreign jazz concerts and festivals, reportage overviews of current events on the Croatian jazz scene. / Donosi snimke hrvatskih i inozemnih jazz-koncerata i festivala, reportažne preglede aktualnih događaja na hrvatskoj jazz-sceni.

programme.title: The World As It Was: Klonimir's Film Records / Svijet kakav je nekad bio: Klonimirovi filmski zapisi
programme.desc: After filming the documentary "All Klonimir's Decades" about the navigator and flight engineer Klonimir Seršić (Baška, Krk, 1925 _ Zagreb, 2021), director Mladen Santrić decided to process his unusual film legacy. It is about a selection of film recordings that Klonimir recorded all over the world in the period from 1960 to 1980. Considering the passage of time, the cycle is a valuable testimony of "the world as it once was", and it consists of sixty short films from Europe, Australia, Canada, the USA, Africa and Asia. This peculiar "time machine" is a valuable film document about a time that new generations would otherwise not be able to experience. / Nakon što je o navigatoru i inženjeru letenja Klonimiru Seršiću (Baška, Krk, 1925. _ Zagreb, 2021.) snimio dokumentarni film "Sva Klonimirova desetljeća", redatelj Mladen Santrić odlučio je obraditi njegovu neobičnu filmsku ostavštinu. Riječ je o izboru filmskih zapisa koje je Klonimir snimao po cijelom svijetu u razdoblju od 1960. do 1980. godine. Ciklus je s obzirom na protok vremena dragocjeno svjedočanstvo o "svijetu kakav je nekad bio", a čini ga šezdesetak kratkih filmova iz Europe, Australije, Kanade, SAD-a, Afrike i Azije. Ovaj osebujan "vremeplov" vrijedan je filmski dokument o vremenu koje nove generacije inače ne bi mogle doživjeti.

programme.title: Tern around the world / Čigrom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Croatian tern and Mladen Šutej sail the seas of the world. In the first five episodes, we will follow the sailing from Biograd, through the Mediterranean, Gibraltar, Portugal, Tenerife, the Atlantic Ocean, the Caribbean, the Panama Canal and the Galapagos. With the help of good winds, self-sacrificing crews and experienced skippers, the Croatian Tern sailed to some of the most interesting parts of the world. In addition to the sailboat built in the shipyard in Kraljevica, we will also see Gibraltar and the port of Tangier in Morocco. We will see what it means to sail across the ocean, when for 25 days there is nothing but wind, sun and endless open sea. After a short stay in the Caribbean, Tern passed through the architectural marvel _ the Panama Canal, and we will also see two faces of Panama City and experience a stay on one of the most interesting natural phenomena _ the Galapagos Islands. In the first episode of "Doors of the Atlantic", the Croatian tern left Biograd, sailed across the Mediterranean and takes us to Gibraltar, Tangier in Morocco and the port of Cadiz, which was the main Spanish starting point for conquests in America. In Villamoura, a fashionable Portuguese resort on the Costa Algarve, Čigraši hung out with the future winner of the non-stop regatta "The Race", and we will also see one of the most beautiful Portuguese cities, Cascais, in the suburbs of Lisbon. / Hrvatska čigra i Mladen Šutej jedre svjetskim morima. U prvih pet epizoda pratit ćemo plovidbu od Biograda, preko Sredozemlja, Gibraltara, Portugala, Teneriffa, Atlantskog oceana, Kariba, Panamskog kanala i Galapagosa. Uz pomoć dobroga vjetra, požrtvovnih posada i iskusnih skipera, Hrvatska čigra doplovila je do nekih od najzanimljivijih dijelova svijeta. Osim jedrilice izgrađene u brodogradilištu u Kraljevici, vidjet ćemo i Gibraltar i luku Tanger u Maroku. Vidjet ćemo što znači plovidba preko oceana, kada 25 dana nema ničeg drugog osim vjetra, sunca i beskraja pučine. Nakon kratkog boravka na Karibima, Čigra je prošla kroz graditeljsko čudo _ Panamski kanal, a vidjet ćemo i dva lica grada Paname te doživjeti boravak na jednom od najzanimljivijih prirodnih fenomena _ otočju Galapagos. U prvoj epizodi "Vrata Atlantika" Hrvatska čigra napustila je Biograd, prejedrila Sredozemlje i vodi nas u Gibraltar, Tanger u Maroku te luku Cadiz koja je bila glavno španjolsko polazište za osvajačke pohode u Ameriku. U Villamouri, mondenom portugalskom ljetovalištu na Costi Algarve, Čigraši su se družili s budućim pobjednikom non-stop regate "The Race", a vidjet ćemo i jedan od najljepših portugalskih gradova Cascais, u predgrađu Lisabona.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: We are talking about the history of Esperanto, the people who created it, the reasons why it was created. It was well received in Croatia. From the beginning, enthusiasts have advocated learning that language of hope (which is the translation of the word Esperanto). The Zagreb school for learning Esperanto is also famous. Literature was born on it, it was a bridge for the translation of works of small literature such as ours, you can pray on it, you can also sing. This is exactly what opera singer Neven Mrzlečki does in our show, who translated some of our famous songs into Esperanto. Prof. Ph.D. Velimir Piškorec talks inspiredly about his experiences in learning and speaking Esperanto, about the history of that language and the people who marked its history. / Govorimo o povijesti esperanta, o ljudima koji su ga stvorili, razlozima zašto je nastao. U Hrvatskoj je naišao na dobar prijem. Od početka su se entuzijasti zauzimali za učenje toga jezika nade (što je prijevod riječi esperanto). Poznata je i zagrebačka škola učenja esperanta. Na njemu je nastala književnost, bio je most za prevođenje djela malih književnosti kakva je naša, na njemu se može i moliti, može se i pjevati. Upravo to u našoj emisiji radi operni pjevač Neven Mrzlečki koji je na esperanto preveo neke naše poznate pjesme. Prof. dr. sc. Velimir Piškorec nadahnuto govori o svojim iskustvima u učenju i govorenju esperanta, o povijesti toga jezika i ljudima koji su njegovu povijest obilježili.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: When Mayor Humdinger's mountain vacation literally goes downhill, the dogs must stop Jake's cabin before it slides off. // Mayor Humdinger tampers with the satellite antenna and crashes the satellite and the entire city communication system. / Kada planinski odmor gradonačelnika Humdingera doslovno krene nizbrdo, psići moraju zaustaviti Jakeovu kolibu prije negoli otkliže. // Gradonačelnik Humdinger petlja po satelitskoj anteni te sruši satelit i cijeli gradski komunikacijski sustav.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Halloween can be spooky fun, but Timmy thinks Finlay's mask is a little scary. / Noć vještica može biti jezivo zabavna, ali Timmy misli da je Finlayeva maska malo strašna.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lou struggles to wait for his turn to play with the toy. / Lu se muči čekati da dođe na red za igranje s igračkom.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Muc wants to eat everything that Tweedy finds and brings to the little room. It's hard to pack a lunch bag when everything ends up in _ Muc! / Muc želi pojesti sve što Tvidi nađe i donese u sobicu. Teško je spremiti torbu s ručkom kad sve završi u _ Mucu!

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Farmer Kaos invents a machine that helps him package agricultural products in even numbers. But the machine loses control! Even animals cannot escape his frenzied classification. Numbers come to the rescue and use even and odd numbers to save the day. / Farmer Kaos izumi stroj koji mu pomaže pakirati poljoprivredne proizvode u parnim brojevima. Ali stroj izgubi kontrolu! Čak ni životinje ne mogu pobjeći od njegovog pomahnitalog razvrstavanja. Brojčići dotrče u pomoć te se koriste parnim i neparnim brojevima kako bi spasili stvar.

programme.title: The song Medo, everything is going well / Pjesmica Medo, sve ide redom
programme.desc: Medo, everything is going in order A cheerful and fun song that introduces us to the rules of good behavior. With the help of Aunt Cow and forest friends, an impatient bear will learn why it's not polite to push yourself over the line. When he wants something _ honey or ice cream, he should be nice and stand in line! / Medo, sve ide redom Vesela i zabavna pjesmica koja nas upoznaje s pravilima lijepog ponašanja. Uz pomoć tete Krave i šumskih prijatelja, jedan nestrpljivi medo naučit će zašto nije pristojno gurati se preko reda. Već kada nešto želi _ med ili sladoled, treba biti fin i stati u red!

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The Zečić-Čudovište team is confident of their victory at the three-legged race in Slitograd, but not everything will go as planned... / Tim Zečić-Čudovište je uvjeren u svoju pobjedu na slatkogradskoj tronožnoj utrci, ali neće sve proteći kao što su planirali...

programme.title: Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bob, or the big robotic wolf, has locked Matobiserka in the castle tower, so they have to get her out somehow. Chosen by: Rahela Štefanović / Bob, ili veliki robotski vuk, zaključao je Matobiserku u toranj dvorca pa je moraju nekako izvući. Odabrala: Rahela Štefanović

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Tango is celebrating her birthday, and Miguel and Dinorancheri have prepared a series of her favorite activities. But the plans are disrupted when they rescue a small triceratops, whom they name Tonko. All of Tango's favorite games are loud and fierce, but unfortunately too intense for little Tonko, so the Dinoranchers decide to adapt the celebration and make it gentler, which upsets Tango. Convinced that everyone cares more about Tonko than she does, Tango runs off to Breakwater Gorge to have fun smashing rocks, but Tonko, who adores Tango, follows her and ends up trapped in a rockfall! Tango immediately calls the Dinoranchers for help, realizing that this time she will have to be gentle in order to save her friend. Once Tonko is safe again, Tango realizes how special this lively little triceratops is and manages to enjoy the birthday party with him. / Tango slavi rođendan, a Miguel i Dinorančeri pripremili su niz njezinih omiljenih aktivnosti. No planovi se poremete kada spase malog triceratopsa kojem daju ime Tonko. Sve Tangine omiljene igre su glasne i žestoke, ali nažalost prežestoke za malog Tonka, pa Dinorančeri odluče prilagoditi proslavu i učiniti je nježnijom, što uzruja Tango. Uvjerena da svima više stalo do Tonka nego do nje, Tango pobjegne u Lomni klanac da se zabavi razbijajući stijene, ali Tonko, koji obožava Tango, krene za njom i završi zarobljen u odronu kamenja! Tango odmah pozove Dinorančere u pomoć, shvaćajući da će ovaj put morati biti nježna kako bi spasila prijatelja. Kada je Tonko ponovno na sigurnom, Tango shvaća koliko je ovaj živahni mali triceratops poseban i uspijeva zajedno s njim uživati u rođendanskoj proslavi.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: Pjesmica ZELENA
programme.desc: We bring fun and educational musical moments that your little ones will enjoy endlessly! / Donosimo zabavne i edukativne glazbene trenutke u kojima će vaši najmlađi beskrajno uživati!

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Pjesmica Brokula
programme.desc: The witty song will reveal to us why broccoli is a real little vegetable heroine on our plate. Her green crown _ full of vitamins, helps us to be strong and healthy. Dance and sing along to the new Juhuhu song! / Duhovita pjesmica otkrit će nam zašto je brokula prava mala povrtna heroina na našem tanjuru. Njezina zelena kruna _ vitamina puna, pomaže nam da budemo jaki i zdravi. Zaplešite i zapjevajte uz novu Juhuhu pjesmicu!

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo is charmed by the boy in the mirror. Draw your new friend and introduce him to everyone in the Drawing World, but befriending a mirror image has its limits. / Pabla očara dječak u zrcalu. Nacrta svoga novog prijatelja i predstavi ga svima u Svijetu crteža, ali prijateljevanje s odrazom u zrcalu ima svoja ograničenja.
