programme.desc: We bring fun and educational musical moments that your little ones will enjoy endlessly! / Donosimo zabavne i edukativne glazbene trenutke u kojima će vaši najmlađi beskrajno uživati!

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Edmund and Luce dream of having a pet. In order to please them and at the same time teach them about responsibility, Edo suggests not one, but many animals! And to welcome them, Edo encourages them to build a "home" for them. But what animals could they be? / Edmund i Luce sanjaju o tome da imaju ljubimca. Kako bi im udovoljio, a ujedno podučio o odgovornosti, Edo predlaže ne jednu, već puno životinja! A da bi im poželjeli dobrodošlicu, Edo ih potiče da im sagrade "dom". Ali koje bi životinje to mogle biti?

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dinoranč
programme.desc: Tango is celebrating her birthday, and Miguel and Dinorancheri have prepared a series of her favorite activities. But the plans are disrupted when they rescue a small triceratops, whom they name Tonko. All of Tango's favorite games are loud and fierce, but unfortunately too intense for little Tonko, so the Dinoranchers decide to adapt the celebration and make it gentler, which upsets Tango. Convinced that everyone cares more about Tonko than she does, Tango runs off to Breakwater Gorge to have fun smashing rocks, but Tonko, who adores Tango, follows her and ends up trapped in a rockfall! Tango immediately calls the Dinoranchers for help, realizing that this time she will have to be gentle in order to save her friend. Once Tonko is safe again, Tango realizes how special this lively little triceratops is and manages to enjoy the birthday party with him. / Tango slavi rođendan, a Miguel i Dinorančeri pripremili su niz njezinih omiljenih aktivnosti. No planovi se poremete kada spase malog triceratopsa kojem daju ime Tonko. Sve Tangine omiljene igre su glasne i žestoke, ali nažalost prežestoke za malog Tonka, pa Dinorančeri odluče prilagoditi proslavu i učiniti je nježnijom, što uzruja Tango. Uvjerena da svima više stalo do Tonka nego do nje, Tango pobjegne u Lomni klanac da se zabavi razbijajući stijene, ali Tonko, koji obožava Tango, krene za njom i završi zarobljen u odronu kamenja! Tango odmah pozove Dinorančere u pomoć, shvaćajući da će ovaj put morati biti nježna kako bi spasila prijatelja. Kada je Tonko ponovno na sigurnom, Tango shvaća koliko je ovaj živahni mali triceratops poseban i uspijeva zajedno s njim uživati u rođendanskoj proslavi.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: When Mayor Humdinger's mountain vacation literally goes downhill, the dogs must stop Jake's cabin before it slides off. // Mayor Humdinger tampers with the satellite antenna and crashes the satellite and the entire city communication system. / Kada planinski odmor gradonačelnika Humdingera doslovno krene nizbrdo, psići moraju zaustaviti Jakeovu kolibu prije negoli otkliže. // Gradonačelnik Humdinger petlja po satelitskoj anteni te sruši satelit i cijeli gradski komunikacijski sustav.

programme.title: Pjesmica Brokula
programme.desc: The witty song will reveal to us why broccoli is a real little vegetable heroine on our plate. Her green crown _ full of vitamins, helps us to be strong and healthy. Dance and sing along to the new Juhuhu song! / Duhovita pjesmica otkrit će nam zašto je brokula prava mala povrtna heroina na našem tanjuru. Njezina zelena kruna _ vitamina puna, pomaže nam da budemo jaki i zdravi. Zaplešite i zapjevajte uz novu Juhuhu pjesmicu!

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Najgora vještica
programme.desc: On her birthday, the Indigo Moon begins to grow and change unexpectedly rapidly; and the spell that should help Izzy settle in at school develops in the exact opposite direction. / Na svoj rođendan Indigo Moon počinje neočekivano brzo rasti i mijenjati se; a čarolija koja bi trebala pomoći Izzy da se udomaći u školi razvije se u sasvim suprotnom smjeru.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: We are talking about the history of Esperanto, the people who created it, the reasons why it was created. It was well received in Croatia. From the beginning, enthusiasts have advocated learning that language of hope (which is the translation of the word Esperanto). The Zagreb school for learning Esperanto is also famous. Literature was born on it, it was a bridge for the translation of works of small literature such as ours, you can pray on it, you can also sing. This is exactly what opera singer Neven Mrzlečki does in our show, who translated some of our famous songs into Esperanto. Prof. Ph.D. Velimir Piškorec talks inspiredly about his experiences in learning and speaking Esperanto, about the history of that language and the people who marked its history. / Govorimo o povijesti esperanta, o ljudima koji su ga stvorili, razlozima zašto je nastao. U Hrvatskoj je naišao na dobar prijem. Od početka su se entuzijasti zauzimali za učenje toga jezika nade (što je prijevod riječi esperanto). Poznata je i zagrebačka škola učenja esperanta. Na njemu je nastala književnost, bio je most za prevođenje djela malih književnosti kakva je naša, na njemu se može i moliti, može se i pjevati. Upravo to u našoj emisiji radi operni pjevač Neven Mrzlečki koji je na esperanto preveo neke naše poznate pjesme. Prof. dr. sc. Velimir Piškorec nadahnuto govori o svojim iskustvima u učenju i govorenju esperanta, o povijesti toga jezika i ljudima koji su njegovu povijest obilježili.

programme.title: Tern around the world / Čigrom oko svijeta
programme.desc: Croatian tern and Mladen Šutej sail the seas of the world. In the first five episodes, we will follow the sailing from Biograd, through the Mediterranean, Gibraltar, Portugal, Tenerife, the Atlantic Ocean, the Caribbean, the Panama Canal and the Galapagos. With the help of good winds, self-sacrificing crews and experienced skippers, the Croatian Tern sailed to some of the most interesting parts of the world. In addition to the sailboat built in the shipyard in Kraljevica, we will also see Gibraltar and the port of Tangier in Morocco. We will see what it means to sail across the ocean, when for 25 days there is nothing but wind, sun and endless open sea. After a short stay in the Caribbean, Tern passed through the architectural marvel _ the Panama Canal, and we will also see two faces of Panama City and experience a stay on one of the most interesting natural phenomena _ the Galapagos Islands. In the first episode of "Doors of the Atlantic", the Croatian tern left Biograd, sailed across the Mediterranean and takes us to Gibraltar, Tangier in Morocco and the port of Cadiz, which was the main Spanish starting point for conquests in America. In Villamoura, a fashionable Portuguese resort on the Costa Algarve, Čigraši hung out with the future winner of the non-stop regatta "The Race", and we will also see one of the most beautiful Portuguese cities, Cascais, in the suburbs of Lisbon. / Hrvatska čigra i Mladen Šutej jedre svjetskim morima. U prvih pet epizoda pratit ćemo plovidbu od Biograda, preko Sredozemlja, Gibraltara, Portugala, Teneriffa, Atlantskog oceana, Kariba, Panamskog kanala i Galapagosa. Uz pomoć dobroga vjetra, požrtvovnih posada i iskusnih skipera, Hrvatska čigra doplovila je do nekih od najzanimljivijih dijelova svijeta. Osim jedrilice izgrađene u brodogradilištu u Kraljevici, vidjet ćemo i Gibraltar i luku Tanger u Maroku. Vidjet ćemo što znači plovidba preko oceana, kada 25 dana nema ničeg drugog osim vjetra, sunca i beskraja pučine. Nakon kratkog boravka na Karibima, Čigra je prošla kroz graditeljsko čudo _ Panamski kanal, a vidjet ćemo i dva lica grada Paname te doživjeti boravak na jednom od najzanimljivijih prirodnih fenomena _ otočju Galapagos. U prvoj epizodi "Vrata Atlantika" Hrvatska čigra napustila je Biograd, prejedrila Sredozemlje i vodi nas u Gibraltar, Tanger u Maroku te luku Cadiz koja je bila glavno španjolsko polazište za osvajačke pohode u Ameriku. U Villamouri, mondenom portugalskom ljetovalištu na Costi Algarve, Čigraši su se družili s budućim pobjednikom non-stop regate "The Race", a vidjet ćemo i jedan od najljepših portugalskih gradova Cascais, u predgrađu Lisabona.

programme.title: The World As It Was: Klonimir's Film Records / Svijet kakav je nekad bio: Klonimirovi filmski zapisi
programme.desc: After filming the documentary "All Klonimir's Decades" about the navigator and flight engineer Klonimir Seršić (Baška, Krk, 1925 _ Zagreb, 2021), director Mladen Santrić decided to process his unusual film legacy. It is about a selection of film recordings that Klonimir recorded all over the world in the period from 1960 to 1980. Considering the passage of time, the cycle is a valuable testimony of "the world as it once was", and it consists of sixty short films from Europe, Australia, Canada, the USA, Africa and Asia. This peculiar "time machine" is a valuable film document about a time that new generations would otherwise not be able to experience. / Nakon što je o navigatoru i inženjeru letenja Klonimiru Seršiću (Baška, Krk, 1925. _ Zagreb, 2021.) snimio dokumentarni film "Sva Klonimirova desetljeća", redatelj Mladen Santrić odlučio je obraditi njegovu neobičnu filmsku ostavštinu. Riječ je o izboru filmskih zapisa koje je Klonimir snimao po cijelom svijetu u razdoblju od 1960. do 1980. godine. Ciklus je s obzirom na protok vremena dragocjeno svjedočanstvo o "svijetu kakav je nekad bio", a čini ga šezdesetak kratkih filmova iz Europe, Australije, Kanade, SAD-a, Afrike i Azije. Ovaj osebujan "vremeplov" vrijedan je filmski dokument o vremenu koje nove generacije inače ne bi mogle doživjeti.

programme.title: Orao protiv morskog psa
programme.desc: Lilly is a shy and somewhat unusual waitress. She falls in love with Jarrod, a video game geek. After bonding at a "favorite animal" themed party, Lilly follows Jarrod to his hometown, where he wants to confront a former school bully. During this journey, both discover their own insecurities and what it means to accept yourself and others. / Lilly je sramežljiva i pomalo neobična konobarica. Zaljubljuje se u Jarroda, mahera za videoigre. Nakon što se zbliže na zabavi na temu "omiljene životinje", Lilly prati Jarroda u njegov rodni grad, gdje se on želi suočiti s nekadašnjim školskim zlostavljačem. Tijekom tog putovanja oboje otkrivaju vlastite nesigurnosti i što znači prihvatiti sebe i druge.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Stone Story - Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquities / Priča od kamena - Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine
programme.desc: In 2007, the Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquities celebrated its 55th anniversary. As a non-profit company, it has been taking care of the city walls and other Dubrovnik historical and cultural monuments for decades, preserving the values ​​that testify to the rich tradition and culture. The members of the Society are volunteers who take care of the city with care and expertise in times when it is increasingly difficult to preserve the true face of the stone city. In the show, we recall the past actions, we recall the recent ones in the maintenance of the Dubrovnik and Ston walls and the walls in Molunt and Cavtat, the restoration of the Sokol fortress and mills on the river Ljutoj, and more. The Society of Friends of Dubrovnik Antiquity is a kind of civic consciousness and the conscience of Dubrovnik and still actively participates in the life of the City. / Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine godine 2007. obilježilo je 55. obljetnicu djelovanja. Kao neprofitabilno društvo, desetljećima skrbi o gradskim zidinama i drugim dubrovačkim povijesno-kulturnim spomenicima, čuvajući vrednote koje svjedoče o bogatoj tradiciji i kulturi. Članovi Društva su volonteri koji brižno i stručno skrbe o gradu u vremenima kada je sve teže sačuvati pravo lice kamenog grada. U emisiji se prisjećamo proteklih akcija, podsjećamo na novije u održavanju dubrovačkih i stonskih zidina te zidina u Moluntu i Cavtatu, obnovu tvrđave Sokol i mlinica na rijeci Ljutoj i drugo. Društvo prijatelja dubrovačke starine svojevrsna je građanska svijest i savjest Dubrovnika i još uvijek aktivno sudjeluje u životu Grada.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: The show about art and culture, in the conversation in the studio and reports, opens up topics that are not talked about enough. / Emisija o umjetnosti i kulturi, u razgovoru u studiju i reportažama otvara teme o kojima se nedovoljno govori.

programme.title: Groznica
programme.desc: The episode explores the very essence of life _ water. From the earliest civilizations to modern-day societies, water is a key thread that shapes our lives, cities and cultures. As we explore the life cycle of water, the rise of ancient civilizations, and the role of water in driving industrialization and sustaining livelihoods, we delve into the cultural, economic, and existential importance of water _ exploring why it is aptly called the driving force of civilizations. / Epizoda istražuje samu esenciju života _ vodu. Od najranijih civilizacija do društava modernog doba, voda je ključna nit koja oblikuje naše živote, gradove i kulture. Dok otkrivamo životni ciklus vode, uspon drevnih civilizacija te ulogu vode u pokretanju industrijalizacije i održavanju sredstava za život, dubinski ispitujemo kulturnu, ekonomsku i egzistencijalnu važnost vode _ istražujući zašto je prikladno nazivaju pokretačkom snagom civilizacija.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The rugged west of France is surrounded by the sea. Brittany, with its often stormy weather and harsh climate, has a peculiar charm. Inland are deep forests and hilly wasteland, on the coast rugged steep slopes with extremely unusual rock formations, and in between beaches with white sand similar to the Caribbean. No place is more than 80 km from the coast. Most Bretons live from the sea and with the sea. / Surovi zapad Francuske okružen je morem. Bretanja s često olujnim vremenom i oštrom klimom ima osebujan šarm. U unutrašnjosti se prostiru duboke šume i brežuljkasta pustopoljina, na obali krševite strme padine s krajnje neobičnim formacijama stijena, a između toga plaže s bijelim pijeskom nalik na karipske. Nijedno mjesto nije udaljeno od obale više od 80 km. Većina Bretonaca živi od mora i s morem.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Sandra Vitaljić belongs to the younger generation of Croatian photographers. Born in 1972 in Pula, after studying at the FAMU Film Academy in Prague, she came to Zagreb, where she worked as a newspaper, advertising and art photographer. Her portraits, whether they are nudes or fashion photography, are a combination of a character study of the person portrayed and her personal view of the world. In photographs of seemingly deserted landscapes, she connects personal research and topics that occupy her with relevant social events. / Sandra Vitaljić pripada mlađoj generaciji hrvatskih fotografa. Rođena 1972. u Puli, nakon školovanja na Filmskoj akademiji FAMU u Pragu dolazi u Zagreb gdje radi kao novinski, reklamni i umjetnički fotograf. Njezini portreti, bilo da je riječ o aktovima ili modnoj fotografiji, spoj su studije karaktera portretiranog i njezinog osobnog pogleda na svijet. Na fotografijama naizgled pustih krajolika ona povezuje osobna istraživanja i teme koje ju zaokupljaju s relevantnim društvenim zbivanjima.

programme.title: Soloists, Ave Chamber Choir, Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT conducted by Ivo Lipanović - KD V. Lisinski / Solisti, Komorni zbor Ave, Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Ive Lipanovića - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Maestro Ivo Lipanović is one of our most prominent conductors, and he comes to the Kanconijer cycle to direct the symphonic program with soloists and choir. The opera music is represented by the famous orchestral excerpt _Dance with Seven Veils from Salome by Richard Strauss, which the musicologist and Strauss biographer Ernst Krause stated "establishes the modern musical formula for the representation of ecstatic sensual desire and brings it to perfection". In 1927, Krešimir Baranović, a composer whose music is woven into the foundations of the national direction of Croatian music in the 20th century, reached for the verses of Fran Galović from the collection Z mojih bregov. The poems from that collection are considered the beginning of new Kajkavian poetry, and Baranović chose three poems _ Pozdravlenje, Međaš and Kum Martin. Lavishly set to music for baritone and orchestra, they evoke a wide range of images: from village idylls, customs and atmosphere, through the actions and feelings of individuals, to hidden expressions of nostalgia, anxiety, loneliness and transience. Baritone Matija Meić, who is building a successful career in Germany, will be joined in the second part of the concert by soprano Valentina Fijačko Kobić, champion of the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, and tenor Filip Filipović, soloist of the same theater company. Their collaboration will also be the highlight of this program, which brings the monumental symphony Bells by Sergei Rachmaninoff. The work contains verses of the poem of the same name by E. A. Poe in a free translation into Russian, and is also a dedication to Russian church bells and the way they accompany human life. The expanded composition of the orchestra vividly evokes campanological symbols for different types of bells: Christmas bells, wedding bells, alarm bells and funeral bells. / Maestro Ivo Lipanović jedan je od naših najistaknutijih dirigenata, a u ciklus Kanconijer dolazi kako bi ravnao simfonijskim programom uz soliste i zbor. Operna glazba zastupljena je glasovitim orkestralnim ulomkom _ Plesom sa sedam velova iz Salome Richarda Straussa, za koji je muzikolog i Straussov biograf Ernst Krause ustvrdio da "uspostavlja modernu glazbenu formulu za prikaz ekstatične senzualne želje te ju dovodi do savršenstva". Skladatelj čija je glazba utkana u temelje nacionalnog smjera hrvatske glazbe 20. stoljeća, Krešimir Baranović, 1927. posegnuo je za stihovima Frana Galovića iz zbirke Z mojih bregov. Pjesme iz te zbirke smatraju se začetkom novije kajkavske poezije, a Baranović je izabrao tri pjesme _ Pozdravlenje, Međaš i Kum Martin. Raskošno uglazbljene za bariton i orkestar evociraju široku paletu slika: od seoske idile, običaja i ozračja, preko postupaka i osjećaja pojedinaca, do skrovitih izraza nostalgije, tjeskobe, samoće i prolaznosti. Baritonu Matiji Meiću, koji gradi uspješnu karijeru u Njemačkoj, u drugome dijelu koncerta pridružit će se sopranistica Valentina Fijačko Kobić, prvakinja Hrvatskog narodnog kazalište u Zagrebu, i tenor Filip Filipović, solist iste kazališne kuće. Njihova suradnja bit će ujedno vrhunac ovoga programa koji donosi monumentalna simfonija Zvona Sergeja Rahmanjinova. Djelo sadrži stihove istoimene pjesme E. A. Poea u slobodnom prijevodu na ruski jezik te je ujedno posveta ruskim crkvenim zvonima i načinu na koji prate ljudski život. Prošireni sastav orkestra slikovito dočarava kampanološke simbole za različite tipove zvona: božićne zvončiće, svadbena zvona, zvona za uzbunu i pogrebna zvona.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of the show Conversation with a reason is sociologist and political scientist Dražen Lalić. He will discover why his family history became an obsession that he could not let go of, but had to dive into it and write the book Two Houses Above the Sea. We will discuss the differences between different levels of memory culture _ private, family and collective _ and why Lalić believes that the traumas of the Second World War are still unhealed. How should we as a society deal with divisions and why is empathy even for victims "on the other side" important? The book, which tells about all of us through the story of two Dalmatian families, is the reason for this conversation with Dražen Lalić. / Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je sociolog i politolog Dražen Lalić. Otkrivat će zašto mu je obiteljska povijest postala opsesija koju nije mogao pustiti, već je morao zaroniti u nju i napisati knjigu Dvije kuće iznad mora. Razgovarat ćemo o razlikama između različitih razina kulture sjećanja _ privatne, obiteljske i kolektivne _ te o tome zašto Lalić smatra da su traume iz Drugog svjetskog rata i dalje neizliječene. Kako se kao društvo trebamo nositi s podjelama i zašto je važna empatija čak i prema žrtvama "s druge strane"? Knjiga, koja kroz priču o dvjema dalmatinskim obiteljima govori o svima nama, razlog je za ovaj razgovor s Draženom Lalićem.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: Every week, passionate readers, critics and theorists discuss one title that is currently being read in Croatia. / Svaki tjedan strastveni čitatelji, kritičari i teoretičari razgovaraju o jednom naslovu koji se trenutačno čita u Hrvatskoj.

programme.title: Klub čitatelja
programme.desc: Readers' club _ Supplementary teaching / Klub čitatelja _ Dopunska nastava

programme.title: Bagdadski Messi
programme.desc: Eleven-year-old Hamoudi loves football and dreams of reaching the level of his idol Lionel Messi. One day he becomes the victim of a suicide attack in Iraq, in which he loses his leg. While his parents do everything they can to protect the family, Hamoudi is determined to fight to realize his shattered dream. / Jedanaestogodišnji Hamoudi voli nogomet i mašta o tome da dosegne razinu svojeg idola Lionela Messija. Jednog dana postaje žrtvom samoubilačkog napada u Iraku, u kojem gubi nogu. Dok njegovi roditelji čine sve što mogu kako bi zaštitili obitelj, Hamoudi je odlučan boriti se da ostvari svoj uništeni san.

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: After Lisa joins the school brass band, Shauna Chalmers unexpectedly becomes her mentor. During this time, Homer becomes a brewer. / Nakon što se Lisa pridruži školskom limenom orkestru, Shauna Chalmers neočekivano joj postaje mentorica. Za to vrijeme, Homer postaje pivar.

programme.title: Orao protiv morskog psa
programme.desc: Lilly is a shy and somewhat unusual waitress. She falls in love with Jarrod, a video game geek. After bonding at a "favorite animal" themed party, Lilly follows Jarrod to his hometown, where he wants to confront a former school bully. During this journey, both discover their own insecurities and what it means to accept yourself and others. / Lilly je sramežljiva i pomalo neobična konobarica. Zaljubljuje se u Jarroda, mahera za videoigre. Nakon što se zbliže na zabavi na temu "omiljene životinje", Lilly prati Jarroda u njegov rodni grad, gdje se on želi suočiti s nekadašnjim školskim zlostavljačem. Tijekom tog putovanja oboje otkrivaju vlastite nesigurnosti i što znači prihvatiti sebe i druge.

programme.title: Soloists, Ave Chamber Choir, Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT conducted by Ivo Lipanović - KD V. Lisinski / Solisti, Komorni zbor Ave, Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Ive Lipanovića - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Maestro Ivo Lipanović is one of our most prominent conductors, and he comes to the Kanconijer cycle to direct the symphonic program with soloists and choir. The opera music is represented by the famous orchestral excerpt _Dance with Seven Veils from Salome by Richard Strauss, which the musicologist and Strauss biographer Ernst Krause stated "establishes the modern musical formula for the representation of ecstatic sensual desire and brings it to perfection". In 1927, Krešimir Baranović, a composer whose music is woven into the foundations of the national direction of Croatian music in the 20th century, reached for the verses of Fran Galović from the collection Z mojih bregov. The poems from that collection are considered the beginning of new Kajkavian poetry, and Baranović chose three poems _ Pozdravlenje, Međaš and Kum Martin. Lavishly set to music for baritone and orchestra, they evoke a wide range of images: from village idylls, customs and atmosphere, through the actions and feelings of individuals, to hidden expressions of nostalgia, anxiety, loneliness and transience. Baritone Matija Meić, who is building a successful career in Germany, will be joined in the second part of the concert by soprano Valentina Fijačko Kobić, champion of the Croatian National Theater in Zagreb, and tenor Filip Filipović, soloist of the same theater company. Their collaboration will also be the highlight of this program, which brings the monumental symphony Bells by Sergei Rachmaninoff. The work contains verses of the poem of the same name by E. A. Poe in a free translation into Russian, and is also a dedication to Russian church bells and the way they accompany human life. The expanded composition of the orchestra vividly evokes campanological symbols for different types of bells: Christmas bells, wedding bells, alarm bells and funeral bells. / Maestro Ivo Lipanović jedan je od naših najistaknutijih dirigenata, a u ciklus Kanconijer dolazi kako bi ravnao simfonijskim programom uz soliste i zbor. Operna glazba zastupljena je glasovitim orkestralnim ulomkom _ Plesom sa sedam velova iz Salome Richarda Straussa, za koji je muzikolog i Straussov biograf Ernst Krause ustvrdio da "uspostavlja modernu glazbenu formulu za prikaz ekstatične senzualne želje te ju dovodi do savršenstva". Skladatelj čija je glazba utkana u temelje nacionalnog smjera hrvatske glazbe 20. stoljeća, Krešimir Baranović, 1927. posegnuo je za stihovima Frana Galovića iz zbirke Z mojih bregov. Pjesme iz te zbirke smatraju se začetkom novije kajkavske poezije, a Baranović je izabrao tri pjesme _ Pozdravlenje, Međaš i Kum Martin. Raskošno uglazbljene za bariton i orkestar evociraju široku paletu slika: od seoske idile, običaja i ozračja, preko postupaka i osjećaja pojedinaca, do skrovitih izraza nostalgije, tjeskobe, samoće i prolaznosti. Baritonu Matiji Meiću, koji gradi uspješnu karijeru u Njemačkoj, u drugome dijelu koncerta pridružit će se sopranistica Valentina Fijačko Kobić, prvakinja Hrvatskog narodnog kazalište u Zagrebu, i tenor Filip Filipović, solist iste kazališne kuće. Njihova suradnja bit će ujedno vrhunac ovoga programa koji donosi monumentalna simfonija Zvona Sergeja Rahmanjinova. Djelo sadrži stihove istoimene pjesme E. A. Poea u slobodnom prijevodu na ruski jezik te je ujedno posveta ruskim crkvenim zvonima i načinu na koji prate ljudski život. Prošireni sastav orkestra slikovito dočarava kampanološke simbole za različite tipove zvona: božićne zvončiće, svadbena zvona, zvona za uzbunu i pogrebna zvona.

programme.title: A bolt from the blue / Grom iz vedra neba
programme.desc: On November 13, 1990, in the New Zealand coastal town of Aramoani, resident David Gray killed 13 people with a large-caliber automatic weapon. It was the worst mass murder in New Zealand's history at the time. While the emergency services tried to reach Aramoana, a handful of young, lightly armed local police officers risked their lives in the search for the attacker. Frightened and confused residents were trapped in their homes for 24 hours, not knowing where David Gray was and whether they would become his next victims. On that terrible day, ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances showed extraordinary courage. / Dana 13. studenoga 1990. u novozelandskom primorskom gradiću Aramoani mještanin David Gray automatskim je oružjem velikog kalibra usmrtio 13 ljudi. Bilo je to najgore masovno ubojstvo u povijesti Novog Zelanda u to doba. Dok su hitne službe pokušavale doći do Aramoane, šačica mladih, slabo naoružanih lokalnih policajaca riskirala je život u potrazi za napadačem. Uplašeni i zbunjeni stanovnici bili su zatočeni u svojim kućama puna 24 sata, ne znajući gdje se David Gray nalazi i hoće li baš oni postati njegova sljedeća žrtva. Tog su strašnog dana obični ljudi u izvanrednim okolnostima pokazali iznimnu hrabrost.

programme.title: Soloists, Ave Chamber Choir, Choir and Symphony Orchestra of HRT conducted by Ivo Lipanović - KD V. Lisinski / Solisti, Komorni zbor Ave, Zbor i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Ive Lipanovića - KD V. Lisinski

programme.title: The World As It Was: Klonimir's Film Records / Svijet kakav je nekad bio: Klonimirovi filmski zapisi
programme.desc: About fifty short films by Mladen Santrić created on the basis of purchased footage of the former pilot Klonimir Sertić. / Pedesetak filmova kratkog formata Mladena Santrića nastalih na temelju otkupljene filmske građe nekadašnjeg pilota Klonimira Sertića.

programme.title: Tern around the world / Čigrom oko svijeta
programme.desc: In the second episode, we will follow the crossing of the Atlantic on one of the most popular sailing routes _ from the Canary Islands to the Caribbean. The Tern departs from the island of Tenerife on a 2,900-mile voyage to Antigua and Guadalupe. During the 25 days of sailing, fish is caught, the boat and equipment are maintained, buhtli is prepared and a special way of life is lived. The crew members on this route are five Croats and five Slovenians, and for many of them this is the first crossing of the Atlantic. / U drugoj epizodi pratit ćemo prijelaz preko Atlantika jednom od najpopularnijih jedriličarskih ruta _ od Kanarskih otoka do Kariba. "Čigra" kreće s otoka Teneriffe na 2900 milja dugu plovidbu do Antigue i Guadalupe. Tijekom 25 dana plovidbe lovi se riba, održavaju brod i oprema, pripremaju buhtli i živi se posebnim načinom života. Na ovoj su ruti članovi posade pet Hrvata i pet Slovenaca, a mnogima od njih ovo je prvi prijelaz Atlantika.

programme.title: Notes on language / Bilješke o jeziku
programme.desc: Bogoslav Šulek, we could say, is the father of our scientific terminology. In the 19th century, the natural sciences flourished throughout Europe. Šulek wants to acquaint the Croatian public with their achievements and at the same time come up with words and terms for new sciences and their discoveries. His terms are for oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen, thermometer, pressure gauge, etc. Some words have not caught on, such as lučba (chemistry), zorba (theory), chinba (practice), etc. In what areas and under what conditions did Bogoslav Šulek work, this show tells. / Bogoslav Šulek, mogli bismo reći, otac je naše znanstvene terminologije. U 19. stoljeću u cijeloj Europi cvatu prirodne znanosti. Šulek s njihovim dostignućima želi upoznati hrvatsku javnost i ujedno smisliti riječi, termine, za nove znanosti i njihova otkrića. Njegovi su termini za kisik, vodik, dušik, toplomjer, tlakomjer i sl. Neke riječi nisu zaživjele, kao lučba (kemija), zorba (teorija), činba (praksa) i sl. Na kojim je područjima i u kojim uvjetima djelovao Bogoslav Šulek, govori ova emisija.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: After Mayor Humdinger steals the concert equipment, it's up to the Big Truck Dogs to rescue him. // Al's big load gets unhooked and it's up to Psići with big trucks to save his friend. / Nakon što gradonačelnik Humdinger ukrade opremu za koncert, Psići s velikim kamionima ga moraju spasiti. // Alov veliki teret se otkvači i na Psićima s velikim kamionima je da spase svog prijatelja.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki.

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Biba gets upset when Lu leaves their pillow castle to play with baby Bo. / Biba se uzruja kad Lu ode iz njihovog dvorca od jastuka kako bi se igrala s bebom Boom.

programme.title: Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: There is a fly in the room! Muc is after her like crazy and nothing can stop him _ the furniture, the shelves, not even the sleeping Tweedy. / U sobici je jedna muha! Muc je naganja kao lud i ništa ga ne može spriječiti _ namještaj, police, pa čak ni Tvidi koji spava.

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a cheerful society in which there are the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: There is trash everywhere in the underwater world! Some garbage is even on Štefa and sea animals. The numbers must save them by removing the garbage from them and stopping its spread. / U podvodnom svijetu posvuda je smeće! Neko smeće čak je i na Štefi i morskim životinjama. Brojčići ih moraju spasiti tako što će maknuti smeće s njih i zaustaviti njegovo širenje.

programme.title: The song Medo, everything is going well / Pjesmica Medo, sve ide redom
programme.desc: Medo, everything is going in order A cheerful and fun song that introduces us to the rules of good behavior. With the help of Aunt Cow and forest friends, an impatient bear will learn why it's not polite to push yourself over the line. When he wants something _ honey or ice cream, he should be nice and stand in line! / Medo, sve ide redom Vesela i zabavna pjesmica koja nas upoznaje s pravilima lijepog ponašanja. Uz pomoć tete Krave i šumskih prijatelja, jedan nestrpljivi medo naučit će zašto nije pristojno gurati se preko reda. Već kada nešto želi _ med ili sladoled, treba biti fin i stati u red!

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The Love Monster is looking forward to showing off his favorite shell to all of Slatkograd during Show Day, but then he finds out that the theme of the day is _ unicorns! / Ljubavno Čudovište se veseli što će tijekom Dana za pokazivanje cijelom Slatkogradu pokazati svoju omiljenu školjku, ali tada sazna da su tema dana _ jednorozi!

programme.title: Consumer code / Potrošački kod
programme.desc: We travel more and more often, and with that the risk of travel fraud also increases. These include fake photos of destinations, faulty booking confirmation links and fake "bargain" offers. Problems often arise due to flight cancellations or delays. More than a month ago, the eighth graders of the Dragutin Tadijanović Elementary School in Petrin were supposed to go to the graduation ceremony, but the travel agency "Klek" canceled the trip just two days before departure. To date, the parents have not received a refund. Will the injured party be able to recover the lost money by activating the insurance? Guests: Tomislav Fain, President of the Association of Travel Agencies Marina Novaković Matanić, Association for Consumer Protection Korana / Putujemo sve više i sve češće, a s time raste i rizik od prijevara na putovanjima. To uključuje lažne fotografije destinacija, neispravne poveznice za potvrdu rezervacija te lažne "povoljne" ponude. Problemi često nastaju i zbog otkazivanja ili kašnjenja letova. Prije više od mjesec dana na maturalac su trebali otići osmaši dvaju razreda petrinjske Osnovne škole Dragutina Tadijanovića, no turistička agencija "Klek" otkazala je putovanje svega dva dana prije polaska. Roditelji do danas nisu dobili povrat novca. Hoće li aktiviranjem osiguranja oštećeni uspjeti doći do izgubljenog novca? Gosti: Tomislav Fain, predsjednik Udruge putničkih agencija Marina Novaković Matanić, Udruga za zaštitu potrošača Korana

programme.title: Prizma - multinacionalni magazin
programme.desc: We talk about the convoy of young Bosniaks and their friends to Srebrenica and Potočare, we discover what the teachers of the Slavic language and culture teach, who performed at the Theater Evenings of National Minorities in Zagreb, and how the small but valuable editorial office of the Ruthenian Association works, which prepares magazines and books in the Ruthenian language. / Govorimo o konvoju mladih Bošnjaka i njihovih prijatelja u Srebrenicu i Potočare, otkrivamo što uče učitelji slovenskog jezika i kulture, tko je nastupio na Kazališnim večerima nacionalnih manjina u Zagrebu, te kako radi mala, ali vrijedna redakcija Saveza Rusina, koja priprema časopise i knjige na rusinskom jeziku.

programme.title: Talenti EU regija
programme.desc: How do European Union member regions respond to demographic challenges? How to stop emigration and how to reward the creativity of talents? Answers to questions about the increasingly pronounced problem of brain drain and growing differences in development are provided by the show "Talents of the EU Region". In 26 short stories of Television Slovenia, examples of good practices from 11 European countries are presented. The project "Talents of the EU region" shows the results of the cohesion policy of the European Union _ one of the key pillars of European development. / Kako regije članica Europske unije odgovaraju na demografske izazove? Kako zaustaviti emigraciju i kako nagraditi kreativnost talenata? Odgovore na pitanja o sve izraženijem problemu odljeva mozgova i rastućim razlikama u razvijenosti donosi emisija "Talenti EU regija". U 26 kratkih priča Televizije Slovenije predstavljaju se primjeri dobrih praksi iz 11 europskih zemalja. Projekt "Talenti EU regija" prikazuje rezultate kohezijske politike Europske unije _ jednog od ključnih stupova europskog razvoja.

programme.title: Romano Bolković - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: We talk with the rector of the University of Zagreb, Stjepan Lakušić, about the key challenges and opportunities that shape the future of the most important higher education institution in Croatia. We will touch on the topic of adapting study programs to the labor market and the needs of the modern economy, as well as the importance of internationalization of education by attracting top foreign students and researchers. We will discuss investments in scientific research, finding new sources of funding, and ways in which the University can strengthen technology transfer and encourage innovations that will bring social and economic benefit. We will pay special attention to the University's role in strengthening Croatia's competitiveness in global challenges, such as climate change, digitization and cyber security. The Rector will talk to us about the importance of an interdisciplinary approach to research and education, as well as strategies for preserving academic freedom, institutional autonomy and transparency in management. We will also discuss the promotion of gender equality, inclusion and support for young scientists to stay and develop in Croatia. Finally, we will touch on the topics of digital transformation of the University, the development of critical and creative thinking among students, as well as the importance of increasing social trust in the academic community. Join us in a conversation about how the University of Zagreb can and wants to be the driver of scientific, technological and social progress in Croatia. Prof. Ph.D. Stjepan Lakušić, former dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, took up the position of rector of the University of Zagreb on October 1, 2022. The mandate of the new rector lasts four years, ie until September 30, 2026. Prof. Ph.D. Stjepan Lakušić was born in 1968 in Slavonski Brod. He graduated in 1994 from the Faculty of Civil Engineering at the University of Zagreb, where he was then employed as an assistant _ researcher in the Institute of Roads. In 1998, he completed his master's degree at that faculty, and in 2003, he obtained the academic degree of doctor of science. In November 2017, he was elected to the scientific-teaching position of full-time professor in the field of technical sciences, the scientific field of construction, the scientific branch of transport. Professor Lakušić has been teaching at the Faculty of Civil Engineering at the University of Zagreb since year 1995/1996, and at the postgraduate studies of that Faculty, he has been teaching since year 2004/2005 He was a guest teacher at the Faculty of Civil Engineering at the University of Rijeka and Skopje. Before the rector's mandate, he held the positions of vice dean and dean of the Faculty of Civil Engineering at the University of Zagreb. Scientific work of prof. Ph.D. Stjepan Lakušić is focused on the field of railways, especially on the research of tram and railway track constructions, the dynamic impact of vehicles on the track, noise and vibrations on the tracks, and the elements of attaching the rail to the base. Professor Lakušić has published as an author or co-author 26 scientific papers in international and domestic journals, 120 papers in proceedings of international and domestic scientific conferences, and 35 book chapters. He participated in numerous international and domestic scientific meetings, was the editor of 13 books and is the editor-in-chief of the magazine Građevinar. In addition, prof. Ph.D. Stjepan Lakušić initiated several international and domestic scientific and scientific-professional conferences and events. His international scientific project Rubberised concrete noise barriers _ RUCONBAR and the innovative product created within that project _ absorbent concrete barriers for noise protection with recycled rubber ‒ RUCONBAR, have been awarded with several international and domestic awards in Belgium, Croatia, the Netherlands, the USA and Switzerland. Professor Lakušić is a member of several professional organizations and a member of the general assembly of the International Association FEHRL (Forum of European National Highway Research Laboratories). He led several domestic and international projects, and was especially involved in the professional affairs of the Department of Railways at the Faculty of Civil Engineering. After the earthquake in the city of Zagreb, he led the preparation of important documents for the Government of the Republic of Croatia, initiated the establishment of the Croatian Center for Earthquake Engineering (HCPI) as a branch of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, and is a member of the Croatian Expert Council for Post-Earthquake Reconstruction. / S rektorom Sveučilišta u Zagrebu Stjepanom Lakušićem razgovaramo o ključnim izazovima i prilikama koje oblikuju budućnost najvažnije visokoobrazovne institucije u Hrvatskoj. Dotaknut ćemo se tema prilagodbe studijskih programa tržištu rada i potrebama modernog gospodarstva, kao i važnosti internacionalizacije obrazovanja privlačenjem vrhunskih stranih studenata i istraživača. Razgovarat ćemo o ulaganjima u znanstvena istraživanja, pronalaženju novih izvora financiranja te o načinima na koje Sveučilište može osnažiti transfer tehnologije i potaknuti inovacije koje će donijeti društvenu i gospodarsku korist. Posebnu pozornost posvetit ćemo ulozi Sveučilišta u jačanju konkurentnosti Hrvatske u globalnim izazovima, kao što su klimatske promjene, digitalizacija i kibernetička sigurnost. Rektor će nam govoriti o važnosti interdisciplinarnog pristupa istraživanjima i obrazovanju, kao i o strategijama za očuvanje akademske slobode, institucionalne autonomije i transparentnosti u upravljanju. Razgovarat ćemo i o poticanju rodne ravnopravnosti, inkluzije te podršci mladim znanstvenicima da ostanu i razvijaju se u Hrvatskoj. Na kraju, dotaknut ćemo se tema digitalne transformacije Sveučilišta, razvoja kritičkog i kreativnog mišljenja kod studenata, kao i važnosti povećanja društvenog povjerenja u akademsku zajednicu. Pridružite nam se u razgovoru o tome kako Sveučilište u Zagrebu može i želi biti pokretač znanstvenog, tehnološkog i društvenog napretka u Hrvatskoj. Prof. dr. sc. Stjepan Lakušić, nekadašnji dekan Građevinskoga fakulteta, stupio je 1. listopada 2022. na dužnost rektora Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Mandat novoga rektora traje četiri godine, odnosno do 30. rujna 2026. Prof. dr. sc. Stjepan Lakušić rođen je 1968. u Slavonskom Brodu. Diplomirao je 1994. na Građevinskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu, gdje je potom zaposlen kao asistent _ znanstveni novak u Zavodu za prometnice. Na tom je fakultetu 1998. završio i magisterij znanosti, a 2003. stekao akademski stupanj doktora znanosti. U studenome 2017. izabran je u znanstveno-nastavno zvanje redovitoga profesora u trajnom zvanju u području tehničkih znanosti, znanstvenom polju građevinarstvo, znanstvenoj grani prometnice. Profesor Lakušić nastavu na Građevinskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu izvodi od ak. god. 1995./1996., a na poslijediplomskom studiju toga Fakulteta predaje od ak. god. 2004./2005. Bio je gostujući nastavnik na Građevinskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Rijeci te u Skoplju. Prije rektorskoga mandata obnašao je dužnosti prodekana i dekana Građevinskoga fakulteta Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Znanstveni rad prof. dr. sc. Stjepana Lakušića usmjeren je na područje željeznica, posebice na istraživanje konstrukcija tramvajskoga i željezničkoga kolosijeka, dinamičkoga utjecaja vozila na kolosijek, buke i vibracija na kolosijecima te elemenata pričvršćenja tračnice na podlogu. Profesor Lakušić objavio je kao autor ili koautor 26 znanstvenih radova u međunarodnim i domaćim časopisima, 120 radova u zbornicima međunarodnih i domaćih znanstvenih skupova te 35 poglavlja u knjigama. Sudjelovao je na brojnim međunarodnim i domaćim znanstvenim skupovima, bio je urednik 13 knjiga te je glavni urednik časopisa Građevinar. Uz to, prof. dr. sc. Stjepan Lakušić pokrenuo je nekoliko međunarodnih i domaćih znanstvenih i znanstveno-stručnih konferencija i događaja. Njegov međunarodni znanstveni projekt Rubberised concrete noise barriers _ RUCONBAR i inovativni proizvod koji je nastao u okviru toga projekta _ apsorbirajuće betonske barijere za zaštitu od buke s recikliranom gumom ‒ RUCONBAR, nagrađeni su s više međunarodnih i domaćih nagrada u Belgiji, Hrvatskoj, Nizozemskoj, SAD-u i Švicarskoj. Profesor Lakušić član je više strukovnih organizacija te član glavne skupštine Međunarodnoga udruženja FEHRL (Forum of European National Highway Research Laboratories). Vodio je više domaćih i međunarodnih projekata, a posebno je uključen i u stručne poslove Katedre za željeznice Građevinskoga fakulteta. Nakon potresa u gradu Zagrebu vodio je izradu važnih dokumenata za Vladu Republike Hrvatske, pokrenuo je osnivanje Hrvatskoga centra za potresno inženjerstvo (HCPI) kao podružnice Građevinskog fakulteta te je član Stručnoga savjeta RH za obnovu nakon potresa.

programme.title: Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: They came from Bosnia for work. In the blazing dawn, they entered the facilities of the Sisak Ironworks and built a better tomorrow. That tomorrow has long been in the past that Sajo, Edo, Mirsad remember... All of them in Caprago, that workers' settlement next to the ironworks, lived through both the most beautiful years of the industrial boom and the most difficult moments of the collapse of the ironworks. Today, Caprag is at a new beginning. There is no industry, but there is a desire for this multinational city within the city to breathe again. / Dolazili su iz Bosne za poslom. U plamenim zorama ulazili su u pogone željezare Sisak i gradili neko bolje sutra. To sutra odavno je već prošlost koje se prisjećaju Sajo, Edo, Mirsad... Svi su oni u Capragu, tom radničkom naselju uz željezaru, proživjeli i najljepše godine industrijskog uzleta i najteže trenutke raspada željezare. Danas je Caprag na nekom novom početku. Industrije nema, ali ima želje da taj multinacionalni grad u gradu ponovno prodiše punim plućima.

programme.title: In the network of the First / U mreži Prvog
programme.desc: What does the increased capacity of the LNG terminal on Krk mean for Croatia? Will American sanctions against Russian companies affect the agreement between Janaf and MOL regarding the supply of oil to Hungary? Along with Russia, who will be affected by the US sanctions on the two largest Russian oil companies? In today's show, the director of the Energy Administration of the Ministry of Economy Željko Krevzelj, the director of LNG Croatia Ivan Fugaš and oil expert Davor Štern talk about this. / Što za Hrvatsku znači povećani kapacitet LNG terminala na Krku? Hoće li američke sankcije ruskim kompanijama utjecati na dogovor između Janafa i MOL-a oko isporuke nafte Mađarskoj? Koga će, uz Rusiju, zahvatiti američke sankcije dvjema najvećim ruskim naftnim kompanijama? O tome u današnjoj emisiji govore ravnatelj Uprave za energetiku Ministarstva gospodarstva Željko Krevzelj, direktor LNG-a Hrvatska Ivan Fugaš i naftni stručnjak Davor Štern.

programme.title: View across the border - Croats in Bosnia and Herzegovina / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: In the show: Better connection of the south of Herzegovina with the Dubrovnik area _ new road opened from Zavala to the border with the Republic of Croatia. Numerous projects in Čitluk _ modernization for a better quality of life of the population. In Čapljina, the meeting "Efficient future _ Conference on energy efficiency, ESG and new technologies" was organized. A workshop on adapting agriculture to climate change was held in Hutovo Blato. How do Croats live in Duboštica, a settlement in the municipality of Vareš? Didak's days began, in memory of the great Franciscan and enlightener. / U emisiji: Bolja povezanost juga Hercegovine s dubrovačkim područjem _ otvorena nova prometnica od Zavale do granice s Republikom Hrvatskom. Brojni projekti u Čitluku _ modernizacija za kvalitetniji život stanovništva. U Čapljini je organiziran skup "Učinkovita budućnost _ Konferencija o energetskoj učinkovitosti, ESG-u i novim tehnologijama". Održana je radionica o prilagodbi poljoprivrede klimatskim promjenama u Hutovu blatu. Kako žive Hrvati u Duboštici, naselju u općini Vareš? Počeli su Didakovi dani, u sjećanje na velikog franjevca i prosvjetitelja.

programme.title: Romano Bolković - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Branko Bačić is the Vice-President of the Government of the Republic of Croatia and the Minister of Spatial Planning, Construction and State Property. He was born on June 7, 1959 in Dubrovnik, and in 1982 he graduated from the Faculty of Geodesy of the University of Zagreb. He worked in the Administration for Cadastre and Geodetic Affairs, where he held the position of director, and participated in the Homeland War on the Southern Front. From 1993 to 2004, he was elected mayor of the Municipality of Blato on Korčula three times. He has been a member of the Croatian Democratic Union since 1990 and has been a member of parliament several times. He held a number of positions in the state administration: from 2004 to 2010, he was the state secretary in the Ministry of the Sea, Transport and Development, and from 2010 to 2011, the minister of construction and environmental protection. He has held numerous positions in the HDZ, including that of secretary general and vice president of the party since 2020. We talk with the Deputy Prime Minister Branko Bačić about the key issues of current politics, achievements and challenges of the Government in the past nine years. At the center are the topics of stability in times of crisis _ from earthquakes and pandemics to energy and inflationary crises _ and an assessment of the extent to which the Government has achieved its program goals. We will also talk about reconstruction after the earthquake, which Bačić accelerated by taking over the department, about criticism of the departure of ministers and the perception of corruption, as well as about measures to mitigate inflation and preserve the standard of living citizens. The special topic of discussion is the National Housing Policy Plan until 2030, the first such strategic document in Croatia, with an emphasis on solving the housing issue of young people, the impact of tourism on the rental market and measures to ensure affordable housing. We also consider the laws that marked the mandate _ from the Law on Reconstruction and Management of State Property to the Law on Building Maintenance _ and which of them the Vice President considers to be the most important step forward. / Branko Bačić potpredsjednik je Vlade Republike Hrvatske i ministar prostornoga uređenja, graditeljstva i državne imovine. Rođen je 7. lipnja 1959. u Dubrovniku, a 1982. godine diplomirao je na Geodetskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Radio je u Upravi za katastar i geodetske poslove, gdje je obnašao dužnost direktora, te sudjelovao u Domovinskom ratu na Južnom bojištu. Od 1993. do 2004. tri je puta biran za načelnika Općine Blato na Korčuli. Član je Hrvatske demokratske zajednice od 1990. te je više puta bio saborski zastupnik. U državnoj upravi obnašao je niz dužnosti: od 2004. do 2010. bio je državni tajnik u Ministarstvu mora, prometa i razvitka, a od 2010. do 2011. ministar graditeljstva i zaštite okoliša. U HDZ-u je obnašao brojne funkcije, među kojima i onu glavnog tajnika te potpredsjednika stranke od 2020. godine. S potpredsjednikom Vlade Brankom Bačićem razgovaramo o ključnim pitanjima aktualne politike, postignućima i izazovima Vlade u proteklih devet godina. U središtu su teme stabilnosti u kriznim vremenima _ od potresa i pandemije do energetske i inflacijske krize _ te procjena koliko je Vlada ostvarila svoje programske ciljeve.Govorit ćemo i o obnovi nakon potresa, koju je Bačić ubrzao preuzimanjem resora, o kritikama na račun odlazaka ministara i percepciji korupcije, kao i o mjerama za ublažavanje inflacije i očuvanje životnog standarda građana.Posebna tema razgovora je Nacionalni plan stambene politike do 2030. godine, prvi takav strateški dokument u Hrvatskoj, s naglaskom na rješavanje stambenog pitanja mladih, utjecaj turizma na tržište najma i mjere za osiguravanje priuštivog stanovanja. Razmatramo i zakone koji su obilježili mandat _ od Zakona o obnovi i upravljanju državnom imovinom do Zakona o održavanju zgrada _ te koji od njih potpredsjednik smatra najvažnijim iskorakom.

programme.title: Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: They came from Bosnia for work. In the blazing dawn, they entered the facilities of the Sisak Ironworks and built a better tomorrow. That tomorrow has long been in the past that Sajo, Edo, Mirsad remember... All of them in Caprago, that workers' settlement next to the ironworks, lived through both the most beautiful years of the industrial boom and the most difficult moments of the collapse of the ironworks. Today, Caprag is at a new beginning. There is no industry, but there is a desire for this multinational city within the city to breathe again. / Dolazili su iz Bosne za poslom. U plamenim zorama ulazili su u pogone željezare Sisak i gradili neko bolje sutra. To sutra odavno je već prošlost koje se prisjećaju Sajo, Edo, Mirsad... Svi su oni u Capragu, tom radničkom naselju uz željezaru, proživjeli i najljepše godine industrijskog uzleta i najteže trenutke raspada željezare. Danas je Caprag na nekom novom početku. Industrije nema, ali ima želje da taj multinacionalni grad u gradu ponovno prodiše punim plućima.

programme.title: Monster Jam
programme.desc: Monster Jam is an extreme competition that has been held primarily in North America since 1992. / Monster Jam е екстремно състезание, което се провежда основно в Северна Америка от 1992 година насам.

programme.title: Extreme-E Desert Ex-pri / Eкстрийм-Е Пустинно Екс-при
programme.desc: Extreme E is an off-road race with electric jeeps that takes place in remote places of the world such as the Amazon rainforest. The purpose of the competition is to direct people to climate change in the world and the reasonable use of cars. / Екстрийм Е е офроуд състезание с електрически джипове, което се провежда в отдалечени места на света като тропическите гори на Амазонка. Целта на състезанието е да насочи хората към климатичните промени в света и разумното използване на автомобилите.

programme.title: Arena sport / Арена спорт
programme.desc: The analytical and informative sports show "Arena Sport" will take viewers beyond pure sports news, expanding and enriching it not only with a picture, but also with the first comments and reactions to what is happening. / Аналитично-информационното спортно предаване "Арена Спорт" ще отведе зрителите отвъд чистите новини в спорта, като ги разшири и обогати не само с картина, но и с първите коментари и реакции на случващото се.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Teodor Salparov / Зала на славата: Теодор Салпаров
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a column in which we present the most famous faces from the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, who with their successes over the years have delighted sports lovers in our country. In the "Hall of Fame" they talk about themselves - about the successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about the sport that plays a huge role in life and about life after sport. Thanks to the rich archive of the Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the greatest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sports. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Cycling: Tour of Croatia / Колоездене: Обиколка на Хърватия
programme.desc: The Tour of Croatia is one of the most significant events in cycling, attracting world professional teams and is part of the UCI European calendar. The tour offers exciting stages that pass through some of Croatia's most beautiful scenery, from the Adriatic coast to the interior of the country. / Обиколката на Хърватия (Tour of Croatia) е едно от най-значимите събития в колоезденето, което привлича световни професионални отбори и е част от Европейския календар на UCI. Турът предлага вълнуващи етапи, които преминават през някои от най-красивите пейзажи на Хърватия — от Адриатическото крайбрежие до вътрешността на страната.

programme.title: The last one wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "Last One Wins" is a fun-informative, family-friendly quiz show featuring four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. At the end of each round, one participant is eliminated, and the winner earns the right to compete in the next episode and play until someone else manages to defeat them. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: A different Italy / Една различна Италия
programme.desc: The episodes contain different thematic objects. / Епизодите съдържат различни по тематика обекти.

programme.title: I am… / Аз съм…
programme.desc: "I am" is a short portrait form that presents interesting and talented young people performing in various fields - athletes, artists, artists, singers. The purpose of the column is to promote the achievements of the young and active part of our society. / "Аз съм" е кратка портретна форма, която представя интересни и талантливи млади хора, изявяващи се в различни области – спортисти, артисти, художници, певци. Целта на рубриката е да популяризира постиженията на младата и активна част от нашето общество.

programme.title: In the rhythm of the city / В ритъма на града
programme.desc: The show collects the most interesting of worldly life. Current topics from the world of show business, meetings with interesting young people and followers on the networks will await you. We'll hear the beat of the street, and AI Jen Z will help the host with the viral news. / Предаването събира най-интересното от светския живот. Ще ви очакват актуални теми от света на шоубизнеса, срещи с интересни млади хора, с последователи в мрежите. Ще чуем ритъма на улицата, а AI Джен Зи ще помага на водещата с вайръл новините.

programme.title: You have a meeting with ... Diana Lyubenova / Имате среща с ... Диана Любенова
programme.desc: The talk show "You have a meeting... with Diana Lyubenova" will host famous personalities from the world of art, culture, music, theater, journalism, sports and more. All of them will reveal their dreams to Diana Ljubenova and the viewers of public television, they will share about the road to success, about the good and difficult moments in their lives, about the priceless friendships and the people they can always count on. / В ток шоуто "Имате среща... с Диана Любенова" ще гостуват известни личности от света на изкуството, културата, музиката, театъра, журналистиката, спорта и не само. Всички те ще разкриват пред Диана Любенова и зрителите на обществената телевизия мечтите си, ще споделят за пътя към успеха, за хубавите и трудните моменти в живота си, за безценните приятелства и хората, на които винаги могат да разчитат.

programme.title: Forgotten by God / Забравени от Бога
programme.desc: Yopi is a member of a motorcycle club. His wife Yade suffers from his lack of attention and decides to organize a romantic afternoon for them. Yopi takes an overdose of morphine and falls asleep, and Yade is glad that he is home and does nothing to help him. / Йопи е член на мотоклуб. programme.title: Tribute to the stars / Omaž zvezdama

programme.title: Football - Bulgarian Cup: Spartak Pleven - Botev Plovdiv / Nogomet - Bugarski kup: Spartak Pleven - Botev Plovdiv

programme.title: Shortlist / Uži izbor

programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935, when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pokal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the third league. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. programme.title: Illertissen - Magdeburg, Football, German Cup / Illertissen - Magdeburg, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935, when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pokal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the third league. The rest of the participants come from the winners of the regional cups. The matches are played according to the single cup system, in which after the regular 90 minutes extra time is played and after the penalty shootout, if the winner is not decided by then. The final has been played every year since 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The winner of the cup secures a place in the UEFA Europa League... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Eintracht Frankfurt - Borussia Dortmund, Football, German Cup / Eintracht Frankfurt - Borussia Dortmund, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal - (sport program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Pokal dates back to 1935, when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pokal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, along with the first four teams in the third league. The rest of the participants come from the winners of the regional cups. The matches are played according to the single cup system, in which after the regular 90 minutes extra time is played and after the penalty shootout, if the winner is not decided by then. The final has been played every year since 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The winner of the cup secures a place in the UEFA Europa League... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.desc: English Football League One - (sport. film, England, 2025) The English Football League One or the official name Sky Bet League 1 according to the main sponsor of the league is the third highest football class in England below the undisputed Premiership and Championship.
