programme.title: Am Puls mit Florian Neuhann
programme.desc: One auto supplier is cutting a quarter of its jobs, the other is filing for bankruptcy. Steel companies are in the red. Not a day without bad news. "Made in Germany" at the end? ZDF business reporter Florian Neuhann travels across the country and asks: Is the situation really that bad? Is Germany about to sell out? What does that mean for the people in the country - and what has to happen for German industry to grow again? Germany - the large industrial nation: We are proud of our cars, our steel, and of "Made in Germany". But if you look around in companies, in the economy and in industry, it becomes clear: the mood is bad, Germany as a location is increasingly losing its appeal. The driving factor behind this development: the energy transition. Because it has dramatic effects on key German industries. The decision to phase out combustion engines affects over 2,000 people at Ford in Saarlouis, for example: "No matter where you look, there are job cuts and company closures in industry everywhere," says Ford works council member Markus Thal. If de-industrialization threatens Germany, then some of it has already taken place in Remscheid in the Bergisches Land: once a proud industrial city, today: deserted and empty factories standing shops. In his former hometown, ZDF host Florian Neuhann visits a company that defies high CO2 costs and cheap competition from China: Dirostahl. How much longer? Is there an end to economic recovery and prosperity? A look at Greece shows that things can look up again: in 2010, still hit by the financial crisis and labeled as a parasite of the EU, Greece's economy is now growing faster than in most other EU countries. Florian Neuhann wants to know: What can we learn from the Greeks? In Germany, they are currently relying on subsidies worth billions. The chip manufacturer Intel is investing 30 billion euros in the construction of two new production facilities in Magdeburg. An investment that Germany is paying dearly: with ten billion euros in subsidies. But announcements of job cuts are already making the rounds. Is the deal in danger of falling through? What will it take to help Germany return to its former glory? Do we have to try new things or say goodbye to old prosperity? Florian Neuhann meets Economics Minister Robert Habeck as well as people who look to the future with concern, anger and pulse - but also people who want to make a difference in this country. / Ein Autozulieferer kurzt ein Viertel der Jobs, der andere meldet Insolvenz an. Stahlkonzerne schreiben rote Zahlen. Kein Tag ohne Hiobsbotschaften. "Made in Germany" am Ende?ZDF-Wirtschaftsreporter Florian Neuhann reist quer durchs Land und fragt: Ist die Lage wirklich so schlecht? Steht Deutschland vor dem Ausverkauf? Was heiSSt das fur die Menschen im Land - und was muss passieren, damit die deutsche Industrie wieder wachst?Deutschland - die groSSe Industrienation: Wir sind stolz auf unsere Autos, unseren Stahl, auf "Made in Germany". Doch hort man sich um in Unternehmen, in der Wirtschaft und der Industrie, wird klar: Die Stimmung ist schlecht, der Standort Deutschland verliert immer mehr an Strahlkraft.Treibender Faktor hinter dieser Entwicklung: die Energiewende. Denn sie hat dramatische Auswirkungen auf deutsche Schlusselindustrien. Das beschlossene Verbrenner-Aus trifft etwa bei Ford in Saarlouis uber 2000 Menschen: "Egal, wo man hinguckt, uberall gibt es Stellenabbau und FirmenschlieSSungen in der Industrie", sagt Ford-Betriebsrat Markus Thal.Wenn Deutschland eine De-Industrialisierung droht, dann hat sie in Remscheid im Bergischen Land zum Teil bereits stattgefunden: Einst stolze Industriestadt, heute: verwaiste Fabriken und leer stehende Geschafte. In seiner ehemaligen Heimatstadt besucht ZDF-Host Florian Neuhann ein Unternehmen, das hohen CO2-Kosten und Billigkonkurrenz aus China trotzt: Dirostahl. Wie lange noch?Ist Schluss mit wirtschaftlichem Aufschwung und Wohlstand? Ein Blick nach Griechenland zeigt, dass es auch wieder aufwarts gehen kann: 2010 noch von der Finanzkrise gebeutelt und als Schmarotzer der EU betitelt, wachst Griechenlands Wirtschaft mittlerweile schneller als in den meisten anderen EU-Staaten. Florian Neuhann will wissen: Was konnen wir von den Griechen lernen?In Deutschland setzt man derweil auf milliardenschwere Subventionen. 30 Milliarden Euro investiert etwa der Chiphersteller Intel in den Bau von zwei neuen Produktionsstatten in Magdeburg. Eine Investition, die Deutschland teuer bezahlt: mit zehn Milliarden Euro Subventionen. Doch schon jetzt machen Ankundigungen vom Stellenabbau die Runde. Droht der Deal zu platzen?Was braucht es, um dem Standort Deutschland zuruck zu altem Glanz zu verhelfen? Mussen wir Neues wagen oder uns von altem Wohlstand verabschieden? Florian Neuhann trifft Wirtschaftsminister Robert Habeck sowie Menschen, die mit Sorge, Wut und Puls in die Zukunft blicken - aber auch Menschen, die Lust haben, hierzulande etwas zu bewegen.

programme.title: I have come to me and three sees. / Am Puls mit Mitri Sirin
programme.desc: On October 3rd, Germany celebrates unity - a symbol of democracy and freedom of expression. But how stable is this fundamental right today? What is still allowed to say in Germany? According to an Allensbach study, 44 percent of Germans believe that they can no longer freely express their political opinions. US Vice President Vance also criticizes: "Freedom of speech is on the decline in Europe." ZDF presenter Mitri Sirin wants to know: Is there something to it? For his “Am Puls” documentary, he launched a call and asked people in Germany what the state of freedom of expression is here. Has the social corridor of opinion actually become narrower or are we simply no longer able to tolerate other opinions? Where are the limits of freedom of expression? And who decides them? Mitri Sirin travels across the USA and Germany: He meets people who have the feeling that they are no longer allowed to say everything and feel pushed into a right-wing corner far too quickly. And it hits those who believe in freedom of expression. Where is the line between an opinion and an insult? Mitri Sirin speaks with a woman who was reported by FDP politician Marie-Agnes Strack-Zimmermann for a critical online comment - and acquitted by the court. And what does the politician, who has now filed almost 2,000 reports of hate speech, say about it? A look at the USA shows that freedom of expression is also under pressure there. Books are banned, universities are attacked, professors are censored. Mitri Sirin speaks to those affected. His impression: "The USA can no longer be described as a completely free country. The intimidation of individuals and institutions by the Trump administration, which I registered during our filming, is absolutely worrying." All of this is reminiscent of a dark chapter in German history: In the former Stasi prison Hohenschonhausen, Mitri Sirin meets Thomas Klingenstein, a former GDR dissident, now a poet. He knows what it means not to be able to speak freely. For him it is clear: Anyone who speaks of a dictatorship of opinion today fails to understand what lack of freedom really means. Democracy researcher Richard Traunmuller classifies and emphasizes how important a differentiated debate is for a democratic society, even if it means holding out opinions. "On the pulse with Mitri Sirin: Is our freedom of expression in danger?": A question that is becoming increasingly explosive. What does it do to a society when people fall silent - or become too loud? And how can a debate be conducted that allows for diversity without causing harm? The documentary is part of the series “Am Puls,” in which well-known ZDF presenters explore the issues that concern Germany. They listen, immerse themselves in the everyday lives of the viewers and shed light on the impact that political decisions have on life in all parts of society. And what urgently needs to be improved. More at https://ampuls.zdf.de / Am 3. Oktober feiert Deutschland die Einheit - ein Symbol fur Demokratie und Meinungsfreiheit. Doch wie stabil ist dieses Grundrecht heute noch? Was darf man in Deutschland noch sagen?Laut einer Allensbach-Studie glauben 44 Prozent der Deutschen, ihre politische Meinung nicht mehr frei auSSern zu konnen. Auch US-Vizeprasident Vance kritisiert: "Die Redefreiheit ist in Europa auf dem Ruckzug." ZDF-Moderator Mitri Sirin will wissen: Ist da was dran?Fur seine "Am Puls"-Doku hat er einen Aufruf gestartet und die Menschen in Deutschland gefragt, wie es um die Meinungsfreiheit bei uns bestellt ist. Ist der gesellschaftliche Meinungskorridor tatsachlich enger geworden oder halten wir andere Meinungen einfach nicht mehr aus? Wo liegt die Grenze der Meinungsfreiheit? Und wer bestimmt sie?Mitri Sirin reist quer durch die USA und durch Deutschland: Er trifft Menschen, die das Gefuhl haben, nicht mehr alles sagen zu durfen und sich viel zu schnell in eine rechte Ecke gedrangt fuhlen. Und er trifft diejenigen, die an die Meinungsfreiheit glauben.Wo ist die Grenze zwischen einer Meinung und einer Beleidigung? Mitri Sirin spricht mit einer Frau, die wegen eines kritischen Onlinekommentars von der FDP-Politikerin Marie-Agnes Strack-Zimmermann angezeigt - und vom Gericht freigesprochen wurde. Und was sagt die Politikerin, die inzwischen fast 2.000 Anzeigen wegen Hassrede gestellt hat, selbst dazu?Ein Blick in die USA zeigt: Auch dort ist die Meinungsfreiheit unter Druck. Bucher werden verboten, Universitaten angegriffen, Professorinnen und Professoren zensiert. Mitri Sirin spricht mit Betroffenen. Sein Eindruck: "Die USA kann man nicht mehr als vollig freies Land bezeichnen. Die Einschuchterung von Individuen und Institutionen durch die Trump-Administration, die ich wahrend unserer Dreharbeiten registriert habe, ist absolut besorgniserregend."Das alles erinnert an ein dunkles Kapitel deutscher Geschichte: Im ehemaligen Stasi-Gefangnis Hohenschonhausen trifft Mitri Sirin Thomas Klingenstein, ehemaliger DDR-Dissident, heute Dichter. Er weiSS, was es bedeutet, nicht frei sprechen zu konnen. Fur ihn ist klar: Wer heute von Meinungsdiktatur spricht, verkennt, was Unfreiheit wirklich bedeutet. Demokratieforscher Richard Traunmuller ordnet ein und betont, wie wichtig eine differenzierte Debatte fur eine demokratische Gesellschaft ist, auch wenn es bedeutet, Meinung auszuhalten."Am Puls mit Mitri Sirin: Ist unsere Meinungsfreiheit in Gefahr?": Eine Frage, die an Brisanz gewinnt. Was macht es mit einer Gesellschaft, wenn Menschen verstummen - oder zu laut werden? Und wie kann eine Debatte gefuhrt werden, die Vielfalt zulasst, ohne zu verletzen?Die Dokumentation ist Teil der Reihe "Am Puls", in der bildschirmbekannte ZDF-Presenter den Themen nachgehen, die Deutschland bewegen. Sie horen zu, tauchen in den Alltag der Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer ein und beleuchten, welche Auswirkungen die Entscheidungen der Politik auf das Leben in allen Teilen der Gesellschaft haben. Und was dringend verbessert werden muss.Mehr unter https://ampuls.zdf.de

programme.title: Am Puls mit Dunja Hayali
programme.desc: (from August 21, 2025)Has Germany become an unsafe country? Or do many people just believe this because they have a distorted perception influenced by the media? What pays? Crime statistics or gut feeling? Dunja Hayali meets people who have very concrete reasons for their insecurity. And she wants to know whether more could be done to ensure our safety. Just like Lea (25), who was critically injured at a city festival in Solingen around a year ago. A suspected Islamist stabbed her in the neck with a knife - one of many attacks in recent years. Although she now takes a closer look at "southern-looking people," Lea says, refugees don't pose a problem for her. But not all people deal with internal (in)security as calmly as she does. Surveys show that the 20+ generation in particular now feels just as unsafe in public places as the 60+ generation. Why is that? The ZDF presenter meets people who now avoid certain places. And police officers who are supposed to maintain order around the infamous Bremen main station. But they admit soberly: “We are always one step behind.” More and more people with an immigration background are feeling unsafe. In Magdeburg, Dunja Hayali meets a young Syrian who was stabbed by a German suspect. The state network of migrant organizations distributes thousands of "pocket alarms" to its members because the number of racist attacks has doubled compared to the previous year. "Am Puls" also shows that some problems are exacerbated by political decisions. The documentation shows that behind the scenes at the Interior Ministers' Conference, a political wrangling is delaying the security authorities' AI-supported data exchange. Critics warn that investigators will continue to recognize potential suspects too late. After the many attacks by mentally disturbed refugees, politicians are demanding that warning signals should be recognized earlier. An innovative therapy project at the University of Konstanz shows how this could be possible: effectively and inexpensively. The federal government has known about it since 2018, but nothing is happening. According to experts, around 900,000 refugees actually need treatment, but only three percent receive care. And the federal and state governments are shortening the resources for better psychosocial help. Through the many encounters with people who have very different experiences and attitudes, Dunja Hayali shows in her documentary: Security is not just a question of numbers, but also a question of feeling. It's about trust, visibility and also about enduring uncomfortable truths. The documentary is part of the series "Am Puls", in which well-known ZDF presenters explore the topics that concern Germany. They listen, immerse themselves in the everyday lives of the viewers and shed light on the impact that political decisions have on life in all parts of society. And what urgently needs to be improved. More at https://ampuls.zdf.de / (vom 21.8.2025)Ist Deutschland ein unsicheres Land geworden? Oder glauben viele Menschen das nur, weil sie, beeinflusst von den Medien, eine verzerrte Wahrnehmung haben?Was zahlt? Kriminalstatistik oder Bauchgefuhl? Dunja Hayali begegnet Menschen, die fur ihre Unsicherheit ganz konkrete Grunde haben. Und sie will wissen, ob nicht mehr fur unsere Sicherheit getan werden konnte.So wie Lea (25), die bei einem Stadtfest in Solingen vor rund einem Jahr lebensgefahrlich verletzt worden ist. Ein mutmaSSlicher Islamist hat ihr mit einem Messer in den Hals gestochen - einer von vielen Angriffen der vergangenen Jahre. Obwohl sie bei "sudlandisch aussehenden Menschen" mittlerweile genauer hinsehe, sagt Lea, stellten fur sie Gefluchtete kein Problem dar.Doch so gelassen wie sie gehen nicht alle Menschen mit der Inneren (Un-)Sicherheit um. Umfragen zeigen, dass sich insbesondere die Generation 20+ mittlerweile ebenso unsicher fuhlt an offentlichen Platzen, wie die Generation 60+. Warum ist das so? Die ZDF-Moderatorin trifft Menschen, die bestimmte Orte mittlerweile meiden. Und Polizisten, die rund um den beruchtigten Bremer Hauptbahnhof fur Ordnung sorgen sollen. Aber die ernuchtert einraumen: "Wir sind immer einen Schritt hinterher."Unsicher fuhlen sich immer mehr Menschen mit Einwanderungsgeschichte. In Magdeburg trifft Dunja Hayali einen jungen Syrer, der von einem deutschen Tatverdachtigen niedergestochen wurde. Das Landesnetzwerk Migrantenorganisationen verteilt Tausende "Taschenalarme" an seine Mitglieder, weil sich die Zahl rassistischer Übergriffe im Vergleich zum Vorjahr verdoppelt hat."Am Puls" zeigt auch, dass einige Probleme durch politische Entscheidungen verscharft werden. So zeigt die Dokumentation, dass hinter den Kulissen der Innenministerkonferenz ein politisches Gerangel den KI-gestutzten Datenaustausch der Sicherheitsbehorden verzogert. Kritiker warnen, dass Ermittler potenzielle Tatverdachtige so weiter zu spat erkennen werden.Politiker fordern nach den vielen Anschlagen durch psychisch auffallige Gefluchtete, dass Warnsignale fruher erkannt werden mussten. An der Universitat Konstanz zeigt ein innovatives Therapieprojekt, wie das moglich ware: effektiv und preiswert. Es ist der Bundesregierung seit 2018 bekannt, doch es tut sich nichts. Tatsachlich sind nach Experteneinschatzung rund 900.000 Gefluchtete therapiebedurftig, doch nur drei Prozent werden versorgt. Und Bund und Lander kurzen die Mittel fur bessere psychosoziale Hilfen.Durch die vielen Begegnungen mit Menschen, die ganz unterschiedliche Erfahrungen und Einstellungen haben, zeigt Dunja Hayali in ihrer Doku: Sicherheit ist nicht nur eine Frage der Zahlen, sondern auch eine Frage des Gefuhls. Es geht um Vertrauen, Sichtbarkeit und auch darum, unbequeme Wahrheiten auszuhalten.Die Doku ist Teil der Reihe "Am Puls", in der bildschirmbekannte ZDF-Presenter den Themen nachgehen, die Deutschland bewegen. Sie horen zu, tauchen in den Alltag der Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer ein und beleuchten, welche Auswirkungen die Entscheidungen der Politik auf das Leben in allen Teilen der Gesellschaft haben. Und was dringend verbessert werden muss.Mehr unter https://ampuls.zdf.de

programme.title: Octopus in danger - searching for clues around the Mediterranean / Oktopus in Gefahr - Spurensuche rund ums Mittelmeer
programme.desc: The octopus is considered a delicacy - whether grilled, boiled or as calamari. But the increasing demand has consequences: the intelligent cephalopod is being overfished in several regions of Europe. Stocks are shrinking dramatically, especially in the Mediterranean region. In Greece, trapping is often done using forbidden traps. Together with the Coast Guard, Sea Shepherd has removed thousands of these traps from the seabed in an effort to combat environmental crime. Whether cooked, grilled or in salads, octopus is one of the most popular seafood around the Mediterranean. In Germany, too, it often ends up on the plate as calamari from the freezer. But where do the squid actually come from - and what about their populations? A team from "planet e." embarks on an investigative journey along the coasts of Europe and Africa. In Galicia, northwest Spain, there are several large fish processing plants that cut up octopuses, freeze them and prepare them for the international market - including Germany. Catching is subject to strict regulations because natural stocks are shrinking rapidly. In order to meet the high demand, factories are increasingly relying on imports from African waters. One company is planning to breed octopuses in aquaculture. But the project met with strong criticism from environmentalists - the project was stopped for the time being. Breeding octopuses is ethically and ecologically questionable: the animals are highly intelligent and sensitive, suffer from stress in captivity and there are no humane slaughter methods. In addition, their meat-based diet puts a strain on marine ecosystems and contradicts sustainable aquaculture. In the Mediterranean, the common octopus (Octopus vulgaris) is caught in many places. In Greece, for example, special plastic traps are used that lie on kilometer-long lines on the seabed. A local fisherman shows the camera team that the yield is getting smaller and smaller - a direct result of overfishing. The ecological consequences are already visible: the invasive blue crab is spreading uncontrollably in Italy. It is one of the octopuses' favorite foods - but without natural enemies it is now destroying mussel cultivation in the Po Delta. Mussel farmers are facing an existential crisis. Could the return of the octopuses be the solution? An organization from Austria is testing exactly this off the Croatian island of Krk. Researchers there are investigating whether octopuses can settle in artificial shelters, reproduce and contribute to the long-term stabilization of the ecosystem. The experiments are still in their early stages, but there is great hope: a sustainable model for the entire Mediterranean region could emerge. / Der Oktopus gilt als Delikatesse - ob gegrillt, gekocht oder als Calamares. Doch die steigende Nachfrage hat Folgen: In mehreren Regionen Europas wird der intelligente KopffuSSer uberfischt.Besonders im Mittelmeerraum schrumpfen die Bestande dramatisch. In Griechenland wird oft mit verbotenen Fallen gefangen. Gemeinsam mit der Kustenwache hat Sea Shepherd Tausende dieser Fallen vom Meeresgrund entfernt - ein Einsatz gegen Umweltkriminalitat.Ob gekocht, gegrillt oder als Salat - rund ums Mittelmeer gehort Oktopus zu den beliebtesten Meeresfruchten. Auch in Deutschland landet er haufig als Calamares aus der Tiefkuhltruhe auf dem Teller. Doch woher stammen die Tintenfische eigentlich - und wie steht es um ihre Bestande?Ein Team von "planet e." begibt sich auf eine investigative Reise entlang der Kusten Europas und Afrikas.In Galizien, Nordwestspanien, befinden sich mehrere groSSe Fischverarbeitungsbetriebe, die Oktopusse zerlegen, einfrieren und fur den internationalen Markt - auch fur Deutschland - vorbereiten. Der Fang unterliegt strengen Regulierungen, denn die naturlichen Bestande schrumpfen rapide. Um die hohe Nachfrage zu decken, greifen die Fabriken zunehmend auf Importe aus afrikanischen Gewassern zuruck.Ein Konzern plant, Oktopusse in Aquakultur zu zuchten. Doch das Vorhaben stoSSt auf heftige Kritik von Umweltschutzern - das Projekt wurde vorerst gestoppt. Die Zucht von Oktopussen ist ethisch und okologisch bedenklich: Die Tiere sind hochintelligent und empfindsam, leiden in Gefangenschaft unter Stress und es gibt keine humane Schlachtmethoden. Zudem belastet ihre fleischbasierte Ernahrung die Meeresokosysteme und widerspricht nachhaltiger Aquakultur.Im Mittelmeer wird der Gemeine Krake (Octopus vulgaris) vielerorts gefangen. In Griechenland etwa kommen spezielle Plastikfallen zum Einsatz, die an kilometerlangen Grundleinen auf dem Meeresboden liegen. Ein lokaler Fischer zeigt dem Kamerateam, dass die Ausbeute immer geringer wird - eine direkte Folge der Überfischung.Die okologischen Folgen sind bereits sichtbar: In Italien breitet sich die invasive Blaukrabbe unkontrolliert aus. Sie zahlt zu den Lieblingsspeisen der Kraken - doch ohne naturliche Feinde zerstort sie nun den Muschelanbau im Po-Delta. Die Muschelfarmer stehen vor einer existenziellen Krise.Konnte die Ruckkehr der Oktopusse die Losung sein? Eine Organisation aus Österreich testet genau das vor der kroatischen Insel Krk. Dort untersuchen Forschende, ob sich Kraken in kunstlichen Unterschlupfen ansiedeln, vermehren und langfristig zur Stabilisierung des Ökosystems beitragen konnen. Die Versuche stehen noch am Anfang, doch die Hoffnung ist groSS: Ein nachhaltiges Modell fur den gesamten Mittelmeerraum konnte entstehen.

programme.title: PDO Cooking K9 / ΠΟΠ Μαγειρική Κ9
programme.desc: Episode: Giorgos Daskoulidis. The original folk singer leaves the music tracks for a while and meets chef Andreas Lagos in the kitchen. Kefalaki Andros and Naoussa PDO peaches become the basis for dishes full of intensity, deliciousness and Greek soul. / Επεισόδιο: Γιώργος Δασκουλίδης. programme.title: Electra K3 E22 (E) / Ηλέκτρα Κ3 Ε22 (Ε)

Η συνάντησή του με τον Στέργιο θα ναι σκληρή.

programme.title: The Last Note / Το Τελευταίο Σημείωμα
programme.desc: With 34-year-old Napoleon Soukatzidis as the central figure, the tragic story of the 200 Greek fighters who were executed on May 1, 1944 in Kaisariani by the German invaders unfolds. Co-production: COSMOTE TV. (113) / Με κεντρικό πρόσωπο τον 34χρονο Ναπολέοντα Σουκατζίδη, ξετυλίγεται η τραγική ιστορία των 200 Ελλήνων αγωνιστών που εκτελέστηκαν την 1η Μαΐου του 1944 στην Καισαριανή από τους Γερμανούς κατακτητές. Συμπαραγωγή: COSMOTE TV. (113)

programme.title: Black Hawk: The Takedown / Μαύρο Γεράκι: Η Κατάρριψη
programme.desc: October 3, 1993. The US raids Mogadishu, Somalia, targeting warlord Aidid. The operation, lasting just 24 hours, results in carnage and the worst defeat for American troops since Vietnam. (180) / 3 Οκτωβρίου 1993. Οι ΗΠΑ κάνουν επιδρομή στο Μογκαντίσου της Σομαλίας, με στόχο τον πολέμαρχο Αϊντίντ. Η επιχείρηση, που διαρκεί μόλις 24 ώρες, καταλήγει σε μακελειό και στη μεγαλύτερη ήττα αμερικανικών στρατευμάτων μετά το Βιετνάμ. (180)

programme.title: Unpacking / Αποδελτίωση

programme.title: The Castle of Terror / Το Κάστρο του Τρόμου
programme.desc: PREMIERE. In 1939, Hartheim Castle in Austria was a care center for people with disabilities. But from 1939 to 1944, it served as a pilot project for the final solution, and the SS used it to test methods of mass murder. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Το 1939, το κάστρο Χάρτχαϊμ στην Αυστρία ήταν κέντρο φροντίδας για άτομα με αναπηρίες. Αλλά από το 1939 έως το 1944, λειτούργησε ως πιλοτικό σχέδιο για την τελική λύση και τα SS το χρησιμοποίησαν για δοκιμές μεθόδων μαζικής δολοφονίας.

programme.title: Heaven / Ουρανός
programme.desc: The Palme d'Or nominated film by Takis Kanellopoulos chronicles the horror of World War II through the tragic stories of brave people who perished, in contrast to their peaceful lives before the war. (73) / Η υποψήφια για Χρυσό Φοίνικα ταινία του Τάκη Κανελλόπουλου, εξιστορεί τον τρόμο του Β Παγκοσμίου Πολέμου μέσα από τις τραγικές ιστορίες γενναίων ανθρώπων που χάθηκαν, σε αντιπαραβολή με την ειρηνική ζωή τους πριν από τον πόλεμο. programme.desc: Episode: The folk songs and rebetikas of 40. The show presents how the folk muse sang the Albanian Epic. The research focuses on folk and rebetika songs that in their time expressed with authenticity and enthusiasm the collective feelings towards the War. / Επεισόδιο: Τα δημοτικά και τα ρεμπέτικα του 40. Η εκπομπή παρουσιάζει το πώς τραγούδησε η λαϊκή μούσα το Αλβανικό Έπος. Η έρευνα επικεντρώνεται σε τραγούδια δημοτικά και ρεμπέτικα που στην εποχή τους εξέφρασαν με γνησιότητα και ενθουσιασμό τα συλλογικά συναισθήματα απέναντι στον Πόλεμο.

programme.title: Hands up Hitler / Ψηλά τα Χέρια Χίτλερ
programme.desc: Two once inseparable friends, who during the German Occupation struggled to survive, meet again after years and remember their past. (77) / Δύο αχώριστοι κάποτε φίλοι, που στη διάρκεια της γερμανικής Κατοχής πάλευαν να επιζήσουν, ξανασυναντιούνται μετά από χρόνια και θυμούνται το παρελθόν τους. (77)

programme.desc: Episode: Digital Immortality. Artificial intelligence is developing rapidly and opening new paths in the field of health. We are now talking about longevity, with technology promising to exceed the limits of human life. / Επεισόδιο: Ψηφιακή Αθανασία. Η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη εξελίσσεται ραγδαία και ανοίγει νέους δρόμους στο χώρο της υγείας. Συζητάμε πλέον για μακροζωία, με την τεχνολογία να υπόσχεται ότι θα ξεπεράσει τα όρια της ανθρώπινης ζωής.

programme.title: Memories Stoned Inside E2 (E) / Οι Μνήμες Πέτρωσαν Μέσα της Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Occupied Life. The Germans invade Greece. War, occupation. Fear and bravery. Life and Death. Love and hate. Logic and irrationality. Dipoles that make up the horror of a possessed life. / Επεισόδιο: Κατεχόμενη Ζωή. Οι Γερμανοί εισβάλλουν στην Ελλάδα. Πόλεμος, κατοχή. Φόβος και γενναιότητα. Ζωή και Θάνατος. Αγάπη και μίσος. Λογική και παραλογισμός. Δίπολα που συνθέτουν τη φρίκη μιας κατεχόμενης ζωής.

programme.title: Unpacking / Αποδελτίωση
programme.desc: The presentation of the important political and economic events that occupied the current affairs, with the commentary of the journalists of ERT3 and with interviews with political figures, institutional and scientific bodies. / Η παρουσίαση των σημαντικών πολιτικών και οικονομικών γεγονότων που απασχόλησαν την επικαιρότητα, με το σχολιασμό των δημοσιογράφων της ΕΡΤ3 και με συνεντεύξεις με πολιτικά πρόσωπα, θεσμικούς και επιστημονικούς φορείς.

programme.title: The Unknown Concentration Camps / Τα Άγνωστα Στρατόπεδα Συγκέντρωσης
programme.desc: PREMIERE. 75 years after the end of World War II, researchers continue to uncover hidden aspects of history. While in 1945 there were just over 2,000 Nazi camps, today more than 44,000 are recorded. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. 75 χρόνια μετά το τέλος του Β Παγκοσμίου Πολέμου, οι ερευνητές συνεχίζουν να ανακαλύπτουν κρυφές πτυχές της ιστορίας. Ενώ το 1945 υπήρχαν λίγο περισσότερα από 2.000 ναζιστικά στρατόπεδα, σήμερα καταγράφονται περισσότερα από 44.000.

programme.title: Music Under the Swastika / Μουσική Κάτω από την Σβάστικα
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Anita Lasker-Walfis manages to survive as a cellist in Auschwitz, while the conductor Wilhelm Furtwängler finally succumbs to a deal with the devil. We tell the story of classical music in the Third Reich for the first time. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Η Ανίτα Λάσκερ-Βάλφις κατάφερε να επιβιώσει ως τσελίστρια στο Άουσβιτς, ενώ ο μαέστρος Βίλχελμ Φούρτβενγκλερ τελικά υποκύπτει σε μια συμφωνία με τον διάβολο. Αφηγούμαστε για πρώτη φορά την ιστορία της κλασικής μουσικής στο Τρίτο Ράιχ.

programme.title: Nor Leber, Songs for Eternity (E) / Ούτε Λέμπερ, Τραγούδια για την Αιωνιότητα (Ε)
programme.desc: Ute Leber revives songs by Jewish composers written in the concentration camps of World War II making a moving musical memorial. / Η Ούτε Λέμπερ αναβιώνει τραγούδια Εβραίων συνθετών που γράφτηκαν στα στρατόπεδα συγκέντρωσης του Β Παγκοσμίου Πολέμου κάνοντας ένα συγκινητικό μουσικό μνημόσυνο.

programme.title: Incredible Train Journeys K1 E5 (E) / Απίθανα Ταξίδια με Τρένο Κ1 Ε5 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Peru. Peruvian railways climb the Andes mountains, cross the Altiplano and reach incredible locations such as Machu Picchu or Lake Titicaca. / Επεισόδιο: Περού. Οι Περουβιανοί σιδηρόδρομοι ανεβαίνουν στα βουνά των Άνδεων, διασχίζουν το Altiplano και φτάνουν σε απίστευτες τοποθεσίες όπως το Μάτσου Πίτσου ή η λίμνη Τιτικάκα.

programme.title: Hezi and his sons - new chapters chapter 35 / חזי ובניו - פרקים חדשים פרק 35

programme.title: Touching Happiness Chapter 54 / לגעת באושר פרק 54
programme.desc: Chapter 54 Naomi gets annoyed by the reconciliation attempt initiated by Nadav and Irit and angrily leaves the house. programme.title: Love around the corner / אהבה מעבר לפינה
programme.desc: drama. Chapter 144 Lior confesses to Keren that he asked Ami to leave, and she travels to meet Ami. Shirley doesn't want to go home. / דרמה. פרק 144 ליאור מתוודה בפני קרן על כך שהוא ביקש מעמי לעזוב, והיא נוסעת כדי לפגוש את עמי. דניאלה לא רוצה להיות עם נתן, בזמן שהרומן שלה עם אמנון ממשיך לפרוח. שירלי לא רוצה לחזור הביתה.

programme.title: Love around the corner / אהבה מעבר לפינה
programme.desc: drama. Chapter 145 Naama discovers the affair between Daniela and Amnon, but Daniela refuses to listen to her. Keren goes to Ami, and Lior decides to bring her back to him. programme.title: Koka the wedding season episode 2 / קוקה עונת החתונה פרק 2

programme.title: Slučajevi pravde
programme.desc: Two brave police inspectors are working on a double murder case. Although they will try to deal a fatal blow to the criminals, their incompetence leads them to their downfall. / Dva hrabra policijska inspektora rade na slučaju dvostrukog ubistva. Iako će zločincima pokušati zadati smrtonosni udarac, njihova nesposobnost ih vodi u propast.

programme.title: Dobro jutro Crna Goro
programme.desc: Start your day with us! A perfect match for a good morning! / Počnite dan sa nama! Savršen spoj za dobro jutro!

programme.title: Lokalni hodači
programme.desc: Combining their professional skills (Ivana is a political scientist, Ivan an audio-video creator) and personal interests with the pleasure of going to selected locations, over time they began to share their records with the general public through digital services and social networks and met with general enthusiasm and support. Thanks to their short travel clips in "vlog" form, many of us have discovered new hiking trails, and visiting their content pages is a perfect brochure for locals and tourists looking for alternatives to popular and overcrowded picnic spots. Ivana and Ivan address the audience in a language free of form, simple, friendly and often using local "slang" speech, but without rude or offensive expressions. / Spajajući svoje profesinalne vještine (Ivana je politikološkinja, Ivan audio-video stvaralac) i lična interesovanja sa zadovoljstvom odlaska na odabrane lokacije, vremenom su putem digitalnih servisa i društvenih mreža sa širom javnošću počeli da dijele svoje zapise i naišli na opšte oduševljenje i podršku. Zahvaljujući njihovim kratkim putopisnim klipovima u "vlog" formi, mnogima od nas otkrili su nove staze za šetnju, a posjeta stranicama s njihovim sadržajem predstavlja savršenu brošuru za lokalce i turiste koji traže alternative popularnim i prenagužvanim izletištima. Ivana i Ivan publici se obraćaju jezikom oslobođenim forme, jednostavno, prijateljski i često koristeći lokalni "sleng" govor, ali bez nepristojnih ili uvredljivih izraza.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2

programme.title: Football - 1st CFL: 13th round: Sutjeska - Jezero / Fudbal - 1. CFL: 13.kolo: Sutjeska - Jezero
programme.desc: The Montenegrin Football League was founded in 2004, but the first season was played in the 2006/2007 season. after the independence of the country. 12 clubs in the three-round competition system fought for the championship title, which was eventually won by Zeta from Golubovac, which remained the only championship title of Montenegro. Today, the number of clubs is reduced to 10, and 30 rounds are played. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Zapis

Author and presenter Miomir Maroš gets ideas for the show from viewers who want to present their regions and the interesting people who live in them, but also from his own tendencies to create a kind of testimony of a time with a documentary touch. / Ova emisija predstavlja svojevrsnu razglednicu Crne Gore. Autor i voditelj Miomir Maroš, ideje za emisiju dobija od gledalaca koji žele da predstave svoje krajeve i zanimljive ljude koji u njima žive, ali i iz sopstvenih tendencija da sa dokumentarnom notom stvori svojevrsno svjedočanstvo jednog vremena.

Enjoy the adventures of Peppa, George, their family and friends! / Pepa je simpatično prase, ona mnogo voli da se igra i zabavlja, ima mlađeg brata Džordža kog ćemo teško videti bez njegove omiljene igračke, zelenog dinosaurusa. Uživajte u avanturama Pepe, Džordža, njihove porodice i drugara!

programme.title: Veliki nordijski mitovi
programme.desc: The producers of the acclaimed documentary series Greek Myths, in a new venture, will try to extract the true meaning of Norse stories based on available old texts. Stories that have influenced some of today's most popular blockbusters, from Tolkien's Lord of the Rings to George Martin's Game of Thrones. / Producenti hvaljene dokumentarne serije Grčki mitovi, u novom poduhvatu pokušaće da izvuku pravo značenje nordijskih priča na osnovu dostupnih starih tekstova. Priča koje su uticale na neke od najpopularnijih blokbastera današnjice, od Tolkinovog Gospodara prstenova do Igre prijestola Džordža Martina.

programme.title: Network.me / Mreža.me
programme.desc: We talk about people, events, places, problems, everything that interests you. Your stories, interesting guests. / Govorimo o ljudima, događajima, mjestima, problemima, o svemu što vas zanima. Vaše priče, interesantni gosti.

programme.title: Dnevna soba
programme.desc: It is an entertainment show, which will try to advise and entertain the viewers. The aim is for the viewers to relax and have fun in the hour and a half, in order to escape from the daily problems. It is intended for all generations and families. In numerous sections, we deal with interesting and current topics, and with the help of our interlocutors, we share tips for a simpler life. Along with simple and concrete advice for the viewers, in the show we will host numerous individuals or groups engaged in humanitarian work, as well as celebrities who we will present in a slightly different light, giving them the opportunity to share with the viewers their life experiences and small secrets in the functioning of the household. / Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. Želja je da se u sat i po gledaoci relaksiraju i zabave, kako bi pobjegli od dnevnih problema. Namijenjena je svim generacijama i porodici. U brojnim rubrikama bavimo se zanimljivim i aktuelnim temama, a uz pomoć sagovornika dijelimo savjete za jednostavniji život. Uz jednostavne i konkretne savjete za gledaoce, u emisiji ćemo ugostiti brojne individualce ili grupe koje se bave humanitarnim radom, kao i poznate ličnosti koje ćemo predstavljati u nešto drugačijem svjetlu, pružiti im mogućnost da sa gledaocima dijele svoja životna iskustva i male tajne u funkcionisanju domaćinstva.

programme.title: Alo Alo
programme.desc: France, World War II. René Artois is the owner of a small cafe, with unusual hardships. In his small cafe, a collection of various characters meet, from fighters of the French resistance movement, through Gestapo officers and German soldiers to British paratroopers. All of them try not to be discovered in their intentions, while Rene tries not to be discovered by his father-in-law and his wife in affairs with waitresses. / Francuska, II Svjetski rat. Rene Artoa je vlasnik malog kafea, sa nesvakidašnjim mukama. U njegovom malom kafeu se sastaje bulumenta raznih likova, od boraca francuskog pokreta otpora, preko oficira Gestapoa i njemačkih vojnika do britanskih padobranaca. Svi oni pokušavaju da ne budu otkriveni u svojim namjerama, dok se Rene trudi da ga tašta i žena ne otkriju u aferama sa konobaricama.

programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is designed to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes aimed at children who play sports, no matter what level of success, will show the essential benefits of sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that there are many talented children in Montenegro who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation to at least one level higher. We want to draw attention to the potential that belongs only to us, that is undeniable, a potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.title: Dnevna soba
programme.desc: It is an entertainment show, which will try to advise and entertain the viewers. The aim is for the viewers to relax and have fun in the hour and a half, in order to escape from the daily problems. It is intended for all generations and families. In numerous sections, we deal with interesting and current topics, and with the help of our interlocutors, we share tips for a simpler life. Along with simple and concrete advice for the viewers, in the show we will host numerous individuals or groups engaged in humanitarian work, as well as celebrities who we will present in a slightly different light, giving them the opportunity to share with the viewers their life experiences and small secrets in the functioning of the household. / Riječ je o emisiji Zabavnog programa, koja će pokušati da savjetuje i razonodi gledaoce. Uz jednostavne i konkretne savjete za gledaoce, u emisiji ćemo ugostiti brojne individualce ili grupe koje se bave humanitarnim radom, kao i poznate ličnosti koje ćemo predstavljati u nešto drugačijem svjetlu, pružiti im mogućnost da sa gledaocima dijele svoja životna iskustva i male tajne u funkcionisanju domaćinstva.

programme.title: Alo Alo
programme.desc: France, World War II. René Artois is the owner of a small cafe, with unusual hardships. In his small cafe, a collection of various characters meet, from fighters of the French resistance movement, through Gestapo officers and German soldiers to British paratroopers. All of them try not to be discovered in their intentions, while Rene tries not to be discovered by his father-in-law and his wife in affairs with waitresses. / Francuska, II Svjetski rat. Rene Artoa je vlasnik malog kafea, sa nesvakidašnjim mukama. programme.title: Basketball: Eurocup: Lietkabelis - Future / Košarka: Eurokup: Lietkabelis - Budućnost
programme.desc: The Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second "Euroleague Basketball" competition. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called "wildcards". / Evrokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo takmičenje "Evroleague Basketball". U ovom takmičenju se bore najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspiju izboriti plasman u Evroligu, te u njemu učestvuju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih evropskih liga. Plasman u Evrokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. "vajldkards".

programme.title: Muzička industrija

programme.title: Advokado
programme.desc: Brane and Beli are faithful friends, whose adventures we follow in this comic series. The two will try to find their way in a world where every attempt by an individual to break away from established conservative norms is viewed with fierce criticism. / Brane i Beli su verni drugovi, čije dogodovštine pratimo u ovoj komičnoj seriji. Njih dvojica probaće da se snađu u svijetu u kome se na svaki pokušaj pojedinca da se otrgne od ustanovljenih konzervativnih normi gleda sa žestokom kritikom.

programme.title: The biggest robberies in the world / Najveće pljačke Svijeta
programme.desc: Pierce Brosnan guides you through the history of the most daring robberies. / Pirs Brosnan vas vodi kroz istoriju najsmjelijih pljačkaških poduhvata.

programme.title: Mladovanje
programme.desc: Young, accomplished people in a certain field talk about the path they took to success, how difficult it is to succeed, what obstacles face young people in Montenegro today, what should be changed, why they decided to stay at a time when young people are increasingly leaving the country. / Mladi, ostvareni ljudi u nekoj oblasti govore o putu koji su prešli do uspjeha, koliko je teško uspjeti, kakve prepreke stoje pred mladima danas u Crnoj Gori, šta bi trebalo mijenjati, zašto su odlučili da ostanu u vrijeme kad mladi ljudi sve više napuštaju zemlju.

programme.title: Podcast: Igor and Vlado / Podcast: Igor i Vlado
programme.desc: Igor and Vlado talk with their guests about sports, but also about other life topics. / Igor i Vlado sa gostima pričaju o sportu, ali i o drugim životnim temama.

programme.title: Porodica Serano
programme.desc: Love brings two people together. After the wedding, what they already had is also combined - and that is their children. One of the most watched Spanish series of all time. A cocktail of laughter, love and optimism created by combining the seemingly incompatible. / Ljubav spaja dvoje ljudi. Nakon vjenčanja spaja se i ono što su oni već imali - a, to su njihova djeca. Jedna od najgledanijih španskih serija, svih vremena. Koktel smijeha, ljubavi i optimizma koji nastaje spajanjem naizgled nespojivog.

programme.title: Network.me / Mreža.me
programme.desc: We talk about people, events, places, problems, everything that interests you. Your stories, interesting guests. / Govorimo o ljudima, događajima, mjestima, problemima, o svemu što vas zanima. Vaše priče, interesantni gosti.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: Follow Dnevnik 2, one of the central, informative programs of Radio Television of Montenegro and find out all the most important news. / Pratite Dnevnik 2, jednu od centralnih, informativnih emisija Radio Televizije Crne Gore i saznajte sve najvažnije vijesti.

programme.title: Basketball: Eurocup: Lietkabelis - Future / Košarka: Eurokup: Lietkabelis - Budućnost
programme.desc: The Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second "Euroleague Basketball" competition. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called "wildcards". / Evrokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo takmičenje "Evroleague Basketball". U ovom takmičenju se bore najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspiju izboriti plasman u Evroligu, te u njemu učestvuju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih evropskih liga. Plasman u Evrokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. "vajldkards".

programme.title: Dobro jutro Crna Goro
programme.desc: Start your day with us! A perfect match for a good morning! / Počnite dan sa nama! Savršen spoj za dobro jutro!

Men Ben ber på ein draum, om kjærast og å leva av det jorda gir.

programme.title: Where no one would believe that someone could live / Der ingen skulle tru at nokon kunne bu
programme.desc: From 2024. Ben Ward could have been looking for love at home in England. Instead, he wants to build an island garden on a steep western slope. programme.title: Mare Vermelha
programme.desc: A group of Russian officers, unhappy with their country's political direction, occupy a nuclear missile base, threatening to destroy Japan and the USA. The American response involves placing a nuclear submarine, commanded by Frank Ramsey, on high alert. But Ramsey and Ron Hunter do not understand each other regarding the actions to be taken, which could start World War III. / Um grupo de oficiais russos, descontentes com o rumo político do seu país, ocupa uma base de mísseis nucleares, ameaçando destruir o Japao e os EUA. A resposta americana passa por colocar um submarino nuclear, comandando por Frank Ramsey, em alerta máximo. Mas Ramsey e Ron Hunter, nao se entendem em relaçao às atitudes a tomar, que poderao dar início à III Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Terra Europa
programme.desc: The series follows the work of MEPs and European institutions like never before, through four new headings. Make Europe uncomplicated with the "European Dictionary". Build Europe, with the participation of young Portuguese voters. / A serie acompanha o trabalho dos eurodeputados e das instituições europeias como nunca antes visto, atraves de quatro novas rúbricas. Descomplicar a Europa com o "Dicionário Europeu". Construir a Europa, com a participaçao de jovens portugueses eleitores.

programme.title: Eurodeputados
programme.desc: MEPs from the different political parties represented in the European Parliament address, from their headquarters in Strasbourg, the major issues that concern Europeans. / Os Eurodeputados dos diferentes partidos políticos representados no Parlamento Europeu abordam, a partir da sede em Estrasburgo, as grandes questões que preocupam os Europeus.

programme.title: Televendas
programme.desc: Every day, a space dedicated to television sales, where product demonstrations are given. / Todos os dias, um espaço dedicado a vendas por televisao, em que sao feitas demonstrações dos produtos.

programme.title: Bom Dia Portugal
programme.desc: Because the day begins in the morning, so start it in our company! Every day, «Bom dia Portugal» dedicates specific spaces to current national and international news, sport, weather, traffic and economy. / Porque e de manha que se começa o dia, entao inicie-o na nossa companhia! Todos os dias, o «Bom dia Portugal» dedica espaços específicos às notícias da atualidade nacional e internacional, desporto, meteorologia, trânsito e economia.

programme.title: Joy Square / Praça da Alegria
programme.desc: Praça da Alegria will bring you the best music, the latest fashion trends, useful advice and new tips that make your daily life easier. All of Portugal will be present at this program! / A Praça da Alegria vai levar ate si a melhor música, as últimas tendencias da moda, conselhos úteis e novas dicas que facilitam o seu dia-a-dia. Portugal inteiro vai marcar presença neste programa!

programme.title: Jornal da Tarde
programme.desc: Every day, at 1pm, your lunch hour is completed with updates on national and global news, from politics, economics, society and not forgetting sport. With Jornal da Tarde, be well informed about what is happening in the country and the world! / Todos os dias, às 13h, a sua hora de almoço e completada com a atualizaçao das notícias que marcam a atualidade nacional e mundial, desde a política, a economia, a sociedade e sem esquecer o desporto. Com o Jornal da Tarde, esteja bem informado sobre o que acontece no país e no mundo!

programme.title: Balacobaco
programme.desc: Isabel is a successful architect who sees her life fall apart when she discovers that her husband, Danilo, lost everything in gambling and illegal schemes, in addition to her sister dying in a mysterious accident, leaving her with custody of her niece Taís. / Isabel e uma arquiteta bem sucedida que ve sua vida ruir quando descobre que seu marido, Danilo, perdeu tudo em jogos de azar e esquemas ilegais, alem de sua irma morrer em um acidente misterioso, deixando-a com a guarda da sobrinha Taís.

programme.title: Our Afternoon / A Nossa Tarde
programme.desc: Discover the more emotional side of Tânia Ribas de Oliveira in RTP's new afternoon program. / Conheça o lado mais emocional de Tânia Ribas de Oliveira no novo programa das tardes da RTP.

programme.title: Portugal em Rede
programme.desc: The Portugal that exists beyond the big cities, from the north to the south and the islands, in a true information network. Includes a segment dedicated to the Portuguese language and its promotion "This language that unites us". The Regional Information Centers will have a relevant participation in this space. / O Portugal que existe para alem das grandes cidades, do norte ao sul e às ilhas, numa verdadeira rede de informaçao. Inclui um segmento dedicado à língua portuguesa e à sua promoçao "Esta língua que nos une". Os Centros de Informaçao Regional terao uma participaçao relevante neste espaço.

programme.title: The Right Price / O Preço Certo
programme.desc: Competition led by Fernando Mendes where anyone who sits in the audience can be invited to play and win lots of prizes. Have fun while finding out about market prices and new products. / Concurso conduzido por Fernando Mendes onde quem se senta na plateia pode ser convidado a jogar e ganhar muitos premios. Divirta-se enquanto se informa sobre os preços de mercado e sobre novos produtos.

programme.title: Telejornal
programme.desc: The most rigorous selection of news, every day at 8 pm. From Monday to Sunday, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos and Ana Lourenço show you the most relevant events in the country and around the world. If it's important, it's on Telejornal. / A mais rigorosa seleçao de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. De segunda a domingo, Joao Adelino Faria, Jose Rodrigues dos Santos e Ana Lourenço mostram-lhe o que de mais relevante se passou o país e no mundo. Se e importante está no Telejornal.

programme.title: Between Sea and Land / Entre o Mar e a Terra
programme.sub-title: An Immense Alentejo Between Horta and Olive Grove / Um Imenso Alentejo Entre a Horta e o Olival
programme.desc: Series about Portuguese products, which come from land and sea, the result of the work of people with ancestral and popular knowledge, but also innovative and scientific. In each episode we visit three producers who work with three different products from the north to the south of the country and islands. / Serie sobre o produto portugues, que sai da terra e do mar, fruto do labor de gente com saberes ancestrais e populares, mas tambem inovadores e científicos. Em cada episodio visitamos tres produtores que trabalham tres produtos distintos de norte a sul do país e ilhas.

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Vasco Palmeirim presents JOKER, the Portuguese's favorite contest. A competitor, with the help of 7 Jokers and the Super Joker, answers 12 questions with just one goal in mind: Win the 50,000 euros maximum prize! / Vasco Palmeirim apresenta o JOKER, o concurso favorito dos portugueses. Um concorrente, com a ajuda de 7 Jokers e do Super Joker, responde a 12 perguntas com um so objetivo em mente: Conquistar os 50 000 euros do premio máximo!

programme.title: Casa Abrigo
programme.sub-title: Vera's Shelter / O Abrigo de Vera
programme.desc: Vera quickly realizes that the House is a shelter and a place of meeting and support for these women (who also find family there) but that it is also a violation of their autonomy, marked by small details. / Rapidamente Vera percebe que a Casa e um abrigo e um local de encontro e suporte para estas mulheres (que tambem ali encontram família) mas que e tambem uma violencia à sua autonomia, marcada por pequenos pormenores.

programme.title: The Extraordinary Journey of the Portuguese Community of France / O Extraordinário Percurso da Comunidade Portuguesa de França
programme.desc: It's a practically unknown story, rarely covered on television. On October 16, 1916, the first labor agreement was signed between France and Portugal. / É uma historia praticamente desconhecida, raramente abordada em televisao. No dia 16 de outubro de 1916 foi assinado o primeiro acordo de mao-de-obra entre a França e Portugal.

programme.title: A Grandiosa Enciclopedia do Ludopedio
programme.desc: It was precisely 100 years ago that Portugal debuted as a national team in a friendly against Spain, with a 3-1 defeat to the Portuguese colors. Here at Grandiosa we mark the date with one of the most prominent goalscorers in the history of the National Team: Pedro Pauleta, the "cyclone of the Azores". / Foi há precisamente 100 anos que Portugal se estreou como Seleçao num "particular" frente à Espanha, com uma derrota para as cores lusitanas por 3-1. Aqui na Grandiosa assinalamos a data com um dos mais proeminentes goleadores da historia da Seleçao Nacional: Pedro Pauleta, o "ciclone dos Açores".

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Intervention Force / S.W.A.T.: Força de Intervençao
programme.desc: When an armored truck robbery ends in bloodshed, the team races to find the priceless jewels before more lives are lost. Hondo's mother pays a visit. / Quando um assalto a um camiao blindado termina em derramamento de sangue, a equipa corre para encontrar as joias de valor incalculável antes que mais vidas sejam perdidas. A mae de Hondo faz uma visita.

Todas as semanas, um tema de fundo, mais ou menos fraturante, e dissecado de fio a pavio ate aos efeitos que tem hoje na vida de todos.

programme.title: Prepared for the Tsunami? / Preparados para o Tsunami?
programme.desc: The Iberian Peninsula is one of the places most at risk of tsunamis in the Atlantic Ocean. What scientific evidence do we have? What does history tell us? This documentary explains how a tsunami is formed and how the Iberian Peninsula has been affected by this natural phenomenon since ancient times. In the last 9000 years, the Gulf of Cádiz has suffered between nine and 14 tsunamis. The last one, the Lisbon earthquake in 1755, changed the history of Europe. What have we learned from the past? How do we prepare for the future? This documentary analyzes the prevention measures that are being developed, from measurement methods - essential for predicting the arrival of tsunamis - to other aspects in which technology will play a fundamental role. / A Península Iberica e um dos locais com maior risco de tsunamis no Oceano Atlântico. Que evidencias científicas temos? O que que a historia nos diz? Este documentário explica como se forma um tsunami e como a Península Iberica tem sido afetada por esse fenomeno natural desde a antiguidade. Nos últimos 9000 anos, o Golfo de Cádiz sofreu entre nove e 14 tsunamis. O último, o terremoto de Lisboa, em 1755, mudou a historia da Europa. O que aprendemos com o passado? Como nos preparamos para o futuro? Este documentário analisa as medidas de prevençao que estao a ser desenvolvidas, desde metodos de mediçao - essenciais para prever a chegada de tsunamis - ate outros aspectos em que a tecnologia desempenhará um papel fundamental.

programme.title: Alta Fidelidade

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Intervention Force / S.W.A.T.: Força de Intervençao

programme.title: Ana Ladina
programme.desc: Ana Ladina is a very mischievous and mischievous 5-year-old girl who finds it really fun to look for Ladina solutions for her daily adventures, sometimes surprising, but always fun! / Ana Ladina e uma menina de 5 anos, muito traquinas e marota que acha muito divertido procurar soluções ladinas para as suas aventuras diárias, por vezes surpreendentes, mas sempre divertidas!

programme.title: Ana Ladina

programme.desc: The Fox-Badger Family is back! Edmundo, his two twin sons and his little sister lived peacefully in their den. However, in nature it is common for foxes and badgers to share dens. / A Família Raposa-Texugo está de volta! Edmundo, os seus dois filhos gemeos e a sua pequenina irma viviam pacificamente na sua toca. No entanto, na natureza e comum raposas e texugos compartilharem as suas tocas.

programme.title: Petit
programme.desc: Discover Petit's unique and imaginative perspective on everyday situations that become fantastic adventures that he will live together with his friends. Based on the award-winning book "Petit El Monstruo" by Isol. / Descubra a perspetiva única e imaginativa de Petit sobre situações do quotidiano que se tornam aventuras fantásticas que ele irá viver, juntamente com os seus amigos. Baseado no premiado livro "Petit El Monstruo" de Isol.

programme.title: Kid Lucky
programme.desc: The town of Nothing Gulch is the biggest and best playground in the Wild West! Kid is an ace slingshot and is destined to be the greatest cowboy in the world! He and his friends have great adventures, riding Kid's loyal Jolly Jumper or helping the Sheriff! / A cidade de Nothing Gulch e o maior e melhor parque infantil do oeste selvagem! Kid e um ás da fisga e está destinado a ser o maior cowboy do mundo! Ele e os seus amigos vivem grandes aventuras, cavalgando o leal Jolly Jumper de Kid ou a ajudar o Sheriff!

programme.title: Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS is a news program for children aged 8 to 12 that aims to encourage critical thinking and conscious citizenship. We will bring together politics and culture, economics and sport, science and children's literature, national and international current affairs in a simple and objective language. / Radar XS e um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciencia e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.desc: A group of teenagers attend a special school for future superheroes where they try to master deadly obstacle courses and create their own super costumes! / Um grupo de adolescentes frequenta uma escola especial para futuros super-herois onde tentam dominar pistas de obstáculos mortais e criar as suas proprias super-roupas!

programme.title: Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Every morning, Nuno and Malika leave home 30 minutes early to go to school and they still arrive late every morning! This is because every morning, something incredible happens along the way. But even though their stories are always true, the school principal never believes them... / Todas as manhas, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhas chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhas, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas historias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: Escola de Herois
programme.desc: Hero School is a school for budding superheroes, where children learn to master their innate powers to help people, solve problems and try to make the world a better place. / A Escola de Herois e uma escola para super-herois principiantes, onde as crianças aprendem a dominar os seus poderes inatos para ajudar as pessoas, resolver problemas e tentar tornar o mundo num lugar melhor.

programme.title: Lobito's Tales / Os Contos do Lobito
programme.desc: Lobito dreams of being like the heroes of the storybooks he loves to read, traveling from story to story to live their adventures. But as the intrepid little wolf quickly discovers, reaching a happy ending is no easy task and he will have to learn from his mistakes. / Lobito sonha ser como os herois dos livros de historias que mais gosta de ler, viajando de conto em conto para viver as suas aventuras. Mas como o intrepido lobinho depressa descobre, chegar ao final feliz nao e tarefa fácil e terá de aprender com os seus erros.

programme.title: Shane, o Chief / Shane, o Chef
programme.desc: Shane and the little chef! He is ambitious and energetic and together with his daughter Izzy, he runs a restaurant in the city of Munchington where they serve delicious delicacies! / Shane e o chef da pequenada! Ele e ambicioso e energico e juntamente com a sua filha Izzy, administram um restaurante na cidade de Munchington onde servem deliciosas iguarias!

programme.title: A Escola dos Roaridos / A Escola dos Rugidos
programme.desc: Going to school for the first time is one of the biggest challenges we have to face. Roaring School helps children prepare for school life by exploring a child's first year through the relationships and experiences of our mini monsters. / Ir para a escola pela primeira vez e um dos maiores desafios que temos de enfrentar. A Escola dos Rugidos ajuda as crianças a prepararem-se para a vida escolar explorando o primeiro ano da criança atraves dos relacionamentos e experiencias dos nossos mini monstros.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks are a really fun group of numbers that work together to solve big and small problems and will teach you to count in a really fun way! / Os Numberblocks sao um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vao ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Kiwi
programme.desc: Let's learn English with Twiki and Twini! Each episode will be an adventure to discover new words and new sounds. / Vamos aprender Ingles com Twiki e Twini! Cada episodio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: A Grande Descoberta
programme.desc: Hugo, like all children, has a curious personality, and constantly questions himself on a journey in search of knowledge, logic and understanding the meaning of things. / Hugo, tal como todas as crianças, tem uma personalidade curiosa, e questiona-se constantemente numa jornada em busca de conhecimento, da logica e de compreender o significado das coisas.

programme.desc: Ziggy is a friendly freshwater crocodile from Australia. He and his friends live in their eccentric houses located in a crater on an island. Ziggy and his friends have a very special secret - besides walking like people, talking like people - they all work in a zoo! / Ziggy e um simpático crocodilo-de-água-doce da Austrália. Ele e os seus amigos vivem nas suas excentricas casas situadas numa cratera de uma ilha. Ziggy e os seus amigos tem um segredo muito especial - alem de andarem como gente, falarem como gente - todos trabalham num jardim zoologico!

programme.title: Dimitri
programme.desc: Dimitri, a small bird, was lost from his family during migration and now roams the African continent, very different from his home continent, Europe. Deprived of his family and friends, Dimitri learns to overcome his fears to explore the extraordinary world of the savannah. / Dimitri, um pequeno pássaro, perdeu-se da sua família durante a migraçao e agora vagueia pelo continente africano, muito diferente do seu continente natal, a Europa. Privado da sua família e amigos, Dimitri aprende a superar os seus medos para explorar o mundo extraordinário da savana.

programme.title: Mia Go
programme.desc: Mia is a girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. With her fearless sense of adventure, she tries things for the first time with a fearless attitude. Mia lives in the busy city Everyday with her closest friends and together they go on great adventures. / Mia e uma menina cujo entusiasmo contagia todos ao seu redor. Com seu destemido sentido de aventura, ela tenta as coisas pela primeira vez com uma atitude destemida. Mia mora na movimentada cidade Todososdias com os seus amigos mais proximos e juntos vao viver grandes aventuras.

programme.desc: Tragic events occur unexpectedly and dramatically. programme.desc: Ana Ladina is a very mischievous and mischievous 5-year-old girl who finds it really fun to look for Ladina solutions for her daily adventures, sometimes surprising, but always fun! / Ana Ladina e uma menina de 5 anos, muito traquinas e marota que acha muito divertido procurar soluções ladinas para as suas aventuras diárias, por vezes surpreendentes, mas sempre divertidas!

programme.desc: The Fox-Badger Family is back! Edmundo, his two twin sons and his little sister lived peacefully in their den. programme.desc: When the remains of a teenage girl are found by construction workers on a motorway central divider near London, Inspector Cassie Stuart and Detective Sunny Khan are called to the scene. / Quando os restos mortais de uma adolescente sao encontrados por operários das obras no separador central de uma autoestrada perto de Londres, a inspetora Cassie Stuart e o detetive Sunny Khan sao chamados ao local.

programme.desc: As the Sheridan family prepares a garden party, Laura tries to understand whether or not the death of a neighbor should change plans. Pela primeira vez, pressente-se a distância entre mundos que ate entao pareciam coexistir.

With independence they were nationalized and production dropped a lot. Currently, the largest is in an advanced state of degradation. / No início do sec. XX, S. Tome e Príncipe era ocupado por roças, fazendas de cafe e cacau, em quase toda a sua superfície. A maioria estava nas maos dos portugueses. programme.title: AS OF 4.0 / SIDA 4.0
programme.sub-title: PrEP - The Revolution in Prevention / PrEP - A Revoluçao na Prevençao
programme.desc: The evolution of new therapies for HIV/AIDS has boomed since the mid-1990s until today. Two different stories with the same destiny: nomads living in the forests, sheltered by a family they chose and living a life far from the society they rejected. Secret hard-tech parties, drugs, hippie revivalism and other rituals are revealed by these two young adults. A journey from a dark past to the present lived in a family community on the margins of society. / Pia e filha de uma ex-modelo francesa e Zinzin e filho de um ex-viciado em heroína. Ambos sao trabalhadores agrícolas sazonais - "saisonniers". Duas historias diferentes com o mesmo destino: nomadas que vivem nas florestas, abrigados por uma família que eles proprios escolheram e a viver uma vida longe da sociedade que rejeitaram. Festas secretas de hard-tech, drogas, revivalismo hippie e outros rituais sao revelados por estes dois jovens adultos. programme.title: AIX vs Montpellier - LNH Division 1 - French Handball Starligue
programme.desc: Dive into the excitement of French handball with Liqui Moly Starligue, formerly LNH Division 1. Established in 1952, this premier league event features 16 top teams battling for glory. With Montpellier’s 14 Handball titles and Paris Saint-Germains 11 wins, the competition is fierce. Champions earn spots in the EHF Champions League, while cup winners qualify for the European League.

programme.title: Al Sadd vs Al Arabi - Qatar Stars League 2025/26 - W8
programme.desc: The Qatari League is the official football league in Qatar. The league includes 12 teams. The most famous participating clubs are Al-Sadd, the champions of the last season; Al-Rayyan and Al-Arabi, the popular teams, Al-Duhail and Al-Gharafa, serious contenders for the title every season. The Qatari league includes star names such as Firmino, Verratti, and Qatari Akram Afif, the best player in Asia.

Football - Croatian league: Gorica - Hajduk / Fudbal - Hrvatska liga: Gorica - Hajduk
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. The absolute record holder for the number of goals scored is Varteksa legend Davor Vugrinec with 144 goals. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se menjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prelazni kup namenjen prvaku delo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo. Apsolutni rekorder po broju postignutih pogodaka legenda je Varteksa Davor Vugrinec sa 144 gola.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Red Star - Mega / Košarka - ABA liga: Crvena zvezda - Mega
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Posušje - Radnik / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Posušje - Radnik
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Montenegrin league: Dečić - Budućnost / Fudbal - Crnogorska liga: Dečić - Budućnost
programme.desc: The Montenegrin Football League was founded in 2004, but the first season was played in the 2006/2007 season. after the independence of the country. 12 clubs in the three-round competition system fought for the championship title, which was eventually won by Zeta from Golubovac, which remained the only championship title of Montenegro. Today, the number of clubs is reduced to 10, and 30 rounds are played. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Football - Croatian league: Gorica - Hajduk / Fudbal - Hrvatska liga: Gorica - Hajduk

programme.title: Water polo - Regional league: Radnički - Šabac / Vaterpolo - Regionalna liga: Radnički - Šabac
programme.desc: The Adriatic Water Polo League or the sponsor name Triglav Regional League is a regional water polo competition in which Montenegrin, Croatian, Slovenian clubs compete, later also Italian and Serbian clubs. The first season, which began on September 26, 2008, gathered 12 clubs, 8 from Croatia, 3 from Montenegro and 1 from Slovenia. The year of establishment is taken as the same year 2008, when the decision was made in Dubrovnik at the qualifying tournament for the European Championship. After the first season, Italian representatives also joined the league, who soon gave up, while since 2014, the league has also included clubs from Serbia. / Jadranska vaterpolo liga ili sponzorski naziv Triglav regionalna liga je regionalno vaterpolo takmičenje u kojoj se od jeseni 2008. godine takmiče crnogorski, hrvatski, slovenački klubovi, kasnije i talijanski te srpski klubovi. Prva sezona, koja je počela 26. septembra 2008., okupljala je 12 klubova, 8 iz Hrvatske, 3 iz Crne Gore i 1 iz Slovenije. Za godinu osnutka se uzima ista ta 2008. godina kada je odluka donešena u Dubrovniku na kvalifikacionom turniru za Evropsko prvenstvo. Nakon prve sezone ligi su se priključili i italijanski predstavnici koji si ubrzo odustali, dok od 2014. godine liga broji i klubove iz Srbije.

As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Future stars of the Arena / Buduće zvezde Arene
programme.desc: We present to you successful young people who represent the future of sports in Serbia. Get to know sportsmen and women who are already achieving exceptional results in junior competitions. / Predstavljamo vam uspešne mlade ljude koji predstavljaju budućnost sporta u Srbiji. Upoznajte sportistkinje i sportiste koji već u juniorskim takmičenjima ostvaruju izuzetne rezultate.

programme.title: Water Polo - Champions League: Pro Recco - Jadran HN / Vaterpolo - Liga šampiona: Pro Recco - Jadran HN
programme.desc: The strongest club water polo competition in the world will offer every fan of this sport a series of unforgettable moments in front of the TV screens. Check which team will lift the title of European champion! / Najjače klupsko vaterpolo takmičenje na svetu će svakom ljubitelju ovog sporta priuštiti niz nezaboravnih trenutaka pred tv ekranima. Proverite koja će ekipa podići titulu prvaka Evrope!

programme.title: Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Posušje - Radnik / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Posušje - Radnik
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.
