programme.title: Za prijatelje
programme.desc: An entertainment show whose goal is to cheer up families across the country, offer them a helping hand, and make dreams come true for individuals. / Zabavna oddaja, katere cilj je razveseljevati družine po državi, jim ponuditi roko pomoči, posameznikom uresničiti sanje.

programme.title: More health: MIC Mengeš / Več zdravja: MIC Mengeš
programme.desc: The advisory show "More health" is dedicated to health and care for it. / Svetovalna oddaja "Več zdravja" je posvečena zdravju in skrbi zanj.

programme.title: Ulice San Francisca
programme.desc: An experienced San Francisco cop teams up with a daring young detective. Although their methods are radically different, this duo is very successful in solving cases. / Izkušeni policist iz San Francisca se združi z drznim mladim detektivom. Čeprav se njune metode radikalno razlikujejo, je ta dvojec zelo uspešen pri reševanju primerov.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Bonanza series takes place around 1860 in Nevada. Ben Cartwright lives with his three sons on the Ponderosa Ranch near Virginia City on the shores of Lake Tahoe. / Serija Bonanza se dogaja okoli leta 1860 v Nevadi.Ben Cartwright skupaj s tremi sinovi živi na ranču Ponderosa v bližini mesta Virginia City ob obali jezera Tahoe.

programme.title: Samra
programme.desc: A telenovela about love and suffering, about injustices and differences in society, about the intertwining of tradition and modernity, about poverty and wealth. / Telenovela o ljubezni in trpljenju, o nepravičnostih in razlikah v družbi, o prepletu tradicije in sodobnosti, o revščini in bogastvu.

programme.title: Kapsula
programme.desc: The Kapsula show presents the latest fashion trends for the young and the young at heart. Every day a new offer and a large selection of different clothes, fashion accessories, shoes and jewelry. / V oddaji Kapsula so predstavljeni najnovejši modni trendi za mlade in mlade po srcu.Vsak dan nova ponudba in velika izbira različnih oblačil, modnih dodatkov, čevljev in nakita.

programme.title: Italijanska modna trgovina
programme.desc: Live TV sales of clothes. / TV prodaja oblačil v živo.

programme.title: Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasury of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer teaches together with interesting guests in the show Klepet ob kava. In each show, they discuss several current topics related to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are also researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and modern approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in every show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experiences and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: Tomaž Gorec travels: Vietnam / Tomaž Gorec potuje: Vietnam
programme.desc: Join the passionate traveler and photographer Tomaž Gorec in discovering the wonderful corners of the world. / Pridružite se strastnemu popotniku in fotografu Tomažu Gorcu pri odkrivanju čudovitih kotičkov sveta.

programme.desc: Narodno-zabavna glasba.

programme.title: American outcasts / Ameriški izobčenci
programme.desc: Jesse James returns from the Civil War to his hometown. There, a bribed railroad owner wants to kick the townspeople off their land in order to build a line. A well-known outlaw tries to right the wrong in the only way he knows and knows how: he gathers a gang of young outlaws who have returned from the war and starts robbing banks. James and his gang win the sympathy of the local population, who see him as Robin Hood. At the same time, the world's first private detective, Alan Pinkerton, tries to step on the renegades' toes. / Jesse James se vrača iz državljanske vojne v svoje rodno mesto. Tam želi podkupljeni lastnik železnice spoditi meščane z njihove zemlje, da bi zgradil progo. Znani izobčenec skuša popraviti krivico na edini način, ki ga pozna in obvlada: zbere bando mladih izobčencev, ki so se vrnili iz vojne in začne ropati banke.James in njegova banda si pridobijo simpatije lokalnega prebivalstva, ki na njega gleda kot na Robina Hooda. Istočasno skuša odpadnikom stopiti na prste prvi zasebni detektiv na svetu, Alan Pinkerton.

programme.title: Of course / Apač
programme.desc: Only one Indian, the Massai, resists the white army, but he is soon captured and sent to prison. Soon he escapes and makes his way to the land of the Apaches, where he meets a kind Cherokee who helps him survive. After a month of hard travel and fighting for his life, Massai finally reaches his home and his beloved Nalinla, but her father hands him over to the soldiers again. Will he ever see the day of atonement? / Vojski belcev se upira le en Indijanec, Massai, vendar ga kmalu zajamejo in pošljejo v zapor. Kmalu pobegne in se prebije na zemljo Apačev, kjer spozna prijaznega Cherokeeja, ki mu pomaga preživeti.Po mesecu težke poti in borbe za življenje Massai končno pride do svojega doma in do svoje ljubljene Nalinle, vendar ga njen oče ponovno izroči vojakom. Bo kdaj dočakal dan sprave?

programme.title: Football (M): Mura - Celje, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Mura - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Mura - Celje, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Mura - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

In the top tier of the football competition, founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for the popular plate every year in August. It was won by Bayern Munich the most times, 24 times. The culture of cheering, full stands and top-class football is what adorns the Bundesliga from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the chance to enjoy Bundesliga matches. You certainly won't regret it. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Mura - Celje, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Mura - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Lini and Lazi, cartoon, Mon. / Lini in Lazi, risani film, pon.
programme.sub-title: On a distant planet, the Aliens Meta and Bine meet in the Glompy Forest and become true friends. Their families, the red Lina and the blue Laz, are not keen on them hanging out. "You must never play with Lin!" exclaims Grandma Laz, while / Na oddaljenem planetu se v Glompastem gozdu srečata Nezemljana Meta in Bine, ki postaneta prava prijatelja. Njuni družini, rdeči Lini in modri Lazi, niso navdušeni nad tem, da se družita. »Z Linom nikoli ne smeš se igrat!« vzklika babica Laz, medtem ko
programme.desc: Meta and Bine escape with Grandpa's red rocket, so Grandma and Grandpa have to bridge their differences. Lini and Lazi travel through space in search of Meta and Binet, and in the process learn to coexist. When the hope of finding them has dried up, the two families head to their home planet, where they see a runaway couple in the Glompa forest. Another surprise awaits Line and Laze. Bine and Meta present to them little Lin-Laza, who is purple from head to toe. / Meta in Bine pobegneta z dedkovo rdečo raketo, zato morata babica in dedek premostiti razlike med seboj. Lini in Lazi iščoč Meto in Bineta potujejo po vesolju, pri tem pa se naučijo sobivati. Ko že usahne upanje, da bi ju našli, se družini odpravita na domači planet, kjer v Glompastem gozdu zagledajo pobegli par. A Line in Laze čaka še eno presenečenje. Bine in Meta jim predstavita otročička Lin-Laza, ki je vijoličast od glave do peta.

programme.title: Brina: Sticky Gecko, cartoon, Mon. / Brina: Lepljivi gekon, risanka, pon.
programme.desc: I: Derganc Maša (mother (Cili)), Hribar Škrlec Lena (Binka), Mihevc Lea (Ščebetavko), Slakonja Klemen (eyes (Beno)), Zupančič Jana (Brina); R: Milčinski Nana... Mami, Brina and Binka are going to the playground, where Jana and her mother are waiting for them. But they never get out of the house. Brina and Binka invent countless games to delay their departure, as they have to wait for the sticky Geki to fall from the ceiling to the floor. / I: Derganc Maša (mami (Cili)), Hribar Škrlec Lena (Binka), Mihevc Lea (Ščebetavko), Slakonja Klemen (oči (Beno)), Zupančič Jana (Brina); R: Milčinski Nana... Mami, Brina in Binka se odpravljajo na igrišče, kjer jih čaka Jana s svojo mamico. A se nikakor ne spravijo iz hiše. Brina in Binka si izmišljata nešteto igric, da zavlačujeta odhod, saj morajo počakati, da lepljivi Geki pade s stropa na tla.

programme.title: Mimi and Liza: In the Garden, cartoon / Mimi in Liza: Na vrtu, risani film
programme.desc: I: Bezeljak Miha (Garden wonder, janitor, worm, choir of words), Derganc Maša (Aunt Šivilja 1, Aunt Šivilja 2), Kogovšek Sabina (Mrs. Pecivček, Mrs. Sivka), Kores Sraka Nika (Liza), Lazar Iva (Mimi), Valič Nina (monster, Zemljič Matej (gardener, V; R: Maurič Lazar Martina... The neighbors happily started cleaning the house in autumn. Each of them will get rid of something old and make room for something new. Mimi and Liza discover a door to a mysterious garden, where they meet a dwarf named the Garden Wizard. He explains to them the wonders of natural cycles. Suddenly, the discarded things turn into a roaring Monster that clumsily jumps around and thus inadvertently destroys the entire garden. The garden prodigy wants her to stop, but he accidentally swallows it. So now the girls must save both of them to prevent disaster. / I: Bezeljak Miha (Vrtni čudežnik, hišnik, črviček, zbor reči), Derganc Maša (tetka Šivilja 1, tetka Šivilja 2), Kogovšek Sabina (gospa Pecivček, gospa Sivka), Kores Sraka Nika (Liza), Lazar Iva (Mimi), Valič Nina (pošast, Zemljič Matej (vrtnar, V; R: Maurič Lazar Martina... Sosedje so se veselo lotili jesenskega čiščenja hiše. Vsak od njih se bo znebil česa starega in naredil prostor za kaj novega. Mimi in Liza odkrijeta vrata v skrivnostni vrt, kjer srečata škrata po imenu Vrtni čudežnik. Razloži jima čudeže naravnih ciklov. Nenadoma pa se zavržene reči spremenijo v ropotajočo Pošast, ki nerodno poskakuje naokoli in tako nehote uniči ves vrt. Vrtni čudežnik jo želi ustaviti, a ga ta po nesreči pogoltne. Deklici morata torej zdaj rešiti oba, da preprečita katastrofo.

programme.title: Pure Boredom Monday, a holiday show for kids / Čisti dolgčas v ponedeljek, počitniška oddaja za otroke
programme.desc: On the holiday show Pure Boredom, Nik and Khaleesi Luna try their hand at stick tricks! Zoja sends them inspiration, and the two leaders quickly tackle fun challenges - from balance to limbo. In the end, they are joined remotely by actor Matej Zemljič, who reveals his favorite vacation memory from his childhood. / V počitniški oddaji Čisti dolgčas Nik in Khaleesi Luna preizkušata trike s palico! Navdih jima pošlje Zoja, voditelja pa se hitro lotita zabavnih izzivov – od ravnotežja do limba. Na koncu se jima na daljavo pridruži igralec Matej Zemljič, ki razkrije svoj najljubši počitniški spomin iz otroštva.

programme.title: Kozmo (I., II.): Cousin on crooked paths, Belgian children's series / Kozmo (I., II.): Bratranec na krivih potih, belgijska otroška nanizanka
programme.desc: I: Coppejans Remco (Robbe), Huysentruyt Bert (Markus), Janssens Maxine (Ellis), Stocker Marit (Esther); R: Temmermans Matthias, Van Leemputten Bart... Cosmos I. and II.; Robbe is thrilled when his cousin Jasper visits them. He and Ellis get along great, but Jasper is behaving strangely. And all the while, three suspicious teenagers are on his heels. / I: Coppejans Remco (Robbe), Huysentruyt Bert (Markus), Janssens Maxine (Ellis), Stocker Marit (Esther); R: Temmermans Matthias, Van Leemputten Bart... Kosmo I. and Ii.; Robbe je navdušen, ko jih obišče njegov bratranec Jasper. Z Ellis se odlično razumejo, toda Jasper se nekam nenavadno vede. In ves čas so mu za petami trije sumljivi najstniki.

programme.title: Challengers, EBU documentary: Lorenzo saves the animals, a documentary for young people / Izzivalci, EBU dokumentarni film: Lorenzo rešuje živali, dokumentarni film za mlade
programme.desc: Challenger Lorenzo from Italy is ten years old and loves all animals, especially birds of prey. What he wants most is to spend the day at a wildlife care and rehabilitation center. When he finally succeeds, there he meets a young wood owl that has fallen from its nest. Lorenzo takes care of her, feeds her and helps her recover until she is ready to go back into the wild. A special bond is forming between them, but Lorenzo knows that sooner or later he will have to let the owl go. It will be moving and brave – a moment of farewell, but also a new beginning. / Izzivalec Lorenzo iz Italije je star deset let in ima rad vse živali, še posebej obožuje ptice roparice. Najbolj si želi, da bi preživel dan v centru za oskrbo in rehabilitacijo divjih živali. Ko mu to končno uspe, tam sreča mlado lesno sovo, ki je padla iz gnezda. Lorenzo skrbi zanjo, jo hrani in ji pomaga pri okrevanju, dokler ni pripravljena za vrnitev v naravo. Med njima se splete posebna vez, a Lorenzo ve, da bo moral sovo prej ali slej izpustiti. To bo ganljivo in pogumno – trenutek slovesa, a tudi nov začetek.

programme.title: Above the Clouds, Belgian film, Mon. / Nad oblaki, belgijski film, pon.
programme.sub-title: Spaceboy; At just 11 years old, Jim shows an extraordinary talent for astronomy. After moving to a new town and changing schools, Jim takes part in a competition for young scientists and is paired with sensitive classmate Emma. Jim wants to use the competition to finish / Spaceboy; Jim pri komaj 11 letih izkazuje izjemen talent za astronomijo. Po selitvi v novo mesto in zamenjavi šole se Jim udeleži tekmovanja za mlade znanstvenike in pristane v paru z občutljivo sošolko Emmo. Jim želi tekmovanje izkoristiti za dokončanj
programme.desc: There are many films about growing up and overcoming family trauma, but this one contains something charming and poetic. The direction is very sensitive and precise, the story is convincing despite the fantasy elements and the film manages to evoke sympathy with the characters. Recommended age: 8+ Original title: SPACEBOY Year of production: 2021 Country: Belgium Genre: children's film Director: Olivier Pairoux Screenplay: Eusebio Larrea, Olivier Paroux Starring: Peter van den Begin, Jean-Benoit Ugeux, Albane Masson. / Filmov o odraščanju in premagovanju družinskih travm je veliko, a ta vsebuje nekaj očarljivega in poetičnega. Režija je zelo senzibilna in natančna, zgodba je prepričljiva kljub fantazijskim elementom in film uspe vzbuditi simpatijo z liki.Priporočena starost: 8+Originalni naslov: SPACEBOYLeto produkcije: 2021Država: BelgijaŽanr: otroški filmRežija: Olivier Pairoux Scenarij: Eusebio Larrea, Olivier Paroux Igrajo: Peter van den Begin, Jean-Benoit Ugeux, Albane Masson.

programme.title: Good morning, Mon. / Dobro jutro, pon.
programme.desc: Start the week with the show Dobro jutro! After reviewing the morning news and other current events, we check with you all kinds of myths and look for answers to eternal dilemmas. Monday is also marked by health minutes, we host renowned experts who answer your questions. The field team advertises from Ljubljana and the surrounding area, and active seniors prove with inspiring stories that age is no obstacle to creativity and good will. In the Topic of the Day section, every week we highlight a socially relevant but inspiring topic, which we think about together with our guests in the studio. The surprise of Monday morning is an interesting interlocutor, which we reveal with the help of hints together with you at the end of the show! / Začnite teden z oddajo Dobro jutro! Po pregledu jutranjih novic in ostalih aktualnih dogodkov z vami preverjamo najrazličnejše mite in iščemo odgovore na večne dileme. Ponedeljek je tudi v znamenju zdravstvenih minut, gostimo priznane strokovnjake, ki odgovarjajo na vaša vprašanja. Terenska ekipa se oglaša iz Ljubljane in okolice, aktivni seniorji pa z navdihujočimi zgodbami dokazujejo, da leta niso ovira za ustvarjalnost in dobro voljo. V rubriki Tema dneva vsak teden izpostavljamo družbeno pomembno, a navdihujočo temo, o kateri razmišljamo skupaj z gosti v studiu. Presenečenje ponedeljkovega jutra pa je zanimiv sogovornik, ki ga s pomočjo namigov razkrijemo skupaj z vami ob koncu oddaje!

programme.title: Tastes of 2 generations, cooking show, Mon. / Okusi 2 generacij, kuharska oddaja, pon.
programme.desc: The Tastes of 2 Generations show combines the rich cultural heritage of Slovenian cuisine with modern food trends. In a relaxed atmosphere, father Primož Dolničar and son Gaber share recipes inspired by the traditional dishes of our grandmothers, but at the same time adapting them to modern tastes and methods of preparation. The show thus presents a wonderful fusion of past and present, where local and fresh ingredients take center stage. / Oddaja Okusi 2 generacij združuje bogato kulturno dediščino slovenske kuhinje s sodobnimi trendi prehranjevanja. Oče Primož Dolničar in sin Gaber v sproščenem vzdušju delita recepte, ki jih navdihujejo tradicionalne jedi naših babic, hkrati pa jih prilagodita sodobnemu okusu in načinom priprave. Oddaja tako predstavlja čudovito zlitje preteklosti in sedanjosti, kjer lokalne in sveže sestavine dobijo osrednjo vlogo.

programme.title: Sunday afternoon, Mon. / Nedeljsko popoldne, pon.
programme.sub-title: On Sunday afternoon, we host skiing and rapper legend Juret Košir and rapper poet Klemn Klemn. Halfway between Strunjan and Begunja, the creative paths of two musicians, Monika Avsenik and Jan Plestenjak, met in the song prijat / V Nedeljskem popoldnevu gostimo smučarsko in repersko legendo Jureta Koširja in raperskega poeta Klemna Klemna. programme.title: Ah, these years!: Nutritional supplements?, Mon. / Ah, ta leta!: Prehranska dopolnila?, pon.
programme.desc: Vitamins, minerals, dietary fiber, amino acids... - all of this can be found in food supplements, which most of us consume at least occasionally. But experts warn: supplements are not a miracle solution. dr. Nada Rotovnik Kozjek, president of the Slovenian Association for Clinical Nutrition, and Dr. Igor Pravst from the Institute of Nutrition emphasizes that taking supplements without real need and without professional supervision can even be harmful. We must be aware that supplements are not medicines and that the control of the food supplement market is not properly regulated. They will also explain how to find out if we have an increased need for a certain vitamin, mineral, amino acid or other nutrient, what it is like to consume food supplements in case of chronic diseases and regular medication, and when it makes sense to check the actual state of the body. The guests are convinced that we can take care of our health with a varied and balanced diet even without nutritional supplements. We can also find out which nutrients are contained in individual foods online, which is why we will be in the section Ah, this web! presented the national food portal: Prehrana.si. / Vitamini, minerali, prehranske vlaknine, aminokisline … – vse to najdemo v prehranskih dopolnilih, ki jih vsaj občasno uživa večina med nami. A strokovnjaki opozarjajo: dopolnila niso čudežna rešitev. Dr. Nada Rotovnik Kozjek, predsednica slovenskega Združenja za klinično prehrano, in dr. Igor Pravst z Inštituta za nutricionistiko poudarjata, da je jemanje dopolnil brez prave potrebe in brez strokovnega nadzora lahko celo škodljivo. Zavedati se moramo, da dopolnila niso zdravila in da nadzor nad trgom prehranskih dopolnil ni ustrezno urejen. Pojasnila bosta tudi, kako ugotovimo, ali imamo povečano potrebo po nekem vitaminu, mineralu, aminokislini ali drugem hranilu, kako je z uživanjem prehranskih dopolnil ob kroničnih boleznih in rednem jemanju zdravil ter kdaj je smiselno preveriti dejansko stanje v telesu. Gosta sta prepričana, da lahko s pestro in uravnoteženo prehrano tudi brez prehranskih dopolnil poskrbimo za svoje zdravje. Katera hranila vsebuje posamezna hrana, pa lahko izvemo tudi na spletu, zato bomo v rubriki Ah, ta splet! predstavili nacionalni portal o hrani: Prehrana.si.

programme.title: Down the Danube with Joanna Lumley, British documentary series, 4/4, Mon. / Po Donavi z Joanno Lumley, britanska dokumentarna serija, 4/4, pon.
programme.sub-title: Joanna Lumley's Danube: Europe's Mightiest River; In this four-part series, Joanna Lumley takes us on an epic journey through the heart of Europe along the world's most international river, the Danube. From its source in the Black Forest in Germany all the way to its mouth on the coast of the Black Sea / Joanna Lumleys Danube: Europes Mightiest River; Joanna Lumley nas v tej štiridelni seriji popelje na epsko potovanje po osrčju Evrope vzdolž najbolj mednarodne reke na svetu, Donave. Od izvira v Črnem gozdu v Nemčiji pa vse do ustja na obali Črnega morj
programme.desc: Part 4: The epic journey along the magnificent Danube is coming to an end. After sailing through the Džerdap gorge, over which the grim face of King Decebal watches over, Joanna visits the former Austro-Hungarian imperial baths and gypsy women, who bless her path with a special ceremony. Then he enters the Danube Delta, a vast wilderness with rich flora and fauna, which he explores in a floating house, accompanied by a biologist. During the day, everything is full of pelicans and storks, and at night, the howling of jackals echoes from the banks. Finally, after nearly 3,000 kilometers of travel, Joanna reaches the zero point where the Danube flows into the Black Sea. JOANNA LUMLEYS DANUBE: EUROPE'S MIGHTIEST RIVER / Great Britain / 2025 / Director: Eric McFarland. / 4. del:Epsko popotovanje po veličastni Donavi se približuje koncu. Po plovbi po soteski Džerdap, nad katero bdi mrki obraz kralja Decebala, Joanna obišče še nekdanje avstroogrske cesarske kopeli in ciganke, ki s posebnim obredom blagoslovijo njeno pot. Nato vstopi v delto Donave, prostrano divjino z bogato floro in favno, ki jo v spremstvu biologa raziskuje v plavajoči hiši. Podnevi je tam vse polno pelikanov in štorkelj, ponoči pa z bregov odmeva tuljenje šakalov. Naposled po skoraj 3000 kilometrih poti Joanna pride do točke nič, kjer se Donava izliva v Črno morje.JOANNA LUMLEYS DANUBE: EUROPES MIGHTIEST RIVER / Velika Britanija / 2025 / Režija: Eric McFarland.

programme.desc: Maggie is still torn between her father's estate, where she spent her childhood, and Boston, where she has the promise of a successful medical career. Cal decides to stay and cheers Maggie up with the news, but soon after makes her very sad. Andrew makes plans for a future together with Maggie. Lola finds documents about a car accident she experienced as a child, but she doesn't remember anything. In addition to health problems, Sully also deals with serious financial problems that threaten the camp. programme.title: A short, cartoon film / Svit, risani film
programme.desc: I: Ban Ivo (Grandfathers), Bučevec Lana (Sister, Girl), Derganc Maša (Svit), Hribar Škrlec Lena (Grandma (10 years old), Grandmother (16 years old)), Mihelčič Saša (Mother, Mother (6 years old)), Pernarčič Vesna (Teacher, Woman, Brother 1), Smrekar Ajda (Jakob, Sister 1), Tomažič Jadranka; R: Milčinski Nana... Svit loves his grandmother, he is often with her and they do many things together. When his grandmother dies, a dark sadness begins to spread inside him, which takes him on a strange journey one night in a dream. He finds himself in a strange world in which he must find an ancient temple of light before darkness reigns over the world. It is a long and dark road to the temple, but it is worth the effort, because at the end of it a grandmother awaits him. He tells his grandson that he is still with him - in beautiful moments together, which will forever be recorded in Svit's heart. / I: Ban Ivo (Dedi), Bučevec Lana (Sestrica, Deklica), Derganc Maša (Svit), Hribar Škrlec Lena (Babi (10let), Babi (16 let)), Mihelčič Saša (Mama, Mama (6 let)), Pernarčič Vesna (Učiteljica, Ženska, Bratec 1), Smrekar Ajda (Jakob, Sestrica 1), Tomažič Jadranka; R: Milčinski Nana... Svit ima rad svojo babico, pogosto je z njo in skupaj počneta marsikaj. Ko babica umre, se začne v njem širiti temna žalost, ki ga neke noči v sanjah popelje na nenavadno potovanje. Znajde se v čudnem svetu, v katerem mora poiskati stari tempelj svetlobe, še preden na svetu zavlada tema. Do templja je dolga in mračna pot, ki pa je vredna truda, saj ga na njenem koncu pričaka babica. Vnučku pove, da je še vedno z njim – v lepih skupnih trenutkih, ki bodo za vedno zapisani v Svitovem srcu.

programme.title: Pure Boredom Tuesday, a holiday show for kids / Čisti dolgčas v torek, počitniška oddaja za otroke
