This time, ski jumper Cene Prevc joins them remotely and reveals his favorite holiday memory from his childhood. / Nik in Martin bosta v novi epizodi oddaje Čisti dolgčas poletela – dobesedno! Svit jima pošlje idejo za izdelavo papirnatega letala, potem pa se začne tekma, kdo bolje meri in kdo upa leteti z zaprtimi očmi. Na daljavo se jima tokrat pridruži smučarski skakalec Cene Prevc in razkrije svoj najljubši počitniški spomin iz otroštva.

programme.title: Kozmo (I., II.): Fosil, a Belgian children's series / Kozmo (I., II.): Fosil, belgijska otroška nanizanka
programme.desc: I: Coppejans Remco (Robbe), Huysentruyt Bert (Markus), Janssens Maxine (Ellis), Stocker Marit (Esther); R: Temmermans Matthias, Van Leemputten Bart... Cosmos I. and II.; Robbe and Ellis go to the museum to see a precious fossil, but it is stolen just during their visit. The thief incapacitated the guard, so he did not see the perpetrator. Will Robbe, Ellis and Kozmo manage to track down the thief? / I: Coppejans Remco (Robbe), Huysentruyt Bert (Markus), Janssens Maxine (Ellis), Stocker Marit (Esther); R: Temmermans Matthias, Van Leemputten Bart... Kosmo I. and Ii.; Robbe in Ellis gresta v muzej na ogled dragocenega fosila, ki pa ga ravno v času njunega obiska ukradejo. Tat je onesposobil čuvaja, zato ta storilca ni videl. Bo Robbeju, Ellis in Kozmu uspelo izslediti tatu?

programme.title: Challengers, EBU documentary: Benet: My first goal, a documentary for young people / Izzivalci, EBU dokumentarni film: Benet: Moj prvi gol, dokumentarni film za mlade
programme.desc: The challenger Benet from Germany is eleven years old and a short person - he measures exactly one meter and eleven centimeters. Nevertheless, he loves sports, especially football! He plays for his hometown club in the town of Rangsdorf near Berlin, along with peers of normal height. He is a very skilled player, but he has never scored a goal in a real game until now. Due to his short stature, he cannot run as much as others and has fewer opportunities to retrieve the ball, which is why it is sometimes more difficult for him on the field. But Benet has strong team support - everyone wants him to score his dream first goal this year. The coach and teammates prepare specific drills and tactics to get Benet to the right shooting opportunity. With the help of everyone who believes in him, will he finally see the moment when his ball ends up in the net? / Izzivalec Benet iz Nemčije je star enajst let in je oseba z nizko rastjo – meri natanko meter in enajst centimetrov. Kljub temu obožuje šport, še posebej nogomet! Igra za domači klub v mestu Rangsdorf blizu Berlina, skupaj z vrstniki običajne rasti. Je zelo spreten igralec, a na pravi tekmi do zdaj še nikoli ni dal gola. Zaradi svoje nizke rasti namreč ne more preteči toliko kot drugi in ima manj možnosti pri odvzemu žoge, zato mu je včasih na igrišču težje. A Benet ima močno podporo ekipe – vsi si želijo, da bi mu letos uspelo doseči sanjski prvi gol. Trener in soigralci pripravijo posebne vaje in taktike, da bi Beneta pripeljali do prave priložnost za strel. Bo s pomočjo vseh, ki verjamejo vanj, končno dočakal trenutek, ko bo njegova žoga končala v mreži?

programme.title: Dunja and the Princess of Aleppo, a Canadian-French film / Dunja in princesa iz Alepa, kanadsko-francoski film
programme.sub-title: Dounia Et La Princesse Dalep / Dounia And The Princess Of Allepo; A stunning emotional and visual journey to Syria through the narrative of the six-year-old girl Dunja. A serious theme is enriched with a charming mix of songs, "fragrances" and magical powers that inspire hope / Dounia Et La Princesse Dalep / Dounia And The Princess Of Allepo; Osupljivo čustveno in vizualno popotovanje v Sirijo skozi pripoved šestletne deklice Dunje. Resna tema je obogatena z očarljivo mešanico pesmi, »dišav« in čarobnih moči, ki vzbujajo upanj
programme.desc: Dunja lives in Aleppo, a thousand-year-old city that was once the center of the world. The lively curly-haired girl loves playing, learning and discovering new recipes. He spends his time at the market, where he and his grandfather look for ingredients for the delicious dishes prepared by his grandmother. Life is full of friendly neighbors, picturesque stories and lively music. One evening, a group of uniformed men take Dunja's father away. Even on the streets, the escalation of tension can be felt more and more. When the war starts, Dunji's grandmother and grandfather try to protect the girl and find a safer place for her. The quince takes with it only a few holly seeds, which are said to have magical powers. Their journey takes them across land and sea, and they overcome dangers with courage, hope, mutual cooperation and humor. Recommended age: 7 + Original title: DOUNIA ET LA PRINCESSE DALEP Year of production: 2022 Country: Canada, France Genre: synchronized animated film Director: Marya Zarif and Andre Kadi Screenplay: Marya ZarifVoices: Maja Kunšič, Vesna Pernarčič, Zvone Hribar, Blaž Šef, Gašper Jarni, Uroš Smolej. / Dunja živi v Alepu, tisočletnem mestu, ki je bilo nekdaj središče sveta. Živahna kodrolasa deklica obožuje igro, učenje in odkrivanje novih receptov. Čas preživlja na tržnici, kjer z dedkom iščeta sestavine za okusne jedi, ki jih pripravlja babica. Življenje je polno prijaznih sosedov, slikovitih pripovedk in živahne glasbe. Nekega večera pa skupina uniformiranih mož odpelje Dunjinega očeta. Tudi na ulicah je vse bolj čutiti stopnjevanje napetosti. Ko se začne vojna, skušata Dunjina babica in dedek zaščititi deklico in poiskati varnejši kraj zanjo. Dunja s seboj vzame le nekaj semen črnike, ki naj bi imela čarobno moč. Potovanje jih vodi čez kopno in morje, nevarnosti pa premagujejo s pogumom, upanjem, medsebojnim sodelovanjem in tudi humorjem.Priporočena starost: 7 +Originalni naslov: DOUNIA ET LA PRINCESSE DALEPLeto produkcije: 2022Država: Kanada, FrancijaŽanr: sinhronizirani animirani filmRežija: Marya Zarif in Andre KadiScenarij: Marya ZarifGlasovi: Maja Kunšič, Vesna Pernarčič, Zvone Hribar, Blaž Šef, Gašper Jarni, Uroš Smolej.

programme.title: Good morning, Mon. / Dobro jutro, pon.
programme.sub-title: Maribor (Tuesday); The Dobro jutro show is a show for viewers. With our advisory, educational, entertainment and informative content, we follow the wishes of viewers of all age groups. In a live and dynamic morning program lasting several hours, which is up for grabs / Maribor (torek); Oddaja Dobro jutro je oddaja gledalcev. S svojimi svetovalnimi, izobraževalnimi, razvedrilnimi in informativnimi vsebinami sledimo željam gledalcev vseh starostnih skupin. V večurnem živem in dinamičnem jutranjem programu, ki je na spor
programme.desc: The show Dobro jutro introduces modern television formats with an emphasis on quality content and is among the best-watched programs on national television, taking into account the share of television viewers. In 2014, the creators of the show received one of the most prestigious Slovenian media awards: the professional winner for the best entertainment TV show. / Oddaja Dobro jutro uvaja sodobne televizijske formate s poudarkom na kakovostnih vsebinah in je upoštevajoč delež televizijskih gledalcev med najbolje gledanimi oddajami nacionalne televizije. V letu 2014 so ustvarjalci oddaje prejeli eno najprestižnejših slovenskih medijskih priznanj: strokovnega viktorja za najboljšo zabavno TV-oddajo.

programme.title: Japajade show, entertainment music show, Mon. / Japajade šov, zabavno glasbena oddaja, pon.
programme.desc: Also in this show, we will get to know the farmers who are competing for the title of Farmer of the Year in the Japajade show. Vanja Lukman from the village of Tabor and Simona Anžlovar from Dolenje Selce arrive. Igor and Zlati zvoki, Tanja Žagar, Rok Švab and Silva Pliberšek with their friends, Polde Pungerčar, the Akordi ensemble and the last Slakov Fant from Praprotna, Andrej Bergant, will provide a great musical mood. / Tudi v tokratni oddaji bomo spoznali kmetici, ki se potegujeta za naziv Naj kmetica leta oddaje Japajade šov. Prideta Vanja Lukman iz vasi Tabor in Simona Anžlovar iz Dolenjih Selc. Za odlično glasbeno razpoloženje bodo poskrbeli Igor in Zlati zvoki, Tanja Žagar, Rok Švab in Silvo Pliberšek s prijatelji, Polde Pungerčar, ansambel Akordi in zadnji Slakov Fant s Praprotna Andrej Bergant.

programme.title: On to the beautiful: From Istria to Kum, Mon. / Na lepše: Od Istre do Kuma, pon.
programme.desc: Na lepše - a central tourist show that reminds us of how big Slovenia is and how many reasons we have for going to a more beautiful place just a few steps away from our doorstep. Weekly, we look for current news, hidden destinations and unknown products for you. A complete overview of everything you want to know about domestic tourism. For all of you who live and work in tourism. Because we sincerely believe that we are tourism people. / Na lepše - osrednja turistična oddaja, ki nas spomni na to, kako velika je Slovenija in koliko razlogov za odhod na lepše imamo samo par korakov stran od domačega praga. Za vas tedensko iščemo aktualne novosti, skrite destinacije in neznane produkte. Popoln pregled vsega, kar želite vedeti o domačem turizmu. Za vse, ki turizem živite in delate. Ker iskreno verjamemo, da smo turizem ljudje.

programme.title: Removing the gaze with Mirjana Borčič, documentary film, Mon. / Odstiranje pogleda z Mirjano Borčič, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Weiss Maja... "My point of view on film education is that the viewer makes the film. Not the director. The director only provides the basis, the material, and the viewer makes the film." / R: Weiss Maja... »Moje stališče do filmske vzgoje je, da gledalec naredi film. Ne režiser. Režiser da samo osnovo, gradivo, gledalec pa naredi film.«
programme.desc: The portrait documentary film by director Maja Weiss tells the life story of film teacher and publicist Mirjana Borčič. The narration takes us to the beginning of film education in Slovenia and to the time when the movement for film culture took shape. The basic question to which both the portraitist, the director and many Slovenian filmmakers exposed today are looking for an answer is what is the essence of education in this field and how this education should also be set in a social context. At the same time, mosaic pictures about teaching aids, film clubs, the importance of regional education for children with special needs, and how and why the famous German film director Werner Herzog came to Ljubljana are revealed to us. / Portretni dokumentarni film režiserke Maje Weiss pripoveduje življenjsko zgodbo o filmski pedagoginji in publicistki Mirjani Borčič. Naracija nas popelje na začetek filmske vzgoje na Slovenskem in v čas, ko se je izoblikovalo gibanje za filmsko kulturo. Osnovno vprašanje, na katerega iščejo odgovor tako portretiranka, režiserka kot mnogi danes izpostavljeni slovenski filmski ustvarjalci je, kaj je bistvo vzgoje na tem področju in kako naj bo ta vzgoja zastavljena tudi v družbenem kontekstu. Hkrati se nam razkrivajo tudi mozaične slike o učnih pripomočkih, filmskih klubih, pomembnosti področne vzgoje pri otrocih s posebnimi potrebami pa tudi o tem, kako in zakaj je v Ljubljano prišel sloviti nemški filmski režiser Werner Herzog.

programme.title: S-passages: 50 years of operation of the Skupina75 photo club, Mon. / S-prehodi: 50 let delovanja fotokluba Skupina75, pon.
programme.desc: The Group 75 Photo Club is celebrating its anniversary this year. On the occasion, they presented the publication and opened the exhibition in the Cultural Center in Gorica. In the studio, we will talk about the operation, milestones and achievements with the founding member of the photo club, Joško Prinčič, and the councilor and long-time president of the club, Silvan Pittoli. / Fotoklub Skupine 75 letos praznuje okroglo obletnico. Ob priložnosti so predstavili publikacijo, ter odprli razstavo v Kulturnem domu v Gorici. O delovanju, mejnikih in dosežkih se bomo v studiu pogovarjali z ustanovnim članom fotokluba Joškom Prinčičem in odbornikom in dolgoletnim predsednikom kluba Silvanom Pittolijem.

programme.title: Osmi and, pound. / Osmi dan, pon.
programme.desc: R: Meško Primož... We followed the 28th Portorož Slovenian Film Festival, where no fewer than 101 films were screened. We will present the recipients of the vesna awards and, among other things, check which films were best received by the audience, what shape Slovenian films are in, and where there are shortcomings and room for improvement. We watched the theater play Medea's Children, a shocking, daring and emotionally charged reinterpretation of the classic tragedy about Medea. Provocative Swiss director Milo Rau, known for socially critical plays that often intertwine real events and fiction, was a guest at Cankarjev dom. In Kino Šiška, we listened to the pioneer of electronic and ambient music, Suzanne Ciani, who greatly influenced the electronica scene. Among other things, we talked with her about the development of this musical genre, the influence of the environment and landscapes on her creation, and the search for new sounds. We met another top musician. Alexej Gerassimez is considered one of the best percussionists of all time. He performed in the Gallus hall of Cankarjev dom at a concert designed as a tribute to the American representative of musical minimalism, Philip Glass, otherwise his repertoire extends from classical and new music to jazz and minimalist music, and he also expands it with his own compositions. / R: Meško Primož... Spremljali smo 28. Festival slovenskega filma Portorož, na katerem so predvajali kar 101 film. Predstavili bomo prejemnike nagrad vesna in med drugim preverili, katere filme je občinstvo najbolje sprejelo, v kakšni formi je slovenski film ter kje so pomanjkljivosti in prostor za izboljšave. Ogledali smo si gledališko predstavo Medejini otroci, pretresljivo, drzno in čustveno nabito reinterpretacijo klasične tragedije o Medeji. V Cankarjevem domu je namreč gostoval provokativni švicarski režiser Milo Rau, znan po družbenokritičnih predstavah, ki nemalokrat prepletajo resnične dogodke in fikcijo. V Kinu Šiška smo prisluhnili pionirki elektronske in ambientalne glasbe Suzanne Ciani, ki je močno vplivala na sceno elektronike. Med drugim smo se z njo pogovarjali o razvoju te glasbene zvrsti, o vplivu okolja in pokrajin na njeno ustvarjanje ter iskanju novih zvokov. Srečali smo se s še enim vrhunskim glasbenikom. Alexej Gerassimez velja za enega najboljših tolkalcev vseh časov. V Gallusovi dvorani Cankarjevega doma je nastopil na koncertu, ki je bil zasnovan kot poklon ameriškemu predstavniku glasbenega minimalizma Philipu Glassu, sicer pa se njegov repertoar razteza od klasične in nove glasbe do jazza in minimalistične glasbe, nadgrajuje pa ga tudi z lastnimi kompozicijami.

programme.title: Table Tennis - World Series, live from Montpellier / Namizni tenis - svetovna serija, v živo iz Montpelliera

Your face is our property - the dangers of facial recognition systems, French documentary, Mon. / Vaš obraz je naša last – nevarnosti sistemov za prepoznavanje obrazov, francoska dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: Your Face Is Ours: The Dangers Of Facial Recognition Software / Vos Visages Sont A Nous: Les Dangers De La Reconnaissance Faciale; In parallel with the rapid development of artificial intelligence in the world, there is also growing concern about its possible abuses and / Your Face Is Ours: The Dangers Of Facial Recognition Software / Vos Visages Sont A Nous: Les Dangers De La Reconnaissance Faciale; Vzporedno z bliskovitim razvojem umetne inteligence v svetu narašča tudi zaskrbljenost zaradi njenih morebitnih zlorab in
programme.desc: YOUR FACE IS OURS: THE DANGERS OF FACIAL RECOGNITION SOFTWARE / YOUR FACE IS OURS: THE DANGERS OF FACIAL RECOGNITION / Francija / 2023 / Režija: Jessica Le Masurier, Romeo Langlois. / YOUR FACE IS OURS: THE DANGERS OF FACIAL RECOGNITION SOFTWARE / VOS VISAGES SONT A NOUS: LES DANGERS DE LA RECONNAISSANCE FACIALE / Francija / 2023 / Režija: Jessica Le Masurier, Romeo Langlois.

programme.title: TV clinic with David Zupančič: Alcohol among young people, Mon. / TV klinika z Davidom Zupančičem: Alkohol med mladimi, pon.
programme.desc: Seven out of ten 15-year-olds have ever resorted to alcohol. What effects does alcohol have on their body and development? We discover why alcohol is especially dangerous in adolescence and what we can do as a society, parents and individuals. / Sedem od desetih 15-letnikov je že kdaj poseglo po alkoholu. Kakšne posledice alkohol pusti na njihovem telesu in razvoju? Odkrivamo, zakaj je alkohol v mladostništvu še posebno nevaren in kaj lahko storimo kot družba, starši in posamezniki.

programme.title: Bonn: Old Friends, New Enemies, German serial, 2/6, Mon. / Bonn: Stari prijatelji, novi sovražniki, nemška nadaljevanka, 2/6, pon.
programme.sub-title: Bonn, Alte Freunde, Neue Feinde; Toni accompanies her boss to the trial of Nazi criminal Joseph von Waidburg and is visibly shaken by what she hears. As if by chance, John's agent Wolfgang starts chatting with her, intending to seduce her in and out of her / Bonn, Alte Freunde, Neue Feinde; Toni spremlja svojega šefa na sojenju nacističnemu zločincu Josephu von Waidburgu in je nad slišanim vidno pretresena. Kot po naključju se začne z njo pomenkovati Johnov agent Wolfgang, ki jo namerava zapeljati in iz nje
programme.desc: Bonn, Alte Freunde, Neue Feinde; Toni accompanies her boss to the trial of Nazi criminal Joseph von Waidburg and is visibly shaken by what she hears. As if by chance, John's agent Wolfgang starts chatting with her, intending to seduce her and extract information about Gehlen from her. By cunning, she soon gets hold of the plan for an underground military complex, and Toni herself begins to investigate how her father's construction company is connected to Gehln. When the family unexpectedly learns that Tonia's brother has been shot as a deserter, it sets off a series of events. The first of these is the unexpected revelation by Tonia's mother Elsa that Stefano's father is her former Jewish neighbor and the love of her life, Noah Berret....... / Bonn, Alte Freunde, Neue Feinde; Toni spremlja svojega šefa na sojenju nacističnemu zločincu Josephu von Waidburgu in je nad slišanim vidno pretresena. Kot po naključju se začne z njo pomenkovati Johnov agent Wolfgang, ki jo namerava zapeljati in iz nje izmamiti podatke o Gehlnu. Z zvijačo se že kmalu dokoplje do načrta za podzemni vojaški kompleks, Toni pa začne tudi sama raziskovati, kako je gradbeno podjetje njenega očeta povezano z Gehlnom. Ko družina nepričakovano izve, da je bil Tonijin brat ustreljen kot dezerter, to sproži niz dogodkov. Prvi izmed njih je nepričakovano razkritje Tonijine mame Else, da je Stefanov oče njen nekdanji judovski sosed in ljubezen njenega življenja Noah Berret.......

programme.title: Joker, quiz, Mon. / Joker, kviz, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Kučej Marjan... Quiz Joker features one contestant in a 12-question battle and provides a tense game of highs and lows. The host of the quiz is Mario Galunič. / R: Kučej Marjan... Kviz Joker predstavlja enega tekmovalca v bitki z 12 vprašanji in zagotavlja napeto igro vzponov in padcev. Voditelj kviza je Mario Galunič.
programme.desc: Dušan Kulovec from Medvod will present himself in the new Joker quiz. A retired special pedagogue who dedicated his life to working with children, his work left an indelible mark on the Malča Beličeva Home. He has been loyal to scouting for more than six decades, he was once a squad leader, and today he is a proud grandfather from the background. He sings in the partisan choir, likes to go to the hills and dreams of standing on the top of Triglav once more. His longtime friend Andrej Rous will be by his side when solving questions, and the possibility of an additional joker will be brought to him by the doctor and host of the TV clinic show David Zupančič. / V novem kvizu Joker se bo predstavil Dušan Kulovec iz Medvod. Upokojeni specialni pedagog, ki je življenje posvetil delu z otroki, je s svojim delom pustil neizbrisen pečat v Domu Malči Beličeve. Že več kot šest desetletij je zvest taborništvu, nekoč je bil načelnik odreda, danes pa ponosen dedek iz ozadja. Poje v partizanskem pevskem zboru, rad hodi v hribe in sanja, da bi še enkrat stal na vrhu Triglava. Pri reševanju vprašanj mu bo stal ob strani dolgoletni prijatelj Andrej Rous, možnost dodatnega jokerja pa mu bo prinesel zdravnik in voditelj oddaje TV klinika David Zupančič.

programme.title: Videotrak
programme.desc: Videotrak is a video-music time zone of the urban Slovenian mainstream, which ranges from pop and rock, rap, rnb and electronics and all the way to metal and alternative. / Videotrak je video-glasbeni časovni pas urbanega slovenskega mainstreama, ki sega od popa in rocka, rapa, rnb-ja ter elektronike in vse tja do metala in alternative.

programme.title: Little Timotej: The Ice Moon, cartoon, Mon. / Mali Timotej: Ledena luna, risanka, pon.
programme.desc: I: Brelih Hatunić Žan (narrator), Mlakar Martin, Oblak Gal, Pavlin Ana (little Timotej); R: Maurič Lazar Martina... Little Timotej asks his whale friend to blow him all the way to the moon. But the whale blows too hard and little Timothy flies past the Moon all the way to Enceladus. This is Saturn's moon spewing high jets of icy water. / I: Brelih Hatunić Žan (pripovedovalec), Mlakar Martin, Oblak Gal, Pavlin Ana (mali Timotej); R: Maurič Lazar Martina... Mali Timotej prosi prijatelja kita, naj ga pihne vse do Lune. Toda kit pihne premočno in mali Timotej leti mimo Lune vse do Enkelada. To je Saturnova luna, ki brizga visoke curke ledene vode.

programme.title: Zog and the Flying Doctor, cartoon, Mon. / Zog in leteča zdravnika, risani film, pon.
programme.desc: I: Cavazza Sebastian, Derganc Maša, Fatur Mojca, Hočevar Janez, Lah Jaka, Slakonja Klemen, Tabaković Saša, Veselko Borut; R: Milčinski Nana... Queen Zala, Klativitez and the dragon Zog are an extremely unusual team of flying doctors. They are devoted to their profession and heal real and fairy-tale animals: a mermaid, a unicorn and a lion. When the king locks Zala in the castle, the queen must choose between escaping to freedom and treating her sick uncle. With the help of Zog and Klativitez, he finds the right medicine. The cartoon is based on a book proposal by writer Julie Donaldson and illustrator Axl Scheffler. / I: Cavazza Sebastian, Derganc Maša, Fatur Mojca, Hočevar Janez, Lah Jaka, Slakonja Klemen, Tabaković Saša, Veselko Borut; R: Milčinski Nana... Kraljična Zala, Klativitez in zmaj Zog so nadvse nenavadna ekipa letečih zdravnikov. Predani so svojemu poklicu in zdravijo resnične in pravljične živali: morsko deklico, samoroga in leva. Ko kralj zapre Zalo v grad, mora kraljična izbrati med begom na svobodo in zdravljenjem svojega bolnega strica. S pomočjo Zoga in Klativiteza najde pravo zdravilo. Risanka je posneta po knjižni predlogi pisateljice Julie Donaldson in ilustratorja Axla Schefflerja.

programme.title: Brina: Soldier, cartoon, Mon. / Brina: Vojaka, risanka, pon.
programme.desc: I: Bučevec Lana (Kalipso), Derganc Maša (mother (Cili)), Hribar Škrlec Lena (Binka), Saša Mihelčič (Kati, Jakčev's mother), Mihevc Lea (Jakčev's sister (Lulu)), Slakonja Klemen (eyes (Beno)), Slapar Vesna (Jakec Žverca), Smolej Uroš (Jakčev's eyes), Zupančič Jana (Bri; R: Milčinski Nana... A new classmate Jakec enters the class. The first day of school is very exciting for him. Jakec has a mole in his ass, has trouble remembering things and keeps forgetting his hat. They make friends with Rjavko, who plays soldier. He also attracts Jakc to the game. After hard training in military skills, Jakec becomes a proud recruit of Žverc. / I: Bučevec Lana (Kalipso), Derganc Maša (mami (Cili)), Hribar Škrlec Lena (Binka), Mihelčič Saša (Kati, Jakčeva mami), Mihevc Lea (Jakčeva sestra (Lulu)), Slakonja Klemen (oči (Beno)), Slapar Vesna (Jakec Žverca), Smolej Uroš (Jakčev oči), Zupančič Jana (Bri; R: Milčinski Nana... V razred pride nov sošolec Jakec. Prvi šolski dan je zanj zelo razburljiv. Jakec ima mevlje v ritki, težko si kaj zapomni in ves čas pozablja klobuk. Spoprijateljita se z Rjavkom, ki se igra vojaka. K igri pritegne še Jakca. Po napornem urjenju vojaških veščin Jakec postane ponosni rekrut Žverca.

programme.title: Bear Hunt, cartoon, Mon. / Lov na medveda, risani film, pon.
programme.desc: I: Hribar Škrlec Lena, Fatur Mojca, Rozman Nika, Lah Jaka, Mihelčič Saša, Murenc Andrej, Brecelj Marijana, Hočevar Janez, Bezlaj Milčinski Tibor; R: Milčinski Nana... When five children go on an unusual adventure, to hunt a bear, they encounter many unexpected obstacles. They face challenges and make their way through tall thick grass, over sticky mud, through a dark forest and a swirling blizzard. While exploring a narrow, dark cave, little sister Roza and her dog Rufus take a different route than the rest of the children and come face to face with a bear. At first they are scared, but Roza soon realizes that the bear is just too cold and lonely and needs a friend. But just when Roza and the bear become attached to each other, she is found by other children who do not know that the bear is friendly. They drag her away and race back through the countryside, the bear hot on their heels. Once they are safely back at home, the children tell their incredulous parents and grandmother what happened to them. In the evening they throw a party, but Roza cannot forget the poor bear who had to return to his dark cave alone. / I: Hribar Škrlec Lena, Fatur Mojca, Rozman Nika, Lah Jaka, Mihelčič Saša, Murenc Andrej, Brecelj Marijana, Hočevar Janez, Bezlaj Milčinski Tibor; R: Milčinski Nana... Ko se pet otrok odpravi na nenavadno pustolovščino, na lov na medveda, se srečajo z mnogimi nepričakovanimi ovirami. Soočijo se z izzivi in se podajo skozi visoko gosto travo, čez lepljivo blato, skozi mračen gozd in vrtinčast snežni metež. Ko raziskujejo ozko temačno votlino, sestrica Roza in njen pes Rufus ubereta drugo pot kot ostali otroci in se srečata iz oči v oči z medvedom. Sprva se prestrašita, a Roza kmalu ugotovi, da je medved samo prezebel in osamljen in potrebuje prijatelja. A ravno ko se Roza in medved navežeta drug na drugega, jo najdejo drugi otroci, ki ne vejo, da je medved prijazen. Odvlečejo jo stran in dirjajo nazaj skozi podeželje, medved pa jim sledi takoj za petami. Ko so spet na varnem doma, otroci povejo svojim nejevernim staršem in babici, kaj se jim je pripetilo. Zvečer priredijo zabavo, a Roza ne more pozabiti ubogega medveda, ki se je moral osamljen vrniti v svojo temačno votlino.

programme.title: Pure Boredom Wednesday, a holiday show for kids / Čisti dolgčas v sredo, počitniška oddaja za otroke
programme.desc: When Nik and Mara Lina get down to fruit salad, nothing is as simple as it seems! The inspiration for the fruit salad this time was sent by Eva, and things escalate in the studio - secret ingredients, closed eyes and unusual combinations make for a lot of laughs. Tina Vrbnjak also appears in the show, and she tells which fruit evokes the best holiday memory from her childhood! / Ko se Nik in Mara Lina lotita sadne solate, ni nič tako preprosto, kot se zdi! Navdih za sadno solato je tokrat poslala Eva, v studiu pa se stvar stopnjuje – skrivne sestavine, zaprte oči in nenavadne kombinacije poskrbijo za veliko smeha. V oddaji se oglasi tudi Tina Vrbnjak, ki pove, katero sadje pri njej prebudi najlepši počitniški spomin iz otroštva!

programme.title: Kozmo (I., II.): Kidnapping, Belgian children's series / Kozmo (I., II.): Ugrabitev, belgijska otroška nanizanka
programme.desc: I: Coppejans Remco (Robbe), Huysentruyt Bert (Markus), Janssens Maxine (Ellis), Stocker Marit (Esther); R: Temmermans Matthias, Van Leemputten Bart... Cosmos I. and II.; Ellis's aunt Paula's cat has been kidnapped and is now demanding a ransom for it. Robbe, Ellis and Kozmo investigate the case and find out that not only Paula's cat has been kidnapped, but other animals as well. Will they be able to stop the kidnappers? / I: Coppejans Remco (Robbe), Huysentruyt Bert (Markus), Janssens Maxine (Ellis), Stocker Marit (Esther); R: Temmermans Matthias, Van Leemputten Bart... Kosmo I. and Ii.; Ellisini teti Pauli je nekdo ugrabil mačko in zdaj zanjo zahteva odkupnino. Robbe, Ellis in Kozmo raziščejo primer in ugotovijo, da ni bila ugrabljena samo Paulina mačka, temveč tudi druge živali. Jim bo uspelo ustaviti ugrabitelje?

programme.title: Challengers, EBU documentary film: Firefighter Ana, a documentary film for young people / Izzivalci, EBU dokumentarni film: Gasilka Ana, dokumentarni film za mlade
programme.desc: Own Production; Challenger Ana from Slovenia is twelve years old and has been a firefighter since the age of seven. This year, however, something is completely new for Ana: she moved to a higher category. She is no longer a cadet, now she is a junior! This means she is competing with girls between the ages of twelve and sixteen. As a cadet, she was used to winning national firefighting competitions, but in the new team, she is not sure if they will even be able to make it from regional to national. They will compete in ten, namely in a firefighting competition with three trials. These are bucket drill, obstacle drill and commands. Ana is afraid that she will be the slowest in the team of older and more experienced girls. But at the same time, she deeply believes in herself - she knows that she can succeed if she practices enough. / Lastna Produkcija; Izzivalka Ana iz Slovenije je stara dvanajst let in je gasilka že od sedmega leta. Letos pa je za Ano nekaj čisto novo: preselila se je v višjo kategorijo. Ni več kadetinja, zdaj je mladinka! To pomeni, da tekmuje z dekleti, starimi od dvanajst do šestnajst let. Kot kadetinja je bila vajena zmagovati na državnih gasilskih tekmovanjih, v novi ekipi pa ni prepričana, ali se jim bo sploh uspelo prebiti z regijskega na državno. Tekmovale bodo v desetini, in sicer na gasilskem tekmovanju s tremi preizkušnjami. To so vaja z vedrovko, vaja z ovirami in povelje. Ana se boji, da bo prav ona najpočasnejša v ekipi starejših in izkušenejših deklet. A hkrati globoko verjame vase – ve, da ji lahko uspe, če bo dovolj vadila.

programme.title: Little Mama, French film, Mon. / Mala mama, francoski film, pon.
programme.sub-title: Petit Maman; A magical, tender and touching new children's and youth film by director Celine Sciamma, one of the most respected authors of contemporary European cinema: unusual, authorial, intimate and meditative, so that it really appeals to audiences of all generations. / Petit Maman; Čaroben, rahločuten in ganljiv novi otroško-mladinski film režiserke Celine Sciamma, ene najbolj cenjenih avtoric sodobnega evropskega filma: neobičajen, avtorski, intimen in meditativen, tako da v resnici nagovarja občinstvo vseh generacij.
programme.desc: An eight-year-old girl, Nelly, goes with her parents to the forest where her grandmother's house stands - her grandmother recently died and they have to clean up her things. While chasing boredom while exploring the house and nature, he meets a girl who looks just like him. They become attached to each other. The girl turns out to be her mother, who looked a lot like her when she was eight. It is not explained whether Nelly is just imagining all this. It is important that he deepens the bond with his mother and grandmother. Recommended age: 10+ Original title: PETITE MAMAN Year of production: 2021 Country: France Genre: drama Director: Celine Sciamma Screenplay: Celine Sciamma Starring: Josephine Sanz, Gabrielle Sanz, Nina Meurisse, Stephane Varupenne. / Osemletna deklica Nelly s starši odide v gozd, kjer stoji babičina hiša – babica je nedavno umrla in pospraviti morajo njene stvari. Medtem ko preganja dolgčas med raziskovanjem hiše in narave, sreča deklico, ki ji je na las podobna. Navežeta se druga na drugo. Izkaže se, da je deklica njena mama, ki ji je bila pri osmih letih zelo podobna. Ni pojasnjeno, ali si Nelly vse to zgolj domišlja. Važno je, da poglobi vez z mamo in babico.Priporočena starost: 10+Originalni naslov: PETITE MAMANLeto produkcije: 2021Država: FrancijaŽanr: dramaRežija: Celine SciammaScenarij: Celine SciammaIgrajo: Josephine Sanz, Gabrielle Sanz, Nina Meurisse, Stephane Varupenne.

programme.title: Kanape - Kanape, show for young people, Mon. / Kanape - Kanape, oddaja za mlade, pon.
programme.sub-title: Kanape/Kanape show is intended for young people. In it, we publish contributions about the life of young people in Prekmurje, conversations with representatives of the variety show. In the second half of the show, in the World of Music section, we play videos of Hungarian, world and Slovenian music / Oddaja Kanape/Kanape je namenjena mladim. V njej objavljamo prispevke o življenu mladih v Prekmurju, pogovori s predstavniki estrade. V drugi polovici oddaje, v rubriki Svet glasbe predvajamo videoposnetke madžarskih, svetovnih, pa tudi slovenskih glasb
programme.desc: The Kanape program is primarily aimed at young people and deals with topics that affect them. In it, we make reports with Hungarian, Kulfold and Slovenian musicians and singers, and in the Music World section we show music video clips. In the Fashion Corner, we present young Slovenian and Hungarian fashion designers. / A Kanape című műsor elsősorban a fiataloknak szol es az őket erintő temákkal foglalkozik. Benne magyar, kulfoldi es szloven egyuttesekkel, enekesekkel keszítunk riportokat, a Zenevilág című rovatban pedig zenes videoklipeket vetítunk. A Divatsarokban fiatal szloven es magyar divattervezőket mutatunk be.

programme.title: Good morning, Mon. / Dobro jutro, pon.
programme.desc: Mid-mornings begin with an overview of the daily press and the current topic, which we put in the center. In the column "Good morning, I have a problem!", together with the viewers, we overcome various dilemmas, and we offer advice on traffic minutes for all road users. We also take a look at what's new in the world of film and entertainment and give you suggestions for good books and interesting content broadcast on TV Slovenija, while the field team shares garden tips. Wednesday is also sports-themed, in the section "Š as a sport" we learn about unusual sports, host sports heroes and comment on and announce important sports events. A morning with us is a good morning! / Sredina jutra se pričnejo s pregledom dnevnega tiska in aktualne teme, ki jo postavljamo V središče. V rubriki »Dobro jutro, imam problem!« skupaj z gledalci premagujemo najrazličnejše zagate, za vse udeležence v prometu pa svetujemo v prometnih minutah. Pogledamo tudi, kaj je novega v svetu filma in zabave ter vam podamo predloge za dobre knjige in zanimive vsebine, ki se predvajajo na TV Slovenija, terenska ekipa pa deli vrtne nasvete. Sreda je tudi športno obarvana, v rubriki »Š kot šport« spoznavamo nenavadne športe, gostimo športne junake in komentiramo ter napovedujemo pomembne športne dogodke. Jutro z nami je dobro jutro!

programme.title: What's going on?: Neja Berger, Mon. / Kaj dogaja?: Neja Berger, pon.
programme.desc: Next week is a holiday, so just make time on Saturday for a new What's up? What are the hidden ingredients in pickles, where did the money for the windmills go and how is the Maribor electric train advertised? We will watch the educational tape - How to become a Ljubljanačan - which was recorded for tourists by Zoran Janković, and in the field we checked what kind of problems the writer Ivan Cankar has recently had in Vrhnika. In Super Hit of the Week, Robert Petan assures that he is not sick, and you can find out in our court whether you should ask your wife or ChatGPT for advice. In the telenovela Palomar, Ursula Von der Leyen and Emmanuel Macron meet in Ljubljana, and our guest will be artificial intelligence expert Neja Berger. The legendary Neca Fans is a guest on the Little Terrace, who will sing for us -Vsi ruška stramije-. / Naslednji teden so počitnice, zato si v soboto le vzemite čas za novi Kaj dogaja? Kaj so skrite sestavine v kumaricah, kam je šel denar za vetrnice in kako se oglaša mariborski električni vlakec? Ogledali si bomo učno kaseto -Kako postati Ljubljančan-, ki jo je za turiste posnel Zoran Janković, na terenu pa smo preverjali, kakšne težave ima zadnje čase na Vrhniki pisatelj Ivan Cankar. Robert Petan v Super hitu tedna zagotavlja, da ni bolan, na našem sodišču pa izveste, ali za nasvete raje prositi ženo ali ChatGPT. V telenoveli Palomar se v Ljubljani srečata Ursula Von der Leyen in Emmanuel Macron, naša gostja pa bo strokovnjakinja za umetno inteligenco Neja Berger. Na Mali terasi gostuje legendarna Neca Fans, ki nam bo zapela -Vsi ljudje strmijo-.

programme.title: About animals and people, educational-advisory show, Mon. / O živalih in ljudeh, izobraževalno–svetovalna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: We visited the Dog Activity Park in Limbus and, among other things, got to know the French Shepherd breed in more detail. We present the story of Luna the goat, who was lucky enough to be given to an understanding and loving family. We hung out with Tjaž Marinič, a veterinarian / Obiskali smo Park pasjih aktivnosti v Limbušu in med drugim podrobneje spoznali pasmo francoski ovčar. Predstavljamo zgodbo koze Lune, ki je imela to srečo, da so jo podarili v razumevajočo in ljubečo družino. Družili smo se s Tjažem Mariničem, veterina
programme.desc: ozivalih@rtvslo.si.

programme.title: People and Earth, educational-advisory show, Mon. / Ljudje in zemlja, izobraževalno–svetovalna oddaja, pon.
programme.desc: This year, the KGZ Novo mesto Technology Day was dedicated to conservation and precision agriculture. In the Beekeeping Center of Gorenjska, awards were given to the most successful honey producers. Maintaining mental health in the workplace is becoming an increasingly topical topic in agriculture as well. Help and support is provided free of charge by KGZS. At the Čož farm, we accompany the children who took part in the riding camp. In the section Organic+local= they ideally present organic apple production. / Dan tehnike KGZ Novo mesto so letos namenili ohranitvenemu in preciznemu kmetijstvu. V Čebelarskem centru Gorenjske so najuspešnejšim pridelovalcem medu podelili priznanja. Ohranjanje duševnega zdravja na delovnem mestu postaja vse bolj aktualna tema tudi v kmetijstvu. Pomoč in podporo brezplačno omogoča KGZS. Na kmetiji Čož spremljamo otroke, ki so se udeležili jahalnega tabora. V rubriki Ekološko+lokalno= idealno predstavljajo ekološko pridelavo jabolk.

programme.title: The path to green: The roots of the future, educational documentary film, Mon. / Pot v zeleno: Korenine prihodnosti, izobraževalno-dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.desc: Climate change and the depletion of natural resources force us to look for new ways of producing food that are more environmentally friendly and, if possible, healthier. The answer to the question of what we will eat tomorrow is even more important in light of the uncertain political situation in the world. Slovenia is insufficiently self-sufficient in food, many farms are collapsing, it seems as if no one wants to work from dawn to dusk anymore and that it is impossible to make a living by growing food. Is it really so? On the hill farms of the Poljanska dolina, young buyers are proving that it is possible to make a living and make money, be it by processing milk, growing organic vegetables, growing raspberries, baking homemade cookies or cooking an old home remedy. / Podnebne spremembe in izčrpanost naravnih virov nas silijo v iskanje novih načinov pridelave hrane, bolj prijaznih do okolja in po možnosti seveda bolj zdravih. Odgovor na vprašanje kaj bomo jedli jutri je še toliko bolj pomemben v luči negotovih političnih razmer v svetu. Slovenija je premalo prehransko samozadostna, veliko kmetij propada, zdi se, kot da nihče več noče delati od zore do mraka in da se s pridelovanjem hrane ne da preživeti. Pa je res tako? Na hribovskih kmetijah Poljanske doline mladi prevzemniki dokazujejo, da se da preživeti in zaslužiti, pa naj bo s predelavo mleka, pridelovanjem ekološke zelenjave, vzgojo malin, peko domačih piškotov ali s kuhanjem starega domačega zdravila.

programme.title: FEATURED: The End of the Sahara, Said Khatibi, Book Show, Mon. / IzBRANO: Konec Sahare, Said Khatibi, oddaja o knjigah, pon.
programme.desc: Writer and journalist Said Khatibi has been living and creating in Slovenia for a long time. The crime novel Konec Sahara is his first work translated into Slovenian. The book is set one month before Black October in 1988 in a city in the south of Algeria, but this is far from just a novel about the murder of the hotel singer Zakia, as the writer skilfully uses genre literature for social criticism. So skillfully, that in 2025 the work was nominated for the prestigious French literary award Grand Prix for crime and detective novels. / Pisatelj in novinar Said Khatibi že dlje časa živi in ustvarja v Sloveniji. Kriminalni roman Konec Sahare je njegovo prvo delo prevedeno v slovenščino. Dogajalni čas knjige je postavljen mesec dni pred Črnim oktobrom leta 1988 v mestu na jugu Alžiriji, a to še zdaleč ni samo roman o umoru hotelske pevke Zakije, saj pisatelj žanrsko literaturo spretno uporabi za družbeno kritiko. Tako spretno, da je bilo delo leta 2025 nominirano za prestižno francosko literarno nagrado Grand Prix za kriminalne in detektivske romane.

programme.title: Compatriots, a show about Slovenians abroad and around the world, Mon. / Rojaki, oddaja o Slovencih v zamejstvu in po svetu, pon.
programme.desc: The show "Compatriots" is a bridge between the homeland and Slovenians who live outside its borders. Song, literature, folklore and many other forms of expression keep the Slovenian word and tradition alive. Slovenia lives on also thanks to new economic connections, research and tourism initiatives and exceptional individuals who enrich our common space. These are all compatriots, get to know them together with us. / Oddaja »Rojaki« je most med domovino in Slovenci, ki živijo zunaj njenih meja. Pesem, literatura, folklora in številne druge oblike izražanja ohranjajo živo slovensko besedo in tradicijo. Slovenstvo živi naprej tudi po zaslugi novih gospodarskih povezovanj, raziskovalnih in turističnih pobud ter izjemnih posameznikov, ki bogatijo naš skupen prostor. Vse to so Rojaki, spoznajte jih skupaj z nami.

programme.title: Opus: 80 years of the Society of Slovenian Composers, Mon. / Opus: 80 let Društva slovenskih skladateljev, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Amir Muratović... The Society of Slovenian Composers is celebrating its 80th anniversary this year. The celebration of this jubilee takes place throughout the concert season with numerous performances of Slovenian works. It is divided into different cycles, which include the Concert Studio as one of them / R: Amir Muratović... Društvo slovenskih skladateljev letos praznuje 80-letnico. Praznovanje tega jubileja poteka vso koncertno sezono s številnimi izvedbami slovenskih del. Razdeljeno je na različne cikle, med katere spadajo Koncertni atelje kot ena od
programme.desc: In the show, we asked composers and performers questions about what the society's role is today, how they see its mission as a client of new compositions, a promoter and a publisher of music releases. We also discussed whether artificial intelligence can displace creativity, which was discussed at the general assembly of the umbrella association of composers. The screenwriter and editor of the show is Darja Korez Korenčan. / V oddaji smo skladateljem in izvajalcem zastavili vprašanja o tem, kakšna je vloga društva danes, kako vidijo njegovo poslanstvo naročnika novih skladb, promotorja in založnika notnih izdaj. Pogovarjali pa smo se tudi, ali lahko umetna inteligenca izpodrine ustvarjalnost, o čemer je med drugim tekla beseda na generalni skupščini krovnega združenja skladateljev.Scenaristka in urednica oddaje je Darja Korez Korenčan.

programme.title: Table Tennis - World Series, live from Montpellier / Namizni tenis - svetovna serija, v živo iz Montpelliera
Environments, pon. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambiences; Every corner of our beautiful Slovenia has its own character - nature that sets it apart from others, and architecture that tells the story of the place. Our ancestors built houses from materials provided by the environment and designed them in accordance with the climate: / Ambienti; Vsak kotiček naše prelepe Slovenije nosi svoj značaj - naravo, ki ga loči od drugih, in arhitekturo, ki pripoveduje zgodbo prostora. Naši predniki so hiše gradili iz materialov, ki jih je nudilo okolje, ter jih oblikovali skladno s podnebjem:
programme.desc: Wood is not just a building material - it is warmth that accompanies us at every step. We use it to build houses, even high-rise buildings, and for small objects that make everyday life more pleasant. On the Bloška plateau, we met a master who knows how to listen to wood and create almost everything from it - from simple wooden spoons to furniture and log cabins. Together with his partner, he created a real wooden paradise, in which there is also an almost fairy-tale shepherd's hut. Gardens often impress with the luxury of colors, but those where green dominates require more observation - and offer a different, quiet beauty. We visited the garden in late spring, where the delicate shades of seasonal flowers only shyly complemented the rich greenery. Despite the absence of a color explosion, we were charmed by its sophisticated, enduring appeal. / Les ni le gradbeni material - je toplina, ki nas spremlja na vsakem koraku. Uporabljamo ga za gradnjo hiš, celo stolpnic, in za drobne predmete, ki vsakdan naredijo prijetnejši. Na Bloški planoti smo srečali mojstra, ki zna prisluhniti lesu in iz njega ustvariti skoraj vse - od preprostih lesenih žlic do pohištva in brunaric. Skupaj s partnerko sta ustvarila pravi leseni raj, v katerem stoji tudi skoraj pravljična pastirska koča.Vrtovi pogosto navdušijo z razkošjem barv, a tisti, kjer prevladuje zelena, zahtevajo več opazovanja – in ponujajo drugačno, tiho lepoto. Obiskali smo vrt v poznem pomladnem času, kjer so nežni odtenki sezonskega cvetja le sramežljivo dopolnjevali bogato zelenje. Kljub odsotnosti barvne eksplozije nas je očarala njegova prefinjena, trajna privlačnost.

programme.title: Automotive: Electric long-track, electric roadster and new Chinese brands in Slovenia, Mon. / Avtomobilnost: Električni dolgoprogaš, električni roadster in novi kitajski znamki v Sloveniji, pon.
programme.sub-title: We are starting the new season of Automotive with an electric long-track: the Mercedes CLA. It's long-distance because it's optimized for highway driving and because it charges quickly - it's a car that covered the distance from Trondheim to Constantinople in one day. / Novo sezono Avtomobilnosti začenjamo z električnim dolgoprogašem: mercedesom CLA. Dolgoprogaš je zato, ker je optimiziran za avtocestne vožnje in ker se hitro polni - to je avto, ki je v enem dnevu prevozil razdaljo od Trondheima do Carigrada.
programme.desc: We hope with two new Chinese brands in Slovenia. Jaecoo and Omoda are part of Cherry. They bring five-star safety according to Euro NCAP, hybrid technology for 1,200 kilometers of autonomy, and above all, the cooperation of humanoid robots - instead of people - salespeople at the points of sale/. The icing on the cake is the electric roadster. It sounds like a wrong world, but what was once sacred to car enthusiasts has entered the new cyber world. According to this experience of ours, we say that we can have a reason for joy, but not for sadness. / Nadajujemo z dvema novima kitajskima znamkama v Sloveniji. Jaecoo in Omoda sta del skupine Cherry. Prinašata petzvezdično varnost po Euro NCAP-u, hibridno tehniko za 1200 kilometrov avtonomije, predvsem pa sodelovanje humanoidnih robotov -namesto ljudi - prodajalcev na prodajnih mestih/.Pika na i pa je električni roadster. Sliši se kot narobe svet, a v novi kibernetični svet je vstopilo še tisto, kar je bilo nekoč ljubiteljem avtomobilom sveto. Po tej naši izkušnji pravimo, da imamo lahko razlog za veselje, ne pa za žalost.

programme.title: Lottery draw / Žrebanje Lota
programme.desc: Lotto is the most popular game of chance in Slovenia, as more than 860,000 Slovenians of legal age play it. The presenter takes us through the Lotto and Lotto plus draws, and in addition to the results of both draws, we also look at the current winnings of the Joker game. / Loto je najbolj priljubljena igra na srečo v Sloveniji, saj jo igra več kot 860 tisoč polnoletnih Slovencev. Voditeljica nas popelje skozi žrebanje Lota in Lota plus, poleg rezultatov obeh žrebanj pa si ogledamo tudi aktualne dobitke igre Joker.

programme.title: Orchestra (I.), Danish serial, 5/10, Mon. / Orkester (I.), danska nadaljevanka, 5/10, pon.
programme.sub-title: Orkestret (i.) / The Orchestra (i.); Jeppe wants to attract his wife's attention by building a bookcase, but he is not doing very well. / Orkestret (i.) / The Orchestra (i.); Jeppe želi pritegniti ženino pozornost z izdelavo regala, kar pa mu ne gre najbolje od rok.
programme.desc: Elin, Bo's student, auditions for a job in a symphony orchestra in the north of Denmark. When Bo learns that Simon's student will also attend the audition, he reluctantly decides to accompany Elin to Aalborg. Elin is more and more fascinated by Bo. On trips in a small car, they become even closer. ORKESTRET / The Orchestra / Denmark / 2022 Screenplay (idea Adam Price): Mikkel Munch-Fals, Soren Felbo, Anna JuulDirector: Mikkel Munch-FalsStarring: Frederik Cilius Jorgensen, Rasmus Bruun, Neel Ronholt, Caspar Phillipson, Emma Sehested Hoeg, Ina-Miriam Rosenbaum. / Elin, Bojeva učenka, se prijavi na avdicijo za službo v simfoničnem orkestru na severu Danske. Ko Bo izve, da se bo avdicije udeležil tudi Simonov učenec, se na vrat na nos odloči, da bo spremljal Elin v Aalborg. Elin je nad Bojem vse bolj očarana. Na potovanj z majhnim avtomobilom se še bolj zbližata. ORKESTRET / The Orchestra / Danska / 2022Scenarij (ideja Adam Price): Mikkel Munch-Fals, Soren Felbo, Anna JuulRežija: Mikkel Munch-FalsV glavnih vlogah: Frederik Cilius Jorgensen, Rasmus Bruun, Neel Ronholt, Caspar Phillipson, Emma Sehested Hoeg, Ina-Miriam Rosenbaum.

programme.title: Different Gods, Same Hell, Documentary, Mon. / Različni bogovi, isti pekel, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.desc: R: Valenčič Erik... Europe and Africa are much more connected than it might seem at first glance. Between them is only the Mediterranean Sea, and the Strait of Gibraltar is less than twenty kilometers wide. If we call the Eastern Arab world the Middle East in Europe, we should call the African continent the Middle South. Indeed, the stability of Europe also depends on its stability, but despite this, we know and understand very little about what is happening in Africa beyond the stereotypes that date back to colonialism and are essentially racist. And if we want to see what awaits Europe in the future, we need to know what is happening in Africa today. After all, everything in this world is connected. Natural borders, walls and fences do not separate us, because common global challenges connect us. Either we will find solutions to these problems together or we will fail together, but until the end, whatever that may be, we will live together - because we are one humanity. The documentary show Different Gods, Same Hell focuses on the situation in West Africa. In 1975, the Economic Community of West African States, with the English abbreviation ECOWAS, was founded. Its members are Nigeria, Togo, Benin, Ghana, Cote d'Ivoire, Liberia, Sierra Leone, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Gambia, Senegal, Niger, Burkina Faso, Mali and Cape Verde. The stability of the area is undermined by civil wars or inter-ethnic conflicts, extremism, terrorism, cross-border crime, human trafficking, poverty and the consequences of climate change. In 1999, members of the community began to connect to an early warning and response system. This is based on the exchange of information about common threats that individual members of the community cannot deal with alone. Filmed in Senegal, Liberia and Nigeria, the show documents the operation of this system. Iztok Hočevar from the Slovenian organization for strengthening human security, the International Trust Fund, also participated in its installation. / R: Valenčič Erik... Evropa in Afrika sta mnogo bolj povezani, kot se morda zdi na prvi pogled. Med njima je le Sredozemsko morje, Gibraltarska ožina pa je široka manj kot dvajset kilometrov. Če vzhodnemu arabskemu svetu v Evropi pravimo Bližnji vzhod, bi morali afriški celini reči Bližnji jug. Od njene stabilnosti je namreč odvisna tudi stabilnost Evrope, a kljub temu o dogajanju v Afriki onkraj stereotipnih predstav, ki izvirajo še iz časa kolonializma in so v svojem bistvu rasistične, vemo in razumemo zelo malo. In če želimo uvideti, kaj čaka Evropo v prihodnosti, moramo vedeti, kaj se v Afriki dogaja danes. Navsezadnje je na tem svetu vse povezano. Naravne meje, zidovi in ograje nas ne ločujejo, kajti povezujejo nas skupni globalni izzivi. Ali bomo rešitve za te težave našli skupaj ali pa bomo skupaj propadli, vendar bomo do konca, kakršenkoli ta že bo, živeli skupaj – ker smo eno človeštvo. Dokumentarna oddaja Različni bogovi, isti pekel se posveča razmeram v Zahodni Afriki. Leta 1975 je bila ustanovljena Gospodarska skupnost zahodnoafriških držav, z angleško kratico ECOWAS. Njene članice so Nigerija, Togo, Benin, Gana, Slonokoščena obala, Liberija, Sierra Leone, Gvineja, Gvineja Bissau, Gambija, Senegal, Niger, Burkina Faso, Mali in Zelenortski otoki. Stabilnost območja spodkopavajo državljanske vojne oziroma medetnični spopadi, ekstremizmi, terorizem, čezmejni kriminal, trgovina z ljudmi, revščina in posledice podnebnih sprememb. Leta 1999 so se začele članice skupnosti povezovati v sistem za zgodnje opozarjanje in odzivanje. Ta temelji na izmenjavi podatkov o skupnih grožnjah, s katerimi se posamične članice skupnosti ne morejo spoprijeti same. Oddaja, posneta v Senegalu, Liberiji in Nigeriji, dokumentira delovanje tega sistema. Pri njegovem postavljanju je sodeloval tudi Iztok Hočevar iz slovenske organizacije za krepitev človekove varnosti International Trust Fund.

programme.desc: Musical space dedicated to the Blues. / Espai musical dedicat al Blues.

programme.title: Jazz a lestudi
programme.desc: Space that deals a dull blow to the panorama of jazz and its variants in Catalonia. One of the key elements of this musical program is that it allows you to see artists such as Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador and Horacio Fumero in their natural areas: the recording studios. / Espai que fa un cop dull al panorama del jazz i les seves variants a Catalunya. Un dels elements clau daquest programa musical es que permet veure artistes com Dani Nel·lo, Raimundo Amador i Horacio Fumero en el seus àmbits naturals: els estudis de gravacio.

programme.title: Videoclips catalans
programme.desc: TVC dedicates a daily space in its programming to the release of video clips of Catalan soloists and musical groups. They include all kinds of styles, be it blues, rock or original song, and in many cases they are audiovisual productions made by the same chain. / TVC dedica un espai diari de la seva programacio a lemissio de videoclips de solistes i grups musicals catalans. Sinclouen tota mena destils, sigui blues, rock o canço dautor, i en molts casos son produccions audiovisuals realitzades per la mateixa cadena.

programme.title: News 3CatInfo / Notícies 3CatInfo
programme.desc: Information space with news, general information, sports and weather forecast. / Espai informatiu amb notícies dinformacio general, esportiva i previsio meteorològica.

programme.title: Matins
programme.desc: Morning program that gives the keys to the day that begins, explains the news that has happened by providing the context to understand them and analyzes with accredited voices the current affairs nearest and beyond the world. / Programa matinal que dona les claus del dia que comença, explica les notícies que han passat aportant-ne el context per entendre-les i analitza amb veus acreditades lactualitat mes propera i la darreu del mon.

programme.title: Everything is soft / Tot es mou
programme.desc: Helena Garcia Melero runs this daily magazine that follows current affairs, gives voice to the protagonists of the moment and deals with those issues that most closely affect the citizens with a friendly and distracted tone. / Helena Garcia Melero condueix aquest magazín diari que segueix lactualitat, dona veu als protagonistes del moment i tracta aquelles questions que toquen mes de prop els ciutadans amb un to amable i distret.

programme.title: Telenotícies comarques
programme.desc: Daily news, directed and presented by Núria Sole, with local and regional information that highlights the voice of the street, the witnesses and the protagonists of the news. TN Comarques explains and reflects the reality of towns and cities in Catalonia. / Informatiu diari, dirigit i presentat per Núria Sole, amb informacio local i comarcal que posa en valor la veu del carrer, els testimonis i els protagonistes de la notícia. TN Comarques explica i reflecteix la realitat dels pobles i ciutats de Catalunya.

programme.title: Telenotícies migdia
programme.desc: Daily news that includes the most outstanding current events, collected by TVC's news services, with the support of chronicles and connections with correspondents and special envoys around the world. / Informatiu diari que inclou els esdeveniments mes destacats de lactualitat, recollits pels serveis informatius de TVC, amb el suport de les cròniques i les connexions amb els corresponsals i enviats especials arreu del mon.

programme.title: Cuines
programme.desc: Space where chef Marc Ribas offers recipes that anyone can make and with easy-to-find ingredients. In addition, the program has the advice section in which Ribas explains curiosities about the products and tricks to know how to buy better. / Espai en el qual el cuiner Marc Ribas ofereix receptes que tothom pot fer i amb ingredients fàcils de trobar. A mes, el programa compta amb la seccio el consell en la que Ribas explica curiositats dels productes i trucs per saber comprar millor.

programme.title: Cuines
programme.desc: Space where chef Marc Ribas offers recipes that anyone can make and with easy-to-find ingredients. In addition, the program has the advice section in which Ribas explains curiosities about the products and tricks to know how to buy better. / Espai en el qual el cuiner Marc Ribas ofereix receptes que tothom pot fer i amb ingredients fàcils de trobar. A mes, el programa compta amb la seccio el consell en la que Ribas explica curiositats dels productes i trucs per saber comprar millor.

programme.title: Like it was yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of former high school classmates meet again, after twenty-five years, at the funeral of one of them. The time at the high school turned them into a heterogeneous group, hooligans and full of life, but life dealt them very different cards. TV3's new bet on the table, after the end of La Riera, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday takes place in Barcelona and the protagonists live spread over the entire geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d'ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present an everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even funny. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Ladies' paradise / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Betrayed by her boyfriend, Teresa leaves the village and flees to the big city. There he discovers that his uncle's store is going through difficulties due to the opening of a large warehouse El Paradís de les Senyores. / Traïda pel seu xicot, Teresa sen va de poble i fuig a la gran ciutat. Allà descobreix que la botiga del seu oncle passa per dificultats a causa de lobertura duns grans magatzems El Paradís de les Senyores.

programme.title: The jungle: Episode 35 / La selva: Episodi 35
programme.desc: Xavier Grasset presents this afternoon magazine in which the current affairs of the day are reviewed in a relaxed way. A meeting full of knowledge and follow-up of the events of the day, but also with a lot of entertainment and with various collaborators. / Xavier Grasset presenta aquest magazín de tardes en el que es fa un repàs a lactualitat del dia de forma distesa. Una trobada plena de coneixement i seguiment dels fets del dia, però tambe amb molt dentreteniment i amb diversos col·laboradors.

programme.title: Atrapam si pots: Episode 189 / Atrapam si pots: Episodi 189
programme.desc: Llucià Ferrer presents this question and answer contest in which six contestants compete to win the pot. The questions cover the whole field of knowledge, focus on trivia and make use of word games and riddles. / Llucià Ferrer presenta aquest concurs de preguntes i respostes en què sis concursants competeixen per guanyar el pot. Les preguntes abasten tot el camp del coneixement, se centren en curiositats i fan ús de jocs de paraules i endevinalles.

programme.title: It's Happening: Episode 35 / Està passant: Episodi 35
programme.desc: Satirical news presented by Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre and Queco Novell, which analyzes the keys to the current affairs of the day. Lespai also gives voice to experts to give their opinion on current events and interview its main protagonists. / Informatiu satíric presentat per Òscar Andreu, Jair Dominguez, Natza Farre i Queco Novell, que analitza les claus de lactualitat del dia. Lespai tambe dona veu a experts perquè donin la seva opinio sobre lactualitat i entrevista els seus principals protagonistes.

programme.title: Telenotícies vespre
programme.desc: Daily information that collects the most outstanding events in the Catalan, national and international sphere. From Monday to Friday, Toni Cruanyes is in charge of presenting the news of the day. / Informatiu diari que recull els esdeveniments mes destacats en làmbit català, estatal i internacional. De dilluns a divendres, Toni Cruanyes es lencarregat de presentar les notícies de la jornada.

programme.title: Aixafa lestafa: Criptomoneda
programme.desc: Una criptomoneda hiperactiva ens promet la riquesa eterna.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Paco crashes his car after drinking too much at a party, thinking he can still hook up with a young girl. Also, his friend Genís, a Tinder scammer, has his wife steal all the savings from the marriage. / Paco sestimba amb el cotxe despres de beure en exces en una festa, pensant-se que encara pot lligar amb una noia jove. A mes, al seu amic Genís, un estafador del Tinder, li roba la dona tots els estalvis del matrimoni.

programme.title: In the car: Episode 5 / Al cotxe: Episodi 5
programme.desc: Comedian and screenwriter Òscar Andreu has become an activist for the Catalan language and explains it in a hilarious monologue that starts from his linguistic biography. Spanish-speaking Dorígens, Andreu gets in the car! and explains his experiences. / Lhumorista i guionista Òscar Andreu sha convertit en un activista per la llengua catalana i ho explica en un monòleg hilarant que parteix de la seva biografia linguística. Dorígens castellanoparlants, Andreu puja Al cotxe! i explica les seves experiències.

programme.title: Mesnit
programme.desc: Informative space with Marina Romero at the head, which has the will to be a center for debating ideas and analyzing political activity. / Espai informatiu amb Marina Romero al capdavant que te la voluntat de ser un centre de debat didees i danàlisi de lactivitat política.

programme.title: Like it was yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of former high school classmates meet again, after twenty-five years, at the funeral of one of them. The time at the high school turned them into a heterogeneous group, hooligans and full of life, but life dealt them very different cards. TV3's new bet on the table, after the end of La Riera, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday takes place in Barcelona and the protagonists live spread over the entire geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d'ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present an everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even funny. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Spanish Climbing CupPotes - Final block / Copa de España de EscaladaPotes - Final bloque
programme.desc: Sport climbing is increasingly popular thanks to the Olympic push. The Spanish Cup of speed and bouldering modalities visits three cities. programme.title: Copa Iberdrola de boxeoFinales

programme.desc: In Sodertalje, the police go out to a wild party and take care of an aggressive man. An illegal street race is stopped in Jonkoping. programme.title: Caught on police camera / Fångat på polisens kamera
programme.desc: The historic helicopter robbery shakes Stockholm and the robbers escape with 39 million. programme.desc: Don Vito Corleone is the head of the Sicilian mafia family that controls organized crime in New York. programme.desc: Tobbe works at the cafe where he both bakes and takes care of customers. Linda and Sofie surprise Sofia with a luxurious mohippa. programme.title: Renoveringsdrommar
programme.desc: At the train station, Anny receives disturbing news. At the manor, Christian has big problems with the roof and on Öland, Anders helps when Bjorn and Andrea have to get a staircase in place in the mill. / Anny på tågstationen får orovackande nyheter. På herrgården har Christian stora problem med taket och på Öland hjalper Anders till nar Bjorn och Andrea ska få en trappa på plats i kvarnen.

programme.title: Renoveringsdrommar
programme.desc: We support a couple who set out to renovate an old house in Bengtsfors. On Öland, a terrace is being built on the mill and on the manor the renovation, to say the least, continues. / Vi moter ett par som givit sig på att renovera ett odehus i Bengtsfors. På Öland byggs en terrass på kvarnen och på herrgården fortsatter den minst sagt komplicerade renoveringen.

programme.title: Jeopardy!
programme.desc: Christmas master Peder Lamm is back to defend the title! Babben Larsson is hoping for luck from his Christmas goat, and Erik Ekstrand thinks his twisted Christmas tree will bring him the win. / Julmastaren Peder Lamm ar tillbaka for att forsvara titeln! Babben Larsson hoppas på tur från sin julbock, och Erik Ekstrand tror att hans snodda julgran ska ge honom vinsten.

programme.title: Den italienska husdrommen
programme.desc: Construction is probably in full swing at Bill and Marie's house in Sambuca di Sicilia. But they have grossly exceeded the budget and now they have to compromise. The floors will be fixed in a different way than what they thought and Bill will start building a sofa all by himself. / Det ar antligen full fart på bygget i Bill och Maries hus i Sambuca di Sicilia. Men de har dragit over budgeten rejalt och nu måste de kompromissa. Golven kommer att laggas på ett annat satt an vad de tankt och Bill borjar bygga en soffa alldeles sjalv.

programme.title: Gransbevakarna Sverige
programme.desc: A wanted person is stopped at Arlanda and in the check Markus finds large amounts of cash. Lisa has to struggle with patience when a Chinese woman without valid documents refuses to cooperate. / En efterlyst stoppas på Arlanda och i kontrollen hittar Markus stora mangder kontanter. Lisa får kampa med tålamodet nar en kinesisk kvinna utan giltiga handlingar vagrar samarbeta.

programme.title: Vagens hjaltar
programme.desc: A truck driver passes out and crashes on the E4 north of Stockholm. The bargeman Peter is the first on the scene and takes care of the driver until the ambulance arrives. / En lastbilschauffor svimmar av och kraschar på E4:an norr om Stockholm. Bargaren Peter ar forst på plats och tar hand om chaufforen tills ambulansen kommer.

programme.title: Gransbevakarna Sverige
programme.desc: The neighborhood police Lina stops a man from leaving the country. He is suspected of attempted murder. Claes deals with an angry and sad man who has just been dumped. / Granspolisen Lina stoppar en man från att lamna landet. Han ar misstankt for mordforsok. Claes hanterar en arg och ledsen man som precis har blivit dumpad.

programme.title: Kompani Svan
programme.desc: The aspirants' endurance and will are subjected to their toughest test yet when the pressure increases. A nerve-wracking rescue effort in total darkness takes mitts - giving courage, focus and sharp determination to those who risk ending up under the red line. / Aspiranternas uthållighet och vilja utsatts for sin tuffaste provning hittills nar pressen okar. En nervkittlande raddningsinsats i totalt morker vantar – dar mod, fokus och skarpa avgor vem som riskerar att hamna under det roda strecket.

programme.title: Across the Atlantic / Över Atlanten
programme.desc: Gurra knows that many people are starting to take safety on board too lightly. In addition, an ovader threatens further up the road towards Saint Martin. / Gurra kanner att många borjar ta for lattvindigt på sakerheten ombord. Dessutom hotar ett ovader langre fram på vagen mot Saint Martin.

programme.desc: Joachim investigates a man who is trying to smuggle gold worth more than a million kroner, while Claes and Markus deal with a rebellious woman who they suspect may be under the influence of drugs. / Joachim utreder en man som forsoker fora ut guld vart mer an en miljon kronor, medan Claes och Markus omhandertar en upprord kvinna, som de misstanker kan vara påverkad av narkotika.

programme.desc: In Jeopardy, Emma Molin maximizes her versatility, Markus Granseth turns up the pace and Johanna Swanberg lasers the clues ice-cold. programme.title: Kompani Svan
programme.desc: In a shooting practice, everything depends on focus and control. After that, a lonely night in the Warmland forest is needed, where everyone must build their own bivouac and manage on their own. Will the silence be a welcome rest or a pure nightmare? / I en skjutovning hanger allt på fokus och kontroll. Darefter vantar en ensam natt i den varmlandska skogen, dar var och en måste bygga sin egen bivack och klara sig på egen hand. Blir tystnaden en valkommen vila eller en ren mardrom?

Jakten mot checkpointen blir tightare an någonsin.

programme.desc: Thomas investigates a suspicious death where a soldier died during a military robbery. Was he exposed to lethal gas? / Thomas utreder ett misstankt dodsfall dar en soldat dott under en militarovning. Blev han utsatt for dodlig gas?

Logan vidtar ovanliga åtgarder for att vinna tillbaka Rory, och tidningspersonalen gor uppror mot Paris terrorvalde på Yale Daily News. Samtidigt intraffar vinterkarnevalen, och Lorelai och Rory har ett stånd med sin hund, Paul Anka, som spåman.

programme.desc: Those who have not yet been infected realize that they must leave the ship in order to survive. Pia gets a new best friend, but they disagree on how to stop the infection. A group of survivors, led by Kalle, tries to get to the engine room to shut off the engines and be able to hoist the lifeboats down. Dan seeks out Nadja and explains his manhood to her. Edith realizes that only extreme measures can stop the infection, even if it means sacrificing innocents. / De som annu inte smittats inser att de måste lamna fartyget for att overleva. Pia får en ny bundsforvant men de blir oeniga om hur de ska stoppa smittan. En grupp overlevande med Kalle i spetsen forsoker ta sig till maskinrummet for att stanga av motorerna och kunna hissa ner livbåtarna. Dan soker upp Nadja och forklarar henne sin karlek. Edith inser att endast extrema åtgarder kan stoppa smittan, aven om det innebar att oskyldiga offras.

programme.desc: When the crew of the space freighter Nostromo responds to a node signal from a rogue planet, they encounter a deadly life form that preys on humans to reproduce. Now the crew must fight for their lives and prevent the creature from reaching Earth. Directed by Ridley Scott and starring Sigourney Weaver (in her breakthrough role), this first Alien film will take your breath away., , Certain sequences of flashing lights may affect light-sensitive viewers. / Nar besattningen på rymdfraktaren Nostromo svarar på en nodsignal från en odslig planet, upptacker de en dodlig livsform som anvander sig av manniskor som vardar for att fortplanta sig. Nu måste besattningen slåss for sina liv och forhindra att varelsen når Jorden. Med regissoren Ridley Scott och skådespelaren Sigourney Weaver (i sin genombrottsroll) kommer denna forsta Alien-film att få dig att tappa andan., , Vissa sekvenser av blinkande ljus kan påverka ljuskansliga tittare.

programme.title: Forsta dejten
programme.desc: It's time for the end of the season, but before Andrea, Cato and Daniel shut down the restaurant for the time being, the last guests will have a chance to fall in love. After 10 years of heartache, 31-year-old Josefine from Gothenburg is probably ready for manhood. Hopefully that man is Ina, 31, from Ljungby. Ina has stagnated in her dating, but with a little pressure from home, she has ventured out on a date. In the bar, Josefine offers a real plot twist that makes Ina's jaw drop. Minna, 26, from Uppsala has never had a relationship but now she has decided to tear down her walls and go all in on the date! Max, 31, from Norrkoping longs to become such a crazy guy and maybe now it will probably happen. As if that wasn't enough, Cato offers a romantic surprise that rubs off on all the couples in the restaurant, and Daniel looks back on a season full of masculinity and courage. / Det har blivit dags for sasongsavslutning, men innan Andrea, Cato och Daniel stanger ner restaurangen for den har gången ska de sista gasterna få chans att bli foralskade. 31-åriga Josefine från Goteborg kanner efter 10 år av hjartesorg sig antligen redo for karlek. Forhoppningsvis ar den karleken Ina, 31, från Ljungby. Ina har stagnerat i sitt dejtande men med lite påtryckningar hemifrån har hon vågat sig ut på dejt. I baren bjuder Josefine på en riktig plot twist som får Ina att tappa hakan. Minna, 26, från Uppsala har aldrig haft en relation men nu har hon bestamt sig for att riva sina murar och gå all in på dejten! Max, 31, från Norrkoping langtar efter att bli sådar galet kar och kanske ar det nu det antligen hander. Som om inte det vore nog bjuder Cato på en romantisk overraskning som smittar av sig på alla par i restaurangen och Daniel blickar tillbaka på en sasong full av karlek och mod.

programme.desc: While Luke struggles with the reality that his daughter, April (VANESSA MARANO), is in his life, Lorelai tries to pretend she's not thinking about the implications of the new situation on their engagement. Rory's concern over Paris' incompetence at the Yale Daily News finally reaches a breaking point when most of the staff resigns in protest. With Logan's help, Rory makes a valiant attempt to get the paper out on time. Lorelai tells Richard and Emily that their money will no longer be needed for Rory's education, leading to resentment. On the following Friday night, there will be a massive confrontation in the office where all four members of the Gilmore family will probably have to air their opinions. / Medan Luke kampar med verkligheten att hans dotter, April (VANESSA MARANO), finns i hans liv, forsoker Lorelai låtsas som att hon inte tanker på konsekvenserna av den nya situationen på deras forlovning. Lorelai berattar for Richard och Emily att deras pengar inte langre kommer att behovas for Rorys utbildning, och det leder till forbittring. Efterfoljande fredag kvall uppstår det en kanslomassig konfrontation dar alla fyra medlemmarna i familjen Gilmore antligen får vadra sina åsikter.

programme.desc: An old stove forms the basis when Frank starts the smoking oven project, in order to preserve pine cones. A self-sufficient farm that is run sustainably and with old methods is the dream for Frank and his family at Kastanjegården. / En gammal kamin utgor grunden nar Frank satter igång projekt rokugn, for att kunna konservera kott. Och så ska den fardigrestaurerade dorren till nya boningshuset antligen komma på plats. Frank får hjalp av Theresa och båda ar spanda på om dorren kommer att passa. Ett sjalvforsorjande lantbruk som drivs på ett hållbart vis och med gamla metoder ar drommen for Frank och hans familj på Kastanjegården.
