programme.title: Screen-free in 100 days / Skarmfri på 100 dagar
programme.desc: Erik Galli is pissed. He wonders if the phone - and the fact that he spends 12-13 hours on the screen on a normal day - could be behind the lousy mood. In a 100-day-long experiment, he will try to go from severe addiction to addiction to addiction. Or at least "screen-functional". In his attempt at detoxification, he takes help from both researchers and inspirations who have their own thoughts and experiences about how to take control of the mobile phone. / Erik Galli mår piss. Han undrar om telefonen - och att han en vanlig dag tillbringar 12-13 timmar på skarmen - kan ligga bakom det usla måendet. I ett 100 dagar långt experiment ska han forsoka gå från gravt skarmberoende till skarmfri. Eller åtminstone ”skarmfunktionell”. I sitt forsok till avgiftning tar han hjalp av både forskare och inspiratorer som har egna tankar och erfarenheter om hur man tar makten over mobilen.

programme.title: Screen-free in 15 min / Skarmfri på 15 min
programme.desc: Is it the digitization zeal of the 90s and the fault of the PC reform that so many Swedes feel dependent on their devices today? How many people use their mobile phone more than they would like and why does it matter? In the studio, Evelina Galli, tech reporter at Sveriges Radio, faces Joakim Ronning, director of foreign affairs for Nyhetsbyrån Direkt and Urban Lindstedt, history podcaster and author of Framtidsloftet - The story of how the internet changed Sweden. Program manager: Prescilia Haddad. / Är det 90-talets digitaliseringsiver och PC-reformens fel att så många svenskar kanner sig beroende av sina skarmar idag? Hur många anvander sin mobiltelefon mer an vad de hade velat och vad spelar det for roll? I studion mots Evelina Galli, techreporter på Sveriges Radio, Joakim Ronning, utrikeschef for Nyhetsbyrån Direkt och Urban Lindstedt, historiepoddare och forfattare till Framtidsloftet - Historien om hur internet forandrade Sverige. Programledare: Prescilia Haddad.

programme.title: Under bar himmel
programme.desc: Markus Torgeby and comedian Per Andersson are building a snob cabin in Jamtland's fjallvarld. They countered in a conversation about fronts and backs with being a yes-sayer. Is Per always as good and happy, or does it happen that he bars the door when someone knocks? / Markus Torgeby och komikern Per Andersson bygger en snobivack i Jamtlands fjallvarld. De mots i ett samtal om fram- och baksidor med att vara en ja-sagare. Är Per alltid lika go och glad, eller hander det att han stanger dorren nar någon knackar på?

programme.title: That's how Sweden does drugs / Så knarkar Sverige
programme.desc: Johan Wicklen visits the Dutch public service program Drugslab, which for 20 years has had its presenters test different types of drugs in order to provide the audience with information. The risks and appeal of MDMA are reviewed. Norwegian researcher Tor-Morten Kvam has tested giving MDMA to deeply depressed patients. / Johan Wicklen besoker nederlandska public serviceprogrammet Drugslab som i 20 års tid låtit sina programledare testa olika typer av narkotika for att ge publiken information. Riskerna och attraktionen med MDMA gås igenom. Norske forskaren Tor-Morten Kvam har testat att ge MDMA till djupt deprimerade patienter.

programme.desc: Exercise with SVT's home gym pass! In today's session, Sofia Åhman focuses on strength and fitness. / Gympa med SVT:s hemmagympapass! I dagens pass fokuserar Sofia Åhman på styrka och kondition.

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Emily wants to get to know her future son-in-law and invites Luke to dinner. To avoid an argument, don't tell Lorelai that the wedding has been postponed. Meanwhile, the Yale Daily News staff has fired Paris and appoints Rory as the new editor. When a furious Paris kicks Rory out of the unit, Rory has no idea where to turn until Logan convinces her to move into his unit. When Rory gives Christopher (DAVID SUTCLIFFE) a tour of Yale, he finds out about the housing team and tells Lorelai. / Emily vill lara kanna sin framtida svarson och bjuder in Luke på middag. For att undvika ett argument, berattar inte Lorelai att brollopet har skjutits upp. Samtidigt har personalen på Yale Daily News avskedat Paris och utser Rory som ny redaktor. Nar ursinniga Paris sparkar ut Rory ur lagenheten har Rory ingen aning om var hon ska vanda sig forran Logan overtygar henne om att flytta in i hans lagenhet. Nar Rory ger Christopher (DAVID SUTCLIFFE) en rundtur på Yale, får han reda på bostadslaget och berattar det for Lorelai.

programme.title: Ask the doctor / Fråga doktorn
programme.desc: Maja Larsson's 13-year-old son died suddenly and unexpectedly while singing. Now she talks completely openly about the grief and moves on to help others in the same situation. In the studio by Reyhaneh Ahangaran, psychologist and Mikael Rostila who does research on losing a loved one. Program manager Sofia Rågenklint. / Maja Larssons 13-årige son dog plotsligt och ovantat i sin sang. Nu berattar hon helt oppet om sorgen och vagen vidare for att hjalpa andra i samma situation. I studion aven Reyhaneh Ahangaran, psykolog och Mikael Rostila som forskar om att forlora en kar anhorig. Programledare Sofia Rågenklint.

programme.title: Innanfor slottets vaggar
programme.desc: Princess Christina and King Carl XVI Gustaf grew up in the southern wing of the Royal Palace in Stockholm. Crown Princess Victoria also lived in this castle for five years. How was it? What are their strongest memories from childhood in such a special growing up environment. / Prinsessan Christina och kung Carl XVI Gustaf vaxte upp i den sodra flygeln i det Kungliga slottet i Stockholm. Kronprinsessan Victoria bodde också fem år i detta slott. Hur var det? Vilka ar deras starkaste minnen från barndomen i en så speciell uppvaxtmiljo.

programme.title: Under bar himmel
programme.desc: Markus Torgeby and comedian Per Andersson are building a snob cabin in Jamtland's fjallvarld. They countered in a conversation about fronts and backs with being a yes-sayer. Is Per always as good and happy, or does it happen that he bars the door when someone knocks? / Markus Torgeby och komikern Per Andersson bygger en snobivack i Jamtlands fjallvarld. De mots i ett samtal om fram- och baksidor med att vara en ja-sagare. Är Per alltid lika go och glad, eller hander det att han stanger dorren nar någon knackar på?

programme.title: Screen-free in 100 days / Skarmfri på 100 dagar
programme.desc: Erik Galli is pissed. He wonders if the phone - and the fact that he spends 12-13 hours on the screen on a normal day - could be behind the lousy mood. In a 100-day-long experiment, he will try to go from severe addiction to addiction to addiction. Or at least "screen-functional". In his attempt at detoxification, he takes help from both researchers and inspirations who have their own thoughts and experiences about how to take control of the mobile phone. / Erik Galli mår piss. Han undrar om telefonen - och att han en vanlig dag tillbringar 12-13 timmar på skarmen - kan ligga bakom det usla måendet. I ett 100 dagar långt experiment ska han forsoka gå från gravt skarmberoende till skarmfri. Eller åtminstone ”skarmfunktionell”. I sitt forsok till avgiftning tar han hjalp av både forskare och inspiratorer som har egna tankar och erfarenheter om hur man tar makten over mobilen.

programme.title: 112 Fire department / 112 Brandkår
programme.desc: When a small fire in dry grass starts a large forest fire, the firefighter must act quickly. Men flammorna sprider sig snabbt och hotar hus och hem.

programme.title: The last thing I see / Det sista jag ser
programme.desc: Hosten 2022 everything changes for the hip-hop artist Naaak, Matar Samba. In just a few weeks, he loses 95 percent of his vision and becomes legally blind. Still, he refuses to use aids or ask for help. He wants to live as before the disease, with all that that meant. But for family and friends, worries grow. How long can he continue to close his eyes to reality? / Hosten 2022 forandras allt for hiphopartisten Naaak, Matar Samba. På bara några veckor forlorar han 95 procent av sin syn och blir juridiskt blind. Ändå vagrar han anvanda hjalpmedel eller be om stod. Han vill leva som innan sjukdomen, med allt vad det innebar. Men for familj och vanner vaxer oron. Hur lange kan han fortsatta blunda for verkligheten?

programme.title: All about killing / Allt om doden
programme.desc: Everyone dies. Series start. Why is it so hard to talk about something that will happen to us all? The only thing we know for sure about life is that everyone has to die. But why do we die? And how can it die? Our reporter Assia visits a drunk driver to find out what happens in unnatural deaths. / Alla dor. Seriestart. Varfor ar det så svårt att prata om något som kommer att handa oss alla? Det enda vi sakert vet om livet ar att alla en gång ska do. Men varfor dor vi? Och hur kanns det att do? Vår reporter Assia besoker en rattslakare for att ta reda på vad som hander vid onaturlig dod.

programme.title: Thank god I'm gay / Tack gud jag ar homo
programme.desc: Thank god I'm me. What is it like to be young and an LGBTQ person at school today? Or to come out in a traditionally religious family? The presenter duo Alice and Linda are back and explain the concepts of hbtqia+. / Tack gud jag ar jag. Hur ar det att vara ung och hbtq-person i skolan idag? Eller att komma ut i en traditionellt religios familj? Programledarduon Alice och Linda ar tillbaka och reder ut begreppen hbtqia+.

programme.title: Islandska foremål berattar
programme.desc: The mysterious market. Just before the Second World War broke out, German glider pilots came to Iceland to teach Icelanders to glide. We are investigating a plot of land believed to have been left as a gift. But perhaps the market tells a completely different story about the purpose of the Germans' stay in Iceland. / Det mystiska market. Strax innan andra varldskriget brot ut kom tyska segelflygspiloter till Island for att lara islanningar att segelflyga. Vi undersoker ett marke som tros ha lamnats kvar som en gåva. Men kanske berattar market en helt annan historia om syftet med tyskarnas vistelse på Island.

programme.title: That's how Sweden does drugs / Så knarkar Sverige
programme.desc: Johan Wicklen visits the Dutch public service program Drugslab, which for 20 years has had its presenters test different types of drugs in order to provide the audience with information. The risks and appeal of MDMA are reviewed. Norwegian researcher Tor-Morten Kvam has tested giving MDMA to deeply depressed patients. / Johan Wicklen besoker nederlandska public serviceprogrammet Drugslab som i 20 års tid låtit sina programledare testa olika typer av narkotika for att ge publiken information. Riskerna och attraktionen med MDMA gås igenom. Norske forskaren Tor-Morten Kvam har testat att ge MDMA till djupt deprimerade patienter.

programme.title: Alone Norge

programme.title: Sveriges historia från 1800- till 1900-tal
programme.desc: The view of masculinity and sex has changed in Sweden over 200 years. From forced celibacy to Stockholm celibacy, the rights of homosexuals, contraceptives and changed divorce laws. How has the Swedes' cohabitation been affected by new laws and norms? / Synen på karlek och sex har forandrats i Sverige under 200 år. Från tvångsaktenskap till Stockholmsaktenskap, homosexuellas rattigheter, preventivmedel och forandrade skilsmassolagar. Hur har svenskarnas samliv påverkats av nya lagar och normer?

programme.title: Fashion with (sign language) / Mote med (teckenspråk)
programme.desc: What is required to transform one's innermost thoughts into a book that depends and changes? Gunilla and Åsa open up about their strong journey to write a book that helps deaf parents understand their deaf children, an account filled with vulnerability and insight. Marcus talks about his long struggle and the joy of apparently having his book published - a dream that came true after many attempts. / Vad kravs for att forvandla sina innersta tankar till en bok som beror och forandrar? Gunilla och Åsa oppnar upp om sin starka resa att skriva en bok som hjalper horande foraldrar att forstå sina dova barn, en berattelse fylld av sårbarhet och insikt. Marcus berattar om sin långa kamp och gladjen over att antligen ha fått sin bok publicerad - en drom som gått i uppfyllelse efter många forsok.

programme.title: Norra distriktet
programme.desc: During the investigation of a series of cottage burglaries, a triple murderer wanted by Interpol is revealed. The hunt is on. Niko lets the jug know a charming woman who comes with an enticing offer. Esko resorts to questionable tricks to avoid the sale of her home. Synthesized into Finnish. / Under utredningen av en serie stuginbrott avslojas en trippelmordare efterlyst av Interpol. Jakten ar i gång. Niko lar kanna en charmerande kvinna som kommer med ett lockande erbjudande. Esko tar till tvivelaktiga knep for att undvika forsaljningen av sitt hem. Syntolkat till finska.

programme.title: 15 minuter från News / 15 minuter från Uutiset
programme.desc: Finland survived the Cold War as an independent nation thanks to its unique foreign policy known as "Finlandization". The price for the friendship with the Soviet Union was strict self-censorship and a president who held power for 26 years. The program is hosted by historians Riku Keski-Rauska and Janne Holmen. , Program manager is Venla Odenbalk. / Finland klarade sig genom Kalla kriget som en sjalvstandig nation tack vare sin unika utrikespolitik som kallas "finlandisering". Priset for vanskapen med Sovjet var strikt sjalvcensur och en president som hade makten i 26 år. Programmet gastas av historikerna Riku Keski-Rauska och Janne Holmen. , Programledare ar Venla Odenbalk.

programme.title: 15 minutes in sign language / 15 minuter på teckenspråk
programme.desc: RFSL Regnbågen has existed for many years, but the future is uncertain. What is the reason for that? What do young people say about RFSL Regnbågen, is it needed? Håkan Collin, who took the initiative to form the association in Sweden, will visit the studio and discuss with the presenter Magnus Bergevin. / RFSL Regnbågen har funnits i många år, men framtiden ar oviss. Vad ar orsaken till det? Vad sager unga om RFSL Regnbågen, behovs det? Håkan Collin, som tog initiativ till att bilda foreningen i Sverige, ska gasta studion och diskutera med programledaren Magnus Bergevin.

programme.title: Babel
programme.desc: Cecilia Udden has been Sveriges Radio's correspondent for over 30 years, based in the Middle East. Now comes her reportage book Everything has a taste of ash -- The Scratcher in Gaza and other people in a tormented region. , One of the country's most popular musicians and songwriters, Mikael Wiehe, is up to date with two books -- The American Songbook, with translations by Leonard Cohen and Bob Dylan and others. and On festive occasions. Wiehe was also noticed recently for his summer talk when he explained that he had suffered from Alzheimer's disease. , Host: Jessika Gedin. / Cecilia Udden har varit Sveriges Radios korrespondent i over 30 år, med Mellanostern som bas. Nu kommer hennes reportagebok Allt har en smak av aska -- Skraddaren i Gaza och andra manniskor i en plågad region. , En av landets mest omtyckta musiker och låtskrivare, Mikael Wiehe, ar aktuell med två bocker -- Den amerikanska sångboken, med oversattningar av Leonard Cohen och Bob Dylan m.fl. och Vid hogtidliga tillfallen. Wiehe uppmarksammades aven nyligen for sitt sommarprat då han berattade att han drabbats av Alzheimers sjukdom. , Programledare: Jessika Gedin.

programme.title: Anders matresa
programme.desc: The tasting journey continues south. In Österlen, it is said that there is a wild flowering locust and we will see if Anders succeeds in finding it. / Smakresan fortsatter soderut. På Österlen sags att det finns vilt blommande lok och vi får se om Anders lyckas hitta den.

programme.title: Parkerad
programme.desc: Alejandra has just broken up with her boyfriend. In order to quell the anxiety, she ventures out into Stockholm's vibrant nightlife together with her best friend van Senait. The whole world is theirs but they never reach the club. How do you know when it's time to relax? A male romance drama by Wasima Ayad from 2024. / Alejandra har precis gjort slut med sin kille. For att dampa ångesten ger hon sig ut i Stockholms pulserande nattliv tillsammans med sin basta van Senait. Hela varlden ar deras men de når aldrig klubben. Hur vet man nar det ar dags att slappa taget? Ett karleksdrama av Wasima Ayad från 2024.

programme.title: Drommen om ett paradis
programme.desc: Filmmaker Rebecka breaks away from the big city and moves with her daughter to a secluded place in the Blekingen countryside. When the key is turned to the new farm, reality catches up. It is a paradise for Rebecka, but for the daughter a journey has just begun that is anything but comfortable. / Filmskaparen Rebecka bryter upp från storstaden och flyttar med sin dotter till en avlagsen plats på den blekingska landsbygden. Nar nyckeln vrids om till den nya gården kommer verkligheten ikapp. Det ar ett paradis for Rebecka, men for dottern har just en resa borjat som ar allt annat an bekvam.

programme.title: Cmon Cmon
programme.desc: When radio journalist Johnny is forced to take care of his nine-year-old nephew Jesse, he must take him on a business trip. During the trip, Johnny talks a lot about responsibility, masculinity and himself. / Nar radiojournalisten Johnny tvingas ta hand om sin nioåriga systerson Jesse måste han ta med honom på en affarsresa. Under resan lar sig Johnny mycket om ansvar, karlek och sig sjalv.

programme.title: 15 minutes in sign language / 15 minuter på teckenspråk
programme.desc: Now the Deaflympics are approaching in Japan, where around 3,000 athletes are expected to participate. We explore how the selection process has gone and what criteria are used to select the participants. In addition, we look at how the Deaflympics have changed over time. In the studio, we are hosted by Alexandra Polivanchuk, chairman of SDK, and program manager Magnus Bergevin. / Nu narmar sig Deaflympics i Japan, dar cirka 3000 idrottare forvantas delta. Vi utforskar hur uttagningsprocessen har gått till och vilka kriterier som anvands for att valja deltagarna. Dessutom tittar vi på hur Deaflympics har forandrats over tid. I studion gastas vi av Alexandra Polivanchuk, ordforande for SDK, och programledaren Magnus Bergevin.

programme.title: Sven Jerring – the rust that opened the world / Sven Jerring – rosten som oppnade varlden
programme.desc: Swedish documentary from 2017. Every year at the sports gala, the prestigious Jerring Prize is awarded. It is named after the radio host who was as good as the king and who became Uncle Sven with the entire Swedish people. But who was he really, Sven Jerring? In a two-part series, Owe Eriksson tells the story of this enigmatic radio legend who opened up the world to the Swedes. / Svensk dokumentar från 2017. Varje år vid idrottsgalan delas det prestigefyllda Jerring-priset ut. Det ar uppkallat efter radiorosten som var lika kand som kungen och som blev Farbror Sven med hela svenska folket. Men vem var han egentligen, Sven Jerring? I en tvådelad serie berattar Owe Eriksson historien om denne gåtfulle radiolegendar som oppnade varlden for svenskarna.

programme.desc: On December 7, 1941, Japan bombs the US naval base at Pearl Harbor. The United States, which has so far managed to stay out of the conflict, is now drawn into the Second World War. The surprise attack becomes a turning point in the large-scale war, and in the history of the world. / Den 7 december 1941 bombar Japan USA:s flottbas Pearl Harbor. USA som hittills har lyckats hålla sig utanfor konflikten dras nu in i andra varldskriget. Överraskningsattacken blir en vandpunkt i det storskaliga kriget, och i varldens historia.

programme.title: Fashion with (sign language) / Mote med (teckenspråk)
programme.desc: What happens to a man who slowly loses himself in the shadow of a narcissist - without realizing it? Anette lived in a relationship for 17 years where manipulation and control were eventually seen as everyday life. Johanna recounts a life flaunted by the power of a narcissistic relative - for over four decades - before she finally broke free. / Vad hander med en manniska som långsamt forlorar sig sjalv i en narcissists skugga - utan att marka det? Anette levde i en relation i 17 år dar manipulation och kontroll till slut kandes som vardag. Johanna berattar om ett liv praglat av en narcissistisk anhorigs makt - i over fyra decennier - innan hon till sist brot sig fri.

programme.title: Skogens fem grona broder
programme.desc: The fir tree. Is the tree more formal than other trees? The author Anni Kytomaki thinks about different types of trees and their different characteristics. (Finland, 2018). / Granen. Är granen mer formell an andra trad? Forfattaren Anni Kytomaki funderar kring olika tradslag och deras olika karaktarsdrag. (Finland, 2018).

programme.title: Dar vaggar talar
programme.desc: For Rebecka, the supernatural has always been a natural part of life. But when the energies start to take over and she herself becomes too affected, that will be enough. Who is the woman in the kitchen and will Rebecka always have an "extra" child with her? Cast: Lena Greus and Rebecka Lindgren. The Tornedalen valley has always been rich in stories about ghosts, farm gnomes and haunted houses. We visit houses and places where people have had inexplicable experiences and find out more about them and their history. / Det overnaturliga har for Rebecka alltid varit en naturlig del i livet. Men nar energierna borjar ta over och hon sjalv blir for påverkad får det vara nog. Vem ar kvinnan i koket och kommer Rebecka alltid ha med sig ett "extra" barn? Medverkande: Lena Greus och Rebecka Lindgren. Tornedalen har alltid varit rik på historier om mylingar, gårdstomtar och hemsokta hus. Vi besoker hus och platser dar manniskor upplevt oforklarliga upplevelser och tar reda på mer om dem och deras historia.

programme.title: Dar vaggar talar
programme.desc: Anna probably gets to buy the house she longed for. The chancellery in the new building is warm and caring. But suddenly one night she is woken up by someone saving the house from burning down. Who is the man in the ring and where do all the reindeer come from? / Anna får antligen kopa sitt hus hon langtat efter. Kanslan i det nya huset ar varm och omhandertagande. Men plotsligt en natt blir hon vackt av någon som raddar huset från att brinna ner. Vem ar mannen i kallaren och var kommer alla renar ifrån?

programme.title: Half me? / Halva jag?
programme.desc: JP tries to get the offspring of his four father candidates to have DNA tested, but one refuses. JP has no other option but to go through dna test persons one slaughter branch at a time and try to find his father that way. Heli travels to Sweden to meet a butcher, and she doesn't just bring good news. How is she received? / JP forsoker få avkomlingar till sina fyra pappakandidater att låta dna-testa sig, men en vagrar. JP har ingen annan mojlighet an att gå igenom dna-testpersoner en slaktgren i taget och forsoka hitta sin pappa på det sattet. Heli reser till Sverige for att traffa en slakting, och hon har inte bara med sig goda nyheter. Hur tas hon emot?

programme.title: Vetenskapens varld
programme.desc: Efter decennier av krig och forstorelse gors nu nya fynd kring de mytomspunna mesopotamiska platserna, civilisationens vagga. En ny generation av internationella arkeologer återoppnar nu gamla fyndplatser.

Men vem var han egentligen, Sven Jerring? I en tvådelad serie berattar Owe Eriksson historien om denne gåtfulle radiolegendar som oppnade varlden for svenskarna.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry and Son
programme.desc: Mrs. Lowry and Son (GB, 2019) Director: Adrian Noble Cast: Vanessa Redgrave, Timothy Spall, Stephen Lord, Wendy Morgan, Michael Keogh, John Alan Roberts Genre: Drama Duration: 85' In the 1930s Lawrence Stephen Lowry, a middle-aged rent collector, lives with his elderly mother Elizabeth in the industrial suburbs of Manchester. Lowry lovingly takes care of Elizabeth, who is infirm and suffers from fluctuating moods caused by nostalgia for a rich and bourgeois past erased by her late husband's debts. Passionate about painting, Lowry portrays the popular life of his neighborhood with a particular and personal style absolutely despised by Elizabeth, who never misses an opportunity to belittle the talent of her son who she prevents from making his works public. After his mother's death in 1939, Lawrence Stephen Lowry would become one of the most acclaimed contemporary British painters. / Mrs. Lowry and Son (GB, 2019) Regia: Adrian Noble Interpreti: Vanessa Redgrave, Timothy Spall, Stephen Lord, Wendy Morgan, Michael Keogh, John Alan Roberts Genere: Drammatico Durata: 85’Negli anni Trenta Lawrence Stephen Lowry, esattore di affitti di mezza età, vive con lanziana madre Elizabeth nella periferia industriale di Manchester. Lowry si prende amorevolmente cura di Elizabeth, che è inferma e soffre di altalenanti stati umorali causati dalla nostalgia per un passato ricco e borghese cancellato dai debiti del defunto marito. Appassionato di pittura, Lowry ritrae la vita popolare del proprio quartiere con uno stile particolare e personale assolutamente disprezzato da Elizabeth, che non perde occasione per sminuire il talento del figlio a cui impedisce di rendere pubbliche le sue opere. Dopo la morte della madre, nel 1939, Lawrence Stephen Lowry diventerà uno dei più acclamati pittori britannici contemporanei.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: The Neverending Story - The profession of weapons / La Storia infinita - Il mestiere delle armi
programme.desc: An uncomfortable and surprising story: that of the Swiss mercenaries, protagonists of a thousand wars for foreign powers. A journey through Switzerland and beyond: from Paris to Rome, from Indonesia to Canada, the episode questions the myth of Swiss neutrality and tells the story of a country that has built its prosperity also thanks to the art of war. Switzerland describes itself as a land of peace and neutrality, but behind this image another story is hidden. For centuries hundreds of thousands of men have left the Alpine valleys to enlist as mercenaries in foreign armies. They fought battles that were not theirs, they defended distant thrones, they brought the name of our country into the bloodiest folds of history. This episode is an epic journey that knows no boundaries. From the impenetrable jungles of Southeast Asia to the fiery squares of Paris, from the papal courts of Rome to the devastated villages of Indonesia, the invisible thread of Swiss mercenaries crosses centuries and continents. It is the trajectory of an armed people who intertwined their destiny with that of monarchies, empires and revolutions. They are not just war chronicles, but fragments of a larger story. A story that forces us to look beyond the myths of neutrality and peace, to discover that our history was also written with blood shed far from home. Through archives, testimonies and powerful images, the episode takes the viewer into a fresco that unites Europe, Asia and the entire world. Not a distant past, but a mirror that forces us to ask ourselves who we really are. A program that is both history and journey, memory and revelation. Because the secret war of the Swiss does not only belong to the past: it continues to question our present. A program by and with Jonas Marti. / Una storia scomoda e sorprendente: quella dei mercenari svizzeri, protagonisti di mille guerre per potenze straniere. Un viaggio sul territorio svizzero e non solo: da Parigi a Roma, dallIndonesia al Canada, la puntata mette in discussione il mito della neutralità elvetica e racconta un paese che ha costruito la sua prosperità anche grazie allarte della guerra. La Svizzera si racconta come terra di pace e di neutralità, ma dietro questa immagine si nasconde unaltra storia. Per secoli centinaia di migliaia di uomini hanno lasciato le valli alpine per arruolarsi come mercenari in eserciti stranieri. Hanno combattuto battaglie che non erano le loro, hanno difeso troni lontani, hanno portato il nome del nostro Paese nelle pieghe più sanguinose della storia. Questa puntata è un viaggio epico che non conosce confini. Dalle giungle impenetrabili dellAsia sudorientale alle piazze infuocate di Parigi, dalle corti papali di Roma ai villaggi devastati dellIndonesia, il filo invisibile dei mercenari svizzeri attraversa secoli e continenti. È la traiettoria di un popolo in armi che ha intrecciato il proprio destino con quello di monarchie, imperi e rivoluzioni. Non sono soltanto cronache di guerra, ma frammenti di un racconto più grande. Un racconto che ci costringe a guardare oltre i miti della neutralità e della pace, per scoprire che la nostra storia è stata scritta anche col sangue versato lontano da casa. Attraverso archivi, testimonianze e immagini potenti, la puntata porta lo spettatore dentro un affresco che unisce Europa, Asia e il mondo intero. Non un passato lontano, ma uno specchio che ci obbliga a chiederci chi siamo davvero. Un programma che è insieme storia e viaggio, memoria e rivelazione. Perche la guerra segreta degli svizzeri non appartiene solo al passato: continua a interrogare il nostro presente. Un programma di e con Jonas Marti.

programme.desc: Original title: Tirailleurs Drama film by Mathieu Vadepied Cast: with Omar Sy, Alassane Diong, Jonas Bloquet Country - Year: FR - 2022 Senegal, 1917: captured by the French army, Thierno is forcibly conscripted and sent to the front line together with his father Bakary, who followed him incognito so as not to leave him alone. While the latter searches for a way to be assigned to the mess, away from the front, Thierno is appointed corporal to replace the officers killed in battle and allows himself to be convinced to participate in a potentially suicidal attack maneuver. / Titolo originale: Tirailleurs Film drammatico di Mathieu Vadepied Cast: con Omar Sy, Alassane Diong, Jonas Bloquet Paese - Anno: FR - 2022Senegal, 1917: catturato dallesercito francese, Thierno viene arruolato a forza e spedito in prima linea insieme al padre Bakary, che lo ha seguito in incognito per non lasciarlo solo. Mentre questultimo cerca un modo per farsi assegnare alla mensa, lontano dal fronte, Thierno viene nominato caporale per rimpiazzare gli ufficiali caduti in battaglia e si lascia convincere a partecipare a una manovra dattacco potenzialmente suicida.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Lauterbrunnen, basejumper paradise and cemetery by Caroline Beck Lauterbrunnen, in the Bernese Oberland, has become one of the world capitals of base jumping. The spectacular morphology of the valley, with its vertical walls, is ideal for this extreme sport. The number of jumps is constantly increasing: up to 25 thousand per year. However, this amount of jumping creates tensions with the local population and raises environmental and safety concerns. Fatal accidents are numerous: so far seventy base jumpers have already lost their lives in Lauterbrunnen; therefore, there are those who ask to ban this extreme sport. Is it possible? On the trail of stolen e-bikes by Adrian Lemmenmeier Every year tens of thousands of bicycles are stolen in Switzerland, especially e-bikes due to their value. In recent years the phenomenon has increased by 50%. Last year, over 50 thousand thefts were reported and insurance losses exceeded eighty million francs. The most affected cities are Basel, Bern and Zurich. But where do the stolen bikes end up? Who are the thieves? We find out by following the path of a stolen bicycle on which a GPS tracker was hidden. Milan and its "new poor" by Emanuele Valenti and Claudio MaggioliniMilan, a symbol of wealth and modernity, hides a reality of growing inequalities. The cost of living has increased to the point that even those who work struggle to support themselves. The "new poor" are emerging: single-income families, young precarious workers, pensioners. The housing crisis, aggravated by short-term rentals, is pushing many towards marginalization. The reportage tells the contradictions of a city that risks excluding its own inhabitants. / Lauterbrunnen, paradiso e cimitero dei basejumper di Caroline Beck Lauterbrunnen, nell’Oberland bernese, è diventata una delle capitali mondiali del base jumping. La spettacolare morfologia della valle, con le sue pareti verticali, è ideale per questo sport estremo. Il numero di salti è in costante aumento: fino a 25mila all’anno. Questa quantità di salti crea però tensioni con la popolazione locale e solleva preoccupazioni ambientali e di sicurezza. Gli incidenti mortali sono numerosi: finora già settanta base jumper hanno perso la vita a Lauterbrunnen; perciò, c’è chi chiede di vietare questo sport estremo. È possibile? Sulle tracce delle e-bike rubate di Adrian Lemmenmeier Ogni anno in Svizzera vengono rubate decine di migliaia di biciclette, soprattutto e-bike a motivo del loro valore. Negli ultimi anni il fenomeno è aumentato del 50%. L’anno scorso sono stati denunciati oltre 50mila furti e i danni assicurativi hanno superato gli ottanta milioni di franchi. Le città più colpite sono Basilea, Berna e Zurigo. Ma dove finiscono le bici rubate? Chi sono i ladri? Lo scopriamo seguendo il percorso di una bicicletta rubata sulla quale è stato nascosto un localizzatore GPS. Milano e i suoi “nuovi poveri” di Emanuele Valenti e Claudio MaggioliniMilano, simbolo di ricchezza e modernità, nasconde una realtà fatta di crescenti disuguaglianze. Il costo della vita è aumentato al punto che anche chi lavora fatica a sostenersi. Emergono i “nuovi poveri”: famiglie monoreddito, giovani precari, pensionati. La crisi abitativa, aggravata dagli affitti brevi, spinge molti verso la marginalità. Il reportage racconta le contraddizioni di una città che rischia di escludere i suoi stessi abitanti.

programme.title: Modem
programme.desc: Usually, in Argentina, mid-term elections do not arouse much interest at an international level. This year, however, they turned into a sort of referendum, in favor of the incumbent president Milei, with the conquest of 64 deputies (against 31 for the progressives). A surprising result compared to the previous polls, which predicted a head-to-head match between Libertà Avanza and the left-wing coalition Fuerza Patria. An economist by profession and an ultra-liberalist by vocation, Milei has been in office for almost two years and had taken over a country on the brink of collapse, also due to corruption and cronyism. As soon as he came to power, the new president wasted no time in using the weapon of cuts above all. He reduced pensions, stopped several public construction sites, reduced funding for schools and hospitals. And he pushed the privatization pedal. However, all this is having important consequences on a social level, suffice it to say that one citizen in three lives below the poverty line. And that the markets don't seem to give him much confidence, in recent days it took an intervention by Donald Trump himself, and by US finances, to at least slow down the loss of value of the peso, the national currency. Where is Milei's Argentina going? What can we say about the two faces of his economic and financial policy, which reduces inflation but increases the social crisis? And what is the role of the United States, and also of China, in this Latin American country that is all too accustomed to living with the risk of bankruptcy? We will discuss it with Elena Basso, RSI collaborator from South America Antonella Mori, professor of political economy of Latin American countries, at Bocconi in Milan / Solitamente, in Argentina, le elezioni di metà legislatura non suscitano molto interesse a livello internazionale. Quest’anno però si sono trasformate in una sorta di referendum, a favore del presidente in carica Milei, con la conquista di 64 deputati (contro i 31 dei progressisti). Un risultato che sorprende rispetto i sondaggi della vigilia, che avevano pronosticato un testa a testa tra la Libertà Avanza e la coalizione di sinistra Fuerza Patria.Economista di professione e ultra-liberista per vocazione, Milei è in carica da quasi due anni e aveva ripreso un Paese sull’orlo del tracolo, anche a causa di corruzione e clientelismo. Appena arrivato al potere il neo-presidente non ha perso tempo nell’utilizzare soprattutto l’arma dei tagli. Ha ridotto le pensioni, fermato parecchi cantieri pubblici, diminuito i fondi per scuole e ospedali. E ha spinto sul pedale delle privatizzazioni. Tutto questo sta però avendo importanti conseguenze a livello sociale, basti dire che un cittadino su tre vive al di sotto della soglia di povertà. E che i mercati non sembrano dargli molta fiducia, proprio in questi giorni ci è voluto un intervento di Donald Trump in persona, e delle finanze USA, per perlomeno rallentare la perdita di valore del peso, la moneta nazionale.Dove sta andando l’Argentina di Milei? Cosa dire dei due volti della sua politica economica e finanziaria, che riduce l’inflazione ma accresce la crisi sociale? E quale il ruolo degli Stati Uniti, e anche della Cina, in questo Paese dell’America Latina fin troppo abituato a convivere con il rischio della bancarotta?Ne discuteremo conElena Basso, collaboratrice RSI dal Sudamerica Antonella Mori, docente di economia politica dei Paesi dell’America latina, alla Bocconi di Milano

programme.title: Storie
programme.desc: In 2002, the Swiss-French journalist Serge decides to leave Geneva for Afghanistan to write an article for Le Figaro and convinces his friend Claude, a young printer, to act as his driver to the capital. But once they arrive, they find themselves faced with a destroyed city and a blocked airport. Claude has no choice but to continue the journey, and with Serge and Paolo, a war photographer, he travels for 2 months inside the country, posing as an RTS reporter and documenting everything with a small amateur camera bought in a Kabul bazaar. After twenty years, Claude finds the tapes of this odyssey crazy and turns it into a documentary, an exciting road movie, a tragicomedy full of humor and self-irony. A documentary by Claude Baechtold / Nel 2002 il giornalista svizzero-francese Serge decide di partire da Ginevra alla volta dell’Afganistan per scrivere un articolo per Le Figaro e convince l’amico Claude, un giovane tipografo, a fargli da autista sino alla capitale. Ma una volta arrivati, si trovano di fronte a una città distrutta e un aeroporto bloccato.Claude non ha altra scelta che proseguire il viaggio, e con Serge e Paolo, un fotografo di guerra, viaggia per 2 mesi all’interno del Paese, fingendosi un reporter di RTS e documentando tutto con una piccola telecamera amatoriale comprata in un bazar di Kabul.Dopo vent’anni, Claude ritrova le cassette di quest’odissea folle e ne fa un documentario, un road movie emozionante, una tragicommedia piena di umorismo e autoironia.Un documentario di Claude Baechtold

programme.title: Serengeti
programme.desc: The arrival of the rains marks the return of life to the Serengeti plains incinerated by the fire. The puppies grow up and face adulthood and a new independence. The lioness Kali is reunited with her family that she feared she had lost in the fire; the end of the baboon leader means that Bakari can return to his pack and regain the affection of Cheka and his adopted son. By courageously repelling the invasion of a rival pack, he also earns the respect of his companions who elect him as their new leader. The death of a large elephant and the abundance of meat that this entails creates an unexpected truce between rivals who feast together in complete harmony. Death and life interpenetrate in the eternal cycle of life. / Larrivo delle piogge segna il ritorno della vita nelle pianure del Serengeti incenerite dallincendio. I cuccioli crescono e si affacciano alla vita adulta e a una nuova indipendenza. La leonessa Kali si ricongiunge alla sua famiglia che temeva di aver perduto nel rogo; la fine del leader dei babbuini fa sì che Bakari possa rientrare nel suo branco e ritrovare laffetto di Cheka e del figlio adottivo. Respingendo coraggiosamente l`invasione di un branco rivale si guadagna inoltre il rispetto dei suoi compagni che lo eleggono loro nuovo leader. La morte di un grande elefante e labbondanza di carne che questo comporta crea una tregua insperata tra rivali che banchettano insieme in completa armonia. Morte e vita si compenetrano nelleterno ciclo della vita.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: La prodigiosa trasformazione della classe operaia in stranieri
programme.desc: Through family photos, animations, testimonies and archive material, the film tells the story of emigration from neighboring countries to Switzerland in an original way, from the post-war period to the present day. At the time we were talking about the working class: a collective identity with a project of social change. In the Seventies this culture collapsed and the working class of the past was now defined as "foreigners". Director Samir intertwines personal history and collective memory, to tell a visual essay on the evolution of an identity that has marked Switzerland. / Attraverso foto di famiglia, animazioni, testimonianze e materiale darchivio, il film racconta in modo originale la storia dellemigrazione dai paesi vicini verso la Svizzera, dal dopoguerra ai giorni nostri.Allepoca si parlava di classe operaia: unidentità collettiva con un progetto di cambiamento sociale. Negli anni Settanta questa cultura crolla e la classe operaia di un tempo viene ormai definita "stranieri". Il regista Samir intreccia storia personale e memoria collettiva, per raccontare un saggio visivo sullevoluzione di unidentità che ha segnato la Svizzera.

programme.title: Segni dei tempi
programme.desc: There are seven thousand Muslims in Ticino. In this episode we will enter the new Sopraceneri mosque. In Giubiasco, this is the news, the Islamic community has purchased a space specifically dedicated to prayer and interreligious meetings. We will meet imam Luan Afmataj with whom we will address some very current issues, from relations with other religions to the role of women in the Islamic world today. / Sono settemila i musulmani in Ticino. In questa puntata entreremo nella nuova moschea del Sopraceneri. A Giubiasco, è questa la novità, la comunità islamica ha acquistato uno spazio appositamente dedicato alla preghiera e agli incontri interreligiosi. Incontreremo l’imam Luan Afmataj con cui affronteremo alcuni temi di stretta attualità, dai rapporti con le altre religioni al ruolo oggi della donna nel mondo islamico.

programme.title: Paganini
programme.desc: "Magical art is that which gives us back the marvelous at the heart of everyday life": this is how the writer Andre Breton expressed himself and - thanking the father of surrealism for the quote and the inspiration - it is precisely the dimension of the magical that the Paganini episode on Sunday 5 October, from 10.30 am on RSI LA1, addresses. The "Livermore Svò" - starring Davide Livermore, now an acclaimed opera director - was a of the funniest and wittiest serial productions in the RSI music sector. In the episode entitled "Magic Music" alongside the histrionic host, the Orchestra of the Teatro Regio of Turin directed by Carlo Boccadoro, a group of madrigalists, the musicians Oliviero Giovannoni and Diego Fasolis alternated. Sorcellerie - literally: witchcraft - is instead a recent French show featuring the pianist duo Jatekok (with works by Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns and Paul Dukas) and two mimes/magicians engaged in an evocative dombre theatre. Fantasymphony is finally the imaginative symphonic program of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra conducted by Christian Schumann which - with the subtitle "a concert of magic and fire" - offers a selection of songs from films, series and video games that address the theme of the magical and the fantastic. Some examples? The Harry Potter soundtrack written by John Williams, the music by Lorne Balfe for the BBC/HBO series His Dark Materials, the song Breath of Life by Florence and the Machine for the film Snow White and the Huntsman, the famous theme by Ramin Djawadi for Game of Thrones or even the musical suite from the series Netflix The Witcher written by Sonya Belousova together with Giona Ostinelli from Ticino. / "Larte magica è quella che ci restituisce il meraviglioso al cuore della vita quotidiana": così si esprimeva lo scrittore Andre Breton e - ringraziando il padre del surrealismo per la citazione e lo spunto - è proprio alla dimensione del magico che si rivolge la puntata di Paganini di domenica 5 ottobre, dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1.Il "Livermore Sciò" - con protagonista Davide Livermore, oggi acclamato regista operistico - è stata una delle produzioni seriali più divertenti e argute del settore musicale RSI. Nellepisodio intitolato "Musica magica" si alternavano, accanto allistrionico padrone di casa, lOrchestra del Teatro Regio di Torino diretta da Carlo Boccadoro, un gruppo di madrigalisti, i musicisti Oliviero Giovannoni e Diego Fasolis.Sorcellerie - letteralmente: stregoneria - è invece un recente spettacolo francese che vede protagonisti il duo di pianiste Jatekok (con opere di Hector Berlioz, Franz Liszt, Camille Saint-Saëns e Paul Dukas) e due mimi/maghi impegnati in un suggestivo teatro dombre.Fantasymphony è infine limmaginifico programma sinfonico della Danish National Symphony Orchestra diretta da Christian Schumann che - con il sottotitolo «un concerto di magia e fuoco» - propone una selezione di brani da film, serie e videogiochi che affrontano il tema del magico e del fantastico. Alcuni esempi? La colonna sonora di Harry Potter scritta da John Williams, le musiche di Lorne Balfe per la serie BBC/HBO His Dark Materials - Queste oscure materie, il brano Breath of Life di Florence and the Machine per il film Biancaneve e il cacciatore, il celebre tema di Ramin Djawadi per Game of Thrones o ancora la Suite musicale dalla serie Netflix The Witcher scritta da Sonya Belousova assieme al ticinese Giona Ostinelli.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Every year tens of thousands of bicycles, especially e-bikes, are stolen in Switzerland. In 2024, over 50 thousand thefts were reported and insurance damages exceeded eighty million francs. But where do the stolen bikes end up? Who buys them? And who are these tireless bicycle thieves? / Ogni anno in Svizzera vengono rubate decine di migliaia di biciclette, e-bike soprattutto. Nel 2024 sono stati denunciati oltre 50mila furti e i danni assicurativi hanno superato gli ottanta milioni di franchi. Ma dove vanno a finire le bici rubate? Chi le compera? E chi sono questi infaticabili ladri di biciclette?

programme.title: Treasures of the World - Ferrara / Tesori del Mondo - Ferrara
programme.desc: Let's protect them. Let's not lose them. Let's get to know them. A series that punctuates the RSI schedule introduces us to the great treasures of the planet that hosts us. Ferrara (Fràra in Ferrarese) is a city of 134,636 inhabitants in Emilia-Romagna, capital of the province of the same name. Located in the lower Emilian plain, the city stands on the banks of the Po di Volano which delimits the border between the ancient city south of the walls with the new contemporary settlements. Ferrara enjoyed an important golden age when in the late Middle Ages and the Renaissance under the government of the Este family it was transformed into an artistic center of important importance not only in Italy but also in Europe, hosting artists such as Titian, George Gordon Byron, Ludovico Ariosto, Niccolò Copernicus, Andrea Mantegna and Torquato Tasso. Towards the end of the Middle Ages and the beginning of the Renaissance, the most important urban planning in history was implemented in Ferrara, the Addizione Erculea, the first example of reasoned planning of urban spaces, commissioned by Duke Ercole I d'Este (from whom it takes its name) and implemented by the architect Biagio Rossetti. / Proteggiamoli. Non perdiamoli. Conosciamoli. Una serie che punteggia il palinsesto RSI ci fa conoscere i grandi tesori del pianeta che ci ospita. Ferrara (Fràra in ferrarese) è una città di 134.636 abitanti dellEmilia-Romagna, capoluogo dellomonima provincia. Situata nella bassa pianura emiliana, la città sorge sulle sponde del Po di Volano che delimita il confine fra la città antica a sud delle mura con i nuovi insediamenti contemporanei. Ferrara gode di un importante periodo aureo quando nel basso medioevo e nel Rinascimento sotto il governo della famiglia degli Este viene trasformata in un centro artistico di importante rilevanza non solo italiano ma anche europeo, arrivando ad ospitare artisti come Tiziano, George Gordon Byron, Ludovico Ariosto, Niccolò Copernico, Andrea Mantegna e Torquato Tasso. Verso la fine del Medioevo e linizio del Rinascimento a Ferrara venne attuata la più importante progettazione urbanistica della storia, lAddizione Erculea, il primo esempio di pianificazione ragionata di spazi urbani, voluta dal duca Ercole I dEste (da cui prende il nome) ed attuata dallarchitetto Biagio Rossetti.

programme.title: Dale, a life in disguise / Dale, una vita in incognito
programme.desc: In the early 1990s, Washington DC was the most dangerous city in the United States. A young pastor, Dale Sutherland, becomes a cop in the midst of the "war on crack" and discovers his passion for the art of undercover operations. He records his encounters with criminal networks on video and accumulates evidence for investigations. Alternating in the role of Italian mafioso, fence, drug trafficker or music producer, for over thirty years he has directed the most spectacular and successful undercover operations of the American police. The path of this character with multiple personalities, divided between his faith and his need to face the city's slums, also reveals a secret part of the history of the infiltrators. / Allinizio degli anni 90, Washington DC è la città più pericolosa degli Stati Uniti. Un giovane pastore, Dale Sutherland, diventa poliziotto nel pieno della "guerra al crack" e scopre la sua passione per larte delle operazioni sotto copertura. Registra in video i suoi incontri con le reti criminali e accumula prove per le indagini. Alternandosi nei panni di mafioso italiano, ricettatore, trafficante di droga o produttore musicale, per oltre trentanni dirige le operazioni in incognito più spettacolari e riuscite della polizia americana. Il percorso di questo personaggio dalle molteplici personalità, diviso tra la sua fede e il suo bisogno di affrontare i bassifondi della città, ci svela anche una parte segreta della storia degli infiltrati.

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.desc: Marie gave Tom a formicarium. Empathizing with the ants, Arrietty asks Tom to free them but the boy refuses, claiming to observe them to understand them better. Faced with Arrietty's insistence, he ends up agreeing with her opinion and goes to release the ants in the vegetable patch in the garden... right where Pod and Yuna are! Arrietty, helped by Tom, will have to act subtly to get them out of a bad situation without spilling the beans on their friendship. / Marie a offert un formicarium à Tom. En empathie avec les fourmis, Arrietty demande à Tom de les liberer mais le garçon s’y refuse, pretextant les observer pour mieux les comprendre. Face à l’insistance d’Arrietty, il finit par se rallier à son avis et file liberer les fourmis dans le potager du jardin... pile à l’endroit où se trouvent Pod et Yuna ! Arrietty, aidee de Tom, va devoir agir avec subtilite pour les sortir d’un mauvais pas sans vendre la mèche sur leur amitie.

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.sub-title: Smile, you are being filmed / Souriez, vous etes filmes
programme.desc: During a pilfering expedition where Arrietty thinks too big, Gurnard accidentally activates the camera on Marie's phone. Here they are filmed... Les voilà filmes… Si un Zumain visionne cette video, l’existence des Chapardeurs sera decouverte... Arrietty et Gurnard vont devoir unir leurs forces pour apprivoiser cette machine afin d’effacer la video sans que les Zumains ne s’en aperçoivent…

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs

programme.title: Big Blue
programme.desc: The crew decides to replace the Calypso's engine, which causes a huge headache for Freddie, but nothing goes as planned and they must come up with an effective solution quickly before the situation escalates. / Lequipage decide de remplacer le moteur de la Calypso, ce qui cause un enorme casse-tete à Freddie, mais rien ne se passe comme prevu et ils doivent elaborer une solution efficace rapidement avant que la situation degenère.

programme.title: Big Blue
programme.desc: Now, Lemo is invited to join United Current headquarters and bring his fun scientific style to the staff, but nothing goes as planned and he must come up with an effective plan quickly. / Aujourdhui, Lemo est invite à rejoindre le quartier general de United Current et à apporter son style scientifique amusant au personnel, mais rien ne se passe comme prevu et il doit elaborer un plan efficace rapidement.

programme.title: Big Blue
programme.desc: The Calypso crew is tasked with guarding the Seahorse King's scepter after it is nearly stolen just before the Seahorse Celebration, but nothing goes as planned and they must come up with an effective solution quickly. / Lequipage de la Calypso est charge de garder le sceptre du roi de lhippocampe après quil a failli etre vole juste avant la celebration de lhippocampe, mais rien ne se passe comme prevu et ils doivent elaborer une solution efficace rapidement.

programme.title: Abominable et la cite invisible
programme.desc: Our three heroes get their first Ping on their new app aimed at helping creatures. programme.title: Abominable et la cite invisible
programme.desc: Following complaints from several users of the CreAlerte Ping app, the team finds itself confronted with a mysterious and stealing creature: the nine-tailed vixen. / Suite aux plaintes de plusieurs utilisateurs de lappli CreAlerte Ping, lequipe se retrouve confrontee à une creature mysterieuse et chapardeuse : la renarde à neuf queues.

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: Louis makes fun of the actors from the Boîte à Théâtre that his father brings to the house. Mais il decouvre à ses depens que le metier dacteur nest pas si facile…

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.sub-title: The lost louse / Le pou perdu
programme.desc: Abacus, BA and Louis think that lice do not exist even if Jim Catastrophe tries to convince them otherwise to better sell them his anti-lice helmets. programme.title: Shaun le mouton
programme.desc: The farmer discovers that he can make a lot of money selling old toys. When he finds Timmy's teddy bear, he locks it in a state-of-the-art safe, convinced that it is worth a fortune. How will Shaun and the flock save the plush toy from “Mossy Bottom Fortress” to console a completely distraught Timmy? / Le fermier decouvre quil peut se faire beaucoup dargent en vendant de vieux jouets. Lorsquil trouve lours en peluche de Timmy, il lenferme dans un coffre-fort dernier cri, persuade quil vaut une fortune. Comment Shaun et le troupeau sauveront-ils la peluche de « la forteresse de Mossy Bottom » pour consoler un Timmy complètement desempare ?

programme.title: More beautiful life, even more beautiful / Plus belle la vie, encore plus belle
programme.desc: Life has slowly taken a new start in the Basket. Indeed, a year after the collapse of the Mistral district, its former inhabitants had to start from scratch in a completely new district. New neighbors, new places and new habits. Everyone is very happy to get together for the inauguration of Thomas, Kilian and Barbara’s new bar. / La vie a doucement pris un nouveau depart dans le Panier. En effet, un an après l’effondrement du quartier du Mistral, ses anciens habitants ont dû repartir à zero dans un tout nouveau quartier. Nouveaux voisins, nouveaux lieux et nouvelles habitudes. Tout le monde est d’ailleurs très heureux de se retrouver pour l’inauguration du nouveau bar de Thomas, Kilian et Barbara.

programme.title: Demain nous appartient
programme.desc: The series “Tomorrow Belongs to Us” takes place in Sète, a city on the Mediterranean Sea. You will be able to follow the daily lives of several families and inhabitants of this city, where stories of love and friendship but also lies, betrayals or even heavy family secrets mingle... Find all the actors in your daily saga with Ingrid Chauvin, Anne Caillon, Alexandre Brasseur... / La serie "Demain nous appartient" se deroule à Sète, une ville au bord de la mer Mediterranee. Vous allez pouvoir suivre le quotidien de plusieurs familles et habitants de cette ville, où se melent des histoires d’amour et d’amitie mais aussi des mensonges, des trahisons ou encore de lourds secrets de famille… Retrouvez tous les comediens de votre saga quotidienne avec Ingrid Chauvin, Anne Caillon, Alexandre Brasseur...

programme.title: We must save the Christmas shop / Il faut sauver la boutique de Noël
programme.desc: Charlie Sawyer is a young data analyst who works for Big Teddy, a large toy store chain. She has one week to try to prevent the closure of all the group's stores in favor of online sales. His meeting with Grant Leviston, dynamic director of store 24, will turn his life upside down. / Charlie Sawyer est une jeune analyste de donnees qui travaille pour Big Teddy, une grande chaîne de magasin de jouets. Elle a une semaine pour tenter d’empecher la fermeture de tous les magasins du groupe au benefice de la vente en ligne. Sa rencontre avec Grant Leviston, directeur dynamique du magasin 24, va bouleverser sa vie.

programme.title: Bewitched by Christmas / Ensorcelee par Noël
programme.desc: A wish forces June, a young woman obsessed with her career as a children's book publisher, to accept all invitations when she stays with her parents for the holidays. But feelings from the past are rekindled when a former childhood sweetheart, Blake, joins the festivities. / Un vœu contraint June, une jeune femme obsedee par sa carrière d’editrice de livres pour enfants, à accepter toutes les invitations lors de son sejour chez ses parents pour les fetes. Mais les sentiments du passe sont ravives quand un ancien amour de jeunesse, Blake, se joint au programme des festivites.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil and Claire have a meeting with a very comfortable couple, meeting during their last vacation. Jay and Gloria have invited a couple of friends with whom they have many things in common, including their age difference. Alex, Luke and Haley, who forgot Mitchell's birthday, try to fix it... / Phil et Claire ont rendez-vous avec un couple très aise, rencontre lors de leurs dernières vacances. Jay et Gloria, eux, ont invite un couple damis avec lesquels ils ont de nombreux points communs, y compris leur difference dâge. Alex, Luke et Haley, qui ont oublie lanniversaire de Mitchell, tentent de reparer cela...

programme.title: Magnum
programme.sub-title: Don't talk to anyone / Nen parlez à personne
programme.desc: When a wealthy businessman hires Magnum and Higgins to find his missing wife, they discover to their shock that a tragedy occurs as a result of their investigation. At the same time, Kumu's suspicion of her stepdaughter's boyfriend creates a wedge between them. / Lorsquun riche homme daffaires engage Magnum et Higgins pour retrouver sa femme disparue, ils decouvrent avec stupefaction quune tragedie se produit à la suite de leur enquete. Dans le meme temps, la suspicion de Kumu à legard du petit ami de sa belle-fille cree un fosse entre elles.

programme.title: Ici tout commence
programme.desc: Filmed in the Camargue, “Here it all begins” is the story of a dynasty of great chefs. Viewers will immerse themselves in the life of a school that will train the future big names in gastronomy. Ready for a new plot? / Tourne en Camargue, "Ici tout commence" est lhistoire d’une dynastie de grands chefs. Les telespectateurs plongeront dans la vie d’une ecole qui formera les futurs grands noms de la gastronomie. Pret(s) pour une nouvelle intrigue ?

programme.title: Cest ma question
programme.desc: A general culture game reflects the diversity and passions of the French-speaking people. It is in fact the public, represented on the set by a wall of images, which will question the duo candidates in the running. Everyone can ask a question related to their profession, their region or their centers of interest. Faced with a multitude of portraits, who to choose? A game presented by Sebastien Pasche / Un jeu de culture generale reflète la diversite et les passions des Romands. programme.title: Ciao ciao bourbine
programme.desc: A crazy referendum plunges Switzerland into a state of emergency. By accepting the “No Bilangue” initiative, there should only be one national language: French. Many German-speaking Swiss are therefore in crisis. Including Walter Egli, 56, who works for the federal police and must ensure that the transition to monolingualism is done correctly. / Un referendum fou plonge la Suisse dans letat durgence. En acceptant linitiative «No Bilangue», il ne devrait plus y avoir quune seule langue nationale : le français. De nombreux Suisses alemaniques sont donc en crise. Dont Walter Egli, 56 ans, qui travaille pour la police federale et doit veiller à ce que le passage au monolinguisme se fasse correctement.

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.sub-title: Queen for a day, queen forever / Reine d’un jour, reine de toujours
programme.desc: Daemon has a new vision of the future that leads him to renounce his claims to the throne and pledge allegiance to Rhaenyra. At the sight of the seven dragons of the Blacks, Aemon fled Dragonstone. Furious, he burned Pointe-Vive and all its inhabitants. Rhaenyra then realizes that trouble is inevitable... / Daemon a une nouvelle vision de lavenir qui lamène à renoncer à ses pretentions au trône et à preter allegeance à Rhaenyra. A la vue des sept dragons des Noirs, Aemon fuit Peyredragon. Furieux, il incendie Pointe-Vive et tous ses habitants. Rhaenyra prend alors conscience que la guère est inevitable...

programme.title: Our House
programme.desc: Fiona tries to recover the money from the sale of her house, but the notary tells her that the funds have already been transferred. Toby debarque chez elle et semble très presse de retrouver Bram.

programme.title: Our House

programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. / When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper go in search of the plant they believe will cure her. Meanwhile, Pixie wonders if she can be cured! / Leroy doit apprendre à lâcher prise lorsque son amie chenille se transforme en papillon. / Lorsque Pixie perd son etincelle, Kelp et Juniper partent à la recherche de la plante qui, selon eux, la guerira. Pendant ce temps, Pixie se demande si elle peut etre guerie !

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.sub-title: The Dolls House / La Maison de poupees
programme.desc: Without listening to Tom's advice, Arrietty brings a bath bomb home, unintentionally causing a foam accident... which spreads into the Atrium! The atmosphere being unbreathable, the Clocks must temporarily settle in with the Davenports, in the dolls' house in the storage room. But now Marie decides to give the doll's house to her little neighbor. What will become of the Davenports? Arrietty tries to save the day, but to do so she will need Tom's help. / Sans ecouter les conseils de Tom, Arrietty rapporte une bombe de bain chez elle, causant involontairement un accident de mousse… qui se repand jusque dans l’Atrium ! L’atmosphère etant irrespirable, les Clock doivent s’installer temporairement chez les Davenport, dans la maison de poupees du debarras. Mais voilà que Marie decide de donner la maison de poupees à sa petite voisine. Que vont devenir les Davenport ? Arrietty tente de sauver la situation, mais pour cela, elle aura besoin de l’aide de Tom.

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs
programme.desc: In Olowi, the Thieves must remain hidden because that day the Zumains are even more monstrous than usual... This is what is said among the Thieves. Of course, Arrietty would like to compare her community's beliefs about this special day with what she knows about her friend Tom, in whom she trusts. But when Tom, disguised as Frankenstein, has fun scaring Arrietty, the Thief's certainties waver... Fortunately, her friendship for Tom is stronger. She will understand the meaning of the festival that the Zumains call “Halloween”… but her absence will worry her entire community, who believe she is in danger. / A Olowi, les Chapardeurs doivent rester caches car ce jour-là les Zumains sont encore plus monstrueux que d’habitude… C’est ce qui se raconte chez les Chapardeurs. Bien sûr, Arrietty voudrait confronter les croyances de sa communaute sur ce jour special avec ce qu’elle connaît de son ami Tom, en qui elle a toute confiance. Mais quand Tom, deguise en Frankenstein, s’amuse à faire peur à Arrietty, les certitudes de la Chapardeuse vacillent… Heureusement, son amitie pour Tom est plus forte. Elle va comprendre le sens de la fete que les Zumains nomment « Halloween »… mais son absence va inquieter toute sa communaute, qui la croit en danger.

programme.title: Big Blue
programme.desc: Billie Biscotti is upset because the crew has to go on a mission and no one can play pirates with her anymore. By looking for someone else to play with, Billie Biscotti will help the crew discover why the seabed is cracking. / Billie Biscotti est contrariee parce que l’equipage doit partir en mission et que personne ne peut plus jouer aux pirates avec elle. En cherchant quelqu’un d’autre avec qui jouer, Billie Biscotti permettra à l’equipage de decouvrir pourquoi le fond marin se fissure.

programme.title: Big Blue
programme.desc: Lemo accidentally sends Lettie's diary to HQ instead of his logbook, so Lemo tries to find it before it's too late, but nothing goes as planned and a solution must be found. / Lemo envoie accidentellement au QG le journal de Lettie au lieu de son carnet de bord, cest pourquoi Lemo tente de le retrouver avant quil ne soit trop tard, mais rien ne se passe comme prevu et une solution doit etre mise au point.

programme.title: Big Blue
programme.desc: When Lettie becomes frustrated with the team's work ethic, she decides she would be better off doing everything herself, but soon she realizes that doing everything alone is too difficult and intense. / Lorsque Lettie est frustree par lethique de travail de lequipe, elle decide quelle ferait mieux de tout faire elle-meme, mais très vite, elle se rend compte que tout faire tout seul pour saverer trop difficile et intense.

programme.title: Abominable et la cite invisible
programme.sub-title: Lili, la plus grande fan de Yi
programme.desc: While Everest goes through the typical stages of an adolescent crisis (not wanting to brush his teeth or clean his room...), the arrival of Lili, an adorable little nine-year-old girl totally obsessed with Yi, Everest and the activities of the Brigade, offers a welcome distraction. / Alors quEverest traverse les etapes typiques dune crise dadolescence (ne pas vouloir se brosser les dents ou ranger sa chambre...), larrivee de Lili, une adorable petite fille de neuf ans totalement obsedee par Yi, Everest et les activites de la Brigade, offre une distraction bienvenue.

programme.title: Abominable et la cite invisible
programme.desc: Superstar mania sets in when the famous creature Qilin, bringer of prosperity, appears in front of Yi's building. Trying to protect Qilin from the crowds of people hoping for their wishes to be granted, the team is distraught when they lose track of the creature. Their dismay increases when they discover that this "Qilin" is not at all a mythical creature of good omen, but an evil robot sent by a mysterious character. / La manie de la superstar sinstalle lorsque la celèbre creature Qilin, porteuse de prosperite, apparaît devant limmeuble de Yi. En essayant de proteger Qilin de la foule de gens qui espèrent que leurs vœux seront exauces, lequipe est desemparee lorsquelle perd la trace de la creature. Leur desarroi saccroît lorsquils decouvrent que ce "Qilin" nest pas du tout une creature mythique de bon augure, mais un robot malfaisant envoye par un mysterieux personnage.

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Loud

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Mouche

programme.desc: Magnum seeks to exonerate a man accused of murder, but wakes up one morning in the heart of the 1930s, while Rick and Higgins, in the present, are worried about his behavior... / Magnum cherche à innocenter un homme accuse de meurtre, mais se reveille un beau matin en plein coeur des annees 30, tandis que Rick et Higgins, dans le present, sinquiètent de son comportement...

programme.title: Magnum
